ex.cn: 新兵早早地就到了，都穿得整整齐齐，盼着出发。

ex.en: She is raring to get back to work after her operation.
ex.cn: 动完了手术，她渴望回到工作岗位上去。

senses.def: a person or thing that is unusual and is therefore often valuable or interesting

ex.en: Women are still something of a rarity in senior positions in business.
ex.cn: 在商界位居高职的女性仍然十分罕见。

ex.en: His collection of plants contains many rarities.
ex.cn: 他收藏的植物包括许多稀有品种。

senses.def: the quality of being rare

ex.en: The value of antiques will depend on their condition and rarity.
ex.cn: 古董的价值依它们的保存状况和稀有程度而定。

senses.def: a person, especially a child or man, who shows a lack of respect for other people and enjoys playing tricks on them

ex.en: Come here, you little rascal!
ex.cn: 过来，你这个小坏蛋！

senses.def: a dishonest man
an area of red spots on a person's skin, caused by an illness or a reaction to sth

ex.en: I woke up covered in a rash.
ex.cn: 我醒来时长了一身皮疹。

ex.en: I come out in a rash (= a rash appears on my skin) if I eat chocolate.
ex.cn: 我一吃巧克力就长皮疹。

ex.en: The sun brought her out in (= caused) an itchy rash.
ex.cn: 太阳晒了她一身痱子，很痒。

ex.en: a heat rash (= caused by heat)
ex.cn: 痱子

senses.def: a lot of sth; a series of unpleasant things that happen over a short period of time
senses.chn: 大量；许多；（涌现的）众多令人不快的事物

ex.en: a rash of movies about life in prison
ex.cn: 大量关于监狱生活的电影

ex.en: There has been a rash of burglaries in the area over the last month.
ex.cn: 近一个月这一带发生了很多起入室行窃案。

senses.def: doing sth that may not be sensible without first thinking about the possible results; done in this way

ex.en: a rash young man
ex.cn: 鲁莽的年轻人

ex.en: It would be rash to assume that everyone will agree with you on this.
ex.cn: 你要是认为在这件事上谁都会同意你的看法，那就太欠考虑了。

ex.en: Think twice before doing anything rash.
ex.cn: 不要草率行事，要三思而行。

ex.en: This is what happens when you make rash decisions.
ex.cn: 这就是你贸然作决定的后果。

senses.def: a thin slice of bacon (= meat from the back or sides of a pig)
a rough unpleasant sound
a metal tool with a long blade covered with rows of sharp points, used for making rough surfaces smooth
to say sth in a rough unpleasant voice

ex.en: 'Where have you been?' she rasped.
ex.cn: “你去哪儿啦？” 她尖声问道。

ex.en: He rasped out some instructions.
ex.cn: 他粗声粗气地发出指令。

senses.def: to make a rough unpleasant sound
senses.chn: 发出刺耳的声音；发出刮擦声

ex.en: a rasping cough/voice
ex.cn: 刺耳的咳嗽声／嗓音

senses.def: to rub a surface with a rasp or with sth rough that works or feels like a rasp
senses.chn: 用锉刀锉；用粗糙的东西磨擦

ex.en: The wind rasped his face.
ex.cn: 寒风刺疼了他的脸。

senses.def: a small dark red soft fruit that grows on bushes

ex.en: raspberry jam
ex.cn: 山莓酱

senses.def: a rude sound made by sticking out the tongue and blowing
senses.chn: （将舌头伸出并吹气而发出的粗鲁的声音）呸声，嘘声

ex.en: to blow a raspberry at sb
ex.cn: 对某人发出嘘声

senses.def: having a rough sound, as if the person has a sore throat

a member of a Jamaican religious group which worships the former Emperor of Ethiopia, Haile Selassie, and which believes that black people will one day return to Africa. Rastafarians often wear dreadlocks and have other distinguishing patterns of behaviour and dress.
senses.chn: 拉斯塔法里教徒（牙买加一教派成员。崇拜前埃塞俄比亚皇帝海尔 · 塞拉西，并认为黑人将返回非洲大陆）

senses.def: to change text or images into a form in which they can be displayed on a screen or printed
senses.chn: 将（文字或图像）光栅化；使栅格化

senses.def: a small animal with a long tail, that looks like a large mouse, usually considered a pest (= an animal which is disliked because it destroys food or spreads disease)

ex.en: rat poison
ex.cn: 老鼠药

senses.def: an unpleasant person, especially one who is not loyal or who tricks sb
senses.chn: 讨厌的人；卑鄙的小人；骗子

senses.def: used to talk about people who leave an organization, a company, etc. that is having difficulties, without caring about the people who are left
senses.chn: （比喻只顾自己而离开处于困境中的机构等）（像）逃离沉船（的老鼠）

senses.def: to suspect that sth is wrong about a situation
senses.chn: 怀疑事情不妙；感觉情况不对

senses.def: to tell sb in authority about sth wrong that sb else has done

ex.en: Where I come from, you don't rat on your friends.
ex.cn: 在我的老家，谁都不出卖朋友。

senses.def: to not do sth that you have agreed or promised to do

ex.en: The government is accused of ratting on its promises to the unemployed.
ex.cn: 政府被指责对失业者背信弃义。

senses.def: extremely drunk
a dish of onions, peppers, aubergines/ eggplants, courgettes/ zucchini and tomatoes cooked together
senses.chn: 蔬菜杂烩，炖焖蔬菜（用洋葱、辣椒、茄子、小胡瓜以及番茄一同烹制）

senses.def: an unpleasant or disgusting person
senses.chn: 讨厌的人；令人厌烦的人

senses.def: a wheel or bar with teeth along the edge and a metal piece that fits between the teeth, allowing movement in one direction only
to increase, or make sth increase, repeatedly and by small amounts

ex.en: Overuse of credit cards has ratcheted up consumer debt to unacceptable levels.
ex.cn: 滥用信用卡使消费债务逐渐增加到了难以接受的地步。

senses.def: a measurement of the speed at which sth happens

ex.en: Most people walk at an average rate of 5 kilometres an hour.
ex.cn: 大多数人步行的平均速度为每小时 5 公里。

ex.en: The number of reported crimes is increasing at an alarming rate.
ex.cn: 报警案件的数量正在以惊人的速度增长。

ex.en: Figures published today show another fall in the rate of inflation.
ex.cn: 今天公布的数字表明通货膨胀速度又一次下降。

ex.en: At the rate you work, you'll never finish!
ex.cn: 以你工作的速度，你永远也做不完！

senses.def: a measurement of the number of times sth happens or exists during a particular period

ex.en: Local businesses are closing at a/the rate of three a year.
ex.cn: 地方企业正在以每年三家的速度关闭。

ex.en: a high/low/rising rate of unemployment
ex.cn: 高／低／不断增长的失业率

ex.en: the annual crime/divorce rate
ex.cn: 年犯罪／离婚率

ex.en: His pulse rate dropped suddenly.
ex.cn: 他的脉搏速率突然下降。

ex.en: a high success/failure rate
ex.cn: 很高的成功／失败率

senses.def: a fixed amount of money that is charged or paid for sth

ex.en: advertising/insurance/postal, etc. rates
ex.cn: 广告费、保险费、邮费等

ex.en: a low/high hourly rate of pay
ex.cn: 按小时支付的低／高报酬

ex.en: We offer special reduced rates for students.
ex.cn: 我们对学生有特惠价格。

ex.en: a fixed-rate mortgage (= one in which the amount of money paid back each month is fixed for a particular period)
ex.cn: 定额偿还按揭贷款

ex.en: the basic rate of tax (= the lowest amount that is paid by everyone)
ex.cn: 基本税额

ex.en: exchange/interest rates
ex.cn: 汇率；利率

senses.def: (in Britain) a tax paid by businesses to a local authority for land and buildings that they use and in the past also paid by anyone who owned a house
senses.chn: （英国地方政府征收的）房地产税，房产税

ex.en: income tax
ex.cn: 所得税

ex.en: tax cuts
ex.cn: 减税

ex.en: The company has to pay customs duties on all imports.
ex.cn: 该公司须为所有进口货物缴纳关税。

ex.en: A general tariff was imposed on foreign imports.
ex.cn: 国外进口货物当时按普通税率征税。

ex.en: Business rates are very high in the city centre.
ex.cn: 市中心的商业房产税非常高。

senses.def: used to say that a particular fact is true despite what has happened in the past or what may happen in the future
senses.chn: （强调事情的真实性）无论如何，不管怎样

ex.en: Well, that's one good piece of news at any rate.
ex.cn: 不管怎么说，那是个好消息。

ex.en: I may be away on business next week but at any rate I'll be back by Friday.
ex.cn: 我下周可能要出差，但无论如何，我最晚星期五回来。

senses.def: used to show that you are being more accurate about sth that you have just said
senses.chn: （表示说得更加确切）不管怎样，至少

ex.en: He said he'll be coming tomorrow. At any rate, I think that's what he said.
ex.cn: 他说他明天要来。至少，我认为他是这么说的。

senses.def: used to show that what you have just said is not as important as what you are going to say

ex.en: There were maybe 60 or 70 people there. At any rate, the room was packed.
ex.cn: 那里也许有六七十人吧。反正屋子里挤得严严实实。

senses.def: very quickly
used to say what will happen if a particular situation continues to develop in the same way

ex.en: At this rate, we'll soon be bankrupt.
ex.cn: 照此情形，我们很快就会破产。

senses.def: the usual amount of money paid for goods or services at a particular time
senses.chn: 现行价格；现行收费标准；现行酬金标准

ex.en: They pay slightly more than the going rate.
ex.cn: 他们支付的酬金略高于现行标准。

senses.def: to have or think that sb/sth has a particular level of quality, value, etc.

ex.en: The university is highly rated for its research.
ex.cn: 这所大学因其研究工作而受到高度评价。

ex.en: They rated him highly as a colleague.
ex.cn: 作为同事，他们对他评价甚高。

ex.en: Voters continue to rate education high on their list of priorities.
ex.cn: 选民继续把教育看作是头等重要的大事。

ex.en: The show was rated (as) a success by critics and audiences.
ex.cn: 评论家和观众都认为这次演出是成功的。

ex.en: The match rated as one of their worst defeats.
ex.cn: 这次比赛可以说是他们最为惨重的一次失败。

ex.en: I'm afraid our needs do not rate very high with this administration.
ex.cn: 我们的需求恐怕不会受到这届政府多大重视。

senses.def: to think that sb/sth is good

ex.en: What did you think of the movie? I didn't rate it myself.
ex.cn: 你觉得这部电影怎么样？我个人认为不怎么样。

senses.def: to place sb/sth in a particular position on a scale in relation to similar people or things

ex.en: The schools were rated according to their exam results.
ex.cn: 这些学校是按考试成绩排名次的。

ex.en: a top-rated programme
ex.cn: 一级项目

ex.en: She is currently rated number two in the world.
ex.cn: 她目前排名世界第二。

senses.def: to be good, important, etc. enough to be treated in a particular way

ex.en: The incident didn't even rate a mention in the press.
ex.cn: 这件事在报纸上连提都不值得一提。

senses.def: to state that a film/movie or video is suitable for a particular audience
(in the US) a limit placed on the amount of interest banks, etc. may charge
(in Britain in the past) a person who paid taxes to the local authority on the buildings and land they owned
used to mean 'fairly' or 'to some degree', often when you are expressing slight criticism, disappointment or surprise
senses.chn: （常用于表示轻微的批评、失望或惊讶）相当，在某种程度上

ex.en: The instructions were rather complicated.
ex.cn: 这些说明相当复杂。

ex.en: She fell and hurt her leg rather badly.
ex.cn: 她跌倒了，腿伤得相当重。

ex.en: I didn't fail the exam; in fact I did rather well!
ex.cn: 我没有考不及格，事实上，我考得不错！

ex.en: It was a rather difficult question.
ex.cn: 这是个相当难的问题。

ex.en: It was rather a difficult question.
ex.cn: 这真是个难题。

ex.en: He looks rather like his father.
ex.cn: 他看上去很像他的父亲。

senses.def: used with a verb to make a statement sound less strong
senses.chn: （与动词连用以减弱语气）有点儿，稍微

ex.en: I rather suspect we're making a mistake.
ex.cn: 我有点儿怀疑我们正在犯错误。

ex.en: We were rather hoping you'd be able to do it by Friday.
ex.cn: 我们希望你最好能在星期五之前做这件事。

senses.def: used to correct sth you have said, or to give more accurate information
senses.chn: （纠正所说的话或提供更确切的信息）更确切地讲，更准确地说

ex.en: She worked as a secretary, or rather, a personal assistant.
ex.cn: 她当了秘书；确切地讲，是私人助理。

ex.en: In the end he had to walk—or rather run—to the office.
ex.cn: 最后他不得不走着，应该说是跑着，去办公室。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, i.e. they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，即是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, that is to say, they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，就是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Mnemonic poems, that is poems designed to help you remember something, are an excellent way to learn lists.
ex.cn: 记事诗，即帮助人记起事情的诗歌，是记住一系列事物的极佳方式。

ex.en: A limerick's rhyme scheme is A–A–B–B–A. In other words, the first, second, and fifth lines all rhyme with one another, while the third and fourth lines have their own rhyme.
ex.cn: 五行打油诗的韵律是 A-A-B-B-A。就是说，第一行、第二行和第五行押一个韵，而第三行和第四行押另一个韵。

senses.def: used to introduce an idea that is different or opposite to the idea that you have stated previously
senses.chn: （提出不同或相反的观点）相反，反而，而是

ex.en: The walls were not white, but rather a sort of dirty grey.
ex.cn: 墙面不是白的，而是灰不溜秋的。

senses.def: used for saying that you would not like to do sth that another person is going to do
senses.chn: （表明不想做别人要去做的事）

ex.en: 'I'm going climbing tomorrow.' 'Rather you than me!'
ex.cn: “我明天去爬山。” “你去吧，我可不去！”

senses.def: instead of sb/sth

ex.en: I think I'll have a cold drink rather than coffee.
ex.cn: 我想要冷饮，不要咖啡。

ex.en: Why didn't you ask for help, rather than trying to do it on your own?
ex.cn: 你干吗非得自己干，而不请人帮忙？

senses.def: would prefer to

ex.en: She'd rather die than give a speech.
ex.cn: 她宁愿死也不愿意演讲。

ex.en: 'Do you want to come with us?' 'No, I'd rather not.'
ex.cn: “你想跟我们一起来吗？” “不，我不想去。”

ex.en: Would you rather walk or take the bus?
ex.cn: 你比较喜欢步行还是坐公共汽车？

ex.en: 'Do you mind if I smoke?' 'Well, I'd rather you didn't.'
ex.cn: “你介意我抽烟吗？” “嗯，最好别抽。”

ex.en: I like the red one better than/more than the green one.
ex.cn: 比起那个绿色的，我更喜欢红的。

ex.en: I prefer beef to lamb.
ex.cn: 我喜欢牛肉胜于羊肉。

senses.def: used to agree with sb's suggestion

ex.en: 'How about a trip to the beach?' 'Rather!'
ex.cn: “去海边旅游怎么样？” “太好了！”

senses.def: instead of sb/sth

ex.en: I think I'll have a cold drink rather than coffee.
ex.cn: 我想要冷饮，不要咖啡。

ex.en: Why didn't you ask for help, rather than trying to do it on your own?
ex.cn: 你干吗非得自己干，而不请人帮忙？

senses.def: to make an agreement officially valid by voting for or signing it

ex.en: The treaty was ratified by all the member states.
ex.cn: 这个条约得到了所有成员国的批准。

senses.def: a measurement of how good, popular, important, etc. sb/sth is, especially in relation to other people or things

ex.en: The poll gave a popular approval rating of 39% for the President.
ex.cn: 民意调查表明民众对总统的支持率为 39%。

ex.en: Education has been given a high-priority rating by the new administration.
ex.cn: 新一届政府将教育放在了高度优先的地位。

senses.def: a set of figures that show how many people watch or listen to a particular television or radio programme, used to show how popular a programme is

ex.en: The show has gone up in the ratings.
ex.cn: 这个节目的收视率上升了。

senses.def: a number or letter that shows which groups of people a particular film/movie is suitable for
senses.chn: 表示电影分级的数字（或字母）；电影的等级

ex.en: The film was given a 15 rating by British censors.
ex.cn: 英国审查员将这部电影定为 15 岁以上级。

ex.en: The movie carries an R rating.
ex.cn: 这部电影带有限制级 R 的标志。

senses.def: a sailor in the navy who is not an officer
the relationship between two groups of people or things that is represented by two numbers showing how much larger one group is than the other

ex.en: What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
ex.cn: 这个部门的男女比例是多少？

ex.en: The school has a very high teacher-student ratio.
ex.cn: 这所学校的师生比例很高。

ex.en: The ratio of applications to available places currently stands at 100:1.
ex.cn: 目前，申请人数和录取名额的比例为 100:1。

senses.def: the process of thinking or arguing about sth in a logical way
a fixed amount of food, fuel, etc. that you are officially allowed to have when there is not enough for everyone to have as much as they want, for example during a war
senses.chn: （食品、燃料等短缺时的）配给量，定量

ex.en: the weekly butter ration
ex.cn: 每周的黄油配给量

senses.def: a fixed amount of food given regularly to a soldier or to sb who is in a place where there is not much food available
senses.chn: （给战士或食品短缺地区的人提供的）定量口粮

ex.en: We're on short rations (= allowed less than usual) until fresh supplies arrive.
ex.cn: 在新的补给到达之前，我们的口粮定量不足。

ex.en: Once these latest rations run out, the country will again face hunger and starvation.
ex.cn: 最后这批口粮一旦用完，国家又要面临饥荒。

senses.def: an amount of sth that is thought to be normal or fair

ex.en: As part of the diet, allow yourself a small daily ration of sugar.
ex.cn: 作为饮食的一部分，每天可以摄入少量的糖。

ex.en: I've had my ration of problems for one day—you deal with it!
ex.cn: 我手头的问题已经够我忙活一天的了，你来处理这件事吧！

senses.def: to limit the amount of sth that sb is allowed to have, especially because there is not enough of it available
senses.chn: 限定…的量；定量供应；配给

ex.en: Eggs were rationed during the war.
ex.cn: 战争期间，鸡蛋限量供应。

ex.en: The villagers are rationed to two litres of water a day.
ex.cn: 村民每天的用水量限定为两升。

senses.def: based on reason rather than emotions

ex.en: a rational argument/choice/decision
ex.cn: 合理的论点／选择／决定

ex.en: rational analysis/thought
ex.cn: 有道理的分析／思考

ex.en: There is no rational explanation for his actions.
ex.cn: 对他的所作所为无法作出合理的解释。

senses.def: able to think clearly and make decisions based on reason rather than emotions

ex.en: No rational person would ever behave like that.
ex.cn: 头脑清醒的人都不会这样做。

senses.def: the principles or reasons which explain a particular decision, course of action, belief, etc.

ex.en: What is the rationale behind these new exams?
ex.cn: 这些新考试的理论依据是什么？

senses.def: the belief that all behaviour, opinions, etc. should be based on reason rather than on emotions or religious beliefs
a person who believes in rationalism
to find or try to find a logical reason to explain why sb thinks, behaves, etc. in a way that is difficult to understand
senses.chn: 对…进行理性的解释；对…加以科学的说明

ex.en: an attempt to rationalize his violent behaviour
ex.cn: 对他的暴力行为作出合理解释的尝试

senses.def: to make changes to a business, system, etc. in order to make it more efficient, especially by spending less money
senses.chn: 使合理化；进行合理化改革；使有经济效益

ex.en: Twenty workers lost their jobs when the department was rationalized.
ex.cn: 在部门的合理化改革中，有二十名工人失业。

ex.en: The President has promised to cut taxes significantly.
ex.cn: 总统承诺大幅度减税。

ex.en: Buyers will bargain hard to cut the cost of the house they want.
ex.cn: 买主会竭力讨价还价以压低他们想买的房子的价格。

ex.en: His salary has been cut by ten per cent.
ex.cn: 他的薪金减少了百分之十。

ex.en: Could you cut your essay from 5 000 to 3 000 words?
ex.cn: 请把你的文章从 5 000 字删减至 3 000 字好吗？

ex.en: The workforce has been slashed by half.
ex.cn: 职工人数裁减了一半。

senses.def: a number that can be expressed as the ratio of two whole numbers
the policy of limiting the amount of food, fuel, etc. that people are allowed to have when there is not enough for everyone to have as much as they want
to tell sb in authority about sth wrong that sb else has done

ex.en: Where I come from, you don't rat on your friends.
ex.cn: 在我的老家，谁都不出卖朋友。

senses.def: to not do sth that you have agreed or promised to do

ex.en: The government is accused of ratting on its promises to the unemployed.
ex.cn: 政府被指责对失业者背信弃义。

senses.def: journalists and photographers who follow famous people around in a way which makes their lives unpleasant

senses.chn: 表示对某人感兴趣；表示愿意提供援助

ex.en: The church needs to find new ways of reaching out to young people.
ex.cn: 教会需要寻找新途径来为年轻人提供帮助。

senses.def: to let sb/yourself find out about sth again or get used to sth again

ex.en: I'll need to reacquaint myself with this program—it's a long time since I've used it.
ex.cn: 我得再熟悉一下这个程序，我已经很长时间没用了。

senses.def: to change or behave in a particular way as a result of or in response to sth
senses.chn: 起反应；（对…）作出反应；回应

ex.en: Local residents have reacted angrily to the news.
ex.cn: 当地居民对这一消息表示愤怒。

ex.en: I nudged her but she didn't react.
ex.cn: 我用胳膊肘捅了她一下，可她没有反应。

ex.en: You never know how he is going to react.
ex.cn: 你根本不知道他会作何反应。

ex.en: The market reacted by falling a further two points.
ex.cn: 股市的反应是再下跌两个百分点。

senses.def: to become ill/sick after eating, breathing, etc. a particular substance

ex.en: People can react badly to certain food additives.
ex.cn: 人们对某些食品添加剂可能会严重过敏。

senses.def: to experience a chemical change when coming into contact with another substance
senses.chn: 起化学反应；发生化学变化

ex.en: Iron reacts with water and air to produce rust.
ex.cn: 铁和水及空气发生反应产生铁锈。

senses.def: to show dislike or opposition in response to sth, especially by deliberately doing the opposite of what sb wants you to do

ex.en: He reacted strongly against the artistic conventions of his time.
ex.cn: 他强烈反对当时的艺术俗套。

senses.def: the opposition of a piece of electrical equipment, etc. to the flow of an alternating current
a substance that takes part in and is changed by a chemical reaction
what you do, say or think as a result of sth that has happened

ex.en: What was his reaction to the news?
ex.cn: 他对这消息有何反应？

ex.en: My immediate reaction was one of shock.
ex.cn: 我当即的反应是大吃一惊。

ex.en: A spokesman said the changes were not in reaction to the company's recent losses.
ex.cn: 一位发言人说，这些变动不是针对公司最近的亏损而作出的反应。

ex.en: There has been a mixed reaction to her appointment as director.
ex.cn: 对她获任命为主管一事，人们的反应各不相同。

ex.en: The decision provoked an angry reaction from local residents.
ex.cn: 这个决定引起了当地居民的愤怒抗议。

ex.en: I tried shaking him but there was no reaction.
ex.cn: 我试着摇了摇他，但他一动不动。

senses.def: a change in people's attitudes or behaviour caused by disapproval of the attitudes, etc. of the past

ex.en: The return to traditional family values is a reaction against the permissiveness of recent decades.
ex.cn: 传统家庭价值观的回归是对近几十年来放纵自由的一种反动。

senses.def: a response by the body, usually a bad one, to a drug, chemical substance, etc.

ex.en: to have an allergic reaction to a drug
ex.cn: 对某药物有过敏反应

senses.def: the ability to move quickly in response to sth, especially if in danger

ex.en: a skilled driver with quick reactions
ex.cn: 反应敏捷的熟练司机

senses.def: a chemical change produced by two or more substances acting on each other

ex.en: a chemical/nuclear reaction
ex.cn: 化学／核反应

senses.def: a force shown by sth in response to another force, which is of equal strength and acts in the opposite direction
opposition to social or political progress or change

ex.en: The forces of reaction made change difficult.
ex.cn: 反动势力使得改革举步维艰。

senses.def: a person who is opposed to political or social change
senses.chn: 反动分子；反对政治（或社会）变革者

senses.def: to make sth start working or happening again after a period of time
senses.chn: 使恢复活动；使重新出现

senses.def: showing a reaction or response
senses.chn: 反应的；有反应的；回应的

ex.en: The police presented a reactive rather than preventive strategy against crime.
ex.cn: 警方对付犯罪的办法，不是事先加以防范，而是事后作出反应。

senses.def: tending to show chemical change when mixed with another substance
senses.chn: 能起化学反应的；易反应的

ex.en: highly reactive substances
ex.cn: 很容易起反应的物质

senses.def: the degree to which sth reacts, or is likely to react

ex.en: Oxygen has high reactivity.
ex.cn: 氧的反应性很高。

senses.def: a large structure used for the controlled production of nuclear energy
to look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols

ex.en: She's still learning to read.
ex.cn: 她还在学习识字。

ex.en: Some children can read and write before they go to school.
ex.cn: 有些孩子在上学前就会看书写字了。

ex.en: I can't read your writing.
ex.cn: 我看不懂你的笔迹。

ex.en: Can you read music?
ex.cn: 你识谱吗？

ex.en: I'm trying to read the map.
ex.cn: 我正看地图呢。

senses.def: to go through written or printed words, etc. in silence or speaking them to other people

ex.en: I'm going to go to bed and read.
ex.cn: 我要上床看书去。

ex.en: He liked reading to his grandchildren.
ex.cn: 他喜欢念书给孙子孙女听。

ex.en: to read a book/a magazine/the newspaper
ex.cn: 读书；看杂志；看报纸

ex.en: Have you read any Steinbeck (= novels by him)?
ex.cn: 你读过斯坦贝克的小说吗？

ex.en: He read the poem aloud.
ex.cn: 他朗读了这首诗。

ex.en: Go on—read it to us.
ex.cn: 念吧，念给我们听听。

senses.def: to discover or find out about sb/sth by reading

ex.en: I read about the accident in the local paper.
ex.cn: 我在当地的报纸上看到了这次事故。

ex.en: I read that he had resigned.
ex.cn: 我看到了他辞职的消息。

ex.en: Don't believe everything you read in the papers.
ex.cn: 报上看到的东西，不能尽信。

senses.def: to guess what sb else is thinking
to look at the movements of sb's lips to learn what they are saying
to understand sth in a particular way

ex.en: How do you read the present situation?
ex.cn: 你对目前的形势有何看法？

ex.en: Silence must not always be read as consent.
ex.cn: 不能总是将沉默理解为同意。

senses.def: to have sth written on it; to be written in a particular way

ex.en: The sign read 'No admittance'.
ex.cn: 告示牌上写着 “禁止入内”。

ex.en: I've changed the last paragraph. It now reads as follows…
ex.cn: 我已经修改了最后一段。现在是这样写的…

senses.def: to give a particular impression when read
senses.chn: 读起来（给人以某种印象）

ex.en: Generally, the article reads very well.
ex.cn: 总的来说，这篇文章读起来很不错。

ex.en: The poem reads like (= sounds as if it is) a translation.
ex.cn: 这首诗读起来像是译文。

senses.def: to show a particular weight, pressure, etc.

ex.en: What does the thermometer read?
ex.cn: 温度计的读数是多少？

senses.def: to get information from a measuring instrument

ex.en: A man came to read the gas meter.
ex.cn: 一个男子来查了煤气表。

senses.def: to hear and understand sb speaking on a radio set
senses.chn: 听到，听明白（用无线电机讲的话）

ex.en: 'Do you read me?' 'I'm reading you loud and clear.'
ex.cn: “你听得见我的话吗？” “听见了，你的声音又大又清楚。”

senses.def: to replace one word, etc. with another when correcting a text

ex.en: For 'madam' in line 3 read 'madman'.
ex.cn: 第 3 行中的 madam 应为 madman。

senses.def: to study a subject, especially at a university

ex.en: I read English at Oxford.
ex.cn: 我在牛津攻读英语。

ex.en: She's reading for a law degree.
ex.cn: 她在攻读法学学位。

senses.def: to take information from a disk

ex.en: My computer can't read the CD-ROM you sent.
ex.cn: 我的电脑不能读你送来的光盘。

ex.en: to read a file into a computer
ex.cn: 把文件读入电脑

senses.def: to look for or discover a meaning in sth that is not openly stated
senses.chn: 领悟隐含的意义；看出言外之意

ex.en: Reading between the lines, I think Clare needs money.
ex.cn: 斟酌一下她的言外之意，我觉得克莱尔需要钱。

senses.def: to understand easily what sb is thinking or feeling
senses.chn: 轻易地了解某人的想法（或感受）；看透某人

senses.def: used to tell sb to listen carefully to what you are saying

ex.en: Read my lips: no new taxes (= I promise there will be no new taxes).
ex.cn: 注意听我说：不会征新税。

senses.def: to tell sb with force that they must not do sth
to accept sth without discussing it
senses.chn: 直接认定为；不经讨论即认可

ex.en: Can we take it as read that you want the job?
ex.cn: 我们能不能认为你想要这份工作？

senses.def: to read a message, etc. to others in order to check that it is correct
to think that sth means more than it really does
senses.chn: 把本没有的意思加进去解释；对…作过多的理解

ex.en: Don't read too much into what she says.
ex.cn: 不要在她的话里加进太多自己的理解。

senses.def: to continue reading

ex.en: That's the story so far. Now read on…
ex.cn: 故事就讲到这里。现在接着读…

senses.def: to read sth using your voice, especially to other people
to read sth carefully from beginning to end to look for mistakes or check details
to read a lot about a subject
senses.chn: （就某课题）广泛阅读，博览群书

ex.en: I'll need to read up on the case before the meeting.
ex.cn: 在开会前，我需要看一些有关这件事的材料。

senses.def: an act or a period of reading sth

ex.en: I was having a quiet read when the phone rang.
ex.cn: 我在静静地看书，忽然电话铃响了。

senses.def: a book, an article, etc. that is good, etc.
senses.chn: 好的（或有意思等的）读物；好书（或文章等）

ex.en: His thrillers are always a gripping read.
ex.cn: 他的惊险小说向来引人入胜。

senses.def: having knowledge that has been gained from reading books, etc.

ex.en: She's very widely read in law.
ex.cn: 她在法律方面知识渊博。

senses.def: that is easy, interesting and enjoyable to read
senses.chn: 可读性强的；通俗易懂的

senses.def: clear and easy to read
senses.chn: 清晰可辨的；易于识读的

senses.def: to look for or discover a meaning in sth that is not openly stated
senses.chn: 领悟隐含的意义；看出言外之意

ex.en: Reading between the lines, I think Clare needs money.
ex.cn: 斟酌一下她的言外之意，我觉得克莱尔需要钱。

senses.def: to change the address written on an envelope because the person the letter is for does not live at the address it has been delivered to
a person who reads, especially one who reads a lot or in a particular way
senses.chn: 读者；读书…的人；阅读量大的人

ex.en: an avid reader of science fiction
ex.cn: 科幻小说迷

ex.en: a fast/slow reader
ex.cn: 读书快／慢的人

ex.en: The reader is left to draw his or her own conclusions.
ex.cn: 读者需要自己去得出结论。

senses.def: a person who reads a particular newspaper, magazine, etc.

ex.en: readers' letters
ex.cn: 读者来信

ex.en: Are you a 'Times' reader?
ex.cn: 你是《泰晤士报》的读者吗？

senses.def: an easy book that is intended to help people learn to read their own or a foreign language

ex.en: a series of graded English readers
ex.cn: 一系列分级英语读物

senses.def: a senior teacher at a British university just below the rank of a professor
senses.chn: 准教授（英国大学教师，仅次于教授）

ex.en: She is Reader in Music at Edinburgh.
ex.cn: 她是爱丁堡大学的音乐准教授。

senses.def: an electronic device that reads data stored in one form and changes it into another form so that a computer can perform operations on it
senses.chn: 电子阅读器；电子识读机

senses.def: a machine that produces on a screen a large image of a text stored on a microfiche or microfilm
the number or type of people who read a particular newspaper, magazine, etc.

ex.en: a readership of around 10 000
ex.cn: 1 万左右的读者人数

ex.en: In its new format, the magazine hopes to attract a much wider readership.
ex.cn: 这份杂志希望以新的版式吸引更多的读者。

senses.def: the position of a Reader at a university
quickly and without difficulty
senses.chn: 快捷地；轻而易举地；便利地

ex.en: All ingredients are readily available from your local store.
ex.cn: 所有的原料都可以方便地从你当地的商店买到。

senses.def: in a way that shows you do not object to sth

ex.en: Most people readily accept the need for laws.
ex.cn: 大多数人都毫不迟疑地认为法律是必要的。

senses.def: the entry of data into a computer or onto a disk
an organized event when people come to a place to read books together
the state of being ready or prepared for sth

ex.en: Everyone has doubts about their readiness for parenthood.
ex.cn: 对于自己是否准备好了为人父母，人人都会感到疑虑。

senses.def: the state of being willing to do sth

ex.en: Over half the people interviewed expressed their readiness to die for their country.
ex.cn: 半数以上受访者表示愿意为国献身。

senses.def: the activity of sb who reads

ex.en: My hobbies include reading and painting.
ex.cn: 我的业余爱好包括读书和绘画。

ex.en: He needs more help with his reading.
ex.cn: 他在阅读方面需要更多的帮助。

ex.en: Are you any good at map reading?
ex.cn: 你会看地图吗？

ex.en: reading glasses (= worn when reading)
ex.cn: 读书用的眼镜

ex.en: a reading lamp/light (= one that can be moved to shine light onto sth that you are reading)
ex.cn: 供阅读用的灯

senses.def: an act of reading sth

ex.en: A closer (= more detailed) reading of the text reveals just how desperate he was feeling.
ex.cn: 细读此文就会看出他当时感到多么绝望。

senses.def: books, articles, etc. that are intended to be read

ex.en: reading matter/material
ex.cn: 阅读材料

ex.en: a series of reading books for children
ex.cn: 一套儿童读物

ex.en: a reading list (= a list of books, etc. that students are expected to read for a particular subject)
ex.cn: 阅读书目

ex.en: further reading (= at the end of a book, a list of other books that give more information about the same subject)
ex.cn: 其他阅读参考材料

ex.en: The report makes for interesting reading (= it is interesting to read)
ex.cn: 这篇报道读起来很有意思。

ex.en: The article is not exactly light reading (= it is not easy to read).
ex.cn: 这篇文章读起来并不轻松。

senses.def: the particular way in which you understand a book, situation, etc.

ex.en: a literal reading of the text
ex.cn: 对文本的字面理解

ex.en: My own reading of events is less optimistic.
ex.cn: 我本人对事态的看法不怎么乐观。

senses.def: the amount or number shown on an instrument used for measuring sth

ex.en: Meter readings are taken every three months.
ex.cn: 每三个月查一次表。

senses.def: an event at which sth is read to an audience for entertainment; a piece of literature that is read at such an event
senses.chn: 读书会；朗诵会；朗诵的作品

ex.en: a poetry reading
ex.cn: 诗歌朗诵会

ex.en: The evening ended with a reading from her latest novel.
ex.cn: 晚会最后朗诵了一段她的最新小说。

senses.def: a short section from the Bible that is read to people as part of a religious service
senses.chn: （在礼拜仪式中朗读的）《圣经》章节

ex.en: The reading today is from the Book of Daniel.
ex.cn: 今天朗读的经文选自《但以理书》。

senses.def: one of the stages during which a bill(= a proposal for a new law) must be discussed and accepted by a parliament before it can become law
senses.chn: 议案宣读（法案在成为法律前须经议会讨论通过的步骤）

senses.def: a person's ability to read, measured by comparing it with the average ability of children of a particular age
senses.chn: 阅读年龄；某一年龄段的阅读能力

ex.en: a 30-year-old man with a reading age of eight
ex.cn: 阅读能力相当于八岁儿童的 30 岁男子

senses.def: a room in a library, club, etc. where people can read or study
to get used to a changed or new situation

ex.en: Children are highly adaptable—they just need time to readjust.
ex.cn: 儿童的适应能力很强，他们只是需要时间重新适应。

ex.en: Once again he had to readjust to living alone.
ex.cn: 他又一次不得不重新适应独居生活。

senses.def: to change or move sth slightly

ex.en: She got out of the car and readjusted her dress.
ex.cn: 她下了车，稍稍整了整裙子。

senses.def: to allow sb to join a group, an organization or an institution again
senses.chn: 重新接纳；允许再次加入

senses.def: to take sb into a hospital again after they had been allowed to leave

ex.en: He was readmitted only a week after being discharged.
ex.cn: 他出院仅一个星期又再次住院。

senses.def: used to tell sb to listen carefully to what you are saying

ex.en: Read my lips: no new taxes (= I promise there will be no new taxes).
ex.cn: 注意听我说：不会征新税。

senses.def: to continue reading

ex.en: That's the story so far. Now read on…
ex.cn: 故事就讲到这里。现在接着读…

senses.def: a display of information on a computer screen
to understand easily what sb is thinking or feeling
senses.chn: 轻易地了解某人的想法（或感受）；看透某人

senses.def: to think that sth means more than it really does
senses.chn: 把本没有的意思加进去解释；对…作过多的理解

ex.en: Don't read too much into what she says.
ex.cn: 不要在她的话里加进太多自己的理解。

senses.def: an occasion when the words of a play are spoken by members of a theatre group, before they begin practising acting it
to advertise sth again, especially a job
senses.chn: 再做广告；再登（招聘）广告

senses.def: if a file, disk or memory is read-write, it allows you to make changes to data
senses.chn: （文档、磁盘或存储器）可读写的，可读取写入的

senses.def: fully prepared for what you are going to do

ex.en: Are you nearly ready?
ex.cn: 你快准备好了吗？

ex.en: 'Shall we go?' 'I'm ready when you are!'
ex.cn: “我们可以走了吗？” “我准备好了，就等你了！”

ex.en: I'm just getting the kids ready for school.
ex.cn: 我正在让孩子们准备好去上学。

ex.en: I was twenty years old and ready for anything.
ex.cn: 我当时二十岁，什么都愿意去做。

ex.en: Right, we're ready to go.
ex.cn: 对，我们准备好了，可以走了。

ex.en: Volunteers were ready and waiting to pack the food in boxes.
ex.cn: 志愿者已经准备完毕，等着将食物装箱。

senses.def: completed and available to be used

ex.en: Come on, dinner's ready!
ex.cn: 快过来，饭好了！

ex.en: The new building should be ready by 2020.
ex.cn: 这座新大楼应该能在 2020 年前交付使用。

ex.en: Can you help me get everything ready for the party?
ex.cn: 你能不能帮我把这次聚会准备妥当？

ex.en: The contract will be ready to sign in two weeks.
ex.cn: 这份合同两周后即可签字。

senses.def: available to be used easily and immediately

ex.en: All the relevant records are easily available ready to hand.
ex.cn: 所有相关记录都在手边，用起来很方便。

ex.en: a ready supply of wood
ex.cn: 现成的木材供应

ex.en: a ready source of income
ex.cn: 现成的收入来源

senses.def: willing and quick to do or give sth
senses.chn: 愿意迅速做某事（或给某物）；急于行动

ex.en: I was very angry and ready for a fight.
ex.cn: 我非常生气，想打一架。

ex.en: She's always ready with advice.
ex.cn: 她总是乐于提出建议。

ex.en: He's always ready to help his friends.
ex.cn: 他总是乐意帮助朋友。

ex.en: Don't be so ready to believe the worst about people.
ex.cn: 不要总把人往坏处想。

senses.def: likely to do sth very soon
senses.chn: 马上要，很可能即将（做某事）

ex.en: She looked ready to collapse at any minute.
ex.cn: 她看样子随时都会倒下。

senses.def: needing sth as soon as possible

ex.en: Right, I'm ready for bed.
ex.cn: 对，我现在就想睡觉。

ex.en: After the long walk, we were all ready for a drink.
ex.cn: 长途步行之后，我们都急需喝水。

senses.def: quick and clever

ex.en: She has great charm and a ready wit.
ex.cn: 她光彩照人，头脑机敏。

senses.def: to prepare

ex.en: to make ready for the President's visit
ex.cn: 为总统来访做准备

senses.def: what you say to tell people to start a race
ready to start
to prepare sb/yourself/sth for sth
senses.chn: 做好…的准备；（为…）做好准备

ex.en: Western companies were readying themselves for the challenge from Eastern markets.
ex.cn: 西方的公司正在为迎接来自东方市场的挑战做准备。

senses.def: already done

ex.en: ready-cooked meals
ex.cn: 现成的饭菜

ex.en: The concrete was ready mixed.
ex.cn: 混凝土是搅拌好的。

senses.def: money that you can use immediately
available to be used immediately

ex.en: We all had our cameras at the ready.
ex.cn: 我们都准备好了照相机。

senses.def: prepared in advance so that you can eat or use it immediately
senses.chn: 预制的；已做好的；现成的

ex.en: ready-made pastry
ex.cn: 现成的油酥面团

senses.def: made in standard sizes, not to the measurements of a particular customer
senses.chn: 标准尺码的；现成的；成品的

ex.en: a ready-made suit
ex.cn: 成品套装

senses.def: already provided for you so you do not need to produce or think about it yourself

ex.en: When he married her he also took on a ready-made family.
ex.cn: 他和她结婚，当上了现成的爸爸。

senses.def: a meal that you buy already prepared and which only needs to be heated before you eat it
already mixed and ready to use

ex.en: ready-mixed concrete
ex.cn: 预拌混凝土

senses.def: money in the form of coins and notes that you can spend immediately
ready to start
made in standard sizes, not to the measurements of a particular customer
to state sth again in order to emphasize that it is still true
a substance used to cause a chemical reaction, especially in order to find out if another substance is present
actually existing or happening and not imagined or pretended
senses.chn: 真实的；实际存在的；非凭空想象的

ex.en: It wasn't a ghost; it was a real person.
ex.cn: 那不是鬼魂，是实实在在的人。

ex.en: pictures of animals, both real and mythological
ex.cn: 现实和神话中的动物图片

ex.en: In the movies guns kill people instantly, but it's not like that in real life.
ex.cn: 电影中，枪能使人在瞬间毙命，而实际情况并非如此。

ex.en: Politicians seem to be out of touch with the real world.
ex.cn: 政治家们似乎不接触现实世界。

ex.en: The growth of violent crime is a very real problem.
ex.cn: 暴力犯罪的增长是个非常实际的问题。

ex.en: There's no real possibility of them changing their minds.
ex.cn: 他们实际上不可能改变主意。

senses.def: genuine and not false or artificial
senses.chn: 真的；正宗的；非假冒的；非人工的

ex.en: Are those real flowers?
ex.cn: 那些是真花吗？

ex.en: real leather
ex.cn: 真皮

senses.def: actual or true, rather than what appears to be true

ex.en: Tell me the real reason.
ex.cn: 告诉我真正的理由。

ex.en: Bono's real name is Paul Hewson.
ex.cn: 波诺的真实姓名是保罗 · 休森。

ex.en: See the real Africa on one of our walking safaris.
ex.cn: 参加一次我们的观察野兽徒步旅行，看一看真实的非洲吧。

ex.en: I couldn't resist the opportunity to meet a real live celebrity.
ex.cn: 我不想错过见到名人真人的机会。

senses.def: having all the important qualities that it should have to deserve to be called what it is called

ex.en: She never had any real friends at school.
ex.cn: 在学校，她从来没有真正的朋友。

ex.en: his first real kiss
ex.cn: 他真正的初吻

ex.en: I had no real interest in politics.
ex.cn: 我对政治兴趣不大。

ex.en: He was making a real effort to be nice to her.
ex.cn: 他费尽心思地对她好。

ex.en: She has not shown any real regret for what she did.
ex.cn: 她对自己做过的事还没有表现出真正后悔的样子。

senses.def: used to emphasize a state or quality

ex.en: He looks a real idiot.
ex.cn: 他看上去像个十足的白痴。

ex.en: This accident could have produced a real tragedy.
ex.cn: 这次事故差一点造成一场惨剧。

ex.en: Her next play was a real contrast.
ex.cn: 她的下一部戏是个鲜明的对比。

senses.def: when the effect of such things as price rises on the power of money to buy things is included in the sums
senses.chn: 实际的（已按物价指数等调整）；按购买力衡量的

ex.en: Real wage costs have risen by 10% in the past year.
ex.cn: 在过去的一年里，实际工资成本增加了 10%。

ex.en: This represents a reduction of 5% in real terms.
ex.cn: 这相当于实际减少了 5%。

senses.def: genuine or serious

ex.en: This is not a fire drill—it's for real.
ex.cn: 这不是救火演习，是真失火了。

ex.en: He managed to convince voters that he was for real.
ex.cn: 他使得投票者相信了他是严肃认真的。

senses.def: used to tell sb that they are behaving in a stupid or unreasonable way
to act in an honest and natural way
the genuine thing

ex.en: Are you sure it's the real thing (= love), not just infatuation?
ex.cn: 你能确定这是真爱，而非一时痴迷？

senses.def: something that is genuine and that has value, not a copy

ex.en: It's an American flying jacket, the real McCoy.
ex.cn: 这是件真正的美国飞行员夹克。

senses.def: the person who really controls an organization, a country, etc. in contrast to the person who is legally in charge
very

ex.en: That tastes real good.
ex.cn: 味道好极了。

ex.en: He's a real nice guy.
ex.cn: 他是个非常好的人。

ex.en: I'm real sorry.
ex.cn: 我很抱歉。

senses.def: a type of beer that is made and stored in the traditional way
senses.chn: （按传统方法制作和贮存的）啤酒

senses.def: property in the form of land or buildings

ex.en: My father sold real estate.
ex.cn: 我父亲经营过房地产。

senses.def: the business of selling houses or land for building
senses.chn: 房地产业；房地产销售业

ex.en: to work in real estate
ex.cn: 经营房地产

senses.def: (especially on a web page) space that is useful or valuable
senses.chn: （尤指网页上）有用的空间，有价值的空间

ex.en: A company's home page is its most valuable real estate.
ex.cn: 一家公司的主页是其最有价值的网上空间。

ex.en: You can increase screen real estate by moving the taskbar to the right of the screen.
ex.cn: 将任务栏移到屏幕右侧可以增加屏幕的使用空间。

senses.def: a person whose job is to sell houses and land for people
ordinary objects used in a class for teaching purposes
senses.chn: 实物教具（用于教学的日常用品）

senses.def: to change the position or direction of sth slightly

ex.en: The road was realigned to improve visibility.
ex.cn: 道路做了调整，以提高能见度。

senses.def: to make changes to sth in order to adapt it to a new situation
senses.chn: 对…进行调整；使适应新形势

ex.en: The company has been forced to realign its operations in the area.
ex.cn: 公司被迫对这一领域的经营作了调整。

senses.def: to change your opinions, policies, etc. so that they are the same as those of another person, group, etc.
senses.chn: 改变观点，改变策略（以与别人相同）

ex.en: The rebel MPs have realigned themselves with the opposition party.
ex.cn: 几个造反的下院议员已与反对党站在一起。

senses.def: a way of seeing, accepting and dealing with situations as they really are without being influenced by your emotions or false hopes
senses.chn: 务实作风；现实主义方式

ex.en: There was a new mood of realism among the leaders at the peace talks.
ex.cn: 参加和平谈判的领导人之间有着一种务实的新气氛。

senses.def: the quality of being very like real life
a style in art or literature that shows things and people as they are in real life
senses.chn: （文艺的）现实主义风格，现实主义

senses.def: a person who accepts and deals with a situation as it really is and does not try to pretend that it is different

ex.en: I'm a realist—I know you can't change people overnight.
ex.cn: 我是个务实的人，我知道人不可能一夜之间被改变。

senses.def: a writer, painter, etc. whose work represents things as they are in real life
senses.chn: 现实主义作家（或画家等）

senses.def: accepting in a sensible way what it is actually possible to do or achieve in a particular situation
senses.chn: 现实的；实际的；实事求是的

ex.en: a realistic assessment
ex.cn: 实事求是的评估

ex.en: We have to be realistic about our chances of winning.
ex.cn: 我们必须实事求是地估计我们获胜的可能性。

ex.en: It is not realistic to expect people to spend so much money.
ex.cn: 期望人们花那么多的钱是不实际的。

senses.def: sensible and appropriate; possible to achieve
senses.chn: 明智的；恰如其分的；能够实现的

ex.en: We must set realistic goals.
ex.cn: 我们必须制订可实现的目标。

ex.en: a realistic target
ex.cn: 切实的目标

ex.en: to pay a realistic salary
ex.cn: 支付合理的薪水

senses.def: representing things as they are in real life

ex.en: a realistic drawing
ex.cn: 逼真的绘画

ex.en: We try to make these training courses as realistic as possible.
ex.cn: 我们努力使这些训练课程尽可能地贴近实际情况。

senses.def: used to say what you think can actually be achieved in a particular situation
senses.chn: （表明你认为实际实现的可能性）如实地，实际地

ex.en: Realistically, there is little prospect of a ceasefire.
ex.cn: 实事求是地讲，停火的希望很渺茫。

senses.def: in a way that shows sb accepts in a sensible way what it is actually possible to do or achieve

ex.en: How many can you realistically hope to sell?
ex.cn: 实事求是地讲，你希望能卖出多少？

ex.en: Kate spoke realistically about the task ahead.
ex.cn: 凯特如实地谈了面临的任务。

senses.def: in a way that represents things as they are in real life

ex.en: a fireplace with realistically glowing coals
ex.cn: 有逼真的炉火闪耀的壁炉

senses.def: the true situation and the problems that actually exist in life, in contrast to how you would like life to be

ex.en: She refuses to face reality.
ex.cn: 她不肯面对现实。

ex.en: You're out of touch with reality.
ex.cn: 你脱离了现实。

ex.en: The reality is that there is not enough money to pay for this project.
ex.cn: 实际情况是没有足够的钱花在这个项目上。

senses.def: a thing that is actually experienced or seen, in contrast to what people might imagine
senses.chn: 事实；实际经历；见到的事物

ex.en: the harsh realities of life
ex.cn: 严峻的生活现实

ex.en: This decision reflects the realities of the political situation.
ex.cn: 这一决定反映了政治形势的真实情况。

ex.en: Will time travel ever become a reality?
ex.cn: 时光旅行真的会成为现实吗？

senses.def: television/shows, etc. that use real people (not actors) in real situations, presented as entertainment

ex.en: a reality TV star
ex.cn: 一个真人秀电视明星

ex.en: the reality show 'Big Brother'
ex.cn: 真人秀节目《老大哥》

senses.def: used to say that a situation is different from what has just been said or from what people believe

ex.en: Outwardly she seemed confident but in reality she felt extremely nervous.
ex.cn: 表面上看，她显得信心十足，而实际上她紧张得要命。

senses.def: an occasion when you are reminded of how things are in the real world, rather than how you would like things to be
senses.chn: （提醒人面对现实而不再想当然的）现实感检验

senses.def: television shows that are based on real people (not actors) in real situations, presented as entertainment
possible to achieve or make happen

ex.en: realizable objectives
ex.cn: 可实现的目标

senses.def: that can be sold and turned into money
senses.chn: 可兑现的；可变为现金的

ex.en: realizable assets
ex.cn: 可变现资产

senses.def: the process of becoming aware of sth

ex.en: the sudden realization of what she had done
ex.cn: 突然意识到她自己究竟干了些什么

ex.en: There is a growing realization that changes must be made.
ex.cn: 越来越多的人认识到改革势在必行。

senses.def: the process of achieving a particular aim, etc.

ex.en: It was the realization of his greatest ambition.
ex.cn: 这就实现了他的宏伟抱负。

senses.def: the act of selling sth that you own, such as property, in order to get the money that you need for sth
the act of producing a sound, play, design, etc.; or the thing that is produced
senses.chn: 发声；（戏剧）演出；设计成果

senses.def: to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation
senses.chn: 理解；领会；认识到；意识到

ex.en: I didn't realize (that) you were so unhappy.
ex.cn: 我没有察觉到你那么不开心。

ex.en: The moment I saw her, I realized something was wrong.
ex.cn: 我一看到她，就觉得不太对劲。

ex.en: I don't think you realize how important this is to her.
ex.cn: 我认为你没有意识到这对她是多么重要。

ex.en: I hope you realize the seriousness of this crime.
ex.cn: 我希望你能认识到这一罪行的严重性。

ex.en: Only later did she realize her mistake.
ex.cn: 只是到了后来她才意识到自己的错误。

ex.en: The situation was more complicated than they had at first realized.
ex.cn: 形势比他们最初意识到的更为复杂。

senses.def: to achieve sth important that you very much want to do

ex.en: She never realized her ambition of becoming a professional singer.
ex.cn: 她从未实现成为一名职业歌手的志向。

ex.en: We try to help all students realize their full potential (= be as successful as they are able to be).
ex.cn: 我们努力帮助所有的学生充分发挥他们的潜力。

senses.def: if sb's fears are realized, the things that they are afraid will happen, do happen

ex.en: His worst fears were realized when he saw that the door had been forced open.
ex.cn: 他一看门被撬了，就知道最担心的事还是发生了。

senses.def: to sell things that you own, for example property, in order to get the money that you need for sth
to be sold for a particular amount of money

ex.en: The paintings realized $2 million at auction.
ex.cn: 这些绘画在拍卖会上以 200 万美元卖出。

senses.def: to produce sth that can be seen or heard, based on written information or instructions
senses.chn: 把（概念等）具体表现出来

ex.en: The stage designs have been beautifully realized.
ex.cn: 舞台设计得到了完美的体现。

senses.def: actually happening or existing in life, not in books, stories or films/movies
senses.chn: 真实的；实际发生的；现实生活中的

ex.en: a novel based on real-life events
ex.cn: 以真实事件为素材的小说

ex.en: a real-life Romeo and Juliet
ex.cn: 现实生活中的罗密欧与朱丽叶

senses.def: to change the way money or materials are shared between different people, groups, projects, etc.
used to say what is actually the fact or the truth about sth
senses.chn: （表明事实或真相）事实上，真正地，真实地

ex.en: What do you really think about it?
ex.cn: 你到底对这事怎么看？

ex.en: Tell me what really happened.
ex.cn: 告诉我究竟发生了什么事。

ex.en: They are not really my aunt and uncle.
ex.cn: 其实他们并不是我的姑姑和姑父。

ex.en: I can't believe I am really going to meet the princess.
ex.cn: 我不敢相信我真的要去见公主。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth you are saying or an opinion you are giving

ex.en: I want to help, I really do.
ex.cn: 我想帮忙，真的。

ex.en: Now I really must go.
ex.cn: 我确实得走了。

ex.en: I really don't mind.
ex.cn: 我一点都不在意。

ex.en: He really likes you.
ex.cn: 他的确喜欢你。

ex.en: I really and truly am in love this time.
ex.cn: 我这一次确确实实是恋爱了。

senses.def: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb

ex.en: a really hot fire
ex.cn: 好热的炉子

ex.en: I'm really sorry.
ex.cn: 我十分抱歉。

senses.def: used, often in negative sentences, to reduce the force of sth you are saying

ex.en: I don't really agree with that.
ex.cn: 对此我不太赞同。

ex.en: It doesn't really matter.
ex.cn: 没什么关系。

ex.en: 'Did you enjoy the book?' ' Not really.'(= 'no' or 'not very much')
ex.cn: “你喜欢那本书吗？” “不怎么喜欢。”

senses.def: used in questions and negative sentences when you want sb to say 'no'
senses.chn: （用于疑问句和否定句，期望对方给以否定的答复）

ex.en: Do you really expect me to believe that?
ex.cn: 你真以为我会相信吗？

ex.en: I don't really need to go, do I?
ex.cn: 我并不一定非要去，对吧？

senses.def: used to express interest in or surprise at what sb is saying

ex.en: 'We're going to Japan next month.' 'Oh, really?'
ex.cn: “我们下个月要去日本。” “哦，真的吗？”

ex.en: 'She's resigned.' 'Really? Are you sure?'
ex.cn: “她辞职了。” “真的？你肯定吗？”

senses.def: used to show that you disapprove of sth sb has done

ex.en: Really, you could have told us before.
ex.cn: 真是的，其实你大可事先跟我们说一声的。

senses.def: an area of activity, interest, or knowledge

ex.en: in the realm of literature
ex.cn: 在文学领域内

ex.en: At the end of the speech he seemed to be moving into the realms of fantasy.
ex.cn: 讲话的最后，他似乎进入了虚幻的境地。

senses.def: a country ruled by a king or queen

ex.en: the defence of the realm
ex.cn: 王国的防卫

senses.def: not possible/possible

ex.en: A successful outcome is not beyond the realms of possibility.
ex.cn: 最后取得成功并非没有可能。

senses.def: any number that is not an imaginary number
a system of politics that is based on the actual situation and needs of a country or political party rather than on moral principles
senses.chn: 现实政治；实用政治；实力政策

senses.def: an old form of tennis played inside a building with a hard ball
senses.chn: 庭院网球（使用硬球的旧式室内网球运动）

senses.def: the fact that there is only a very short time between a computer system receiving information and dealing with it

ex.en: To make the training realistic the simulation operates in real time.
ex.cn: 为使训练真实，模拟是实时运行的。

ex.en: real-time missile guidance systems
ex.cn: 实时导弹制导系统

senses.def: a part of a song or other recording that is used as the sound a mobile/cell phone makes when it rings
senses.chn: 原音铃声（使用歌曲等录音片段的手机铃声）

ex.en: Get the top realtones from the best artists delivered instantly to your mobile.
ex.cn: 即时取得一流歌手的最佳原声手机铃声。

senses.def: existing in the real world and not specially invented for a particular purpose
senses.chn: 存在于现实世界的；真实的

ex.en: Teachers need to prepare their students to deal with real-world situations outside the classroom.
ex.cn: 教师应该让学生做好应对课堂以外的现实世界的准备。

senses.def: a large quantity of writing

ex.en: She wrote reams in the exam.
ex.cn: 她在考试中写得很多。

senses.def: 500 sheets of paper
senses.chn: 令（纸张的记数单位，等于 500 张）

senses.def: to treat sb unfairly or cheat them

ex.en: We got reamed on that deal.
ex.cn: 那笔交易我们上当受骗了。

senses.def: to criticize sb strongly because they have done sth wrong
to give sb/sth new life or energy
senses.chn: 赋予新的生命；使重新充满活力

senses.def: to obtain sth, especially sth good, as a direct result of sth that you have done

ex.en: They are now reaping the rewards of all their hard work.
ex.cn: 现在，他们的全部辛劳都得到了回报。

senses.def: to cut and collect a crop, especially wheat, from a field
to benefit or suffer as a direct result of sth that you have done
senses.chn: 享受成果；承担后果；种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆

senses.def: you have to deal with the bad effects or results of sth that you originally started
a person or a machine that cuts and collects crops on a farm
to appear again after not being heard of or seen for a period of time

ex.en: She went upstairs and did not reappear until morning.
ex.cn: 她上了楼，直到第二天早晨才再次露面。

senses.def: to put another layer of a substance on a surface

ex.en: Sunblock should be reapplied every hour.
ex.cn: 防晒霜应每隔一小时再抹一次。

senses.def: to make another formal request for sth

ex.en: Previous applicants for the post need not reapply.
ex.cn: 申请过这个职位的人不需重新申请。

senses.def: to use sth again, especially in a different situation

ex.en: Students are taught a number of skills that can be reapplied throughout their studies.
ex.cn: 教给学生一些方法，让他们在整个学习过程中可以反复使用。

senses.def: to give sb the job that they used to have in the past
senses.chn: 使恢复职位；使回到原岗位

ex.en: After the trial he was reappointed (as) treasurer.
ex.cn: 审理过后，他被重新任命为财务主管。

senses.def: the act of examining sth again to see if it needs to be changed
to think again about the value or nature of sth/sb to see if your opinion about it/them should be changed
the back part of sth

ex.en: A trailer was attached to the rear of the truck.
ex.cn: 卡车后面挂了一辆拖车。

ex.en: There are toilets at both front and rear of the plane.
ex.cn: 飞机前后舱都有洗手间。

ex.en: A high gate blocks the only entrance to the rear.
ex.cn: 一座高大的门挡住了通往后面的唯一入口。

ex.en: What's that at the back of the fridge?
ex.cn: 冰箱尽里头那东西是什么？

ex.en: Smoking is only allowed at the rear of the aircraft.
ex.cn: 只有飞机后舱允许抽烟。

ex.en: Our room was at the back of the hotel.
ex.cn: 我们的房间在旅馆靠后面的地方。

senses.def: the part of the body that you sit on

ex.en: a kick in the rear
ex.cn: 踢了一下屁股

senses.def: to be at the back of a line of people, or last in a race
senses.chn: 站在队尾；落在最后；殿后

senses.def: at or near the back of sth

ex.en: front and rear windows
ex.cn: 前面和后面的窗户

ex.en: the rear entrance of the building
ex.cn: 大楼的后门

senses.def: to care for young children or animals until they are fully grown

ex.en: She reared a family of five on her own.
ex.cn: 她一个人养活五个孩子。

senses.def: to breed or keep animals or birds, for example on a farm

ex.en: to rear cattle
ex.cn: 养牛

senses.def: to raise itself on its back legs, with the front legs in the air

ex.en: The horse reared, throwing its rider.
ex.cn: 这匹马后腿直立，将骑手摔下。

senses.def: to seem to lean over you, especially in a threatening way

ex.en: The great bulk of the building reared up against the night sky.
ex.cn: 夜幕下，巨大的高楼显得阴森森的。

senses.def: if sth unpleasant rears its head or rears its ugly head, it appears or happens
to give a person or an animal a particular type of food, entertainment, etc. while they are young

ex.en: I was the son of sailors and reared on stories of the sea.
ex.cn: 我是水手的儿子，是听海的故事长大的。

senses.def: an officer of very high rank in the navy

ex.en: Rear Admiral Baines
ex.cn: 海军少将贝恩斯

senses.def: to drive into the back of another vehicle
a group of soldiers that protect the back part of an army especially when the army is retreating after it has been defeated
a struggle to change or stop sth even when it is not likely that you will succeed

ex.en: They have been fighting a rearguard action for two years to stop their house being demolished.
ex.cn: 两年来，为了不让他们的房子被拆除，他们一直在顽强抗争。

senses.def: the process of caring for children as they grow up, teaching them how to behave as members of society
the process of breeding animals or birds and caring for them as they grow

ex.en: livestock rearing
ex.cn: 家畜饲养

senses.def: to obtain, or supply sb with, new or better weapons, armies, etc.

ex.en: The country was forbidden to rearm under the terms of the treaty.
ex.cn: 根据条约规定，这个国家不允许重新武装。

ex.en: Rebel troops were being rearmed.
ex.cn: 叛军在进行重新装备。

senses.def: furthest back

ex.en: the rearmost section of the aircraft
ex.cn: 飞机的最后部

senses.def: to change the position or order of things; to change your position

ex.en: We've rearranged the furniture in the bedroom.
ex.cn: 我们重新摆放了卧室里的家具。

ex.en: She rearranged herself in another pose.
ex.cn: 她重新摆了个姿势。

senses.def: to change the time, date or place of an event
senses.chn: 重新安排；改变时间（或日期、地点）

ex.en: Can we rearrange the meeting for next Tuesday at 2?
ex.cn: 我们把会议改到下周二下午两点好吗？

senses.def: a mirror in which a driver can see the traffic behind
at or near the back of sth

ex.en: rearward seats
ex.cn: 后面的座位

senses.def: a system in which power from the engine is sent to the back wheels of a vehicle
a cause or an explanation for sth that has happened or that sb has done

ex.en: I'd like to know the reason why you're so late.
ex.cn: 我想知道你为什么迟到那么长时间。

ex.en: Give me one good reason why I should help you.
ex.cn: 我为什么要帮你？给我一个充分的理由。

ex.en: We aren't going for the simple reason that we can't afford it.
ex.cn: 我们不去，只是因为我们负担不起。

ex.en: She gave no reasons for her decision.
ex.cn: 她没有对她的决定作出任何解释。

ex.en: I have no particular reason for doubting him.
ex.cn: 我没有什么特别的理由怀疑他。

ex.en: He said no but he didn't give a reason.
ex.cn: 他说不行，但没有说明原因。

senses.def: a fact that makes it right or fair to do sth

ex.en: They have reason to believe that he is lying.
ex.cn: 他们有理由认为他是在撒谎。

ex.en: We have every reason (= have very good reasons) to feel optimistic.
ex.cn: 我们完全有理由感到乐观。

ex.en: There is no reason why we should agree to this.
ex.cn: 我们没有理由同意这点。

ex.en: This result gives us all the more reason for optimism.
ex.cn: 这个结果使我们更有理由保持乐观。

ex.en: She complained, with reason (= rightly), that she had been underpaid.
ex.cn: 她抱怨给她的报酬太低，是有道理的。

senses.def: the power of the mind to think in a logical way, to understand and have opinions, etc.

ex.en: Only human beings are capable of reason (= of thinking in a logical way, etc.).
ex.cn: 只有人类才有理性思考的能力。

ex.en: to lose your reason (= become mentally ill)
ex.cn: 神经失常

senses.def: what is possible, practical or right

ex.en: I can't get her to listen to reason.
ex.cn: 我没法跟她讲道理。

ex.en: Why can't they see reason?
ex.cn: 他们为什么不明事理？

ex.en: to be open to reason (= to be willing to accept sensible advice)
ex.cn: 广纳良言

ex.en: He's looking for a job and he's willing to do anything within reason.
ex.cn: 他在找工作，而且只要是正当的事他都愿意做。

senses.def: it must be clear to any sensible person who thinks about it
senses.chn: 这是人人都清楚的；这是明摆着的

ex.en: It stands to reason that they'll leave if you don't pay them enough.
ex.cn: 这是明摆着的，你不给他们足够的报酬，他们就走人。

senses.def: if there is no rhyme or reason to sth or it happens without rhyme or reason, it happens in a way that cannot be easily explained or understood
senses.chn: 毫无道理；无规律可循；莫名其妙

senses.def: to form a judgement about a situation by considering the facts and using your power to think in a logical way

ex.en: She reasoned that she must have left her bag on the train.
ex.cn: 她断定准是把包落在火车上了。

ex.en: They couldn't fire him, he reasoned. He was the only one who knew how the system worked.
ex.cn: 他推断他们不会解雇他。他是唯一知道这套系统如何运转的人。

senses.def: to use your power to think and understand

ex.en: the human ability to reason
ex.cn: 人的思考能力

senses.def: to try and find the answer to a problem by using your power to think in a logical way
senses.chn: 通过思考想出对策；推理出（结果）

senses.def: to talk to sb in order to persuade them to be more sensible

ex.en: I tried to reason with him, but he wouldn't listen.
ex.cn: 我尽量跟他讲道理，可他就是不听。

senses.def: fair, practical and sensible
senses.chn: 公平的；合理的；有理由的；明智的

ex.en: It is reasonable to assume that he knew beforehand that this would happen.
ex.cn: 有理由认为，他事先就知道会发生这样的事。

ex.en: Be reasonable! We can't work late every night.
ex.cn: 要讲道理呀！我们不能每天晚上都加班呀。

ex.en: Any reasonable person would have done exactly as you did.
ex.cn: 任何有头脑的人都会完全像你那样去做的。

ex.en: The prosecution has to prove beyond reasonable doubt that he is guilty of murder.
ex.cn: 控方必须毫无疑义地证明他犯有谋杀罪。

senses.def: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
senses.chn: 可以接受的；合乎情理的；公道的

ex.en: He made us a reasonable offer for the car.
ex.cn: 他给我们出的车价公平合理。

ex.en: You must submit your claim within a reasonable time.
ex.cn: 你必须在适当的时间内提出要求。

senses.def: not too expensive

ex.en: We sell good quality food at reasonable prices.
ex.cn: 我们以公道的价格出售优质食品。

ex.en: a bottle of cheap perfume
ex.cn: 一瓶低价劣质香水

senses.def: fairly good, but not very good
senses.chn: 不错的；还算好的；过得去的

ex.en: a reasonable standard of living
ex.cn: 还算不错的生活水平

ex.en: The hotel was reasonable, I suppose (= but not excellent).
ex.cn: 我觉得这家酒店还可以。

senses.def: to a degree that is fairly good but not very good

ex.en: The instructions are reasonably straightforward.
ex.cn: 用法说明还算简单易懂。

ex.en: She seems reasonably happy in her new job.
ex.cn: 她在新的工作岗位上好像还挺开心。

senses.def: in a logical and sensible way
senses.chn: 合情合理地；明智地；通情达理地

ex.en: We tried to discuss the matter calmly and reasonably.
ex.cn: 我们试图冷静且通情达理地来讨论这个问题。

senses.def: in a fair way

ex.en: He couldn't reasonably be expected to pay back the loan all at once.
ex.cn: 公平合理地讲，不可能指望他一下子归还全部借款。

ex.en: The apartments are reasonably priced (= not too expensive).
ex.cn: 这些公寓房价格合理。

senses.def: presented in a logical way that shows careful thought
the process of thinking about things in a logical way; opinions and ideas that are based on logical thinking
senses.chn: 推想；推理；理性的观点；论证

ex.en: What is the reasoning behind this decision?
ex.cn: 作出这个决定的依据是什么？

ex.en: This line of reasoning is faulty.
ex.cn: 这样的思路有问题。

senses.def: to try and find the answer to a problem by using your power to think in a logical way
senses.chn: 通过思考想出对策；推理出（结果）

senses.def: to talk to sb in order to persuade them to be more sensible

ex.en: I tried to reason with him, but he wouldn't listen.
ex.cn: 我尽量跟他讲道理，可他就是不听。

senses.def: to fit the parts of sth together again after it has been taken apart

ex.en: We had to take the table apart and reassemble it upstairs.
ex.cn: 我们只好先把桌子拆开，到楼上再组装起来。

senses.def: to meet together again as a group after a break

ex.en: The class reassembled after lunch.
ex.cn: 午饭后，全班同学又集合起来。

senses.def: to make other people recognize again your right or authority to do sth, after a period when this has been in doubt

ex.en: She found it necessary to reassert her position.
ex.cn: 她觉得有必要重申她的立场。

senses.def: to start to have an effect again, after a period of not having any effect

ex.en: He thought about giving up his job, but then common sense reasserted itself.
ex.cn: 他曾想放弃这份工作，但后来还是理智占了上风。

senses.def: to state again, clearly and firmly, that sth is true

ex.en: He reasserted that all parties should be involved in the talks.
ex.cn: 他再次声明各方均应参加会谈。

ex.en: Traditional values have been reasserted.
ex.cn: 传统价值观再次得到肯定。

senses.def: to think again about sth to decide if you need to change your opinion of it
to give sb a different duty, position or responsibility
senses.chn: 重新委派，再次指派（任务、职位、责任等）

ex.en: After his election defeat he was reassigned to the diplomatic service.
ex.cn: 落选之后，他又被派到外交部门工作。

senses.def: to give sth to a different person or organization; to change the status of sth
senses.chn: 重新分配…（给某人或机构）；重新指定

ex.en: The case was reassigned to a different court.
ex.cn: 这桩案件已交由另一法院审理。

senses.def: the fact of giving advice or help that takes away a person's fears or doubts

ex.en: to give/provide/offer reassurance
ex.cn: 表明肯定的态度

senses.def: something that is said or done to take away a person's fears or doubts
senses.chn: 能消除疑虑的说话（或行动）；保证

ex.en: We have been given reassurances that the water is safe to drink.
ex.cn: 我们得到保证说这水适合饮用。

senses.def: to say or do sth that makes sb less frightened or worried

ex.en: They tried to reassure her, but she still felt anxious.
ex.cn: 他们设法让她放心，可她还是焦虑不安。

ex.en: The doctor reassured him that there was nothing seriously wrong.
ex.cn: 医生安慰他说，没什么大毛病。

senses.def: making you feel less worried or uncertain about sth
senses.chn: 令人感到宽慰的；令人放心的

ex.en: a reassuring smile
ex.cn: 使人信心倍增的微笑

ex.en: It's reassuring (to know) that we've got the money if necessary.
ex.cn: 我们有了应急的钱，这下不必担心了。

senses.def: to make you feel a particular emotion again or to make you remember sth again
senses.chn: 勾起，唤起，再次引发（感情、回忆等）

ex.en: The place reawakened childhood memories.
ex.cn: 这地方唤起了童年的回忆。

senses.def: not attractive
senses.chn: 无吸引力的；令人厌恶的

senses.def: an amount of money that is paid back to you because you have paid too much

ex.en: a tax rebate
ex.cn: 退还税款

senses.def: an amount of money that is taken away from the cost of sth, before you pay for it
senses.chn: 折扣，返还（退还的部分货价）；折扣

ex.en: Buyers are offered a cash rebate.
ex.cn: 购买者享受现金折扣。

senses.def: a person who fights against the government of their country
senses.chn: 反政府的人；叛乱者；造反者

ex.en: rebel forces
ex.cn: 叛乱武装

ex.en: Armed rebels advanced towards the capital.
ex.cn: 武装叛乱分子向首都推进。

senses.def: a person who opposes sb in authority over them within an organization, a political party, etc.
a person who does not like to obey rules or who does not accept normal standards of behaviour, dress, etc.

ex.en: I've always been the rebel of the family.
ex.cn: 我在家里向来是个叛逆者。

senses.def: to fight against or refuse to obey an authority, for example a government, a system, your parents, etc.

ex.en: He later rebelled against his strict religious upbringing.
ex.cn: 他后来背叛了他所受的严格的宗教教育。

ex.en: Most teenagers find something to rebel against.
ex.cn: 大多数青少年都有反抗意识。

senses.def: an attempt by some of the people in a country to change their government, using violence

ex.en: The north of the country rose in rebellion against the government.
ex.cn: 这个国家的北方地区发生了反对政府的叛乱。

ex.en: The army put down the rebellion.
ex.cn: 军队镇压了叛乱。

senses.def: opposition to authority within an organization, a political party, etc.

ex.en: (a) back-bench rebellion
ex.cn: 下院普通议员的反对

senses.def: opposition to authority; being unwilling to obey rules or accept normal standards of behaviour, dress, etc.

ex.en: teenage rebellion
ex.cn: 青少年的叛逆

senses.def: unwilling to obey rules or accept normal standards of behaviour, dress, etc.
senses.chn: 反叛的；叛逆的；桀骜不驯的

ex.en: rebellious teenagers
ex.cn: 叛逆的青少年

ex.en: He has always had a rebellious streak.
ex.cn: 他总是有点叛逆。

senses.def: opposed to the government of a country; opposed to those in authority within an organization
senses.chn: 叛乱的；造反的；反对权威的

ex.en: rebellious cities/factions
ex.cn: 叛乱的城市；反对派别

senses.def: a period of new life, growth or activity

ex.en: the seasonal cycle of death and rebirth
ex.cn: 死而复生的四季轮回

senses.def: a spiritual change when a person's faith becomes stronger or they convert to another religion
senses.chn: （信仰加强或皈依另一宗教后精神上的）新生，再生

senses.def: a type of psychotherapy that involves reproducing the experience of being born using controlled breathing
senses.chn: 呼吸重生法，再生疗法（通过控制呼吸重新体验出生的心理疗法）

senses.def: if you reboot a computer or it reboots, you switch it off and then start it again immediately
to become active or popular again
to be born again

ex.en: If you were reborn as an animal, which animal would you be?
ex.cn: 如果你转世成为动物，你愿意做哪种动物？

senses.def: having become active again

ex.en: a reborn version of social democracy
ex.cn: 一种社会民主主义的翻版

senses.def: having experienced a complete spiritual change

ex.en: reborn evangelical Christians
ex.cn: 获得再生的福音教会信徒

senses.def: to bounce back after hitting sth

ex.en: The ball rebounded from the goalpost and Podolski headed it in.
ex.cn: 球从门柱弹回，波多尔斯基头球破门。

senses.def: if sth that you do rebounds on you, it has an unpleasant effect on you, especially when the effect was intended for sb else
to rise again after they have fallen
a ball that hits sth and bounces back
the act of catching the ball after a player has thrown it at the basket and has not scored a point
a positive reaction that happens after sth negative
while you are sad and confused, especially after a relationship has ended
senses.chn: （尤指关系破裂之后）在伤心困惑之时

senses.def: to change the image of a company or an organization or one of its products or services, for example by changing its name or by advertising it in a different way
senses.chn: 重塑…的形象（如通过改变名称或广告）；将…重塑

ex.en: In the 1990s the Labour Party rebranded itself as New Labour.
ex.cn: 工党于 20 世纪 90 年代重塑形象，改称新工党。

senses.def: an unkind refusal of a friendly offer, request or suggestion

ex.en: Her offer of help was met with a sharp rebuff.
ex.cn: 她主动帮忙，却遭到断然拒绝。

senses.def: to build or put sth together again

ex.en: After the earthquake, the people set about rebuilding their homes.
ex.cn: 地震过后，人们开始重建家园。

ex.en: He rebuilt the engine using parts from cars that had been scrapped.
ex.cn: 他用废弃的汽车零件重新组装了发动机。

senses.def: to make sth/sb complete and strong again

ex.en: When she lost her job, she had to rebuild her life completely.
ex.cn: 她丢了工作以后，不得不彻底重新安排自己的生活。

ex.en: attempts to rebuild the shattered post-war economy
ex.cn: 为恢复支离破碎的战后经济所作的尝试

senses.def: to speak severely to sb because they have done sth wrong

ex.en: The company was publicly rebuked for having neglected safety procedures.
ex.cn: 公司因忽略了安全规程而受到公开批评。

senses.def: a combination of pictures and letters which represent a word or phrase whose meaning has to be guessed
senses.chn: （以图画和字母混合构成的）图形字谜

senses.def: to say or prove that a statement or criticism is false
senses.chn: 反驳；驳斥；证明（言论等）错误

senses.def: unwilling to obey rules or follow instructions; difficult to control
senses.chn: 不守规章的；不服从指挥的；桀骜不驯的；难以控制的

senses.def: to remember sth

ex.en: She could not recall his name.
ex.cn: 她想不起他的名字。

ex.en: If I recall correctly, he lives in Luton.
ex.cn: 如果我没记错的话，他住在卢顿。

ex.en: I can't recall meeting her before.
ex.cn: 我想不起来以前曾经见过她。

ex.en: He recalled that she always came home late on Wednesdays.
ex.cn: 他回想起她星期三总是很晚回家。

ex.en: Can you recall exactly what happened?
ex.cn: 你能记起到底发生了什么事吗？

ex.en: 'It was on a Thursday in March,' he recalled.
ex.cn: “那是三月份的一个星期四。” 他回忆道。

senses.def: to make sb think of sth

ex.en: The poem recalls Eliot's 'The Waste Land'.
ex.cn: 这首诗令人想起艾略特的《荒原》。

senses.def: to order sb to return

ex.en: Both countries recalled their ambassadors.
ex.cn: 两个国家都召回了各自的大使。

ex.en: He was recalled to military duty.
ex.cn: 他被召回执行军事任务。

ex.en: They have both been recalled to the Welsh squad (= selected as members of the team after a time when they were not selected).
ex.cn: 他们俩都被重新召回了威尔士队。

senses.def: to ask for sth to be returned, often because there is sth wrong with it

ex.en: The company has recalled all the faulty hairdryers.
ex.cn: 公司回收了所有有瑕疵的吹风机。

senses.def: the ability to remember sth that you have learned or sth that has happened in the past

ex.en: She has amazing powers of recall.
ex.cn: 她有惊人的记忆力。

ex.en: to have instant recall (= to be able to remember sth immediately)
ex.cn: 有快速记忆的能力

ex.en: to have total recall (= to be able to remember all the details of sth)
ex.cn: 记得所有细节

senses.def: an official order or request for sb/sth to return, or for sth to be given back
senses.chn: 召回令；回归请求；回收令

ex.en: Thomas's recall to the Welsh team
ex.cn: 让托马斯回归威尔士队的要求

senses.def: impossible to bring back to the original state; impossible to remember
senses.chn: 不可恢复；想不起来；记不住

senses.def: to say, often publicly, that you no longer have the same belief or opinion that you had before
senses.chn: 公开宣布放弃（原先的信仰、观点等）

senses.def: to repeat or give a summary of what has already been said, decided, etc.

ex.en: To recapitulate briefly, the three main points are these…
ex.cn: 简要概括起来，主要有这样三点…

senses.def: to win back a place, position, etc. that was previously taken from you by an enemy or a rival

ex.en: Government troops soon recaptured the island.
ex.cn: 政府的军队很快夺回了这个岛。

senses.def: to catch a person or an animal that has escaped
to bring back a feeling or repeat an experience that you had in the past

ex.en: He was trying to recapture the happiness of his youth.
ex.cn: 他在努力回忆年轻时的快乐。

senses.def: to change sth by organizing or presenting it in a different way

ex.en: She recast her lecture as a radio talk.
ex.cn: 她把讲稿修改成了一篇广播讲话。

senses.def: to change the actors or the role of a particular actor in a play, etc.
senses.chn: 重新安排（演员阵容）；改变（演员角色）

senses.def: to move gradually away from sb or away from a previous position

ex.en: The sound of the truck receded into the distance.
ex.cn: 卡车的声音渐渐在远处消失了。

ex.en: She watched his receding figure.
ex.cn: 她看着他的身影渐渐远去。

senses.def: to become gradually weaker or smaller

ex.en: The prospect of bankruptcy has now receded (= it is less likely).
ex.cn: 破产的可能性现已减少了。

ex.en: The pain was receding slightly.
ex.cn: 疼痛正在一点一点地减弱。

senses.def: to stop growing at the front of the head
senses.chn: （头顶前部）头发停止生长，变秃

ex.en: a middle-aged man with receding hair/a receding hairline
ex.cn: 发际线后移的中年男子

senses.def: a chin that slopes backwards towards the neck
a piece of paper that shows that goods or services have been paid for

ex.en: Can I have a receipt, please?
ex.cn: 请给我开个收据，好吗？

ex.en: to make out (= write) a receipt
ex.cn: 开收据

senses.def: the act of receiving sth

ex.en: to acknowledge receipt of a letter
ex.cn: 告诉对方已收到信件

ex.en: The goods will be dispatched on receipt of an order form.
ex.cn: 订单一到即发货。

ex.en: Are you in receipt of any state benefits?
ex.cn: 你目前是否享有政府补助金？

senses.def: money that a business, bank or government receives
senses.chn: （企业、银行、政府等）收到的款项，收入

ex.en: net/gross receipts
ex.cn: 净收入；总收入

senses.def: for which money has not yet been received

ex.en: accounts receivable
ex.cn: 应收账款

senses.def: money that is owed to a business
to get or accept sth that is sent or given to you

ex.en: to receive a letter/present/phone call
ex.cn: 收到信／礼物；接到电话

ex.en: to receive information/payment/thanks
ex.cn: 接收信息／付款；受到感谢

ex.en: He received an award for bravery from the police service.
ex.cn: 他以其勇敢行为受到警务部门的嘉奖。

senses.def: to experience or be given a particular type of treatment or an injury
senses.chn: 体验；受到（某种待遇或伤害）

ex.en: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.
ex.cn: 我们受到了主人的热情欢迎。

ex.en: Emergency cases will receive professional attention immediately.
ex.cn: 急诊病人将立即得到诊治。

ex.en: to receive severe injuries
ex.cn: 受重伤

senses.def: to react to sth new, in a particular way

ex.en: The play was well received by the critics.
ex.cn: 这出戏受到剧评家的认可。

ex.en: The statistics were received with concern.
ex.cn: 这些统计数字受到了关切。

senses.def: to welcome or entertain a guest, especially formally

ex.en: He was received as an honoured guest at the White House.
ex.cn: 他在白宫受到贵宾的礼遇。

senses.def: to officially recognize and accept sb as a member of a group

ex.en: Three young people were received into the Church at Easter.
ex.cn: 复活节时有三位年轻人入教。

senses.def: to change broadcast signals into sounds or pictures on a television, radio, etc.

ex.en: to receive programmes via satellite
ex.cn: 通过卫星收看节目

senses.def: to be able to hear a radio message that is being sent by sb
senses.chn: 接收到，收听到（无线电消息）

ex.en: I'm receiving you loud and clear.
ex.cn: 我听得到你的声音，又清晰，又响亮。

senses.def: to buy or accept goods that you know have been stolen
to be the player that the server hits the ball to

ex.en: She won the toss and chose to receive.
ex.cn: 她猜中了掷币结果，选择接发球。

senses.def: to be the person that an action, etc. is directed at, especially an unpleasant one

ex.en: She found herself on the receiving end of a great deal of criticism.
ex.cn: 她发现自己遭到众多的批评。

senses.def: accepted by most people as being correct
senses.chn: 被承认的；被一致认可的

ex.en: The received wisdom is that they cannot win.
ex.cn: 大家一致认为他们不会赢。

senses.def: the view or belief that most people hold
senses.chn: 大多数人的看法；普遍信念

ex.en: Conventional wisdom has it that riots only ever happen in cities.
ex.cn: 人们普遍认为，只有城市里才发生暴乱。

senses.def: the part of a telephone that you hold close to your mouth and ear

ex.en: to pick up/lift/put down/replace the receiver
ex.cn: 拿起／放回听筒

senses.def: a piece of radio or television equipment that changes broadcast signals into sound or pictures
senses.chn: 无线电接收机；收音机；电视机

ex.en: a satellite receiver
ex.cn: 卫星信号接收机

senses.def: a person who is chosen by a court to be in charge of a company that is bankrupt
senses.chn: （破产公司的）财产管理人，官方接管人

ex.en: to call in the receivers
ex.cn: 申请委派官方接管人

senses.def: a person who receives sth

ex.en: Molly's more of a giver than a receiver.
ex.cn: 莫莉更乐于给予而不是接受。

senses.def: a person who buys or accepts stolen goods, knowing that they have been stolen
a player who plays in a position in which the ball can be caught when it is being passed forward
the state of a business being controlled by an official receiver because it has no money
senses.chn: 破产管理；破产产业接管

senses.def: that happened or began only a short time ago

ex.en: a recent development/discovery/event
ex.cn: 近来的发展／发现／事件

ex.en: his most recent visit to Poland
ex.cn: 他最近到波兰的访问

ex.en: There have been many changes in recent years.
ex.cn: 近几年发生了许多变化。

senses.def: not long ago

ex.en: We received a letter from him recently.
ex.cn: 我们不久以前收到了他的一封信。

ex.en: Until recently they were living in York.
ex.cn: 他们不久以前还住在约克。

ex.en: I haven't seen them recently (= it is some time since I saw them).
ex.cn: 我近来没见过他们。

ex.en: Have you used it recently (= in the recent past)?
ex.cn: 你最近用过它吗？

senses.def: a container for putting sth in

ex.en: The seas have been used as a receptacle for a range of industrial toxins.
ex.cn: 海洋成了各种有毒工业废料的大容器。

senses.def: the area inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go first when they arrive

ex.en: the reception area
ex.cn: 接待区

ex.en: We arranged to meet in reception at 6.30.
ex.cn: 我们约定 6:30 在接待处会面。

ex.en: You can leave a message with reception.
ex.cn: 你可以在接待处留言。

ex.en: the reception desk
ex.cn: 服务台

senses.def: a formal social occasion to welcome sb or celebrate sth
senses.chn: 接待仪式；欢迎会；招待会

ex.en: a wedding reception
ex.cn: 结婚喜筵

senses.def: the type of welcome that is given to sb/sth

ex.en: Her latest album has met with a mixed reception from fans.
ex.cn: 她的最新唱片在歌迷中间反响不一。

ex.en: Delegates gave him a warm reception as he called for more spending on education.
ex.cn: 由于他呼吁增加教育经费，代表们向他报以热烈的欢迎。

senses.def: the quality of radio and television signals that are broadcast
senses.chn: （无线电和电视信号的）接收效果

ex.en: good/bad reception
ex.cn: 良好的／差的接收效果

ex.en: There was very poor reception on my phone.
ex.cn: 我的电话接收效果很差。

senses.def: the act of receiving or welcoming sb

ex.en: the reception of refugees from the war zone
ex.cn: 接纳交战地区来的难民

senses.def: a place where people can get information or advice

ex.en: The museum is building a new reception centre for visitors.
ex.cn: 博物馆正在修建新的来宾接待室。

senses.def: a place where people, for example those without a home, can get help and temporary accommodation

ex.en: a reception centre for refugees
ex.cn: 难民救助站

senses.def: (in Britain) the first class at school for children aged 4 or 5
senses.chn: （英国学校为 4 至 5 岁儿童开设的）预备班，启蒙班

senses.def: a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, an office building, a doctor's surgery, etc.
(used especially when advertising houses for sale) a room in a house where people can sit, for example a living room or dining room
senses.chn: （尤用于推销房屋时的）接待室，会客室

senses.def: willing to listen to or to accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.chn: （对新观点、建议等）愿意倾听的，乐于接受的

ex.en: She was always receptive to new ideas.
ex.cn: 她总是愿意接受新观点。

ex.en: He gave an impressive speech to a receptive audience.
ex.cn: 他做了一次感人的讲演，听众深受感动。

senses.def: a sense organ or nerve ending in the body that reacts to changes such as heat or cold and makes the body react in a particular way
a period of time during the year when the members of a parliament, committee, etc. do not meet
a short break in a trial in court

ex.en: The judge called a short recess.
ex.cn: 法官宣布短暂休庭。

senses.def: a period of time between lessons at school
a part of a wall that is set further back than the rest of the wall, forming a space

ex.en: a recess for books
ex.cn: 放书的壁橱

senses.def: the part of a place that is furthest from the light and hard to see or get to

ex.en: He stared into the dark recesses of the room.
ex.cn: 他盯着房间里黑暗的角落。

ex.en: The doubt was still there, in the deep recesses of her mind.
ex.cn: 在她的内心深处依然存有疑虑。

senses.def: to take or to order a recess

ex.en: The hearing was recessed for the weekend.
ex.cn: 听证会周末暂停。

senses.def: to put sth in a position that is set back into a wall, etc.
senses.chn: 把…放进壁龛（或壁橱）；将…嵌入墙壁

ex.en: recessed shelves
ex.cn: 凹进墙壁的格子架

senses.def: a difficult time for the economy of a country, when there is less trade and industrial activity than usual and more people are unemployed

ex.en: the impact of the current recession on manufacturing
ex.cn: 时下经济萎缩对制造业的影响

ex.en: The economy is in deep recession.
ex.cn: 经济正处于严重的衰退之中。

ex.en: policies to pull the country out of recession
ex.cn: 引导国家走出经济萎缩的政策

senses.def: the movement backwards of sth from a previous position

ex.en: the gradual recession of the floodwater
ex.cn: 洪水的渐渐消退

senses.def: connected with a recession or likely to cause one
a recessive physical characteristic only appears in a child if it has two genes for this characteristic, one from each parent. It does not appear if a dominant gene is also present.
to fill a battery with electrical power; to be filled with electrical power

ex.en: He plugged his razor in to recharge it.
ex.cn: 他把剃刀插在插座上，给它充电。

ex.en: The drill takes about three hours to recharge.
ex.cn: 钻机充满电大约要三个小时。
