senses.def: to get back your strength and energy by resting for a time
senses.chn: 恢复体力；恢复精力；休整

ex.en: We needed the break in order to recharge.
ex.cn: 我们需要休息一下以恢复体力。

senses.def: to get back your strength and energy by resting for a while
to get back your strength and energy by resting for a while
a person who continues to commit crimes, and seems unable to stop, even after being punished
a set of instructions that tells you how to cook sth and the ingredients(= items of food) you need for it

ex.en: a recipe for chicken soup
ex.cn: 鸡汤的做法

ex.en: vegetarian recipes
ex.cn: 素菜食谱

ex.en: a recipe book
ex.cn: 烹饪书

senses.def: a method or an idea that seems likely to have a particular result

ex.en: His plans are a recipe for disaster.
ex.cn: 他的计划后患无穷。

ex.en: What's her recipe for success?
ex.cn: 她成功的秘诀是什么？

senses.def: a person who receives sth

ex.en: recipients of awards
ex.cn: 领奖者

senses.def: involving two people or groups who agree to help each other or behave in the same way to each other

ex.en: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
ex.cn: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生跨院选课。

senses.def: a verb that expresses the idea of an action that is done by two or more people or things to each other, for example 'kiss' in the sentence 'Paul and Claire kissed.'
senses.chn: 相互动词，交互动词（如 Paul and Claire kissed 中的 kiss）

senses.def: to behave or feel towards sb in the same way as they behave or feel towards you

ex.en: Her passion for him was not reciprocated.
ex.cn: 她对他的热情没有得到回应。

ex.en: He smiled but his smile was not reciprocated.
ex.cn: 他露出微笑，可他的微笑没有得到回应。

ex.en: I wasn't sure whether to laugh or to reciprocate with a remark of my own.
ex.cn: 我不知道是该笑一笑还是该说点什么作为回应。

senses.def: to move backwards and forwards in a straight line

ex.en: a reciprocating action
ex.cn: 往复运动

senses.def: a situation in which two people, countries, etc. provide the same help or advantages to each other
a public performance of music or poetry, usually given by one person or a small group
senses.chn: 音乐演奏会；诗歌朗诵会

ex.en: to give a piano recital
ex.cn: 举办钢琴演奏会

senses.def: a spoken description of a series of events, etc. that is often long and boring
an act of saying a piece of poetry or literature that you have learned to an audience
an act of talking or writing about a series of things

ex.en: She continued her recitation of the week's events.
ex.cn: 她接着逐一讲述这一周发生的事。

senses.def: a passage in an opera or oratorio that is sung in the rhythm of ordinary speech with many words on the same note
to say a poem, piece of literature, etc. that you have learned, especially to an audience

ex.en: Each child had to recite a poem to the class.
ex.cn: 每个孩子都得在班上背诵一首诗。

senses.def: to say a list or series of things

ex.en: They recited all their grievances to me.
ex.cn: 他们把所受的委屈都告诉了我。

ex.en: She could recite a list of all the kings and queens.
ex.cn: 她能一一说出所有的国王和王后的名字。

senses.def: showing a lack of care about danger and the possible results of your actions
senses.chn: 鲁莽的；不计后果的；无所顾忌的

ex.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
ex.cn: 他全然不顾个人安危。

ex.en: She was a good rider, but reckless.
ex.cn: 她是个好骑手，但太鲁莽。

ex.en: He had always been reckless with money.
ex.cn: 他花钱总是大手大脚。

ex.en: to cause death by reckless driving
ex.cn: 鲁莽驾驶造成死亡

senses.def: to think sth or have an opinion about sth

ex.en: I reckon (that) I'm going to get that job.
ex.cn: 我认为我会得到那份工作。

ex.en: He'll be famous one day. What do you reckon (= do you agree)?
ex.cn: 总有一天，他会成为名人的。你觉得呢？

ex.en: It's worth a lot of money, I reckon.
ex.cn: 我想这值很多钱。

ex.en: 'They'll never find out.' ' You reckon? ' (= I think you may be wrong about that)
ex.cn: “他们永远不会发现。” “是吗？”

ex.en: Do you think (that) they'll come?
ex.cn: 你认为他们会来吗？

ex.en: Well, I like it. What do you think?
ex.cn: 嗯，我喜欢这个。你认为怎么样？

senses.def: to be generally considered to be sth
senses.chn: 被普遍认为是；被看作是

ex.en: Children are reckoned to be more sophisticated nowadays.
ex.cn: 人们认为今天的孩子比过去世故。

ex.en: It was generally reckoned a success.
ex.cn: 大家都认为那是一次成功。

senses.def: to expect to do sth

ex.en: We reckon to finish by ten.
ex.cn: 我们预计十点钟以前结束。

senses.def: to calculate an amount, a number, etc.

ex.en: The age of the earth is reckoned at about 4 600 million years.
ex.cn: 估计地球的年龄大约为 46 亿年。

ex.en: They reckon (that) their profits are down by at least 20%.
ex.cn: 他们估计利润至少下降了 20%。

ex.en: The journey was reckoned to take about two hours.
ex.cn: 路上估计要花大约两个小时。

senses.def: a person or thing that is well known and respected in a particular field
senses.chn: 大名鼎鼎的人；重量级人物；影响巨大的事物

ex.en: Miyazaki is still a name to conjure with among anime fans.
ex.cn: 宫崎骏在日本动漫迷中仍是一个大名鼎鼎的名字。

senses.def: used when you mention a name that you think is difficult to remember or pronounce
senses.chn: 难记的名字；拗口的名字

ex.en: He comes from Tighnabruaich—now there's a name to conjure with!
ex.cn: 他来自 Tighnabruaich，这个名字真够拗口的！

senses.def: to expect sth to happen or to rely on sth happening

ex.en: They hadn't reckoned on a rebellion.
ex.cn: 他们没有料到会发生叛乱。

ex.en: We'd reckoned on having good weather.
ex.cn: 我们原指望会有好天气。

senses.def: to calculate the total amount or number of sth

ex.en: He reckoned up the cost of everything in his mind.
ex.cn: 他在脑子里把所有费用都合计了一下。

senses.def: to consider or treat sb/sth as a serious opponent, problem , etc.

ex.en: They were already a political force to be reckoned with.
ex.cn: 他们已经成为一支不容忽视的政治力量。

senses.def: to consider sth as a possible problem that you should be prepared for
senses.chn: 把（可能出现的问题）考虑进去

ex.en: I didn't reckon with getting caught up in so much traffic.
ex.cn: 我没有考虑到塞车会这么严重。

senses.def: to not consider sb/sth as a possible problem that you should be prepared for

ex.en: They had reckoned without the determination of the opposition.
ex.cn: 他们没料到会遭到坚决反对。

senses.def: the act of calculating sth, especially in a way that is not very exact

ex.en: By my reckoning you still owe me £5.
ex.cn: 我算计着，你还欠我 5 英镑。

senses.def: a time when sb's actions will be judged to be right or wrong and they may be punished

ex.en: In the final reckoning truth is rewarded.
ex.cn: 在最后算总账的时候，诚实的人会有好报。

ex.en: Officials concerned with environmental policy predict that a day of reckoning will come.
ex.cn: 担心环境政策的官员们预言总有一天人们会遭到报应。

senses.def: among/not among those who are likely to win or be successful
to expect sth to happen or to rely on sth happening

ex.en: They hadn't reckoned on a rebellion.
ex.cn: 他们没有料到会发生叛乱。

ex.en: We'd reckoned on having good weather.
ex.cn: 我们原指望会有好天气。

senses.def: to get sth back or to ask to have it back after it has been lost, taken away, etc.

ex.en: You'll have to go to the police station to reclaim your wallet.
ex.cn: 你得到警察局去认领你的钱包。

ex.en: The team reclaimed the title from their rivals.
ex.cn: 这个队从对手手中夺回了冠军。

senses.def: to make land that is naturally too wet or too dry suitable to be built on, farmed, etc.

ex.en: The site for the airport will be reclaimed from the swamp.
ex.cn: 这片湿地将会被开发来建机场。

ex.en: reclaimed marshland
ex.cn: 被开发利用的沼泽地

senses.def: if a piece of land is reclaimed by desert, forest, etc., it turns back into desert, etc. after being used for farming or building
senses.chn: 重新变为沙漠（或森林等）；沙化；荒漠化；抛荒

senses.def: to obtain materials from waste products so that they can be used again
senses.chn: 回收（废品中有用的东西）

senses.def: to rescue sb from a bad or criminal way of life
senses.chn: 挽救；感化；使纠正；使悔过自新

senses.def: to put sth in a different class or category
senses.chn: 将…重新分类；将…重新归类

ex.en: The drug is to be reclassified after trials showed it to be more harmful than previously thought.
ex.cn: 试验显示这种药比先前想象的危害更大，要重新归类。

senses.def: to sit or lie in a relaxed way, with your body leaning backwards

ex.en: She was reclining on a sofa.
ex.cn: 她倚靠在沙发上。

ex.en: a reclining figure (= for example in a painting)
ex.cn: 半躺着的人像

senses.def: when a seat reclines or when you recline a seat, the back of it moves into a comfortable sloping position

ex.en: a reclining chair
ex.cn: 躺椅

senses.def: a soft comfortable chair with a back that can be pushed back at an angle so that you can lean back in it
a person who lives alone and likes to avoid other people

ex.en: to lead the life of a recluse
ex.cn: 过隐居的生活

senses.def: the act of remembering who sb is when you see them, or of identifying what sth is

ex.en: He glanced briefly towards her but there was no sign of recognition.
ex.cn: 他瞥了她一眼，但似乎没认出她来。

ex.en: the automatic recognition of handwriting and printed text by computer
ex.cn: 计算机对手写和印刷文本的自动识别

senses.def: the act of accepting that sth exists, is true or is official

ex.en: a growing recognition that older people have potential too
ex.cn: 越来越多的人认识到老年人也是有潜力的

ex.en: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.
ex.cn: 人们普遍认识到迫切需要改革。

ex.en: to seek international/official/formal recognition as a sovereign state
ex.cn: 寻求国际上的／官方的／正式的承认，承认它是一个主权国家

senses.def: public praise and reward for sb's work or actions

ex.en: She gained only minimal recognition for her work.
ex.cn: 她的工作仅仅得到极少的赞誉。

ex.en: He received the award in recognition of his success over the past year.
ex.cn: 他受到了奖励，这是对他过去一年的成绩的肯定。

senses.def: to change so much that you can hardly recognize it
senses.chn: 变得面目全非；沧海桑田

ex.en: The town has changed beyond recognition since I was last here.
ex.cn: 自从我上次离开这里以来，这座小镇已经变得让人认不出来了。

senses.def: easy to know or identify
senses.chn: 容易认出的；易于识别的

ex.en: The building was easily recognizable as a prison.
ex.cn: 很容易看出这座建筑是所监狱。

ex.en: After so many years she was still instantly recognizable.
ex.cn: 过了这么多年，还是一眼就能认出她。

senses.def: a promise by sb who is accused of a crime to appear in court on a particular date; a sum of money paid as a guarantee of this promise
senses.chn: 保证书；具结；保释金；保证金

senses.def: to know who sb is or what sth is when you see or hear them or it, because you have seen or heard them or it before

ex.en: I recognized him as soon as he came in the room.
ex.cn: 他一进屋我就认出了他。

ex.en: Do you recognize this tune?
ex.cn: 你能听出这是哪支曲子吗？

ex.en: I recognized her by her red hair.
ex.cn: 我从她的红头发认出了她。

ex.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
ex.cn: 她认出了袭击她的人。

ex.en: I couldn't see who was speaking, but I knew the voice.
ex.cn: 我看不到谁在讲话，但我能辨别出声音。

ex.en: She knows a bargain when she sees one.
ex.cn: 她一看就知道有没有便宜可捡。

senses.def: to admit or to be aware that sth exists or is true

ex.en: They recognized the need to take the problem seriously.
ex.cn: 他们承认需要严肃对待这个问题。

ex.en: Drugs were not recognized as a problem then.
ex.cn: 那时候还没有把毒品看成是一个问题加以重视。

ex.en: Nobody recognized how urgent the situation was.
ex.cn: 当时没有人意识到形势有多么紧急。

ex.en: We recognized that the task was not straightforward.
ex.cn: 我们意识到这个任务并非轻而易举。

ex.en: It was recognized that this solution could only be temporary.
ex.cn: 人们意识到这只是个临时的解决方案。

ex.en: Drugs were not recognized to be a problem then.
ex.cn: 那时候还没有把毒品看成是一个问题加以重视。

senses.def: to accept and approve of sb/sth officially

ex.en: recognized qualifications
ex.cn: 获得承认的资格

ex.en: The UK has refused to recognize the new regime.
ex.cn: 英国已拒绝承认这个新的政权。

ex.en: He is recognized to be their natural leader.
ex.cn: 人们都承认他是他们的当然领袖。

senses.def: to be thought of as very good or important by people in general

ex.en: The book is now recognized as a classic.
ex.cn: 这本书现在是一部公认的经典著作。

ex.en: She's a recognized authority on the subject.
ex.cn: 她在这个学科上是公认的权威。

senses.def: to give sb official thanks for sth that they have done or achieved

ex.en: His services to the state were recognized with the award of a knighthood.
ex.cn: 他被封为爵士，以表彰他对国家的贡献。

senses.def: to move your body quickly away from sb/sth because you find them or it frightening or unpleasant

ex.en: She recoiled from his touch.
ex.cn: 她躲开他的触摸。

ex.en: He recoiled in horror at the sight of the corpse.
ex.cn: 他一见到尸体就吓得往后缩了。

senses.def: to react to an idea or a situation with strong dislike or fear
senses.chn: 对…作出厌恶（或恐惧）的反应

ex.en: She recoiled from the idea of betraying her own brother.
ex.cn: 背叛自己亲兄弟的这个想法使她感到恐惧。

senses.def: to move suddenly backwards when you fire it
a sudden movement backwards, especially of a gun when it is fired
senses.chn: 反冲；（尤指枪炮的）后坐力

senses.def: to remember sth, especially by making an effort to remember it

ex.en: She could no longer recollect the details of the letter.
ex.cn: 她想不起那封信的细节了。

ex.en: As far as I can recollect, she wasn't there on that occasion.
ex.cn: 据我回忆，当时她不在场。

ex.en: I don't recollect what he said.
ex.cn: 我不记得他说过什么。

ex.en: I recollect that we were all gathered in the kitchen.
ex.cn: 我记得当时我们都被召集到厨房里。

ex.en: I recollect him/his saying that it was dangerous.
ex.cn: 我记得他说那很危险。

ex.en: 'It was just before the war,' she recollected.
ex.cn: “那是在战争即将发生之际。” 她回忆道。

senses.def: the ability to remember sth; the act of remembering sth

ex.en: I have no recollection of meeting her before.
ex.cn: 我不记得以前见过她。

ex.en: My recollection of events differs from his.
ex.cn: 我记忆中的情况和他的不一样。

ex.en: To the best of my recollection (= if I remember correctly) I was not present at that meeting.
ex.cn: 如果我没记错的话，我没有出席那次会议。

senses.def: a thing that you remember from the past

ex.en: to have a clear/vivid/dim/vague recollection of sth
ex.cn: 对某事的记忆清晰／历历在目／模糊不清／依稀如烟

senses.def: to begin again; to start doing sth again

ex.en: Work on the bridge will recommence next month.
ex.cn: 下个月将重新开始这座桥的建造工作。

ex.en: The two countries agreed to recommence talks the following week.
ex.cn: 两国同意于随后的一周重新开始会谈。

senses.def: to tell sb that sth is good or useful, or that sb would be suitable for a particular job, etc.

ex.en: Can you recommend a good hotel?
ex.cn: 你能推荐一家好的旅馆吗？

ex.en: I recommend the book to all my students.
ex.cn: 我向我所有的学生都推荐这本书。

ex.en: She was recommended for the post by a colleague.
ex.cn: 她由同事推荐到这个岗位。

ex.en: The hotel's new restaurant comes highly recommended (= a lot of people have praised it).
ex.cn: 这家酒店的新餐厅得到了人们的普遍赞扬。

senses.def: to advise a particular course of action; to advise sb to do sth

ex.en: The report recommended a 10% pay increase.
ex.cn: 报告提议工资增加 10%。

ex.en: It is dangerous to exceed the recommended dose.
ex.cn: 超过建议服用的剂量会有危险。

ex.en: a recommended price of $50
ex.cn: 建议售价 50 美元

ex.en: I recommend (that) he see a lawyer.
ex.cn: 我建议他去找个律师。

ex.en: I recommend (that) he should see a lawyer.
ex.cn: 我建议他去找个律师。

ex.en: It is strongly recommended that the machines should be checked every year.
ex.cn: 强烈建议每年都要检查机器。

senses.def: to make sb/sth seem attractive or good
senses.chn: 使显得吸引人；使受欢迎

ex.en: This system has much to recommend it.
ex.cn: 这套系统有很多可取之处。

senses.def: an official suggestion about the best thing to do

ex.en: to accept/reject a recommendation
ex.cn: 接受／拒绝一项建议

ex.en: The committee made recommendations to the board on teachers' pay and conditions.
ex.cn: 委员会就教师的工资和工作条件问题向董事会提出建议。

ex.en: I had the operation on the recommendation of my doctor.
ex.cn: 我根据医生的建议做了手术。

senses.def: the act of telling sb that sth is good or useful or that sb would be suitable for a particular job, etc.

ex.en: We chose the hotel on their recommendation (= because they recommended it).
ex.cn: 我们根据他们的推荐选了这家酒店。

ex.en: It's best to find a builder through personal recommendation.
ex.cn: 最好通过私人介绍寻找施工人员。

ex.en: Here's a list of my top CD recommendations.
ex.cn: 这是我认为最值得推荐的 CD 的清单。

senses.def: a formal letter or statement that sb would be suitable for a particular job, etc.
something, usually money, that you are given because you have suffered in some way, or as a payment for sth

ex.en: There must be adequate recompense for workers who lose their jobs.
ex.cn: 必须给失业的工人足够的补偿。

ex.en: I received $1 000 in recompense for loss of earnings.
ex.cn: 我得到了 1 000 美元的收入损失赔偿。

senses.def: to do sth for sb or give them a payment for sth that they have suffered

ex.en: There was no attempt to recompense the miners for the loss of their jobs.
ex.cn: 没有人表示要对失业矿工给予补偿。

senses.def: to find an acceptable way of dealing with two or more ideas, needs, etc. that seem to be opposed to each other
senses.chn: 使和谐一致；调和；使配合

ex.en: an attempt to reconcile the need for industrial development with concern for the environment
ex.cn: 协调工业发展的需要和环境保护之间关系的努力

ex.en: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
ex.cn: 他很难兼顾事业上的抱负和孩子们的需要。

senses.def: to make people become friends again after an argument or a disagreement

ex.en: The pair were reconciled after Jackson made a public apology.
ex.cn: 杰克逊公开道歉之后，这两个人又言归于好了。

ex.en: He has recently been reconciled with his wife.
ex.cn: 他最近已经和妻子和好了。

senses.def: to make sb/yourself accept an unpleasant situation because it is not possible to change it

ex.en: He could not reconcile himself to the prospect of losing her.
ex.cn: 他一想到有可能失去她，就觉得难以忍受。

senses.def: an end to a disagreement and the start of a good relationship again

ex.en: Their change of policy brought about a reconciliation with Britain.
ex.cn: 他们的政策改变促成了与英国的和解。

senses.def: the process of making it possible for two different ideas, facts, etc. to exist together without being opposed to each other

ex.en: the reconciliation between environment and development
ex.cn: 环境保护与发展之间的和谐统一

senses.def: not known about or understood by many people
to repair a machine so that it is in good condition and works well
senses.chn: 修复（机器）；使（机器）恢复正常运转

senses.def: to make changes to the way that sth is arranged to work, especially computer equipment or a program
senses.chn: 重新配置（计算机设备等）；重新设定（程序等）

ex.en: You may need to reconfigure the firewall if you add a new machine to your network.
ex.cn: 如果在网络中增加新计算机，可能就得重新设定防火墙。

senses.def: to check again that sth is definitely correct or as previously arranged

ex.en: You have to reconfirm your flight 24 hours before travelling.
ex.cn: 你必须在乘飞机之前 24 小时再次确认你的航班。

senses.def: the activity of getting information about an area for military purposes, using soldiers, planes, etc.

ex.en: to make an aerial reconnaissance of the island
ex.cn: 对这座岛进行空中侦察

ex.en: Time spent on reconnaissance is seldom wasted.
ex.cn: 花在侦察上的时间很少会白费。

ex.en: a reconnaissance aircraft/mission/satellite
ex.cn: 侦察飞机／任务／卫星

senses.def: to connect sth again; to connect to sth again

ex.en: I replaced the taps and reconnected the water supply.
ex.cn: 我更换了水龙头，再次接通了自来水。

ex.en: Once you have removed the virus it is safe to reconnect to the Internet.
ex.cn: 病毒一清除，就可以安全地重新连接互联网。

senses.def: to get information about an area, especially for military purposes, by using soldiers, planes, etc.
to take control again of a country or city by force, after having lost it
senses.chn: 重新占领（国家或城市）；再征服；夺回

senses.def: to think about sth again, especially because you might want to change a previous decision or opinion

ex.en: to reconsider your decision/position
ex.cn: 重新考虑你的决定／立场

ex.en: Recent information may persuade the board to reconsider.
ex.cn: 最近得到的信息也许会使董事会重新考虑。

senses.def: to form an organization or a group again in a different way

ex.en: The group reconstituted itself as a political party.
ex.cn: 这个团体重新组建为一个政党。

senses.def: to bring dried food, etc. back to its original form by adding water
senses.chn: 使（脱水食物等）恢复原状；使还原

senses.def: to build or make sth again that has been damaged or that no longer exists

ex.en: They have tried to reconstruct the settlement as it would have been in Iron Age times.
ex.cn: 他们已试着按铁器时代的样子重建这个小村落。

senses.def: to be able to describe or show exactly how a past event happened, using the information you have gathered

ex.en: Investigators are trying to reconstruct the circumstances of the crash.
ex.cn: 调查人员正试图重现撞车时的情形。

senses.def: the process of changing or improving the condition of sth or the way it works; the process of putting sth back into the state it was in before

ex.en: the post-war reconstruction of Germany
ex.cn: 德国的战后重建

ex.en: a reconstruction period
ex.cn: 重建时期

senses.def: the activity of building again sth that has been damaged or destroyed

ex.en: the reconstruction of the sea walls
ex.cn: 海堤的修复

senses.def: a copy of sth that no longer exists

ex.en: The doorway is a 19th century reconstruction of Norman work.
ex.cn: 门廊是 19 世纪时模仿诺曼式建筑修建的。

senses.def: a short film showing events that are known to have happened, made in order to try and get more information or better understanding, especially about a crime
senses.chn: 再现（犯罪过程等的）影片

ex.en: Last night police staged a reconstruction of the incident.
ex.cn: 昨天晚上，警方放映了再现事故经过的影片。

senses.def: (in the US) the period after the Civil War when the southern states returned to the US and laws were passed that gave rights to African Americans
senses.chn: 重建时期（美国南北战争后南方各州重新加入联邦）

senses.def: that involves reconstructing part of a person's body because it has been badly damaged or because the person wants to change its shape

ex.en: reconstructive surgery
ex.cn: 整形手术

senses.def: if a meeting, parliament, etc. reconvenes or if sb reconvenes it, it meets again after a break
a written account of sth that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future

ex.en: You should keep a record of your expenses.
ex.cn: 你应该记下你的各项开支。

ex.en: medical/dental records
ex.cn: 病历；牙科病历

ex.en: Last summer was the wettest on record.
ex.cn: 去年夏天是有记录以来降雨量最大的。

ex.en: It was the worst flood since records began.
ex.cn: 这是有记录以来最严重的水灾。

senses.def: a thin round piece of plastic on which music, etc. is recorded

ex.en: to play a record
ex.cn: 播放唱片

ex.en: a record collection
ex.cn: 收藏的唱片

senses.def: a piece or collection of music released as a record, or on CD, the Internet, etc.

ex.en: a record company (= one which produces and sells records)
ex.cn: 唱片公司

ex.en: During her career Billie Holiday made over 100 records.
ex.cn: 比莉 · 哈乐黛在她的歌唱生涯中录制了 100 多张唱片。

ex.en: His new record is available on CD or as a download.
ex.cn: 他的新专辑可以通过购买 CD 或从网上下载获得。

senses.def: the best result or the highest or lowest level that has ever been reached, especially in sport
senses.chn: （尤指体育运动中最高或最低的）纪录

ex.en: She holds the world record for the 100 metres.
ex.cn: 她保持着 100 米的世界纪录。

ex.en: to break the record (= to achieve a better result than there has ever been before)
ex.cn: 破纪录

ex.en: to set a new record
ex.cn: 刷新纪录

ex.en: There was a record number of candidates for the post.
ex.cn: 这个职位的候选人数量空前。

ex.en: I got to work in record time.
ex.cn: 我以历来最快的速度赶到单位上班。

ex.en: record profits
ex.cn: 创纪录的利润

senses.def: the facts that are known about sb/sth's past behaviour, character, achievements, etc.
senses.chn: （有关过去的）事实；记录；经历；功过

ex.en: The report criticizes the government's record on housing.
ex.cn: 这份报告批评了政府在住房问题上的所作所为。

ex.en: The airline has a good safety record.
ex.cn: 这家航空公司的安全记录一向很好。

ex.en: He has an impressive record of achievement.
ex.cn: 他所取得的一系列成就令人赞叹。

senses.def: the fact of having committed crimes in the past

ex.en: Does he have a record?
ex.cn: 他有没有前科？

senses.def: used to show that you want what you are saying to be officially written down and remembered
senses.chn: （希望载入正式记录）（仅）供记录

senses.def: used to emphasize a point that you are making, so that the person you are speaking to takes notice

ex.en: And, for the record, he would be the last person I'd ask.
ex.cn: 需要强调的是，他是我最不愿意去找的人。

senses.def: if you tell sb sth off the record, it is not yet official and you do not want them to repeat it publicly
senses.chn: 非正式的；私下的；不得发表的

senses.def: to say sth publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

ex.en: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
ex.cn: 他不想公开赞扬或批评这项提议。

senses.def: to give people the correct information about sth in order to make it clear that what they previously believed was in fact wrong
something that has been recorded as being true
to keep a permanent account of facts or events by writing them down, filming them, storing them in a computer, etc.

ex.en: Her childhood is recorded in the diaries of those years.
ex.cn: 她的童年生活都记在当年的日记里。

ex.en: You should record all your expenses during your trip.
ex.cn: 你应该记下你一路上的所有开支。

ex.en: His job is to record how politicians vote on major issues.
ex.cn: 他的工作就是要记录政治家是如何对重大问题投票的。

ex.en: She recorded in her diary that they crossed the Equator on 15 June.
ex.cn: 她在日记中记载他们是在 6 月 15 日越过赤道的。

ex.en: It is recorded that, by the year 630, four hundred monks were attached to the monastery.
ex.cn: 据记载，到 630 年有 400 个僧侣隶属该寺院。

senses.def: to make a copy of music, a film/movie, etc. by storing it on tape or a disc so that you can listen to or watch it again

ex.en: Did you remember to record that programme for me?
ex.cn: 你记得为我录下那个节目了吗？

ex.en: a recorded concert
ex.cn: 录制的音乐会

ex.en: Tell me when the tape starts recording.
ex.cn: 磁带开始录时告诉我一声。

ex.en: He recorded the class rehearsing before the performance.
ex.cn: 他录下了演出前班级的排练。

senses.def: to perform music so that it can be copied onto and kept on tape
senses.chn: 演奏音乐供录制；灌（唱片）

ex.en: The band is back in the US recording their new album.
ex.cn: 乐队回美国录制新唱片去了。

senses.def: to make an official or legal statement about sth
senses.chn: 发表正式（或法律方面的）声明；申明

ex.en: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
ex.cn: 验尸官判定这是一次意外死亡。

senses.def: to show a particular measurement or amount

ex.en: The thermometer recorded a temperature of 40°C.
ex.cn: 温度计显示气温达到了 40 摄氏度。

senses.def: a person or thing that achieves a better result or higher level than has ever been achieved before
a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it gets an official note to say it has been posted and the person receiving it must sign a form when it is delivered
senses.chn: 挂号邮寄（需收件人签收）

ex.en: I'd like to send this (by) recorded delivery.
ex.cn: 这个邮件要挂号。

senses.def: a machine for recording sound or pictures or both

ex.en: a tape/cassette/video/DVD recorder
ex.cn: 磁带／盒式录音机；录像机；DVD 录像机

senses.def: a musical instrument in the shape of a pipe that you blow into, with holes that you cover with your fingers
a judge in a court in some parts of Britain and the US
senses.chn: （英国和美国某些地区的）刑事法院法官，法官

senses.def: a person who keeps a record of events or facts
a person who has achieved the best result that has ever been achieved in a sport
sound or pictures that have been recorded on CD, DVD, video, etc.
senses.chn: 录制的音像；录音；视频；录像

ex.en: a video recording of the wedding
ex.cn: 婚礼的录像

senses.def: the process of making a record, film/movie, radio or television show, etc.

ex.en: during the recording of the show
ex.cn: 在录制这场表演期间

ex.en: recording equipment
ex.cn: 录制设备

ex.en: a recording studio
ex.cn: 录音棚

ex.en: the recording industry (= the industry that records and sells music)
ex.cn: 唱片业

senses.def: the process or act of writing down and storing information for official purposes

ex.en: the recording of financial transactions
ex.cn: 关于金融交易的记载

senses.def: a person whose job is making sound recordings, especially in a recording studio
senses.chn: （尤指录音棚的）录音员，录音师

senses.def: a piece of equipment for playing records in order to listen to the music, etc. on them
to tell sb about sth, especially sth that you have experienced

ex.en: She was asked to recount the details of the conversation to the court.
ex.cn: 她被要求向法庭陈述谈话细节。

ex.en: They recounted what had happened during those years.
ex.cn: 他们叙述了那些年里发生的事。

ex.en: 'It was before the war,' he recounted.
ex.cn: “那是在战前。” 他叙述道。

senses.def: to count sth again, especially votes
to get back an amount of money that you have spent or lost

ex.en: We hope to recoup our initial investment in the first year.
ex.cn: 我们希望我们的前期投资在第一年就能赚回来。

senses.def: the fact of having to, or being able to, use sth that can provide help in a difficult situation

ex.en: Your only recourse is legal action.
ex.cn: 你的唯一依靠就是诉诸法律。

ex.en: She made a complete recovery without recourse to surgery.
ex.cn: 她未做手术就完全恢复了健康。

ex.en: The government, when necessary, has recourse to the armed forces.
ex.cn: 政府在必要时可以动用军队。

senses.def: to put a new cover on sth
to get well again after being ill/sick, hurt, etc.

ex.en: He's still recovering from his operation.
ex.cn: 手术后，他仍在恢复之中。

senses.def: to return to a normal state after an unpleasant or unusual experience or a period of difficulty

ex.en: It can take many years to recover from the death of a loved one.
ex.cn: 从心爱的人去世的痛苦中恢复过来可能要花很多年。

ex.en: The economy is at last beginning to recover.
ex.cn: 经济终于开始复苏了。

senses.def: to get back the same amount of money that you have spent or that is owed to you

ex.en: He is unlikely to ever recover his legal costs.
ex.cn: 他不大可能收回他的诉讼费用了。

senses.def: to get back or find sth that was lost, stolen or missing

ex.en: The police eventually recovered the stolen paintings.
ex.cn: 警方最终追回了失窃的油画。

ex.en: Six bodies were recovered from the wreckage.
ex.cn: 从残骸中找到了六具尸体。

senses.def: to win back a position, level, status, etc. that has been lost

ex.en: The team recovered its lead in the second half.
ex.cn: 下半场这支队再次领先。

senses.def: to get back the use of your senses, control of your emotions, etc.

ex.en: It took her a few minutes to recover consciousness.
ex.cn: 过了几分钟她才恢复知觉。

ex.en: to recover your sight
ex.cn: 恢复视力

ex.en: She seemed upset but quickly recovered herself.
ex.cn: 她显得心烦意乱，但很快静下心来。

senses.def: that you can get back after it has been spent or lost
senses.chn: 可收回的；可重新获得的

ex.en: Travel expenses will be recoverable from the company.
ex.cn: 差旅费用可到公司报销。

senses.def: that can be obtained from the ground

ex.en: recoverable oil reserves
ex.cn: 可开采的石油资源

senses.def: the process of becoming well again after an illness or injury

ex.en: My father has made a full recovery from the operation.
ex.cn: 我父亲手术后已完全康复了。

ex.en: to make a remarkable/quick/speedy/slow, etc. recovery
ex.cn: 恢复显著、很快、迅速、缓慢等

ex.en: She is on the road to (= making progress towards) recovery.
ex.cn: 她正在康复之中。

senses.def: the process of improving or becoming stronger again

ex.en: The government is forecasting an economic recovery.
ex.cn: 政府预测经济会复苏。

ex.en: a recovery in consumer spending
ex.cn: 消费支出的回升

ex.en: The economy is showing signs of recovery.
ex.cn: 经济呈现出复苏的迹象。

senses.def: the action or process of getting sth back that has been lost or stolen

ex.en: There is a reward for information leading to the recovery of the missing diamonds.
ex.cn: 凡能为找回丢失的钻石提供线索者可获奖赏。

senses.chn: 整修；给…安装新配件；改装

ex.en: He spent £70 000 refitting his yacht.
ex.cn: 他花了 7 万英镑整修他的游艇。

senses.def: to increase the amount of money that is used in a country, usually in order to increase the demand for goods
senses.chn: 通货再膨胀，通货复胀（增加货币供应以刺激对商品等的需求）

senses.def: to show the image of sb/sth on the surface of sth such as a mirror, water or glass

ex.en: His face was reflected in the mirror.
ex.cn: 他的脸映照在镜子里。

ex.en: She could see herself reflected in his eyes.
ex.cn: 她在他的眼中看到了自己的样子。

senses.def: to throw back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface

ex.en: The windows reflected the bright afternoon sunlight.
ex.cn: 窗户反射着午后明媚的阳光。

ex.en: When the sun's rays hit the earth, a lot of the heat is reflected back into space.
ex.cn: 太阳光线照射到地球时，大量的热被反射回太空。

senses.def: to show or be a sign of the nature of sth or of sb's attitude or feeling
senses.chn: 显示，表明，表达（事物的自然属性或人们的态度、情感等）

ex.en: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.
ex.cn: 本报的宗旨是表达当地人民的心声。

senses.def: to think carefully and deeply about sth

ex.en: Before I decide, I need time to reflect.
ex.cn: 在作出决定以前，我需要时间认真考虑考虑。

ex.en: She was left to reflect on the implications of her decision.
ex.cn: 由她来考虑她这个决定会牵扯哪些问题。

ex.en: On the way home he reflected that the interview had gone well.
ex.cn: 回家的路上，他琢磨着这次面试非常顺利。

ex.en: She reflected how different it could have been.
ex.cn: 她琢磨着那件事本可以有多大的不同。

ex.en: 'It could all have been so different,' she reflected.
ex.cn: “那件事本可以完全不同的。” 她思索着。

senses.def: to make sb/sth appear to be good, bad, etc. to other people
senses.chn: 使给人以好的（或坏的等）印象

ex.en: This incident reflects badly on everyone involved.
ex.cn: 这一事件给所有相关人士都造成了恶劣影响。

senses.def: a measure of how much light is reflected off a surface, considered as a part of the total light that shines onto it
admiration or praise that is given to sb, not because of sth that they have done, but because of sth that sb connected with them has done

ex.en: She basked in the reflected glory of her daughter's success.
ex.cn: 她尽情地享受她女儿的成功带给她的荣耀。

senses.def: an image in a mirror, on a shiny surface, on water, etc.

ex.en: He admired his reflection in the mirror.
ex.cn: 他欣赏着自己在镜中的影像。

senses.def: the action or process of sending back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface
a sign that shows the state or nature of sth

ex.en: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality.
ex.cn: 穿着常常反映出一个人的个性。

ex.en: The increase in crime is a sad reflection on (= shows sth bad about) our society today.
ex.cn: 犯罪的增加令人遗憾地反映了当今社会不太好的一面。

senses.def: careful thought about sth, sometimes over a long period of time

ex.en: She decided on reflection to accept his offer after all.
ex.cn: 经过审慎的思考，她还是决定接受他的提议。

ex.en: A week off would give him time for reflection.
ex.cn: 歇上一周会使他有时间考虑考虑。

senses.def: your written or spoken thoughts about a particular subject or topic

ex.en: a book of her reflections on childhood
ex.cn: 一本关于她童年生活的回忆录

senses.def: an account or a description of sth

ex.en: The article is an accurate reflection of events that day.
ex.cn: 这篇文章准确地记录了那天发生的事。

senses.def: after thinking about sth carefully and for a long time
senses.chn: 经过深思熟虑；经过审慎考虑

senses.def: thinking deeply about things

ex.en: a quiet and reflective man
ex.cn: 文静而爱沉思的男子

senses.def: reflective surfaces send back light or heat
senses.chn: （指物体表面）反射热的，反光的

ex.en: reflective car number plates
ex.cn: 反光的汽车牌照

ex.en: On dark nights children should wear reflective clothing.
ex.cn: 在漆黑的夜晚，儿童应该穿反光的衣服。

senses.def: typical of a particular situation or thing; showing the state or nature of sth
senses.chn: 典型的；代表性的；体现状态（或本质）的

ex.en: His abilities are not reflective of the team as a whole.
ex.cn: 他的能力并不代表整队的水平。

ex.en: Everything you do or say is reflective of your personality.
ex.cn: 你的一言一行都体现你的个性。

senses.def: the degree to which a material reflects light or radiation
a surface that reflects light
a small piece of special glass or plastic that is put on a bicycle, or on clothing, so that it can be seen at night when light shines on it
senses.chn: （夜间光线照射后能反光的）反光玻璃（或塑料），反光体

senses.def: an action or a movement of your body that happens naturally in response to sth and that you cannot control; sth that you do without thinking
senses.chn: 反射动作；本能反应；反射作用

ex.en: The doctor tested her reflexes.
ex.cn: 医生检测了她的反射动作。

ex.en: to have quick/slow reflexes
ex.cn: 反射动作快／慢

ex.en: a reflex response/reaction
ex.cn: 反射性反应

ex.en: Only the goalkeeper's reflexes (= his ability to react quickly) stopped the ball from going in.
ex.cn: 只是因为守门员反应迅速，球才没有进。

ex.en: Almost as a reflex action, I grab my pen as the phone rings.
ex.cn: 几乎是一种本能反应，电话铃一响，我就抓起笔。

senses.def: an angle of more than 180°
a reflexive word or form of a word shows that the action of the verb affects the person who performs the action

ex.en: In 'He cut himself', 'cut' is a reflexive verb and 'himself' is a reflexive pronoun.
ex.cn: 在 He cut himself 一句中，cut 是反身动词，himself 是反身代词。

senses.def: a type of alternative treatment in which sb's feet are rubbed in a particular way in order to heal other parts of their body or to make them feel mentally relaxed
senses.chn: 反射疗法（通过脚部按摩治疗身体其他部位疾病或松弛神经）

senses.def: to make a boat or ship float again, for example after it has become stuck on the bottom in shallow water
a method of joining metals together by heating and melting solder (= a soft metal mixture)
the fact of changing text on a computer screen so that it takes more or less space
senses.chn: 文档重整，页面重排（调整文本在计算机屏幕上的显示密度）

senses.def: to give attention, effort, etc. to sth new or different
senses.chn: 将（注意力、精力等）转向；调整…的重点

ex.en: Policy must refocus on people instead of places.
ex.cn: 政策重心必须改变，针对人而非地方。

ex.en: We need to refocus attention on the real issues facing this country.
ex.cn: 我们需要将注意力转向国家所面临的实际问题。

senses.def: to adapt or be adjusted again so that things can be seen clearly; to adjust sth again so that you can see things clearly
the act of planting new trees in an area where there used to be a forest
to form again or form sth again, especially into a different group or pattern

ex.en: The band is re-forming after 23 years.
ex.cn: 23 年后，这个乐队又在重组。

ex.en: The party has recently been re-formed.
ex.cn: 这个政党最近进行了重新组合。

senses.def: to improve a system, an organization, a law, etc. by making changes to it

ex.en: proposals to reform the social security system
ex.cn: 改革社会保障制度的建议

ex.en: The law needs to be reformed.
ex.cn: 法律需要进行改革。

senses.def: to improve your behaviour; to make sb do this

ex.en: He has promised to reform.
ex.cn: 他许诺要改过自新。

ex.en: She thought she could reform him.
ex.cn: 她觉得她可以使他洗心革面。

senses.def: change that is made to a social system, an organization, etc. in order to improve or correct it

ex.en: a government committed to reform
ex.cn: 致力于改革的政府

ex.en: economic/electoral/constitutional, etc. reform
ex.cn: 经济、选举、宪法等改革

ex.en: the reform of the educational system
ex.cn: 教育体制的改革

ex.en: reforms in education
ex.cn: 教育改革

ex.en: far-reaching/major/sweeping reforms
ex.cn: 意义深远的／重大的／彻底的变革

senses.def: to give a new format to a computer disk
the act of improving or changing sb/sth

new ideas in religion in 16th century Europe that led to attempts to reform the Roman Catholic Church and to the forming of the Protestant Churches; the period of time when these changes were taking place
senses.chn: 宗教改革（欧洲 16 世纪改革天主教从而导致新教的产生）；宗教改革时期

senses.def: a type of school that young criminals are sent to instead of prison
senses.chn: 少年犯管教所；青少年教养院

senses.def: a church that has accepted the principles of the Reformation, especially a Calvinist one
senses.chn: （基督教）新教教会归正会，归正宗（尤指加尔文教派）

senses.def: a person who works to achieve political or social change
wanting or trying to change political or social situations
senses.chn: 主张改革的；改革派的；改良主义的

senses.def: to create or prepare sth again

ex.en: It is never too late to reformulate your goals.
ex.cn: 重订目标决不会为时过晚。

senses.def: to say or express sth in a different way

ex.en: Let me try to reformulate the problem.
ex.cn: 让我换个说法讲这个问题吧。

senses.def: to make waves, such as those of light, sound or energy, change direction when they go through at an angle
senses.chn: 使（光波、声波、能量波等）折射；使产生折射

ex.en: Light is refracted when passed through a prism.
ex.cn: 光通过棱镜时产生折射。

senses.def: causing, caused by or relating to refraction
a measurement of how much an object or a substance refracts light
an instrument for measuring a refractive index
something such as a lens which refracts light (= causes it to change direction)
difficult to control; behaving badly
senses.chn: 难以驾驭的；行为乖戾的

senses.def: difficult to treat or cure
senses.chn: 难以诊治的；难以治愈的

senses.def: to stop yourself from doing sth, especially sth that you want to do

ex.en: Please refrain from smoking.
ex.cn: 请勿吸烟。

ex.en: He has refrained from criticizing the government in public.
ex.cn: 他克制住了自己，没有在公开场合批评政府。

senses.def: a comment or complaint that is often repeated
senses.chn: 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）

ex.en: Complaints about poor food in schools have become a familiar refrain.
ex.cn: 抱怨学校饭菜差已是耳熟能详的老调了。

senses.def: the part of a song or a poem that is repeated after each verse
to make sb feel less tired or less hot

ex.en: The long sleep had refreshed her.
ex.cn: 一场酣睡使她重又精力充沛。

ex.en: He refreshed himself with a cool shower.
ex.cn: 他冲了个凉水澡凉快凉快。

senses.def: to fill sb's glass or cup again

ex.en: Let me refresh your glass.
ex.cn: 我给你再斟一杯吧。

senses.def: to remind yourself/sb of sth, especially with the help of sth that can be seen or heard

ex.en: He had to refresh his memory by looking at his notes.
ex.cn: 他不得不靠看笔记来提醒自己。

senses.def: to make the most recent information show, for example on an Internet page

ex.en: Click here to refresh this document.
ex.cn: 点击此处以刷新文件。

ex.en: The page refreshes automatically.
ex.cn: 页面会自动更新。

senses.def: a short period of training to improve your skills or to teach you about new ideas and developments in your job
pleasantly new or different
senses.chn: 令人耳目一新的；别具一格的

ex.en: It made a refreshing change to be taken seriously for once.
ex.cn: 总算有一次受到认真对待，这变化真是令人耳目一新。

senses.def: making you feel less tired or hot
senses.chn: 使人精力充沛的；使人凉爽的

ex.en: a refreshing drink/shower
ex.cn: 提神的饮料／淋浴

senses.def: drinks and small amounts of food that are provided or sold to people in a public place or at a public event
senses.chn: （在公共活动场所供应或销售的）饮料，小食

ex.en: Light refreshments will be served during the break.
ex.cn: 中间休息时有点心供应。

senses.def: food and drink

ex.en: In York we had a short stop for refreshment.
ex.cn: 在约克，我们稍作停留，吃了点东西。

ex.en: Can we offer you some refreshment?
ex.cn: 您要吃点什么吗？

ex.en: a refreshment room/kiosk/tent
ex.cn: 小吃部；饮食亭；活动小吃摊

ex.en: liquid refreshment (= alcoholic drink)
ex.cn: 酒

senses.def: the fact of making sb feel stronger or less tired or hot

ex.en: a place to rest and find refreshment for mind and body
ex.cn: 休息和恢复身心活力的场所

senses.def: beans that have been boiled and fried in advance and are heated again when needed, used especially in Mexican cooking
to make food, etc. cold in order to keep it fresh or preserve it

ex.en: Once opened, this product should be kept refrigerated.
ex.cn: 本产品开封后应冷藏。

ex.en: a refrigerated lorry/truck
ex.cn: 冷藏卡车

senses.def: to fill sth, especially a plane, with fuel in order to continue a journey; to be filled with fuel
senses.chn: （尤指给飞机）补充燃料，加燃料；加油

ex.en: to refuel a plane
ex.cn: 给飞机加油

ex.en: The planes needed to refuel before the next mission.
ex.cn: 这些飞机需要添加燃料才能再次飞行。

ex.en: a refuelling stop
ex.cn: 加油停留

senses.def: shelter or protection from danger, trouble, etc.

ex.en: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
ex.cn: 又有 300 人在美国大使馆避难。

ex.en: They were forced to seek refuge from the fighting.
ex.cn: 他们被迫寻求庇护，以躲避战争。

ex.en: a place of refuge
ex.cn: 避难所

ex.en: As the situation at home got worse she increasingly took refuge in her work.
ex.cn: 随着家庭情况的恶化，她越来越在工作中寻求慰藉。

senses.def: a place, person or thing that provides shelter or protection for sb/sth

ex.en: He regarded the room as a refuge from the outside world.
ex.cn: 他把这个屋子当作是逃避外界的避难所。

ex.en: a wetland refuge for birds
ex.cn: 湿地鸟类保护区

senses.def: a building that provides a temporary home for people in need of shelter or protection from sb/sth

ex.en: a women's refuge
ex.cn: 妇女收容所

ex.en: a refuge for the homeless
ex.cn: 无家可归者的收容所

senses.def: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons

ex.en: a steady flow of refugees from the war zone
ex.cn: 从交战地区不断涌出的难民

ex.en: political/economic refugees
ex.cn: 政治避难者；由于经济危机而造成的难民

ex.en: a refugee camp
ex.cn: 难民营

senses.def: very bright
a sum of money that is paid back to you, especially because you paid too much or because you returned goods to a shop/store

ex.en: a tax refund
ex.cn: 税金退款

ex.en: to claim/demand/receive a refund
ex.cn: 要求／接受退款

ex.en: If there is a delay of 12 hours or more, you will receive a full refund of the price of your trip.
ex.cn: 如果耽搁达到或超过 12 小时，你会得到旅费全额退款。

senses.def: to give sb their money back, especially because they have paid too much or because they are not satisfied with sth they bought

ex.en: Tickets cannot be exchanged or money refunded.
ex.cn: 门票不可退换。

ex.en: We will refund your money to you in full if you are not entirely satisfied.
ex.cn: 如果你并不感到完全满意，我们会退还全部金额。

ex.en: We will refund you your money in full.
ex.cn: 我们会给你全额退款。

senses.def: to clean and decorate a room, building, etc. in order to make it more attractive, more useful, etc.
an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept sth

ex.en: the refusal of a request/an invitation/an offer
ex.cn: 拒绝请求／邀请／建议

ex.en: a blunt/flat/curt refusal
ex.cn: 率直的／断然的／粗率的拒绝

ex.en: His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.
ex.cn: 他拒绝商量这件事，令人很恼火。

senses.def: to say that you will not do sth that sb has asked you to do

ex.en: Go on, ask her; she can hardly refuse.
ex.cn: 去吧，去求她，她不大可能拒绝。

ex.en: He flatly refused to discuss the matter.
ex.cn: 他断然拒绝商讨这件事。

ex.en: She refused to accept that there was a problem.
ex.cn: 她拒不承认有问题存在。

senses.def: to say that you do not want sth that has been offered to you

ex.en: I politely refused their invitation.
ex.cn: 我礼貌地回绝了他们的邀请。

ex.en: The job offer was simply too good to refuse.
ex.cn: 这个工作机会太好了，简直无法推掉。

senses.def: to say that you will not allow sth; to say that you will not give or allow sb sth that they want or need
senses.chn: 不准许；拒绝给（所需之物）

ex.en: The bank refused his demand for a full refund.
ex.cn: 银行拒绝了他全额退款的要求。

ex.en: The authorities refused permission for the new housing development.
ex.cn: 当局不允许新住宅开发。

ex.en: They refused him a visa.
ex.cn: 他们拒绝给他签证。

ex.en: She would never refuse her kids anything.
ex.cn: 她对孩子百依百顺。

senses.def: waste material that has been thrown away

ex.en: domestic/household refuse
ex.cn: 生活垃圾

ex.en: the city refuse dump
ex.cn: 城市垃圾场

ex.en: refuse collection/disposal
ex.cn: 垃圾收集／处理

senses.def: a person who refuses to obey an order or law as a protest
senses.chn: 拒绝服从指令（或法规）的人；反抗者；抗议者

senses.def: to prove that sth is wrong

ex.en: to refute an argument/a theory, etc.
ex.cn: 驳斥一个论点、理论等

senses.def: to say that sth is not true or fair

ex.en: She refutes any suggestion that she behaved unprofessionally.
ex.cn: 谁要是表示她不在行，她都予以反驳。

senses.def: registration

ex.en: a V reg car (= a car with 'V' in its registration number, showing the year that it was registered)
ex.cn: 汽车牌照号码含 V 的汽车

senses.def: to get back sth you no longer have, especially an ability or a quality
senses.chn: 重新获得，恢复（能力或品质等）

ex.en: I struggled to regain some dignity.
ex.cn: 我努力恢复自己的一点儿尊严。

ex.en: The party has regained control of the region.
ex.cn: 这一政党重新获得了这个地区的控制权。

ex.en: She paused on the edge, trying to regain her balance.
ex.cn: 她在边缘上暂停下来，努力恢复平衡。

ex.en: He did not regain consciousness (= wake up after being unconscious) for several days.
ex.cn: 他好几天都没有恢复知觉。

senses.def: to get back to a place that you have left

ex.en: They finally managed to regain the beach.
ex.cn: 他们最后终于回到了海滩。

senses.def: typical of a king or queen, and therefore impressive

ex.en: regal power
ex.cn: 王权

ex.en: the regal splendour of the palace
ex.cn: 帝王宫殿之豪华气派

ex.en: She dismissed him with a regal gesture.
ex.cn: 她像女王般挥手打发他离开。

senses.def: to amuse or entertain sb with stories, jokes, etc.
senses.chn: （通过讲故事或说笑话等）使愉悦，使高兴

ex.en: He regaled us with tales of his days as a jazz pianist.
ex.cn: 他给我们讲述他当爵士乐钢琴师时的事，逗我们开心。

senses.def: to amuse or entertain sb with stories, jokes, etc.
senses.chn: （通过讲故事或说笑话等）使愉悦，使高兴

ex.en: He regaled us with tales of his days as a jazz pianist.
ex.cn: 他给我们讲述他当爵士乐钢琴师时的事，逗我们开心。

senses.def: the special clothes that are worn or objects that are carried at official ceremonies
senses.chn: （正式场合上的）特别服饰，特别物品

senses.def: to think about sb/sth in a particular way

ex.en: Her work is very highly regarded.
ex.cn: 她的工作受到高度评价。

ex.en: Capital punishment was regarded as inhuman and immoral.
ex.cn: 死刑过去被认为是非人道且不道德的。

ex.en: He regards himself as a patriot.
ex.cn: 他自认为是个爱国者。

ex.en: She is widely regarded as the current leader's natural successor.
ex.cn: 人们普遍认为她是现任领导的当然继任者。

ex.en: He seemed to regard the whole thing as a joke.
ex.cn: 他似乎是把整件事当成玩笑。

ex.en: I wouldn't call German an easy language.
ex.cn: 我并不认为德语是一门容易学的语言。

senses.def: to look at sb/sth, especially in a particular way

ex.en: He regarded us suspiciously.
ex.cn: 他以怀疑的眼光看着我们。

senses.def: concerning or in connection with sb/sth

ex.en: I have little information as regards her fitness for the post.
ex.cn: 至于说她是否适合这个职位，我无可奉告。

ex.en: As regards the first point in your letter…
ex.cn: 关于你信中所提到的第一点…

senses.def: attention to or thought and care for sb/sth

ex.en: to do sth with scant/little/no regard for sb/sth
ex.cn: 做事不怎么／几乎不／根本不顾及某人／某事物

ex.en: to have/pay/show little regard for other people's property
ex.cn: 不大爱惜别人的财物

ex.en: He was driving without regard to speed limits.
ex.cn: 他开着车，根本不理会速度限制。

ex.en: Social services should pay proper regard to the needs of inner-city areas.
ex.cn: 社会服务机构应该对市中心贫民区的需求给予应有的关注。

senses.def: respect or admiration for sb

ex.en: He held her in high regard (= had a good opinion of her).
ex.cn: 他对她非常敬重。

ex.en: I had great regard for his abilities.
ex.cn: 我非常敬佩他的能力。

senses.def: used to send good wishes to sb at the end of a letter, or when asking sb to give your good wishes to another person who is not present
senses.chn: （用于信函结尾或转达问候）致意，问候

ex.en: With kind regards, Yours…
ex.cn: 谨此致意，…敬上

ex.en: Give your brother my regards when you see him.
ex.cn: 看到你哥哥时，代我向他问好。

senses.def: to remember and think carefully about sth

ex.en: It is always necessary to have regard to the terms of the contract.
ex.cn: 记住合同条款总是必要的。

senses.def: concerning what has just been mentioned

ex.en: I have nothing further to say in this regard.
ex.cn: 在这方面，我没什么要说的了。

senses.def: concerning sb/sth

ex.en: a country's laws in regard to human rights
ex.cn: 一个国家关于人权的法律

ex.en: The company's position with regard to overtime is made clear in their contracts.
ex.cn: 公司关于加班的立场在合同中有明确说明。

senses.def: used when you are referring to sth

ex.en: As to tax, that will be deducted from your salary.
ex.cn: 至于税款，将从你薪水中扣除。

senses.def: concerning sb/sth; about sb/sth

ex.en: She has said nothing regarding your request.
ex.cn: 关于你的要求，她什么也没说。

ex.en: Call me if you have any problems regarding your work.
ex.cn: 你如果还有什么工作方面的问题就给我打电话。

senses.def: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties

ex.en: The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless.
ex.cn: 天气非常恶劣，但我们并不理会，照常进行。

senses.def: paying no attention to sth/sb; treating sth/sb as not being important

ex.en: The club welcomes all new members regardless of age.
ex.cn: 俱乐部对所有新成员不分年龄一律欢迎。

ex.en: He went ahead and did it, regardless of the consequences.
ex.cn: 他说干就干了，没有考虑后果。

ex.en: The amount will be paid to everyone regardless of whether they have children or not.
ex.cn: 不管有没有孩子，每个人都会得到相同的金额。

senses.def: a sporting event in which races between rowing boats or sailing boats are held
senses.chn: 赛艇会；划船比赛；帆船比赛

senses.def: a period of government by a regent (= a person who rules a country in place of the king or queen)
to make an area, institution, etc. develop and grow strong again
senses.chn: 使振兴；使复兴；发展壮大

ex.en: The money will be used to regenerate the commercial heart of the town.
ex.cn: 这笔钱将用来重振市镇的商业中心。

senses.def: to grow again; to make sth grow again

ex.en: Once destroyed, brain cells do not regenerate.
ex.cn: 脑细胞一旦遭到破坏，就不能再生。

ex.en: If the woodland is left alone, it will regenerate itself in a few years.
ex.cn: 如果林地不受干扰，几年后就会再生。

senses.def: a person who rules a country because the king or queen is too young, old, ill/sick, etc.

ex.en: to act as regent
ex.cn: 担任摄政王

senses.def: a type of popular music with strong rhythms, developed in Jamaica in the 1960s
senses.chn: 雷盖乐（20 世纪 60 年代于牙买加兴起的一种节奏强劲的流行音乐）

senses.def: a type of dance music, developed in Puerto Rico in the 1980s, which is a mixture of reggae, salsa and hip hop or rap, and which often includes words that are sung or spoken in Spanish
senses.chn: 雷鬼顿（混合雷盖乐、萨尔萨舞曲和嘻哈或说唱乐的一种舞曲，20 世纪 80 年代兴起于波多黎各，常包含西班牙语唱词或说唱）

senses.def: the crime of killing a king or queen; a person who is guilty of this crime
a method or system of government, especially one that has not been elected in a fair way
senses.chn: （尤指未通过公正选举的）统治方式，统治制度，政权，政体

ex.en: a fascist/totalitarian/military, etc. regime
ex.cn: 法西斯、极权主义、军事等政权

ex.en: an oppressive/brutal regime
ex.cn: 压迫民众的／残暴的政权

senses.def: a method or system of organizing or managing sth

ex.en: Our tax regime is one of the most favourable in Europe.
ex.cn: 我们的税收管理体制是欧洲最受欢迎的税收体制之一。

senses.def: a set of rules about food and exercise or medical treatment that you follow in order to stay healthy or to improve your health
senses.chn: 生活规则；养生之道；养生法

senses.def: a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel
a large number of people or things
connected with a particular regiment of soldiers

ex.en: a regimental flag
ex.cn: 团旗

ex.en: regimental headquarters
ex.cn: 团部

senses.def: involving strict discipline and/or organization

ex.en: The school imposes a very regimented lifestyle on its students.
ex.cn: 学校将非常死板的生活方式强加给学生。

senses.def: arranged in strict groups, patterns, etc.
senses.chn: 严格规划的；排列整齐的

ex.en: regimented lines of trees
ex.cn: 排列整齐的树木

senses.def: a word meaning 'queen', used, for example, in the titles of legal cases which are brought by the state when there is a queen in Britain
senses.chn: 女王（英国女王在位时用于政府诉讼案案目等）

ex.en: Regina v Jones
ex.cn: 女王诉琼斯案

senses.def: the capital city of the Canadian province of Saskatchewan, situated in central Canada
senses.chn: 里贾纳（加拿大萨斯喀彻温省首府，位于加拿大中部）

senses.def: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders
senses.chn: （通常界限不明的）地区，区域，地方

ex.en: the Arctic/tropical/desert, etc. regions
ex.cn: 北极、热带、沙漠等地区

ex.en: one of the most densely populated regions of North America
ex.cn: 北美人口最为稠密的地区之一

senses.def: one of the areas that a country is divided into, that has its own customs and/or its own government

ex.en: the Basque region of Spain
ex.cn: 西班牙的巴斯克自治区

senses.def: all of a country except the capital city
senses.chn: （一国除首都以外的）全部地区，所有区域

senses.def: a part of the body, usually one that has a particular character or problem
senses.chn: （通常指有某种特性或问题的）身体部位

ex.en: pains in the abdominal region
ex.cn: 腹部的疼痛

senses.def: used when you are giving a number, price, etc. to show that it is not exact
senses.chn: （表示不确切的数字等）大约，差不多

ex.en: He earns somewhere in the region of €50 000.
ex.cn: 他大约赚 5 万欧元。

senses.def: of or relating to a region

ex.en: regional variations in pronunciation
ex.cn: 发音的地区差异

ex.en: the conflict between regional and national interests
ex.cn: 地方利益和国家利益的冲突

ex.en: regional councils/elections/newspapers
ex.cn: 地方议会／选举／报纸

senses.def: a feature of a language that exists in a particular part of a country, and is not part of the standard language
the desire of the people who live in a particular region of a country to have more political and economic independence
senses.chn: 地方分权主义；地域主义

senses.def: to record your/sb's/sth's name on an official list

ex.en: to register a birth/marriage/death
ex.cn: 登记出生／结婚／死亡

ex.en: to register a company/trademark
ex.cn: 注册公司／商标

ex.en: The ship was registered in Panama.
ex.cn: 这艘船是在巴拿马注册的。

ex.en: She is officially registered (as) disabled.
ex.cn: 她正式登记为伤残者。

ex.en: to register with a doctor
ex.cn: 向医生登记

ex.en: to register at a hotel
ex.cn: 在旅馆登记

senses.def: to make your opinion known officially or publicly
senses.chn: （正式地或公开地）发表意见，提出主张

ex.en: China has registered a protest over foreign intervention.
ex.cn: 中国对外国干涉正式提出了抗议。

senses.def: if a measuring instrument registers an amount or sth registers an amount on a measuring instrument, the instrument shows or records that amount

ex.en: The thermometer registered 32°C.
ex.cn: 温度计显示读数为 32 摄氏度。

ex.en: The earthquake registered 3 on the Richter scale.
ex.cn: 地震震级为里氏 3 级。

ex.en: The stock exchange has registered huge losses this week.
ex.cn: 本周证券交易遭到重创。

senses.def: to show or express a feeling

ex.en: Her face registered disapproval.
ex.cn: 她脸上流露出不赞同的神色。

ex.en: Shock registered on everyone's face.
ex.cn: 人人都面露震惊之色。

senses.def: to notice sth and remember it; to be noticed

ex.en: He barely registered our presence.
ex.cn: 他几乎没有注意到我们在场。

ex.en: I told her my name, but it obviously didn't register.
ex.cn: 我把名字告诉了她，但她显然没有在意。

senses.def: to send sth by mail, paying extra money to protect it against loss or damage

ex.en: Can I register this, please?
ex.cn: 请给我把这个挂号邮寄。

ex.en: a registered letter
ex.cn: 挂号信

senses.def: an official list or record of names, items, etc.; a book that contains such a list

ex.en: a parish register (= of births, marriages and deaths)
ex.cn: 教区登记簿

ex.en: to be on the electoral register/register of voters
ex.cn: 成为登记在册的选民

ex.en: Could you sign the hotel register please, sir?
ex.cn: 先生，请在旅馆登记簿上签字好吗？

ex.en: The teacher called the register (= checked who was present at school).
ex.cn: 老师点了名。

senses.def: the range, or part of a range, of a human voice or a musical instrument

ex.en: in the upper/middle/lower register
ex.cn: 在高／中／低声区

senses.def: the level and style of a piece of writing or speech, that is usually appropriate to the situation that it is used in
senses.chn: （适合特定场合使用的）语体风格；语域

ex.en: The essay suddenly switches from a formal to an informal register.
ex.cn: 这篇文章的语体风格突然从正式转为非正式。

senses.def: an opening, with a cover that you can have open or shut, that allows hot or cold air from a heating or cooling system into a room
senses.chn: （供暖或制冷设备的）调风口，节气门，百叶型风口

senses.def: a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it can claim money if it arrives late or is lost or damaged
a nurse who has a degree in nursing and who has passed an exam to be allowed to work in a particular state
a nurse who has an official qualification
senses.chn: （获得正式资格的）注册护士；合格的护士

senses.def: the sign or name of a product, etc. that is officially recorded and protected so that nobody else can use it
the official way of referring to a registry office
a person whose job is to keep official records, especially of births, marriages and deaths
the senior officer who organizes the affairs of a college or university
senses.chn: （大学的）教务长，教务主任，注册主任

senses.def: a doctor working in a British hospital who is training to become a specialist in a particular area of medicine

ex.en: a paediatric registrar
ex.cn: 儿科住院医生

senses.def: the act of making an official record of sth/sb

ex.en: the registration of letters and parcels
ex.cn: 信件和包裹的挂号

ex.en: the registration of students for a course
ex.cn: 学生的选课登记

ex.en: registration fees
ex.cn: 注册费

ex.en: vehicle registrations
ex.cn: 车辆登记

ex.en: the registration of a child's birth
ex.cn: 婴儿出生登记

senses.def: a document showing that an official record has been made of sth
the time when a teacher looks at the list of students on the class register and checks that the students are present
the series of letters and numbers that are shown on a number plate at the front and back of a vehicle to identify it
senses.chn: 车辆的登记号码；牌照号码

senses.def: a place where registers are kept
(in Britain) a place where civil marriages (= that do not involve a religious ceremony) are performed and where records of births, marriages and deaths are made
senses.chn: 户籍登记处（在英国可举办不涉及宗教仪式的婚礼，并负责登记出生及婚丧等事项）

ex.en: to get married in/at a registry office
ex.cn: 在户籍登记处登记结婚

senses.def: a registration for a car, etc.
to return to an earlier or less advanced form or way of behaving
the process of going back to an earlier or less advanced form or state
becoming or making sth less advanced

ex.en: The policy has been condemned as a regressive step.
ex.cn: 这项政策被认为是一种倒退而受到谴责。

senses.def: having less effect on the rich than on the poor
senses.chn: 递减的（对富人的影响比对穷人的小）

senses.def: to feel sorry about sth you have done or about sth that you have not been able to do

ex.en: If you don't do it now, you'll only regret it.
ex.cn: 你如果现在不做，以后一定会后悔的。

ex.en: The decision could be one he lives to regret.
ex.cn: 这一决定也许会有让他后悔的一天。

ex.en: 'I've had a wonderful life,' she said, 'I don't regret a thing.'
ex.cn: “我一辈子生活得很好，” 她说，“我没什么可遗憾的。”

ex.en: He bitterly regretted ever having mentioned it.
ex.cn: 他非常懊悔提起那件事。

ex.en: I deeply regret what I said.
ex.cn: 我非常后悔说了那些话。

ex.en: I regret that I never got to meet him in person.
ex.cn: 很遗憾我始终没能见到他本人。

senses.def: used to say in a polite or formal way that you are sorry or sad about a situation
senses.chn: （有礼貌地或正式地表示抱歉、痛惜或悲伤）

ex.en: The airline regrets any inconvenience.
ex.cn: 航空公司对所造成的任何不便表示歉意。

ex.en: I regret that I am unable to accept your kind invitation.
ex.cn: 很遗憾，我不能接受你的友好邀请。

ex.en: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful.
ex.cn: 我们很遗憾地通知您，您的申请未获通过。

ex.en: It is to be regretted that so many young people leave school without qualifications.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是那么多年轻人肄业离校。

senses.def: a feeling of sadness or disappointment that you have because of sth that has happened or sth that you have done or not done

ex.en: It is with great regret that I accept your resignation.
ex.cn: 接受你的辞呈，我感到非常遗憾。

ex.en: She expressed her regret at the decision.
ex.cn: 她对这个决定表示失望。

ex.en: a pang/twinge of regret
ex.cn: 一阵痛悔之情

ex.en: I have no regrets about leaving Newcastle (= I do not feel sorry about it).
ex.cn: 我一点也不后悔离开纽卡斯尔。

ex.en: What is your greatest regret (= the thing that you are most sorry about doing or not doing)?
ex.cn: 你最大的遗憾是什么？

ex.en: He gave up teaching in 2009, much to the regret of his students.
ex.cn: 他于 2009 年放弃了教学，这使他的学生深感遗憾。

senses.def: feeling or showing sadness or disappointment because of sth that has happened or sth that you have done or not done
senses.chn: 后悔的；失望的；令人惋惜的；遗憾的

ex.en: a regretful look
ex.cn: 失望的眼神

senses.def: in a way that shows you are sad or disappointed about sth
senses.chn: 遗憾地；痛惜地；失望地；懊悔地

ex.en: 'I'm afraid not,' he said regretfully.
ex.cn: 他遗憾地说：“恐怕不行。”

ex.en: Emma shook her head regretfully.
ex.cn: 埃玛遗憾地摇了摇头。

senses.def: used to show that you are sorry that sth is the case and you wish the situation were different

ex.en: Regretfully, mounting costs have forced the museum to close.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是，成本不断增加，博物馆不得不关闭。

ex.en: Regretfully, some jobs will be lost.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是有些人将会失去工作。

ex.en: Regrettably, some jobs will be lost.
ex.cn: 令人遗憾的是有些人将会失去工作。

ex.en: He sighed regretfully.
ex.cn: 他懊丧地叹了口气。

senses.def: that you are sorry about and wish had not happened
senses.chn: 令人惋惜的；可惜的；令人遗憾的

ex.en: It is regrettable that the police were not informed sooner.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是没有早些报警。

ex.en: The loss of jobs is highly regrettable.
ex.cn: 失去工作非常令人遗憾。

senses.def: to arrange the way people or soldiers work together in a new way, especially in order to continue fighting or attacking sb

ex.en: They regrouped their forces and renewed the attack.
ex.cn: 他们重新聚集兵力，再次发动进攻。

ex.en: After its election defeat, the party needs to regroup.
ex.cn: 选举失败后，这个党需要改组。

senses.def: to return to a normal state after an unpleasant experience or a period of difficulty, and become ready to make an effort again with new enthusiasm or strength

ex.en: Summer is a time to relax, regroup and catch up on all those things you've been putting off all year.
ex.cn: 夏天是休养整顿、处理一年中积压事务的时候。

senses.def: following a pattern, especially with the same time or space in between each thing and the next
senses.chn: 规则的；有规律的；间隙均匀的；定时的

ex.en: regular breathing
ex.cn: 均匀的呼吸

ex.en: a regular pulse/heartbeat
ex.cn: 正常的脉搏／心跳

ex.en: A light flashed at regular intervals.
ex.cn: 一盏灯有规律地闪着亮光。

ex.en: There is a regular bus service to the airport.
ex.cn: 有公共汽车定时开往机场。

ex.en: regular meetings/visits
ex.cn: 定期会议／访问

ex.en: The equipment is checked on a regular basis.
ex.cn: 设备定期进行检查。

senses.def: done or happening often
senses.chn: 频繁的；经常做（或发生）的

ex.en: Do you take regular exercise?
ex.cn: 你经常锻炼吗？

ex.en: Domestic violence is a regular occurrence in some families.
ex.cn: 在某些家庭中，家庭暴力是常事。

senses.def: doing the same thing or going to the same place often
senses.chn: 经常做某事的；常去某地的

ex.en: our regular customers
ex.cn: 老主顾

ex.en: regular offenders (= against the law)
ex.cn: 惯犯

ex.en: He was a regular visitor to her house.
ex.cn: 他是她家的常客。

senses.def: usual

ex.en: I couldn't see my regular doctor today.
ex.cn: 我今天找不到平常给我看病的医生。

ex.en: On Monday he would have to return to his regular duties.
ex.cn: 星期一，他就得回去正常上班了。

ex.en: It's important to follow the regular procedure.
ex.cn: 按照惯常的程序行事是很重要的。

senses.def: having an even shape

ex.en: a face with regular features
ex.cn: 五官端正的脸庞

ex.en: a regular geometric pattern
ex.cn: 正几何图形

senses.def: lasting or happening over a long period

ex.en: a regular income
ex.cn: 固定的收入

ex.en: She couldn't find any regular employment.
ex.cn: 她找不到任何固定工作。

senses.def: of a standard size
senses.chn: 标准尺寸的；中等大小的；中号的

ex.en: Regular or large fries?
ex.cn: 中号的还是大号的炸薯条？

senses.def: ordinary; without any special or extra features

ex.en: Do you want regular or diet cola?
ex.cn: 你要普通的还是低热量的可乐？

ex.en: He's just a regular guy who loves his dog.
ex.cn: 他也不过是个十分疼爱自己狗儿的平凡人。

senses.def: belonging to or connected with the permanent armed forces or police force of a country

ex.en: a regular army/soldier
ex.cn: 正规军；正规军士兵

senses.def: changing their form in the same way as most other verbs and nouns

ex.en: The past participle of regular verbs ends in '-ed'.
ex.cn: 规则动词的过去分词以 -ed 结尾。

senses.def: used for emphasis to show that sb/sth is an exact or clear example of the thing mentioned

ex.en: The whole thing was a regular disaster.
ex.cn: 整个事情完全是一场灾难。

senses.def: very regularly; happening at the same time in the same way

ex.en: He is home by six every day, regular as clockwork.
ex.cn: 他每天 6 点前必定准时回到家。

senses.def: a customer who often goes to a particular shop/store, pub, restaurant, etc.

ex.en: He's one of our regulars.
ex.cn: 他是我们的一位老主顾。

senses.def: a person who often plays in a particular team, takes part in a particular television show, etc.
senses.chn: 主力（或正式）队员；（电视节目的）常任主持人；经常参加某项活动的人

ex.en: We are missing six first-team regulars because of injury.
ex.cn: 我们有六位一线主力队员因伤不能出场。

senses.def: a professional soldier who belongs to a country's permanent army
the fact that the same thing happens again and again, and usually with the same length of time between each time it happens

ex.en: Aircraft passed overhead with monotonous regularity.
ex.cn: 飞机一次又一次反复从头顶飞过。

senses.def: the fact that sth is arranged in an even way or in an organized pattern
senses.chn: 匀称；端正；有规则的分布

ex.en: the striking regularity of her features
ex.cn: 她的五官非常端正

senses.def: a thing that has a pattern to it
senses.chn: 有规则的东西；有规律的事物

ex.en: They had observed regularities in the behaviour of the animals.
ex.cn: 他们曾观察过这些动物的习性。

senses.def: to make a situation that already exists legal or official

ex.en: Illegal immigrants were given the opportunity to regularize their position.
ex.cn: 非法移民得到了使其身份合法化的机会。

senses.def: at regular intervals or times

ex.en: We meet regularly to discuss the progress of the project.
ex.cn: 我们定期会面，讨论工程进展情况。

senses.def: often

ex.en: I go there quite regularly.
ex.cn: 我经常去那儿。

senses.def: in an even or balanced way

ex.en: The plants were spaced regularly, about 50 cm apart.
ex.cn: 这些植株分布均匀，间距大约为 50 厘米。

senses.def: to control sth by means of rules

ex.en: The activities of credit companies are regulated by law.
ex.cn: 信贷公司的业务受法律的制约。

ex.en: It is up to the regulating authority to put the measures into effect.
ex.cn: 应该由管理部门落实这些措施。

senses.def: to control the speed, pressure, temperature, etc. in a machine or system
senses.chn: 调节，控制（速度、压力、温度等）

ex.en: This valve regulates the flow of water.
ex.cn: 这个阀门调节水流。

senses.def: an official rule made by a government or some other authority
senses.chn: 章程；规章制度；规则；法规

ex.en: too many rules and regulations
ex.cn: 过多的规章制度

ex.en: fire/safety/building, etc. regulations
ex.cn: 防火条例、安全规章、建筑法规等

ex.en: to comply with the regulations
ex.cn: 遵守章程

ex.en: Under the new regulations spending on office equipment will be strictly controlled.
ex.cn: 根据新的规定，办公设备开支将受到严格控制。

ex.en: the strict regulations governing the sale of weapons
ex.cn: 关于武器销售的严格规定

senses.def: controlling sth by means of rules

ex.en: the voluntary regulation of the press
ex.cn: 新闻出版业的自律

senses.def: that must be worn or used according to the official rules
senses.chn: 规定的；必须穿戴的；必须使用的

ex.en: in regulation uniform
ex.cn: 穿着规定的制服

senses.def: a person or an organization that officially controls an area of business or industry and makes sure that it is operating fairly
senses.chn: （某行业等的）监管者，监管机构

senses.def: a device that automatically controls sth such as speed, temperature or pressure
senses.chn: （速度、温度、压力的）自动调节器

senses.def: having the power to control an area of business or industry and make sure that it is operating fairly
senses.chn: （对工商业）具有监管权的，监管的

ex.en: regulatory bodies/authorities/agencies
ex.cn: 监管部门／机构

senses.def: to bring food that has been swallowed back up into the mouth again
senses.chn: 使（咽下的食物）返回到口中；反刍

senses.def: to repeat sth you have heard or read without really thinking about it or understanding it
the process of helping to cure sb who has a problem with drugs or alcohol

ex.en: to go into rehab
ex.cn: 进行康复治疗

ex.en: a rehab clinic
ex.cn: 康复诊所

senses.def: to help sb to have a normal, useful life again after they have been very ill/sick or in prison for a long time
senses.chn: 使（重病患者）康复；使（长期服刑者）恢复正常生活

ex.en: a unit for rehabilitating drug addicts
ex.cn: 帮助吸毒者恢复正常生活的机构

senses.def: to begin to consider that sb is good or acceptable after a long period during which they were considered bad or unacceptable
senses.chn: 恢复…的名誉；给…平反昭雪

ex.en: He played a major role in rehabilitating Magritte as an artist.
ex.cn: 他对恢复玛格里特艺术家的名誉起了重要的作用。

senses.def: to return a building or an area to its previous good condition
senses.chn: 使（建筑物或地区）恢复原状；修复

senses.def: to arrange ideas, pieces of writing or pieces of film into a new form but without any great change or improvement
senses.chn: （稍微改动）重新推出；以新形式表达旧内容

ex.en: He just rehashes songs from the 60s.
ex.cn: 他只是把 60 年代的歌曲稍加改编而已。

senses.def: to hear or consider again a case in court
an opportunity for a case to be heard or considered again in court
time that is spent practising a play or piece of music in preparation for a public performance

ex.en: to have a rehearsal
ex.cn: 进行排练

ex.en: We only had six days of rehearsal.
ex.cn: 我们只有六天的排练时间。

ex.en: Our new production of 'Hamlet' is currently in rehearsal.
ex.cn: 我们的新版《哈姆雷特》正在排练之中。

ex.en: a rehearsal room
ex.cn: 排练房

senses.def: an experience or event that helps to prepare you for sth that is going to happen in the future

ex.en: These training exercises are designed to be a rehearsal for the invasion.
ex.cn: 这些训练是为了入侵而进行的演习。

senses.def: the act of repeating sth that has been said before

ex.en: We listened to his lengthy rehearsal of the arguments.
ex.cn: 我们听着他没完没了地重复他的论点。

senses.def: (especially in North America) a special meal after the practice for a marriage ceremony, usually held the night before the wedding
senses.chn: （尤指北美国家的）婚礼彩排晚宴

senses.def: to practise or make people practise a play, piece of music, etc. in preparation for a public performance

ex.en: We were given only two weeks to rehearse.
ex.cn: 只给了我们两个星期排练。

ex.en: Today, we'll just be rehearsing the final scene.
ex.cn: 今天，我们只排演最后一幕。

ex.en: The actors were poorly rehearsed.
ex.cn: 演员排练得不够。

senses.def: to prepare in your mind or practise privately what you are going to do or say to sb

ex.en: She walked along rehearsing her excuse for being late.
ex.cn: 她一边走一边默诵着她迟到的托辞。

senses.def: to repeat ideas or opinions that have often been expressed before
to heat cooked food again after it has been left to go cold
to find a new owner for a pet, especially a dog or cat, usually after caring for it for a time

ex.en: The organization rescues stray dogs and rehomes them.
ex.cn: 这个组织救助流浪狗，并给它们找新主人。

senses.def: to provide sb with a different home to live in

ex.en: Thousands of earthquake victims are still waiting to be rehoused.
ex.cn: 数千名地震灾民仍在等待安排新住处。

senses.def: the period during which a king, queen, emperor, etc. rules

ex.en: in/during the reign of Charles II
ex.cn: 在查理二世统治期间

senses.def: the period during which sb is in charge of an organization, a team, etc.
to rule as king, queen, emperor, etc.

ex.en: the reigning monarch
ex.cn: 当政的君主

ex.en: Queen Victoria reigned from 1837 to 1901.
ex.cn: 维多利亚女王自 1837 年至 1901 年在位。

ex.en: Herod reigned over Palestine at that time.
ex.cn: 那时，希律王统治巴勒斯坦。

senses.def: to be the best or most important in a particular situation or area of skill
senses.chn: 成为最佳；成为最重要的

ex.en: the reigning champion
ex.cn: 冠军称号的保持者

ex.en: In the field of classical music, he still reigns supreme.
ex.cn: 在古典音乐领域，他仍然是最为杰出的。

senses.def: to be the most obvious feature of a place or moment

ex.en: At last silence reigned (= there was complete silence).
ex.cn: 最后，万籁俱寂。

senses.def: to start burning again; to make sth start burning again

ex.en: The oven burners reignite automatically if blown out.
ex.cn: 烤炉的火如果吹灭了会自动再点燃。

ex.en: You may need to reignite the pilot light.
ex.cn: 你得重新点燃长明火。

ex.en: Their passion was reignited by a romantic trip to Venice.
ex.cn: 去威尼斯的浪漫之旅重新燃起了他们的激情。

senses.def: a period during which there is a lot of violence and many people are killed by the ruler or people in power
a method of healing based on the idea that energy can be directed into a person's body by touch
senses.chn: 灵气疗法（通过触摸向人体内输送能量）

senses.def: to pay back money to sb which they have spent or lost

ex.en: We will reimburse any expenses incurred.
ex.cn: 我们将付还所有相关费用。

ex.en: You will be reimbursed for any loss or damage caused by our company.
ex.cn: 如我公司给您造成损失或有所损坏，您都将得到赔偿。

senses.def: a long narrow leather band that is attached to a metal bar in a horse's mouth (= a bit ) and is held by the rider in order to control the horse

ex.en: She pulled gently on the reins.
ex.cn: 她轻轻地拉着缰绳。

senses.def: strips of leather, etc. worn by a small child and held by an adult in order to stop the child from walking off and getting lost
senses.chn: （幼儿佩带以防走失的）保护带

senses.def: the state of being in control or the leader of sth

ex.en: It was time to hand over the reins of power (= to give control to sb else).
ex.cn: 是该让权的时候了。

ex.en: The vice-president was forced to take up the reins of office.
ex.cn: 副总统被迫走马上任。

senses.def: to give sb complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely
senses.chn: 对…不加约束；放任自由；充分表达（感情）

ex.en: The designer was given free rein.
ex.cn: 设计者可以自由发挥。

ex.en: The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
ex.cn: 剧本允许她充分展现她那夸张的表演风格。

senses.def: to control sb/sth carefully or strictly
senses.chn: 对…严加控制（或约束）；牢牢驾驭

senses.def: to start to control sb/sth more strictly

ex.en: We need to rein back public spending.
ex.cn: 我们需要严格控制公共开销。

ex.en: She kept her emotions tightly reined in.
ex.cn: 她尽量克制着自己的感情。

senses.def: to stop a horse or make it go more slowly by pulling back the reins
to be born again in another body after you have died; to make sb be born again in this way

ex.en: They believe humans are reincarnated in animal form.
ex.cn: 他们相信人死后转生为动物。

senses.def: the belief that after sb's death their soul lives again in a new body
a person or an animal whose body contains the soul of a dead person
a large deer with long antlers (= horns shaped like branches), that lives in cold northern regions

ex.en: herds of reindeer
ex.cn: 驯鹿群

senses.def: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger

ex.en: Such jokes tend to reinforce racial stereotypes.
ex.cn: 这样的笑话往往会进一步加深关于种族的模式化观念。

ex.en: The climate of political confusion has only reinforced the country's economic decline.
ex.cn: 政局混乱只是加速了国家经济的衰退。

ex.en: Success in the talks will reinforce his reputation as an international statesman.
ex.cn: 谈判成功将会增强他作为国际政治家的声望。

senses.def: to make a structure or material stronger, especially by adding another material to it

ex.en: All buildings are now reinforced to withstand earthquakes.
ex.cn: 所有建筑现都已加固，以抗地震。

ex.en: reinforced steel
ex.cn: 增强钢材

senses.def: to send more people or equipment in order to make an army, etc. stronger
senses.chn: 给…加强力量（或装备）；使更强大

ex.en: The UN has undertaken to reinforce its military presence along the borders.
ex.cn: 联合国已经着手增强边境驻军。

senses.def: concrete with metal bars or wires inside to make it stronger
extra soldiers or police officers who are sent to a place because more are needed

ex.en: to send in reinforcements
ex.cn: 派出增援部队

senses.def: the act of making sth stronger, especially a feeling or an idea
senses.chn: （感情或思想等的）巩固，加强，强化

senses.def: to give back a job or position that had been taken away from sb
senses.chn: 使恢复原职；使重返岗位

ex.en: He was reinstated in his post.
ex.cn: 他重新回到了自己的岗位。

senses.def: to return sth to its previous position or status
senses.chn: 把…放回原处；使恢复原状

ex.en: There have been repeated calls to reinstate the death penalty.
ex.cn: 不断有人呼吁恢复死刑。

senses.def: the practice of one insurance company buying insurance from another company against any losses that result from claims that are made against it
senses.chn: 再保险，分保保险（指一保险公司向其他公司购买保险以减少索赔损失）

senses.def: to interpret sth in a new or different way
to start to use sth again

ex.en: to reintroduce the death penalty
ex.cn: 恢复死刑

ex.en: plans to reintroduce trams to the city
ex.cn: 市内重新启用有轨电车的计划

senses.def: to put a type of animal, bird or plant back into a region where it once lived
to present yourself/sth in a new form or with a new image
senses.chn: 以新形象示人；以新形式出现

ex.en: The former wild man of rock has reinvented himself as a respectable family man.
ex.cn: 过去的那位摇滚狂人已经改变形象，成了一位体面的爱家的男人。

senses.def: to waste time creating sth that already exists and works well
senses.chn: 重复发明；无谓地重复；浪费时间做无用功

senses.def: to waste time creating sth that already exists and works well
senses.chn: 重复发明；无谓地重复；浪费时间做无用功

senses.def: to put profits that have been made on an investment back into the same investment or into a new one
senses.chn: 再投资；把（利润）用于再投资

senses.def: to give new energy or strength to sth/sb
senses.chn: 给…增添精力（或力量）；使再振作

ex.en: We need to reinvigorate the economy of the area.
ex.cn: 我们需要给这个地区的经济注入新的活力。

ex.en: I felt reinvigorated after a rest and a shower.
ex.cn: 我休息了一会儿，冲了个淋浴，感到精神焕发。

senses.def: to publish or produce again a book, record, etc. that has not been available for some time

ex.en: old jazz recordings reissued on CD
ex.cn: 以激光唱片重新发行的老爵士乐

ex.en: The novel was reissued in paperback.
ex.cn: 这本小说重新发行了平装本。

senses.def: an old book or record that has been published or produced again after not being available for some time
senses.chn: 再版书；重新发行的唱片（或其他录制品）

senses.def: to repeat sth that you have already said, especially to emphasize it

ex.en: to reiterate an argument/a demand/an offer
ex.cn: 重申论点；重复一项要求／建议

ex.en: Let me reiterate that we are fully committed to this policy.
ex.cn: 我再说一遍，我们对这项政策是全力以赴、坚定不移的。

ex.en: 'I said “money”,' he reiterated.
ex.cn: “我说的是 '钱'。” 他重申道。

senses.def: to refuse to accept or consider sth

ex.en: to reject an argument/a claim/a decision/an offer/a suggestion
ex.cn: 拒绝接受一个论点／一项要求／一个决定／一项提议／一个建议

ex.en: The prime minister rejected any idea of reforming the system.
ex.cn: 首相对任何改革体制的想法都不予考虑。

ex.en: The proposal was firmly rejected.
ex.cn: 这项提议被断然否决。

ex.en: All our suggestions were rejected out of hand.
ex.cn: 我们所有的建议都被一口拒绝了。

senses.def: to refuse to accept sb for a job, position, etc.

ex.en: Please reject the following candidates…
ex.cn: 请排除以下候选人…

ex.en: I've been rejected by all the universities I applied to.
ex.cn: 所有我申请的大学都没有录取我。

senses.def: to decide not to use, sell, publish, etc. sth because its quality is not good enough
senses.chn: （因质量差）不用，不出售，不出版

ex.en: Imperfect articles are rejected by our quality control.
ex.cn: 我们严把质量关，不完美的物件都被退回。

senses.def: to not accept a new organ after a transplant operation, by producing substances that attack the organ
to fail to give a person or an animal enough care or affection

ex.en: The lioness rejected the smallest cub, which died.
ex.cn: 母狮不理会最小的幼狮，任由它死去。

ex.en: When her husband left home she felt rejected and useless.
ex.cn: 丈夫离家后，她觉得遭到了抛弃，且认为自己一无是处。

senses.def: something that cannot be used or sold because there is sth wrong with it
a person who has not been accepted as a member of a team, society, etc.
senses.chn: 不合格者；被剔除者；被拒收者

ex.en: one of society's rejects
ex.cn: 一名社会弃儿

senses.def: to make changes to sth; to arrange sth in a different way
senses.chn: 更改；重新安排；重新布置

senses.def: to express great happiness about sth

ex.en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
ex.cn: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

ex.en: The motor industry is rejoicing at the cut in car tax.
ex.cn: 汽车行业对汽车减税感到非常高兴。

ex.en: They rejoiced to see their son well again.
ex.cn: 他们看到儿子恢复了健康，无比高兴。

ex.en: I rejoice that justice has prevailed.
ex.cn: 我非常高兴正义得到伸张。

senses.def: to have a name that sounds funny

ex.en: He rejoiced in the name of Owen Owen.
ex.cn: 他有个滑稽的名字叫欧文 · 欧文。

senses.def: the happy celebration of sth

ex.en: a time of great rejoicing
ex.cn: 尽情欢庆的时光
