senses.def: to join sb/sth again after leaving them
senses.chn: 重新加入；和…重新在一起

ex.en: to rejoin a club
ex.cn: 重新加入俱乐部

ex.en: She turned off her phone and rejoined them at the table.
ex.cn: 她关掉电话，再回到餐桌旁和他们坐在一起。

ex.en: The path goes through a wood before rejoining the main road.
ex.cn: 这条小路穿过一片树林后与大路交汇。

senses.def: to say sth as an answer, especially sth quick, critical or amusing

ex.en: 'You're wrong!' she rejoined.
ex.cn: “你错了！” 她反驳道。

senses.def: a reply, especially a quick, critical or amusing one
to make sb/sth look or feel younger, more lively or more modern
senses.chn: 使年轻；使更有活力；使更新潮

senses.def: to make sth become active again

ex.en: to rekindle feelings/hopes
ex.cn: 再次引发感情；重新点燃希望

senses.def: the fact of becoming ill/sick again after making an improvement

ex.en: to have/suffer a relapse
ex.cn: 旧病复发

ex.en: a risk of relapse
ex.cn: 旧病复发的危险

senses.def: to go back into a previous condition or into a worse state after making an improvement
senses.chn: 退回原状；（好转后）再倒退

ex.en: They relapsed into silence.
ex.cn: 他们又都沉默不语。

ex.en: He relapsed into his old bad habits.
ex.cn: 他重染恶习。

ex.en: Two days after leaving the hospital she relapsed into a coma.
ex.cn: 出院两天后，她再度昏迷。

senses.def: show or make a connection between two or more things
senses.chn: 联系；使有联系；把…联系起来

ex.en: I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.
ex.cn: 我觉得很难把这两种想法联系在一起。

ex.en: In the future, pay increases will be related to productivity.
ex.cn: 以后，工资的上涨将和业绩挂钩。

senses.def: to give a spoken or written report of sth; to tell a story

ex.en: She relates her childhood experiences in the first chapters.
ex.cn: 在开始的几章中，她叙述了自己童年的经历。

ex.en: He related the facts of the case to journalists.
ex.cn: 他给记者们讲述了这件事的实际情况。

ex.en: She related how he had run away from home as a boy.
ex.cn: 她追述了他小时候是如何离家出走的。

ex.en: The story relates that an angel appeared and told him to sing.
ex.cn: 这个故事讲述一个天使现身，叫他唱歌。

senses.def: to be connected with sth/sb; to refer to sth/sb

ex.en: We shall discuss the problem as it relates to our specific case.
ex.cn: 我们应针对我们的具体情况来讨论这个问题。

ex.en: The second paragraph relates to the situation in Scotland.
ex.cn: 第二段谈到苏格兰的形势。

senses.def: to be able to understand and have sympathy with sb/sth
senses.chn: 能够理解并同情；了解；体恤

ex.en: Many adults can't relate to children.
ex.cn: 许多成年人并不了解儿童的想法。

ex.en: Our product needs an image that people can relate to.
ex.cn: 我们的产品需要一个大家能理解的形象。

senses.def: connected with sth/sb in some way

ex.en: Much of the crime in this area is related to drug abuse.
ex.cn: 这一地区的许多犯罪都与吸毒有关。

ex.en: These problems are closely related.
ex.cn: 这些问题都是密切相关的。

ex.en: a related issue/question
ex.cn: 相关的议题／问题

ex.en: a stress-related illness
ex.cn: 压力导致的疾病

senses.def: in the same family
senses.chn: 属同一家族的；有亲属关系的

ex.en: Are you related to Margaret?
ex.cn: 你与玛格丽特是一家人吗？

ex.en: We're distantly related.
ex.cn: 我们是远亲。

senses.def: belonging to the same group
senses.chn: 属于同一种类的；同一组别的

ex.en: related languages
ex.cn: 同系语言

ex.en: The llama is related to the camel.
ex.cn: 美洲驼和骆驼是亲缘物种。

senses.def: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
senses.chn: （人、团体、国家之间的）关系，联系，交往

ex.en: diplomatic/international/foreign relations
ex.cn: 外交／国际／对外关系

ex.en: US-Chinese relations
ex.cn: 美中关系

ex.en: teacher-pupil relations
ex.cn: 师生关系

ex.en: Relations with neighbouring countries are under strain at present.
ex.cn: 目前，与邻国的关系正处于紧张状态。

ex.en: We seek to improve relations between our two countries.
ex.cn: 我们寻求改进我们两国间的关系。

ex.en: to have sexual relations (= to have sex)
ex.cn: 发生性关系

senses.def: the way in which two or more things are connected

ex.en: the relation between rainfall and crop yields
ex.cn: 降雨量和农作物产量之间的关系

ex.en: the relation of the farmer to the land
ex.cn: 农民和土地的关系

ex.en: The fee they are offering bears no relation to the amount of work involved.
ex.cn: 他们支付的酬金和所需的工作量无关。

ex.en: I have some comments to make in relation to (= concerning) this matter.
ex.cn: 关于这件事我有几点看法。

ex.en: Its brain is small in relation to (= compared with) its body.
ex.cn: 和它的身体相比，它的大脑很小。

senses.def: a person who is in the same family as sb else

ex.en: a close/near/distant relation of mine
ex.cn: 我的一个近亲／远亲

ex.en: a relation by marriage
ex.cn: 姻亲

ex.en: a party for friends and relations
ex.cn: 亲戚朋友的聚会

ex.en: He's called Brady too, but we're no relation (= not related).
ex.cn: 他也叫布雷迪，但我们不是亲戚。

ex.en: Is he any relation to you?
ex.cn: 他是你的什么亲戚吗？

senses.def: existing or considered in relation to sth else
a database that recognizes relationships between different pieces of information
the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
senses.chn: （人、团体、国家之间的）关系，联系

ex.en: The relationship between the police and the local community has improved.
ex.cn: 警察和当地民众之间的关系已经得到改善。

ex.en: She has a very close relationship with her sister.
ex.cn: 她和她妹妹非常亲密。

ex.en: I have established a good working relationship with my boss.
ex.cn: 我与老板已经建立起良好的工作关系。

ex.en: a master-servant relationship
ex.cn: 主仆关系

senses.def: a loving and/or sexual friendship between two people

ex.en: Their affair did not develop into a lasting relationship.
ex.cn: 他们的暧昧关系未能发展成为持久的爱情。

ex.en: She's had a series of miserable relationships.
ex.cn: 她经历了一次又一次的恋爱波折。

ex.en: Are you in a relationship?
ex.cn: 你在恋爱吗？

senses.def: the way in which two or more things are connected

ex.en: the relationship between mental and physical health
ex.cn: 精神健康和身体健康之间的关系

ex.en: This comment bore no relationship to the subject of our conversation.
ex.cn: 这个意见与我们所谈论的话题毫不相干。

ex.en: People alter their voices in relationship to background noise.
ex.cn: 人们根据环境噪音的大小调节自己的声音。

senses.def: the way in which a person is related to sb else in a family

ex.en: a father-son relationship
ex.cn: 父子关系

ex.en: I'm not sure of the exact relationship between them—I think they're cousins.
ex.cn: 我不太清楚他们之间的确切关系，我想他们是表亲吧。

senses.def: considered and judged by being compared with sth else

ex.en: the relative merits of the two plans
ex.cn: 相比较之下两个计划各自的优点

senses.def: considered according to its position or connection with sth else

ex.en: the position of the sun relative to the earth
ex.cn: 太阳与地球的相对位置

senses.def: that exists or that has a particular quality only when compared with sth else

ex.en: They now live in relative comfort (= compared with how they lived before).
ex.cn: 他们现在过得比较舒适。

ex.en: Given the failure of the previous plan, this turned out to be a relative success.
ex.cn: 由于前面那个计划失败了，这个计划算是比较成功的。

ex.en: It's all relative though, isn't it? We never had any money when I was a kid and $500 was a fortune to us.
ex.cn: 不过，一切都是相对的，不是吗？我小的时候，我们根本没有钱，500 美元对于我们来说就是很大的一笔钱了。

senses.def: having a connection with sth; referring to sth

ex.en: the facts relative to the case
ex.cn: 与这个案件有关的事实

senses.def: referring to an earlier noun, sentence or part of a sentence
senses.chn: （指代前面的名词、句子或句子的一部分）

ex.en: In 'the man who came', 'who' is a relative pronoun and 'who came' is a relative clause.
ex.cn: 在 the man who came 中，who 是关系代词，而 who came 是关系从句。

senses.def: a person who is in the same family as sb else

ex.en: a close/distant relative
ex.cn: 近亲；远亲

ex.en: her friends and relatives
ex.cn: 她的亲友

senses.def: a thing that belongs to the same group as sth else

ex.en: The ibex is a distant relative of the mountain goat.
ex.cn: 北山羊与石山羊有较远的亲缘关系。

senses.def: the average mass of all the naturally occurring atoms of a chemical element
the mass of a substance divided by the mass of the same volume of water or air
to a fairly large degree, especially in comparison to sth else
senses.chn: 相当程度上；相当地；相对地

ex.en: I found the test relatively easy.
ex.cn: 我觉得这次测验比较容易。

ex.en: We had relatively few applications for the job.
ex.cn: 申请我们这项工作的人相对较少。

ex.en: Lack of exercise is also a risk factor for heart disease but it's relatively small when compared with the others.
ex.cn: 缺乏锻炼也是导致心脏病的一个因素。但和其他因素相比危险较小。

senses.def: used when you are comparing sth with all similar things
senses.chn: （和所有类似事物比较）相对而言

ex.en: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.
ex.cn: 相对来说，这些工作报酬都不低。

senses.def: used when you are comparing sth with all similar things
senses.chn: （和所有类似事物比较）相对而言

ex.en: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.
ex.cn: 相对来说，这些工作报酬都不低。

senses.def: the belief that truth is not always and generally valid, but can be judged only in relation to other things, such as your personal situation
senses.chn: 相对主义（认为真理并非绝对的，只能根据其他事物加以判断）

senses.def: Einstein's theory of the universe based on the principle that all movement is relative and that time is a fourth dimension related to space
the state of being relative and only able to be judged when compared with sth else
to start or present sth again in a new or different way, especially a product for sale
to rest while you are doing sth enjoyable, especially after work or effort

ex.en: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
ex.cn: 休息休息，看看电影吧。

ex.en: I'm going to spend the weekend just relaxing.
ex.cn: 这个周末，我什么也不干，就是休息。

ex.en: When I get home from work I like to relax with the newspaper.
ex.cn: 我下班回到家里，喜欢看看报纸，放松一下。

senses.def: to become or make sb become calmer and less worried

ex.en: I'll only relax when I know you're safe.
ex.cn: 我只有知道你安然无恙才会放心。

ex.en: Relax! Everything will be OK.
ex.cn: 别着急！一切都会好的。

senses.def: to become or make sth become less tight or stiff

ex.en: Allow your muscles to relax completely.
ex.cn: 让你的肌肉完全放松。

ex.en: The massage relaxed my tense back muscles.
ex.cn: 按摩使得我背部紧张的肌肉松弛下来。

ex.en: He relaxed his grip on her arm.
ex.cn: 他本来抓着她的胳膊，现在松开了手。

ex.en: The dictator refuses to relax his grip on power.
ex.cn: 独裁者拒绝放松对权力的控制。

senses.def: to allow rules, laws, etc. to become less strict

ex.en: The council has relaxed the ban on dogs in city parks.
ex.cn: 政务委员会已经放宽了对带狗到市内公园里去的禁令。

senses.def: to allow your attention or effort to become weaker

ex.en: You cannot afford to relax your concentration for a moment.
ex.cn: 你必须集中精力，一刻都不能松懈。

senses.def: a drug that is used to make the body relax

ex.en: a muscle relaxant
ex.cn: 肌肉松弛药

senses.def: ways of resting and enjoying yourself; time spent resting and enjoying yourself
senses.chn: 放松；休息；消遣；用于放松消遣的时间

ex.en: I go hill-walking for relaxation.
ex.cn: 我要是想放松一下，就到山上走走。

ex.en: a few days of relaxation
ex.cn: 几天的休息时间

ex.en: relaxation techniques
ex.cn: 放松的方法

ex.en: There are three bars, with live entertainment seven nights a week.
ex.cn: 有三家酒吧每周七个晚上都有现场文艺节目。

ex.en: It wasn't serious—it was all done in fun.
ex.cn: 那不是认真的，全是闹着玩的。

ex.en: We didn't mean to hurt him. It was just a bit of fun.
ex.cn: 我们并非有意要伤害他，只不过是开个玩笑罢了。

senses.def: something pleasant that you do in order to rest, especially after you have been working

ex.en: Fishing is his favourite relaxation.
ex.cn: 钓鱼是他最喜欢的消遣活动。

senses.def: the act of making a rule or some form of control less strict or severe

ex.en: the relaxation of foreign currency controls
ex.cn: 对外汇管制的放宽

ex.en: a relaxation of travel restrictions
ex.cn: 旅游限制的放宽

senses.def: calm and not anxious or worried

ex.en: He appeared relaxed and confident before the match.
ex.cn: 比赛前，他显得镇定而自信。

ex.en: She had a very relaxed manner.
ex.cn: 她的举止特别自然。

senses.def: calm and informal

ex.en: a family-run hotel with a relaxed atmosphere
ex.cn: 家庭经营的旅店，气氛自由随便

senses.def: not caring too much about discipline or making people follow rules

ex.en: I take a fairly relaxed attitude towards what the kids wear to school.
ex.cn: 孩子穿什么上学，我觉得无所谓。

senses.def: helping you to rest and become less anxious
senses.chn: 有助于休息的；令人放松的；轻松的

ex.en: a relaxing evening with friends
ex.cn: 和朋友在一起的轻松夜晚

senses.def: to receive and send on information, news, etc. to sb

ex.en: He relayed the message to his boss.
ex.cn: 他将这个消息转给了他的老板。

ex.en: Instructions were relayed to him by phone.
ex.cn: 通过电话将指令转达给了他。

senses.def: to broadcast television or radio signals
senses.chn: 播放，转播（电视或广播信号）

ex.en: The game was relayed by satellite to audiences all over the world.
ex.cn: 这场比赛通过卫星向全世界的观众进行了转播。

senses.def: a race between teams in which each member of the team runs or swims one section of the race

ex.en: the 4 × 100m relay
ex.cn: 4 × 100 米接力赛

ex.en: a relay team
ex.cn: 接力队

ex.en: the sprint relay
ex.cn: 短跑接力赛

senses.def: a fresh set of people or animals that take the place of others that are tired or have finished a period of work
senses.chn: 接班的人（或动物）；轮换者

ex.en: Rescuers worked in relays to save the trapped miners.
ex.cn: 救援人员轮班营救受困的矿工。

senses.def: an electronic device that receives radio or television signals and sends them on again with greater strength

ex.en: a relay station
ex.cn: 中继站

senses.def: to let sb/sth come out of a place where they have been kept or trapped

ex.en: to release a prisoner/hostage
ex.cn: 释放囚犯／人质

ex.en: Firefighters took two hours to release the driver from the wreckage.
ex.cn: 消防队员花了两个小时将司机从汽车残骸中救出来。

senses.def: to stop holding sth or stop it from being held so that it can move, fly, fall, etc. freely
senses.chn: 放开；松开；使自由移动（或飞翔、降落等）

ex.en: He refused to release her arm.
ex.cn: 他不肯放开她的胳膊。

ex.en: 10 000 balloons were released at the ceremony.
ex.cn: 典礼上放飞了一万个气球。

ex.en: Intense heat is released in the reaction.
ex.cn: 反应过程中产生高热。

senses.def: to express feelings such as anger or worry in order to get rid of them

ex.en: She burst into tears, releasing all her pent-up emotions.
ex.cn: 她放声大哭，发泄出全部郁积起来的情感。

senses.def: to free sb from a duty, responsibility, contract, etc.
senses.chn: 免除，解除（某人的职责、责任、合同等）；解雇

ex.en: The club is releasing some of its older players.
ex.cn: 俱乐部正在解聘一些老队员。

ex.en: The new law released employers from their obligation to recognize unions.
ex.cn: 新的法律免除了雇主承认工会的义务。

senses.def: to remove sth from a fixed position, allowing sth else to move or function

ex.en: to release the clutch/handbrake/switch, etc.
ex.cn: 松开离合器、手闸、开关等

senses.def: to make sth less tight

ex.en: You need to release the tension in these shoulder muscles.
ex.cn: 你需要放松肩部肌肉。

senses.def: to make sth available to the public

ex.en: Police have released no further details about the accident.
ex.cn: 关于这次事故，警方没有透露更多的细节。

ex.en: to release a movie/book/CD
ex.cn: 发行电影／书／CD

ex.en: new products released onto the market
ex.cn: 投放到市场的新产品

senses.def: to make sth available that had previously been restricted

ex.en: The new building programme will go ahead as soon as the government releases the funds.
ex.cn: 政府一拨付资金，新的建筑项目就动工。

senses.def: the act of setting a person or an animal free; the state of being set free

ex.en: The government has been working to secure the release of the hostages.
ex.cn: 政府一直在努力争取使人质获释。

ex.en: She can expect an early release from prison.
ex.cn: 她有望早一点出狱。

senses.def: the act of making sth available to the public

ex.en: The new software is planned for release in April.
ex.cn: 新软件计划四月份发行。

ex.en: The movie goes on general release (= will be widely shown in cinemas/movie theaters) next week.
ex.cn: 这部电影将于下周公开上映。

senses.def: a thing that is made available to the public, especially a new CD or film/movie
senses.chn: 新发行的东西；（尤指）新激光唱片，新电影

ex.en: the latest new releases
ex.cn: 最新发行的产品

senses.def: the act of letting a gas, chemical, etc. come out of the container where it has been safely held

ex.en: the release of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
ex.cn: 二氧化碳向大气层的排放

ex.en: to monitor radiation releases
ex.cn: 监测辐射的释放

senses.def: the feeling that you are free from pain, anxiety or some other unpleasant feeling

ex.en: a sense of release after the exam
ex.cn: 考试后的解脱感

ex.en: I think her death was a merciful release.
ex.cn: 我认为她的死是一种幸运的解脱。

senses.def: a version of a product, especially computer software, that is fully developed and nearly ready to be made available to the public. It comes after the beta version.
senses.chn: 候选发布版本（尤指计算机软件的一个版本，在测试版之后发布，已开发完成，准备推出供用户使用）

senses.def: to give sb a lower or less important position, rank, etc. than before
senses.chn: 使贬职；使降级；降低…的地位

ex.en: She was then relegated to the role of assistant.
ex.cn: 随后她被降级做助手了。

ex.en: He relegated the incident to the back of his mind.
ex.cn: 他将这个事件抛到了脑后。

senses.def: to move a sports team, especially a football (soccer) team, to a lower position within an official league
senses.chn: 使（运动队，尤指足球队）降级；使降组

senses.def: to finally agree to sth after refusing

ex.en: 'Well, just for a little while then,' she said, finally relenting.
ex.cn: “好吧，不过只能待一会儿。” 她最后终于答应了。

senses.def: to become less determined, strong, etc.

ex.en: After two days the rain relented.
ex.cn: 两天后，雨势减弱了。

ex.en: The police will not relent in their fight against crime.
ex.cn: 警方将继续严厉打击犯罪活动。

senses.def: not stopping or getting less strong
senses.chn: 不停的；持续强烈的；不减弱的

ex.en: her relentless pursuit of perfection
ex.cn: 她对完美的不懈追求

ex.en: The sun was relentless.
ex.cn: 太阳还是那么热。

senses.def: refusing to give up or be less strict or severe
senses.chn: 不放弃的；严格的；苛刻的；无情的

ex.en: a relentless enemy
ex.cn: 残酷的敌人

senses.def: closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are thinking about

ex.en: a relevant suggestion/question/point
ex.cn: 相关的提议／问题／观点

ex.en: Do you have the relevant experience?
ex.cn: 你有相关的经验吗？

ex.en: These comments are not directly relevant to this inquiry.
ex.cn: 这些意见与这项调查没有直接联系。

senses.def: having ideas that are valuable and useful to people in their lives and work

ex.en: Her novel is still relevant today.
ex.cn: 她的小说今天仍有现实意义。

senses.def: that can be trusted to do sth well; that you can rely on

ex.en: We are looking for someone who is reliable and hard-working.
ex.cn: 我们在物色可靠而又勤奋的人。

ex.en: a reliable friend
ex.cn: 可信赖的朋友

senses.def: that is likely to be correct or true

ex.en: Our information comes from a reliable source.
ex.cn: 我们的消息来源可靠。

ex.en: a reliable witness
ex.cn: 可信的目击证人

senses.def: able to work or operate for long periods without breaking down or needing attention
senses.chn: 性能可靠的；稳定耐用的

ex.en: My car's not as reliable as it used to be.
ex.cn: 我的车不像过去那样耐用了。

senses.def: the state of needing sb/sth in order to survive, be successful, etc.; the fact of being able to rely on sb/sth

ex.en: Heavy reliance on one client is risky when you are building up a business.
ex.cn: 创业时过分依赖某一个客户是有风险的。

ex.en: Such learning methods encourage too great a reliance upon the teacher.
ex.cn: 这样的学习方法会造成对老师的过分依赖。

ex.en: The study programme concentrates more on group work and places less reliance on (= depends less on) lectures.
ex.cn: 这个学习计划较注重小组活动而不倚重讲座。

ex.en: I wouldn't place too much reliance on (= trust) these figures.
ex.cn: 我不会太相信这些数字的。

senses.def: needing sb/sth in order to survive, be successful, etc.

ex.en: The hostel is heavily reliant upon charity.
ex.cn: 这家收容所在很大程度上依赖赞助。

senses.def: an object, a tradition, a system, etc. that has survived from the past

ex.en: The building stands as the last remaining relic of the town's cotton industry.
ex.cn: 这座建筑物是小镇棉纺业仅存的遗迹。

ex.en: Videotapes may already seem like relics of a bygone era.
ex.cn: 录像带似乎已成为过去时代的遗物。

senses.def: a part of the body or clothing of a holy person, or sth that they owned, that is kept after their death and respected as a religious object

ex.en: holy relics
ex.cn: 圣人遗物

senses.def: the feeling of happiness that you have when sth unpleasant stops or does not happen

ex.en: a sense of relief
ex.cn: 解脱感

ex.en: We all breathed a sigh of relief when he left.
ex.cn: 他走了以后，我们大家都如释重负地松了口气。

ex.en: She sighed with relief.
ex.cn: 她松了口气。

ex.en: Much to my relief the car was not damaged.
ex.cn: 令我非常庆幸的是车并没有损坏。

ex.en: News of their safety came as a great relief.
ex.cn: 他们平安的消息给大家带来了巨大的安慰。

ex.en: It was a relief to be able to talk to someone about it.
ex.cn: 能和别人谈谈这件事，感到舒心多了。

senses.def: the act of removing or reducing pain, anxiety, etc.
senses.chn: （焦虑、痛苦等的）减轻，消除，缓和

ex.en: modern methods of pain relief
ex.cn: 消除疼痛的新办法

ex.en: the relief of suffering
ex.cn: 痛苦的消除

senses.def: food, money, medicine, etc. that is given to help people in places where there has been a war or natural disaster
senses.chn: （给灾区或交战地区人民提供的）救济，救援物品

ex.en: famine relief
ex.cn: 饥荒救济物资

ex.en: a relief agency/organization/worker
ex.cn: 救助机构／组织／工作者

senses.def: financial help given by the government to people who need it
something that is interesting or enjoyable that replaces sth boring, difficult or unpleasant for a short period of time
senses.chn: （暂时替代单调乏味事物的）调剂，轻松场面

ex.en: a few moments of light relief in an otherwise dull performance
ex.cn: 沉闷的表演中几处轻松的情节

ex.en: There was little comic relief in his speech.
ex.cn: 他的演讲少有轻松幽默的地方。

ex.en: The calm of the countryside came as a welcome relief from the hustle and bustle of city life.
ex.cn: 离开喧嚣忙碌的城市生活，来到宁静的乡村，是一种令人愉快的调剂。

senses.def: a person or group of people that replaces another when they have finished working for the day or when they are sick

ex.en: The next crew relief comes on duty at 9 o'clock.
ex.cn: 下一批换班的员工 9 点钟接班。

ex.en: relief drivers
ex.cn: 换班的司机

senses.def: the act of freeing a town, etc. from an enemy army that has surrounded it
a way of decorating wood, stone, etc. by cutting designs into the surface of it so that some parts stick out more than others; a design that is made in this way

ex.en: The column was decorated in high relief (= with designs that stick out a lot) with scenes from Greek mythology.
ex.cn: 柱子上饰有描述希腊神话中的场面的高浮雕。

ex.en: The bronze doors are covered with sculpted reliefs.
ex.cn: 青铜门上覆有浮雕。

senses.def: the effect of colours, light, etc. that makes an object more noticeable than others around it
senses.chn: （光和色彩等产生的）醒目效果；醒目；光彩夺目

ex.en: The snow-capped mountain stood out in sharp relief against the blue sky.
ex.cn: 白雪覆盖的高山在蓝天的映衬下格外醒目。

senses.def: the quality of a particular situation, problem, etc. that makes it more noticeable than before
senses.chn: 突出的品质；令人注目的特征

ex.en: Their differences have been thrown into sharp relief by the present crisis.
ex.cn: 目前的危机使得他们的分歧更加引人注目。

senses.def: a map that uses various colours, etc. to show the different heights of hills, valleys, etc.
senses.chn: （用不同颜色表示地势高低的）地形图，地势图，地貌图

senses.def: a road that vehicles can use to avoid an area of heavy traffic, especially a road built for this purpose
senses.chn: （交通高峰时减缓拥挤的）疏导路，旁道

senses.def: to remove or reduce an unpleasant feeling or pain
senses.chn: 解除，减轻，缓和（不快或痛苦）

ex.en: to relieve the symptoms of a cold
ex.cn: 减轻感冒的症状

ex.en: to relieve anxiety/guilt/stress
ex.cn: 消除焦虑／内疚；缓解压力

ex.en: Being able to tell the truth at last seemed to relieve her.
ex.cn: 最后能够讲出真话似乎使她感到轻松。

senses.def: to make a problem less serious
senses.chn: 减轻（问题的严重性）；缓和；缓解

ex.en: efforts to relieve poverty
ex.cn: 缓解贫困的努力

ex.en: to relieve traffic congestion
ex.cn: 缓解交通拥堵

senses.def: to make sth less boring, especially by introducing sth different

ex.en: We played cards to relieve the boredom of the long wait.
ex.cn: 长时间等待实在无聊，我们就打扑克来解闷儿。

ex.en: The black and white pattern is relieved by tiny coloured flowers.
ex.cn: 五彩缤纷的小花使得黑白图案不那么单调。

senses.def: to replace sb who is on duty

ex.en: to relieve a sentry
ex.cn: 换岗

ex.en: You'll be relieved at six o'clock.
ex.cn: 六点钟有人来换你的班。

senses.def: to free a town, etc. from an enemy army that has surrounded it
senses.chn: 将（城镇从敌人的围困中）解围

senses.def: a polite way of referring to going to the toilet
senses.chn: （去厕所的一种委婉说法）方便，解手

ex.en: I had to relieve myself behind a bush.
ex.cn: 我只好在树丛后面方便了一下。

senses.def: to help sb by taking sth heavy or difficult from them
senses.chn: 替…拿重物；帮助…减轻（负担）

ex.en: Let me relieve you of some of your bags.
ex.cn: 我来帮你拿几个袋子吧。

ex.en: The new secretary will relieve us of some of the paperwork.
ex.cn: 新来的秘书会减轻我们文案工作的一些负担。

senses.def: to steal sth from sb

ex.en: A boy with a knife relieved him of his wallet.
ex.cn: 一个持刀的家伙偷了他的钱包。

senses.def: to dismiss sb from a job, position, etc.

ex.en: General Beale was relieved of his command.
ex.cn: 比尔将军被解除了指挥权。

senses.def: feeling happy because sth unpleasant has stopped or has not happened; showing this
senses.chn: 感到宽慰的；放心的；显得开心的

ex.en: She sounded relieved.
ex.cn: 她听上去很放心。

ex.en: You'll be relieved to know your jobs are safe.
ex.cn: 现在知道你们的工作保住了，可以放心了。

ex.en: I'm just relieved that nobody was hurt.
ex.cn: 谁都没有受伤，我深感宽慰。

ex.en: They exchanged relieved glances.
ex.cn: 他们如释重负地彼此看了看。

ex.en: He was glad he'd come.
ex.cn: 他很高兴他来了。

ex.en: She was glad when the meeting was over.
ex.cn: 会议结束时她很高兴。

senses.def: to help sb by taking sth heavy or difficult from them
senses.chn: 替…拿重物；帮助…减轻（负担）

ex.en: Let me relieve you of some of your bags.
ex.cn: 我来帮你拿几个袋子吧。

ex.en: The new secretary will relieve us of some of the paperwork.
ex.cn: 新来的秘书会减轻我们文案工作的一些负担。

senses.def: to steal sth from sb

ex.en: A boy with a knife relieved him of his wallet.
ex.cn: 一个持刀的家伙偷了他的钱包。

senses.def: to dismiss sb from a job, position, etc.

ex.en: General Beale was relieved of his command.
ex.cn: 比尔将军被解除了指挥权。

senses.def: the belief in the existence of a god or gods, and the activities that are connected with the worship of them, or in the teachings of a spiritual leader
senses.chn: 宗教；宗教信仰；精神信仰

ex.en: Is there always a conflict between science and religion?
ex.cn: 科学和宗教信仰之间是否永远存在着冲突？

senses.def: one of the systems of faith that are based on the belief in the existence of a particular god or gods, or in the teachings of a spiritual leader

ex.en: the Jewish religion
ex.cn: 犹太教

ex.en: Christianity, Islam and other world religions
ex.cn: 基督教、伊斯兰教和其他世界性宗教

ex.en: The law states that everyone has the right to practise their own religion.
ex.cn: 法律规定每个人都有信仰宗教的权利。

senses.def: a particular interest or influence that is very important in your life
senses.chn: 特别的兴趣；重大的影响

ex.en: For him, football is an absolute religion.
ex.cn: 对于他来说，足球就是他至高无上的追求。

senses.def: to suddenly start believing in a religion
senses.chn: 突然有了信仰；突然开始信教

senses.def: the state of being religious or too religious
senses.chn: 笃信宗教；过度的宗教热忱

senses.def: connected with religion or with a particular religion

ex.en: religious beliefs/faith
ex.cn: 宗教信仰；信德

ex.en: religious education (= education about religion)
ex.cn: 宗教教育

ex.en: religious instruction (= instruction in a particular religion)
ex.cn: 教义讲授

ex.en: religious groups
ex.cn: 宗教团体

ex.en: objects which have a religious significance
ex.cn: 圣物

senses.def: believing strongly in a particular religion and obeying its laws and practices

ex.en: His wife is very religious.
ex.cn: 他的妻子非常虔诚。

senses.def: very carefully or regularly
senses.chn: 十分认真地；审慎地；很有规律地

ex.en: She followed the instructions religiously.
ex.cn: 她非常认真地按照说明操作。

senses.def: in a way that is connected with religion

ex.en: Were you brought up religiously?
ex.cn: 你是在宗教的氛围中长大的吗？

senses.def: to stop having sth, especially when this happens unwillingly

ex.en: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
ex.cn: 他被迫放弃对公司的控制权。

ex.en: They had relinquished all hope that she was alive.
ex.cn: 他们已经完全不指望她还活着了。

ex.en: She relinquished possession of the house to her sister.
ex.cn: 她将房子让给了她的妹妹。

senses.def: a container in which a relic of a holy person is kept
senses.chn: 圣髑盒；盛放圣人遗物的容器

senses.def: to get great pleasure from sth; to want very much to do or have sth
senses.chn: 享受；从…获得乐趣；渴望；喜欢

ex.en: to relish a fight/challenge/debate
ex.cn: 喜欢打架／挑战／争辩

ex.en: to relish the idea/thought of sth
ex.cn: 欣赏某种观点／想法

ex.en: I don't relish the prospect of getting up early tomorrow.
ex.cn: 我可不愿意明天早上早起。

ex.en: Nobody relishes cleaning the oven.
ex.cn: 没有人喜欢清理烤炉。

senses.def: great enjoyment or pleasure

ex.en: She savoured the moment with obvious relish.
ex.cn: 她显然津津有味地回味着那一刻。

senses.def: a cold thick spicy sauce made from fruit and vegetables that have been boiled, that is served with meat, cheese, etc.
senses.chn: 风味佐料（用水果和蔬菜煮后制成的冷稠酱汁）

senses.def: to experience sth again, especially in your imagination
senses.chn: （尤指在想象中）再次体验，重温；回味

ex.en: He relives the horror of the crash every night in his dreams.
ex.cn: 每天晚上他都会梦见那次撞车的可怕情景。

senses.def: a relative

ex.en: All the rellies will be at the party.
ex.cn: 所有亲戚都会来参加聚会。

senses.def: to put more bullets into a gun, more film into a camera, etc.
senses.chn: 给…再装填（子弹或胶卷等）

senses.def: to put data or a program into the memory of a computer again
senses.chn: 给（计算机）重新装入（数据或程序）

senses.def: to fill a container, vehicle, machine, etc. again
senses.chn: 再装满（容器、车辆、机器等）

senses.def: to move or to move sb/sth to a new place to work or operate

ex.en: The firm may be forced to relocate from New York to Stanford.
ex.cn: 公司也许会被迫从纽约迁移到斯坦福。

ex.en: The company relocated its head office to Stanford.
ex.cn: 公司将总部迁到了斯坦福。

senses.def: hesitating before doing sth because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do

ex.en: reluctant agreement
ex.cn: 勉强同意

ex.en: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
ex.cn: 她不愿承认自己有错。

ex.en: He finally gave a reluctant smile.
ex.cn: 他最后露出了一丝无可奈何的微笑。

ex.en: a reluctant hero (= a person who does not want to be called a hero)
ex.cn: 不情愿做英雄的英雄

senses.def: to need or depend on sb/sth

ex.en: As babies, we rely entirely on others for food.
ex.cn: 在婴儿时期，我们完全依赖别人喂食。

ex.en: These days we rely heavily on computers to organize our work.
ex.cn: 现在，我们在很大程度上依赖电脑来安排我们的工作。

ex.en: The industry relies on the price of raw materials remaining low.
ex.cn: 这一产业靠的是原料便宜，不涨价。

senses.def: to trust or have faith in sb/sth

ex.en: You should rely on your own judgement.
ex.cn: 你应该相信你自己的判断。

ex.en: You can rely on me to keep your secret.
ex.cn: 你可以相信我一定会为你保守秘密。

ex.en: He can't be relied on to tell the truth.
ex.cn: 不能指望他说真话。

ex.en: You can trust me not to tell anyone.
ex.cn: 你可以相信我不会跟任何人讲。

ex.en: Don't trust what you read in the newspapers!
ex.cn: 别相信你在报纸上读到的！

ex.en: He was the sort of person you could depend on.
ex.cn: 他是你可以信赖的人。

senses.def: rapid eye movement (describes a period of sleep during which you dream and your eyes make many small movements)
senses.chn: 快速眼动（夜间做梦时眼睛快速而细微的移动）

senses.def: to continue to be sth; to be still in the same state or condition

ex.en: to remain silent/standing/seated/motionless
ex.cn: 依然沉默／站着／坐着／一动不动

ex.en: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.
ex.cn: 火车票价很可能会保持不变。

ex.en: It remains true that sport is about competing well, not winning.
ex.cn: 体育重在勇于竞争而非获胜，一向如此。

ex.en: In spite of their quarrel, they remain the best of friends.
ex.cn: 尽管有过争吵，他们仍是最好的朋友。

ex.en: He will remain (as) manager of the club until the end of his contract.
ex.cn: 他将继续担任俱乐部经理，直至合同期满。

senses.def: to still be present after the other parts have been removed, used, etc.; to continue to exist

ex.en: Very little of the house remained after the fire.
ex.cn: 火灾之后，这座房子所剩无几。

ex.en: There were only ten minutes remaining.
ex.cn: 只剩下十分钟了。

senses.def: to still need to be done, said, or dealt with

ex.en: Much remains to be done.
ex.cn: 还有很多事要去做。

ex.en: It remains to be seen (= it will only be known later) whether you are right.
ex.cn: 你说得对不对还有待证实。

ex.en: There remained one significant problem.
ex.cn: 还有一个非常重要的问题。

ex.en: Questions remain about the president's honesty.
ex.cn: 总统是否诚实，还有许多疑问。

ex.en: I feel sorry for her, but the fact remains (that) she lied to us.
ex.cn: 我为她感到难过，可事实是她对我们撒了谎。

ex.en: While the film is undoubtedly too long, it is nevertheless an intriguing piece of cinema.
ex.cn: 虽然这部电影的确太长了，但它不失为一部有趣的影片。

senses.def: to stay in the same place; to not leave

ex.en: They remained in Mexico until June.
ex.cn: 他们在墨西哥一直住到了六月。

ex.en: The plane remained on the ground.
ex.cn: 飞机仍未起飞。

ex.en: She left, but I remained behind.
ex.cn: 她走了，而我留了下来。

senses.def: to not become involved in sth; to show no interest in people
senses.chn: 不参与；远离；无动于衷；漠不关心

ex.en: The Emperor kept himself aloof from the people.
ex.cn: 这个皇帝对人民漠不关心。

senses.def: the remaining people, things or time
senses.chn: 其他人员；剩余物；剩余时间

ex.en: I kept some of his books and gave away the remainder.
ex.cn: 我保留了一些他的书，其他的都送人了。

ex.en: Most of our employees work in New York; the remainder are in London.
ex.cn: 我们大部分员工在纽约工作，其余的在伦敦。

senses.def: the numbers left after one number has been subtracted from another, or one number has been divided into another

ex.en: Divide 2 into 7, and the answer is 3, remainder 1.
ex.cn: 7 除以 2，商 3 余 1。

senses.def: a book that has been remaindered
senses.chn: 廉价出售的图书；滞销图书

senses.def: to sell books at a reduced price
still needing to be done or dealt with

ex.en: The remaining twenty patients were transferred to another hospital.
ex.cn: 其余的二十名病人被转送到另一家医院去了。

ex.en: Any remaining tickets for the concert will be sold on the door.
ex.cn: 其余门票均于音乐会时即场发售。

senses.def: the parts of sth that are left after the other parts have been used, eaten, removed, etc.

ex.en: She fed the remains of her lunch to the dog.
ex.cn: 她把剩下的午饭喂狗了。

senses.def: the parts of ancient objects and buildings that have survived and are discovered in the present day
senses.chn: 古代遗物；古迹；遗迹；遗址

ex.en: prehistoric remains
ex.cn: 史前遗迹

ex.en: the remains of a Roman fort
ex.cn: 罗马要塞的遗址

senses.def: the body of a dead person or animal

ex.en: They had discovered human remains.
ex.cn: 他们发现过人类遗骸。

senses.def: a new or different version of an old film/movie or song
to make a new or different version of sth such as an old film/movie or song; to make sth again
senses.chn: 重新制作，改编（电影或歌曲等）；重做

ex.en: 'The Seven Samurai' was remade in Hollywood as 'The Magnificent Seven'.
ex.cn: 《七武士》在好莱坞被重新制作成《七侠荡寇志》。

senses.def: to send sb away from a court to wait for their trial which will take place at a later date

ex.en: The two men were charged with burglary and remanded in custody (= sent to prison until their trial).
ex.cn: 两名男子被控入室偷窃而被还押候审。

ex.en: She was remanded on bail (= allowed to go free until the trial after leaving a sum of money with the court).
ex.cn: 她获准取保候审。

senses.def: the process of keeping sb in prison while they are waiting for their trial

ex.en: He is currently being held on remand.
ex.cn: 他正被还押候审。

ex.en: a remand prisoner
ex.cn: 还押罪犯

senses.def: a place where young people are sent when they are accused of a crime and are waiting for their trial
to make a key on a keyboard have a different function
senses.chn: 给（键盘）重新映射（重新设定按键的功能）

senses.def: something that you say or write which expresses an opinion, a thought, etc. about sb/sth

ex.en: to make a remark
ex.cn: 发表评论

ex.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
ex.cn: 关于这里的食物他说了许多无礼的评论。

ex.en: What exactly did you mean by that last remark?
ex.cn: 你最后那句话究竟是什么意思？

ex.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
ex.cn: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

ex.en: She made helpful comments on my work.
ex.cn: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

ex.en: the announcement of a peace agreement
ex.cn: 和平协议公告

senses.def: the quality of being important or interesting enough to be noticed

ex.en: The exhibition contains nothing that is worthy of remark.
ex.cn: 这次展览没有任何值得看的东西。

senses.def: to say or write a comment about sth/sb

ex.en: The judges remarked on the high standard of entries for the competition.
ex.cn: 众评委说参赛作品水准很高。

ex.en: She remarked how tired I was looking.
ex.cn: 她说我看上去显得特别累。

ex.en: 'It's much colder than yesterday,' he remarked casually.
ex.cn: “今天比昨天冷多了。” 他漫不经心地说。

ex.en: Critics remarked that the play was not original.
ex.cn: 评论家们指出这部戏剧缺乏创意。

ex.en: The similarities between the two have often been remarked on.
ex.cn: 人们经常谈到两者的相似之处。

ex.en: He refused to comment until after the trial.
ex.cn: 他拒绝在审判前作任何评论。

senses.def: unusual or surprising in a way that causes people to take notice
senses.chn: 非凡的；奇异的；显著的；引人注目的

ex.en: a remarkable achievement/career/talent
ex.cn: 非凡的成就／事业／才能

ex.en: She was a truly remarkable woman.
ex.cn: 她是一位真正非同凡响的女人。

ex.en: The area is remarkable for its scenery.
ex.cn: 这一地区以其优美的景色而引人瞩目。

ex.en: It is remarkable that nobody noticed sooner.
ex.cn: 竟然没有人早点发现，真有意思。

senses.def: to marry again after being divorced or after your husband or wife has died
to make a new master copy of a recording in order to improve the sound quality

ex.en: All the tracks have been digitally remastered from the original tapes.
ex.cn: 所有的曲子都已经从原始录音带转录到了数码母带上。

senses.def: a match or game played again between the same people or teams, especially because neither side won the first match or game
senses.chn: （尤指因首轮未决出胜负）重赛，复赛

senses.def: that can be solved or cured

ex.en: remediable problems/diseases
ex.cn: 可以解决的问题；可治愈的疾病

senses.def: aimed at solving a problem, especially when this involves correcting or improving sth that has been done wrong
senses.chn: 旨在解决问题的；补救的；纠正的

ex.en: remedial treatment (= for a medical problem)
ex.cn: 治疗

ex.en: Remedial action must be taken now.
ex.cn: 现在必须进行补救。

senses.def: connected with school students who are slower at learning than others

ex.en: remedial education
ex.cn: 补习教育

ex.en: a remedial class
ex.cn: 补习班

senses.def: the process of improving sth or correcting sth that is wrong, especially changing or stopping damage to the environment
senses.chn: 补救；纠正；（尤指对环境破坏的）整改，制止

ex.en: remediation of contaminated soil
ex.cn: 受污染土壤的改善

senses.def: a way of dealing with or improving an unpleasant or difficult situation
senses.chn: 处理方法；改进措施；补偿

ex.en: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
ex.cn: 失业问题没有简单的解决办法。

ex.en: There are a number of possible remedies to this problem.
ex.cn: 这个问题有许多可能采取的解决办法。

senses.def: a treatment or medicine to cure a disease or reduce pain that is not very serious

ex.en: a herbal remedy
ex.cn: 草药

ex.en: an excellent home remedy for sore throats
ex.cn: 治疗咽喉疼痛的极佳的家庭疗法

senses.def: a way of dealing with a problem, using the processes of the law
senses.chn: （通过法律程序的）解决方法，救济

ex.en: Holding copyright provides the only legal remedy against unauthorized copying.
ex.cn: 持有版权是制止盗版的唯一法律手段。

senses.def: to correct or improve sth

ex.en: to remedy a problem
ex.cn: 解决问题

ex.en: This situation is easily remedied.
ex.cn: 这种情形易于补救。

senses.def: to have or keep an image in your memory of an event, a person, a place, etc. from the past

ex.en: This is Carla. Do you remember her?
ex.cn: 这位是卡拉。你记得她吗？

ex.en: I don't remember my first day at school.
ex.cn: 我已经忘了第一天上学的情景。

ex.en: He still remembered her as the lively teenager he'd known years before.
ex.cn: 他记忆中的她依然是他多年以前认识的那个活泼的少女。

ex.en: As far as I can remember, this is the third time we've met.
ex.cn: 我记得这是我们第三次会面了。

ex.en: Do you remember switching the lights off before we came out?
ex.cn: 你记得我们出来之前关灯了吗？

ex.en: I vaguely remember hearing him come in.
ex.cn: 我隐约记得听到他进来。

senses.def: to bring back to your mind a fact, piece of information, etc. that you knew

ex.en: I'm sorry—I can't remember your name.
ex.cn: 对不起，我想不起你的名字了。

ex.en: You were going to help me with this. Remember?
ex.cn: 你说要帮着我做的。记得吗？

ex.en: Can you remember how much money we spent?
ex.cn: 你能回忆起我们花了多少钱吗？

ex.en: Remember that we're going out tonight.
ex.cn: 别忘了我们今天晚上要出去。

senses.def: to keep an important fact in your mind

ex.en: Remember (that) you may feel sleepy after taking the pills.
ex.cn: 记住，吃了这些药片之后，你可能会犯困。

ex.en: It should be remembered that the majority of accidents happen in the home.
ex.cn: 不要忘记大多数事故都是在家里发生的。

senses.def: to not forget to do sth; to actually do what you have to do
senses.chn: 记着，不忘（去做）；动手做（必须做的事）

ex.en: Remember to call me when you arrive!
ex.cn: 你到了之后别忘了给我打电话！

ex.en: Did you remember your homework (= to bring it)?
ex.cn: 你记得带家庭作业了吗？

senses.def: to think about sb with respect, especially when saying a prayer

ex.en: a church service to remember the war dead
ex.cn: 纪念战争死难者的教堂礼拜仪式

senses.def: to give money, a present, etc. to sb/sth

ex.en: My aunt always remembers my birthday (= by sending a card or present).
ex.cn: 我姨妈在我的生日总要送我礼物。

ex.en: His grandfather remembered him (= left him money) in his will.
ex.cn: 他爷爷在遗嘱中给他留下了一笔钱。

senses.def: to be famous or known for a particular thing that you have done in the past
senses.chn: 因某事而成名（或名留青史）

ex.en: He is best remembered as the man who brought jazz to England.
ex.cn: 他因为将爵士音乐传到英国而为人们所熟知。

senses.def: used to ask sb to give your good wishes to sb else

ex.en: Remember me to your parents.
ex.cn: 代我向你的父母问好。

senses.def: used to ask sb to give your good wishes to sb else

ex.en: Remember me to your parents.
ex.cn: 代我向你的父母问好。

senses.def: the act or process of remembering an event in the past or a person who is dead

ex.en: A service was held in remembrance of local soldiers killed in the war.
ex.cn: 为当地阵亡的战士举行了纪念仪式。

ex.en: a remembrance service
ex.cn: 纪念仪式

ex.en: He smiled at the remembrance of their first kiss.
ex.cn: 他想起了他们的初吻，露出了微笑。

senses.def: an object that causes you to remember sb/sth; a memory of sb/sth
senses.chn: 纪念品；纪念物；一段记忆

ex.en: The cenotaph stands as a remembrance of those killed during the war.
ex.cn: 矗立着的纪念碑是对战争中死难者的纪念。

senses.def: the Sunday nearest to the 11 November on which those killed in war, especially the wars of 1914–18 and 1939–45, are remembered in ceremonies and church services in Britain and some other countries
senses.chn: 阵亡将士纪念日（最接近 11 月 11 日的星期天。英国和其他一些国家为战争中的死难者，尤为两次世界大战中的阵亡者举行纪念仪式和教堂礼拜仪式）

senses.def: to help sb remember sth, especially sth important that they must do

ex.en: I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name. Can you remind me?
ex.cn: 对不起，我忘了你的名字。提醒我一下好吗？

ex.en: That (= what you have just said, done, etc.) reminds me, I must get some cash.
ex.cn: 那倒提醒了我，我得带上一些现金。

ex.en: 'You need to finish that essay.' ' Don't remind me (= I don't want to think about it).'
ex.cn: “你要完成那篇论文。” “别提啦！”

ex.en: 'Don't forget the camera.' 'Remind me about it nearer the time.'
ex.cn: “别忘了带相机。” “到时候再提醒我一下。”

ex.en: Remind me to phone Alan before I go out.
ex.cn: 提醒我在出去之前给艾伦打电话。

ex.en: Passengers are reminded (that) no smoking is allowed on this train.
ex.cn: 乘客们请注意，本次列车禁止吸烟。

senses.def: if sb/sth reminds you of sb/sth else, they make you remember or think about the other person, place, thing, etc. because they are similar in some way
senses.chn: 使想起（类似的人、地方、事物等）

ex.en: You remind me of your father when you say that.
ex.cn: 你说那样的话，使我想起了你的父亲。

ex.en: That smell reminds me of France.
ex.cn: 那股气味使我想起了法国。

senses.def: something that makes you think about or remember sb/sth, that you have forgotten or would like to forget
senses.chn: 引起回忆的事物；提醒人的事物

ex.en: The sheer size of the cathedral is a constant reminder of the power of religion.
ex.cn: 大教堂的宏大规模使人时时感受到宗教的威严。

ex.en: The incident served as a timely reminder of just how dangerous mountaineering can be.
ex.cn: 这次事故及时地提醒了人们登山运动有时会有多危险。

senses.def: a letter or note informing sb that they have not done sth
senses.chn: （告知该做某事的）通知单，提示信

senses.def: to think, talk or write about a happy time in your past
senses.chn: 回忆，追忆，缅怀（昔日的快乐时光）

ex.en: We spent a happy evening reminiscing about the past.
ex.cn: 我们一晚上回忆往事，感到很愉快。

senses.def: a spoken or written description of sth that sb remembers about their past life

ex.en: The book is a collection of his reminiscences about the actress.
ex.cn: 这本书辑录了他对那位女演员的回忆。

ex.en: reminiscences of a wartime childhood
ex.cn: 战时童年生活的回忆录

senses.def: the act of remembering things that happened in the past
something that reminds you of sth similar
senses.chn: 使人想起类似事物的东西；引起联想的相似事物

ex.en: Her music is full of reminiscences of African rhythms.
ex.cn: 她的音乐总是使人联想到非洲音乐的节奏。

senses.def: reminding you of sb/sth

ex.en: The way he laughed was strongly reminiscent of his father.
ex.cn: 他笑的样子让人很容易想起他的父亲。

senses.def: showing that you are thinking about the past, especially in a way that causes you pleasure
senses.chn: 回忆过去的；怀旧的；缅怀往事的

ex.en: a reminiscent smile
ex.cn: 追忆往事时露出的微笑

senses.def: not giving sth enough care and attention

ex.en: It was remiss of them not to inform us of these changes sooner.
ex.cn: 他们粗心大意，没有早一些通知我们这些变化。

ex.en: She had clearly been remiss in her duty.
ex.cn: 她在工作中显然马马虎虎。

senses.def: a period during which a serious illness improves for a time and the patient seems to get better

ex.en: The patient has been in remission for the past six months.
ex.cn: 在过去的六个月中，病人的病情已经有所缓解。

ex.en: The symptoms reappeared after only a short remission.
ex.cn: 短暂的康复之后，症状再次出现。

senses.def: a reduction in the amount of time sb spends in prison, especially because they have behaved well
an act of reducing or cancelling the amount of money that sb has to pay

ex.en: New businesses may qualify for tax remission.
ex.cn: 新的企业有资格享受税收减免。

ex.en: There is a partial remission of fees for overseas students.
ex.cn: 对留学生可以减免部分费用。

senses.def: the area of activity over which a particular person or group has authority, control or influence
senses.chn: 职权范围；控制范围；影响范围

ex.en: Such decisions are outside the remit of this committee.
ex.cn: 这样的决定超出了委员会的职权范围。

ex.en: In future, staff recruitment will fall within the remit of the division manager.
ex.cn: 以后新员工招募将属于部门经理的职责。

ex.en: a remit to report on medical services
ex.cn: 报告医疗服务情况的权限

senses.def: to send money, etc. to a person or place

ex.en: to remit funds
ex.cn: 汇寄资金

ex.en: Payment will be remitted to you in full.
ex.cn: 报酬将会全额汇寄给你。

senses.def: to cancel or free sb from a debt, duty, punishment, etc.
senses.chn: 免除（债务、职责、惩罚等）；赦免

ex.en: to remit a fine
ex.cn: 免除罚金

ex.en: to remit a prison sentence
ex.cn: 免除徒刑

senses.def: to send a matter to an authority so that a decision can be made
senses.chn: 将…提交（权力部门以便作出决定）

ex.en: The case was remitted to the Court of Appeal.
ex.cn: 这个案件被提交给了上诉法院。

senses.def: to send a matter to an authority so that a decision can be made
senses.chn: 将…提交（权力部门以便作出决定）

ex.en: The case was remitted to the Court of Appeal.
ex.cn: 这个案件被提交给了上诉法院。

senses.def: a sum of money that is sent to sb in order to pay for sth

ex.en: Please return the completed form with your remittance.
ex.cn: 请将填好的表格连同汇款寄回。

senses.def: the act of sending money to sb in order to pay for sth

ex.en: Remittance can be made by cheque or credit card.
ex.cn: 可通过支票或信用卡汇款。

senses.def: to make a new version of a recorded piece of music by using a machine to arrange the separate parts of the recording in a different way, add new parts, etc.
a part of sth that is left after the other parts have been used, removed, destroyed, etc.

ex.en: The woods are remnants of a huge forest which once covered the whole area.
ex.cn: 这片树林只是剩下的一部分，原来这一带是一大片森林。

senses.def: a small piece of cloth that is left when the rest has been sold
to change the structure or shape of sth
a protest or complaint
to protest or complain about sth/sb

ex.en: They remonstrated with the official about the decision.
ex.cn: 他们就这一决定向这位官员提出了抗议。

senses.def: the feeling of being extremely sorry for sth wrong or bad that you have done

ex.en: I felt guilty and full of remorse.
ex.cn: 我感到内疚，并且非常懊悔。

ex.en: He was filled with remorse for not believing her.
ex.cn: 他因为没有相信她而懊悔不已。

senses.def: seeming to continue or become worse in a way that cannot be stopped

ex.en: the remorseless increase in crime
ex.cn: 犯罪的持续增长

senses.def: cruel and having or showing no pity for other people
senses.chn: 残酷的；无情的；无同情心的

ex.en: a remorseless killer
ex.cn: 残酷的杀手

senses.def: to arrange a second mortgage on your house or apartment, or to increase or change your first one
far away from places where other people live

ex.en: a remote beach
ex.cn: 偏远的海滩

ex.en: one of the remotest areas of the world
ex.cn: 世界上最荒僻的地区之一

ex.en: The farmhouse is remote from any other buildings.
ex.cn: 这家农舍附近没有别的房屋。

senses.def: far away in time

ex.en: in the remote past/future
ex.cn: 在遥远的过去／将来

ex.en: a remote ancestor (= who lived a long time ago)
ex.cn: 远祖

senses.def: not closely related

ex.en: a remote cousin
ex.cn: 远房表亲

senses.def: that you can connect to from far away, using an electronic link

ex.en: a remote terminal/database
ex.cn: 远程终端／数据库

senses.def: very different from sth
senses.chn: 相差很大的；极不相同的

ex.en: His theories are somewhat remote from reality.
ex.cn: 他的理论有点儿脱离现实。

senses.def: not very friendly or interested in other people
not very great

ex.en: There is still a remote chance that they will find her alive.
ex.cn: 他们仍然有一线希望能把她活着找到。

ex.en: I don't have the remotest idea what you're talking about.
ex.cn: 你在说什么我一点儿都不懂。

senses.def: the use of a computer system, etc. that is in another place, that you can connect to when you are far away, using an electronic link
the ability to operate a machine from a distance using radio or electrical signals

ex.en: It works by remote control.
ex.cn: 它通过遥控工作。

ex.en: a remote-control camera
ex.cn: 遥控摄像机

senses.def: a device that allows you to operate a television, etc. from a distance

ex.en: I can't find the remote control.
ex.cn: 我找不到遥控器。

senses.def: to a very slight degree
senses.chn: 微弱地；细微地；程度很低地

ex.en: It wasn't even remotely funny (= it wasn't at all funny).
ex.cn: 这一点也不好笑。

ex.en: The two incidents were only remotely connected.
ex.cn: 两次事件之间无甚关联。

senses.def: from a distance

ex.en: remotely operated
ex.cn: 远程操作的

senses.def: far away from places where other people live

ex.en: The church is remotely situated on the north coast of the island.
ex.cn: 教堂位于这个岛偏僻的北部海岸。

senses.def: the use of satellites to search for and collect information about the earth
to change sth such as an idea, a system, etc.

ex.en: attempts to remould policy to make it more acceptable
ex.cn: 力图改变政策以使其易于为人们所接受

senses.def: to get on a horse, bicycle, etc. again after getting off it or falling off it
senses.chn: 再次骑上，重新跨上（马、自行车等）

senses.def: to organize and begin sth a second time
that can be taken off or out of sth
the act of taking sb/sth away from a particular place

ex.en: Clearance of the site required the removal of a number of trees.
ex.cn: 清理这一场所需要移走不少树。

ex.en: the removal of a tumour
ex.cn: 肿瘤切除

senses.def: the act of getting rid of sth

ex.en: stain removal
ex.cn: 清除污渍

ex.en: the removal of trade barriers
ex.cn: 贸易壁垒的消除

senses.def: the act of dismissing sb from their job

ex.en: events leading to the removal of the president from office
ex.cn: 导致总统下台的一些事件

senses.def: an act of taking furniture, etc. from one house to another

ex.en: house removals
ex.cn: 搬家

ex.en: a removal company/firm
ex.cn: 搬家公司

ex.en: When are the removal men coming?
ex.cn: 搬家工人什么时候到？

senses.def: a person or company that takes furniture, etc. from one house or premises to another
a large van used for moving furniture from one house to another
to take sth/sb away from a place
senses.chn: 移开；拿开；去掉；从…机构开除

ex.en: Illegally parked vehicles will be removed.
ex.cn: 非法停放的车辆将被拖走。

ex.en: He removed his hand from her shoulder.
ex.cn: 他将手从她的肩膀上拿开。

ex.en: Three children were removed from the school for persistent bad behaviour.
ex.cn: 三个孩子因一再行为不检被学校开除。

senses.def: to take off clothing, etc. from the body

ex.en: She removed her glasses and rubbed her eyes.
ex.cn: 她摘下眼镜，揉了揉眼睛。

senses.def: to get rid of sth unpleasant, dirty, etc.; to make sth disappear
senses.chn: 去除，排除（污渍、不愉快的事物等）；使消失

ex.en: She has had the tumour removed.
ex.cn: 她已经将肿瘤切除了。

ex.en: to remove problems/obstacles/objections
ex.cn: 解决问题；排除障碍；消除异议

ex.en: The news removed any doubts about the company's future.
ex.cn: 这个消息消除了一切有关公司前景的疑虑。

senses.def: to dismiss sb from their position or job

ex.en: The elections removed the government from power.
ex.cn: 这几次选举使得政府倒台。

senses.def: belonging to a different generation

ex.en: He's my cousin's son so he's my first cousin once removed.
ex.cn: 他是我表兄弟的儿子，所以他是低我一辈的表亲。

senses.def: to be very different from sth; to not be connected with sth

ex.en: Many of these books are far removed from the reality of the children's lives.
ex.cn: 很多这样的书都远远地脱离了孩子们的现实生活。

senses.def: an amount by which two things are separated

ex.en: Charlotte seemed to be living at one remove from reality.
ex.cn: 夏洛特好像生活在现实之外。

senses.def: a substance used for getting rid of marks, paint, etc.

ex.en: nail varnish remover
ex.cn: 指甲油清除剂

ex.en: stain remover
ex.cn: 去污剂

senses.def: a person or company whose job is to take furniture, etc. from one house to another

ex.en: a firm of removers
ex.cn: 搬家公司

senses.def: to pay sb for work that they have done
an amount of money that is paid to sb for the work they have done
paying a lot of money

ex.en: remunerative work
ex.cn: 报酬很高的工作

senses.def: the period in Europe during the 14th, 15th and 16th centuries when people became interested in the ideas and culture of ancient Greece and Rome and used these influences in their own art, literature, etc.
senses.chn: 文艺复兴（欧洲 14、15 和 16 世纪时，人们以古希腊罗马的思想文化来繁荣文学艺术）

ex.en: Renaissance art
ex.cn: 文艺复兴时期的艺术

senses.def: a situation when there is new interest in a particular subject, form of art, etc. after a period when it was not very popular
senses.chn: （某一学科或艺术形式等衰落后的）复兴

ex.en: to experience a renaissance
ex.cn: 经历复兴

senses.def: a person who is good at a lot of things and has a lot of interests, especially writing and painting
senses.chn: 文艺复兴人，全才人（尤指写作和绘画方面多才多艺的人）

senses.def: relating to or involving the kidneys

ex.en: renal failure
ex.cn: 肾衰竭

senses.def: to give sb/sth a new name

ex.en: to rename a street
ex.cn: 给一条街道改名

ex.en: Leningrad was renamed St Petersburg.
ex.cn: 列宁格勒被重新命名为圣彼得堡。

senses.def: a situation in which there is new interest in a particular subject, form of art, etc. after a period when it was not very popular
to tear sth apart with force or violence

ex.en: They rent their clothes in grief.
ex.cn: 他们在悲痛之中扯碎了自己的衣服。

ex.en: a country rent in two by civil war
ex.cn: 被内战一分为二的国家

ex.en: Loud screams rent the air.
ex.cn: 高声的尖叫划破了天空。

senses.def: to cause sb/sth to be in a particular state or condition
senses.chn: 使成为；使变得；使处于某状态

ex.en: to render sth harmless/useless/ineffective
ex.cn: 使某事物无害／无用／无效

ex.en: Hundreds of people were rendered homeless by the earthquake.
ex.cn: 成百上千的人因为地震而无家可归。

senses.def: to give sb sth, especially in return for sth or because it is expected

ex.en: They rendered assistance to the disaster victims.
ex.cn: 他们给灾民提供了援助。

ex.en: to render a service to sb
ex.cn: 给某人提供服务

ex.en: to render sb a service
ex.cn: 为某人服务

ex.en: It was payment for services rendered.
ex.cn: 这是服务酬金。

senses.def: to present sth, especially when it is done officially

ex.en: The committee was asked to render a report on the housing situation.
ex.cn: 要求委员会提交一份有关住房情况的报告。

senses.def: to express or perform sth

ex.en: He stood up and rendered a beautiful version of 'Summertime'.
ex.cn: 他站起来表演了一段优美的《夏日时光》。

ex.en: The artist has rendered the stormy sea in dark greens and browns.
ex.cn: 画家用了深绿色和棕色来表现波涛汹涌的大海。

senses.def: to express sth in a different language
senses.chn: （用不同的语言）表达；翻译；把…译成

ex.en: The Italian phrase can be rendered as 'I did my best'.
ex.cn: 这个意大利语的短语可以译为 “我尽力了”。

ex.en: It's a concept that is difficult to render into English.
ex.cn: 这个概念难以用英语来表达。

senses.def: to cover a wall with a layer of plaster or cement
to make fat liquid by heating it; to melt sth
the performance of a piece of music, a role in a play, etc.; the particular way in which sth is performed

ex.en: her dramatic rendering of Lady Macbeth
ex.cn: 她饰演麦克白夫人的生动表演

senses.def: a piece of writing that has been translated into a different language; the particular way in which it has been translated

ex.en: a faithful rendering of the original text
ex.cn: 对原文的忠实翻译

senses.def: a layer of plaster or cement that is put on a brick or stone wall in order to make it smooth
an arrangement to meet sb at a particular time and place
a place where people have arranged to meet
a bar, etc. that is a popular place for people to meet
senses.chn: （酒吧等）热门聚会场所，聚会处

ex.en: a lively Paris rendezvous
ex.cn: 巴黎一处很热闹的公共场所

senses.def: to meet at a time and place that have been arranged in advance
senses.chn: （在约定的时间和地点）会面，相会，集合

senses.def: the performance of sth, especially a song or piece of music; the particular way in which it is performed
(especially in the US) the practice of sending foreign suspects to be questioned in another country where the laws about the treatment of prisoners are less strict
senses.chn: （尤指在美国）非常规引渡（将外籍嫌疑犯引渡到其他对待囚犯较宽松的国家受审）

senses.def: a person who leaves one political, religious, etc. group to join another that has very different views
senses.chn: 变节者；叛徒；背叛者；叛教者

senses.def: a person who opposes and lives outside a group or society that they used to belong to
to break a promise, an agreement, etc.
senses.chn: 违背（诺言）；背信弃义；食言

ex.en: to renege on a deal/debt/contract, etc.
ex.cn: 违背协定、赖债、违背合约等

senses.def: to begin sth again after a pause or an interruption

ex.en: The army renewed its assault on the capital.
ex.cn: 军队重新发动对首都的攻击。

ex.en: We have to renew our efforts to attract young players.
ex.cn: 我们只好重新开始努力吸引年轻队员。

ex.en: The annual dinner is a chance to renew acquaintance with old friends.
ex.cn: 一年一度的聚餐会是与老朋友叙旧的好机会。

senses.def: to make sth valid for a further period of time
senses.chn: 使继续有效；延长…的期限

ex.en: to renew a licence/lease/subscription/contract, etc.
ex.cn: 延长执照的期限、续签租约、续订、续签合约等

ex.en: How do I go about renewing my passport?
ex.cn: 我该如何去续签护照？

ex.en: I'd like to renew these library books (= arrange to borrow them for a further period of time).
ex.cn: 我想续借这几本图书馆的书。

senses.def: to emphasize sth by saying or stating it again

ex.en: to renew an appeal/a request/a complaint, etc.
ex.cn: 再次呼吁、请求、投诉等

ex.en: Community leaders have renewed calls for a peaceful settlement.
ex.cn: 社区领导人再次呼吁要和平解决。

ex.en: The project is to go ahead following renewed promises of aid from the UN.
ex.cn: 在得到联合国重申提供援助的承诺以后，这个项目将着手进行。

senses.def: to change sth that is old or damaged and replace it with sth new of the same kind

ex.en: The wiring in your house should be renewed every ten to fifteen years.
ex.cn: 你家里的电线应该每十到十五年更换一次。

senses.def: that is replaced naturally or controlled carefully and can therefore be used without the risk of finishing it all
senses.chn: 可更新的；可再生的；可恢复的

ex.en: renewable sources of energy such as wind and solar power
ex.cn: 像风力和太阳能这种用之不竭的能源

senses.def: that can be made valid for a further period of time after it has finished
senses.chn: 可延长有效期的；可展期的；可续订的
