ex.en: learning by repetition
ex.cn: 通过重复来学习

senses.def: a thing that has been done or said before

ex.en: We do not want to see a repetition of last year's tragic events.
ex.cn: 我们不想看到去年的悲剧重演。

senses.def: involving sth that is often repeated, in a way that becomes boring
senses.chn: 重复的；一再的；重复乏味的

ex.en: a long and repetitious speech
ex.cn: 冗长重复的讲话

senses.def: saying or doing the same thing many times, so that it becomes boring

ex.en: a repetitive task
ex.cn: 重复乏味的工作

senses.def: repeated many times

ex.en: a repetitive pattern of behaviour
ex.cn: 重复的行为模式

senses.def: to say or write sth using different words in order to make the meaning clearer
senses.chn: 换个说法说，改变词句（以使意思更清楚）

senses.def: to be used instead of sth/sb else; to do sth instead of sb/sth else

ex.en: The new design will eventually replace all existing models.
ex.cn: 新的设计最终将会取代全部现有的型号。

ex.en: Teachers will never be replaced by computers in the classroom.
ex.cn: 课堂上电脑永远不会取代老师。

senses.def: to remove sb/sth and put another person or thing in their place

ex.en: He will be difficult to replace when he leaves.
ex.cn: 他离开后，他的位置很难有人接替。

ex.en: It is not a good idea to miss meals and replace them with snacks.
ex.cn: 不吃正餐，改吃点心，这不是什么好主意。

senses.def: to change sth that is old, damaged, etc. for a similar thing that is newer or better

ex.en: All the old carpets need replacing.
ex.cn: 所有的旧地毯都需要更换。

ex.en: You'll be expected to replace any broken glasses.
ex.cn: 玻璃杯如有损坏，要负责赔偿。

senses.def: to put sth back in the place where it was before

ex.en: I replaced the cup carefully in the saucer.
ex.cn: 我小心翼翼地将杯子放回茶碟。

ex.en: to replace the handset (= after using the telephone).
ex.cn: 放回电话听筒

senses.def: that can be replaced
the act of replacing one thing with another, especially sth that is newer or better

ex.en: the replacement of worn car parts
ex.cn: 汽车上损坏零件的更换

ex.en: replacement windows
ex.cn: 新换的窗子

senses.def: a thing that replaces sth, especially because the first thing is old, broken, etc.

ex.en: a hip replacement
ex.cn: 人工髋关节

senses.def: a person who replaces another person in an organization, especially in their job
senses.chn: （尤指工作中的）接替者，替代者

ex.en: We need to find a replacement for Sue.
ex.cn: 我们需要找一个替代休的人。

senses.def: a game that is played again because neither side won in the previous game
senses.chn: （由于未决出胜负而进行的）重赛

senses.def: the playing again of a short section of a film/movie, tape, etc. especially to look at or listen to sth more carefully
senses.chn: （录像、录音等的）重放，重演，重播

ex.en: We watched a replay of the wedding on DVD.
ex.cn: 我们看了重放的婚礼 DVD 录像。

senses.def: something that is repeated or happens in exactly the same way as it did before
senses.chn: 重演的事物；重复出现的事物

ex.en: This election will not be a replay of the last one.
ex.cn: 这次选举将不会是上一次的重演。

senses.def: to play a sports game again because neither team won the first game
to play again sth that has been recorded on tape, film, etc.

ex.en: The police replayed footage of the accident over and over again.
ex.cn: 警察一遍又一遍地重放事故的片段。

ex.en: He replayed the scene in his mind.
ex.cn: 他不断回想起当时的情景。

senses.def: to make sth full again by replacing what has been used

ex.en: to replenish food and water supplies
ex.cn: 补充食物和水

ex.en: Allow me to replenish your glass.
ex.cn: 让我再给您斟满。

senses.def: filled with sth; with a full supply of sth

ex.en: literature replete with drama and excitement
ex.cn: 充满紧张刺激情节的文学作品

senses.def: very full of food
a very good or exact copy of sth

ex.en: a replica of the Eiffel Tower
ex.cn: 埃菲尔铁塔模型

ex.en: The weapon used in the raid was a replica.
ex.cn: 抢劫案中使用的武器是一件仿制品。

ex.en: replica guns
ex.cn: 仿制的枪支

senses.def: that can be copied exactly

ex.en: The design is easily replicable.
ex.cn: 这个设计很容易复制。

senses.def: to copy sth exactly

ex.en: Subsequent experiments failed to replicate these findings.
ex.cn: 后来的实验没有得出同样的结果。

senses.def: to produce exact copies of itself

ex.en: The drug prevents the virus from replicating itself.
ex.cn: 这种药能防止病毒复制。

senses.def: a gene which causes a section of DNA to copy itself
to say or write sth as an answer to sb/sth

ex.en: to reply to a question/an advertisement
ex.cn: 回答问题；回应广告

ex.en: He never replied to any of my letters.
ex.cn: 他从来没给我回过信。

ex.en: She only replied with a smile.
ex.cn: 她只是报以微笑。

ex.en: 'I won't let you down,' he replied confidently.
ex.cn: 他信心十足地答道：“我不会让你失望的。”

ex.en: The senator replied that he was not in a position to comment.
ex.cn: 参议员回答说他不宜发表评论。

ex.en: I'm writing to answer your questions.
ex.cn: 特此函复贵方提问。

senses.def: to do sth as a reaction to sth that sb has said or done

ex.en: The terrorists replied to the government's statement with more violence.
ex.cn: 恐怖分子以更多的暴力事件来回应政府的声明。

senses.def: an act of replying to sth/sb in speech, writing or by some action

ex.en: We had over 100 replies to our advertisement.
ex.cn: 我们的广告收到了 100 多个回应。

ex.en: I asked her what her name was but she made no reply.
ex.cn: 我问她叫什么名字，但她没有回答。

ex.en: I am writing in reply to your letter of 16 March.
ex.cn: 3 月 16 日来函收悉，现答复如下。

ex.en: a reply-paid envelope (= on which you do not have to put a stamp because it has already been paid for)
ex.cn: 邮资已付信封

ex.en: Morocco scored four goals without reply to win the game.
ex.cn: 摩洛哥队在一球未失的情况下连入四球，赢得了这场比赛。

ex.en: I'm writing to answer your questions.
ex.cn: 特此函复贵方提问。

senses.def: a person whose job is to repossess (= take back) goods from people who still owe money for them and cannot pay
senses.chn: （向拖欠货款者追回商品的）商品收回员

senses.def: to give people information about sth that you have heard, seen, done, etc.

ex.en: The crash happened seconds after the pilot reported engine trouble.
ex.cn: 飞行员报告发动机有故障后几秒钟飞机就坠毁了。

ex.en: Call me urgently if you have anything to report.
ex.cn: 如果有什么事要向我汇报，立即给我打电话。

ex.en: The committee will report on its research next month.
ex.cn: 委员会下个月将汇报他们的研究情况。

ex.en: The neighbours reported seeing him leave the building around noon.
ex.cn: 邻居们反映说在中午时分看见他离开了大楼。

ex.en: The doctor reported the patient fully recovered.
ex.cn: 医生说这位病人已经完全康复。

ex.en: The house was reported as being in excellent condition.
ex.cn: 报告说明这房子的状况极佳。

senses.def: to present a written or spoken account of an event in a newspaper, on television, etc.

ex.en: The stabbing was reported in the local press.
ex.cn: 当地的新闻媒体报道了持刀伤人事件。

ex.en: It was reported that several people had been arrested.
ex.cn: 据报道已有数人被捕。

ex.en: The TV news reported that several people had been arrested.
ex.cn: 据电视新闻报道，已有数人被捕。

ex.en: She reports on royal stories for the BBC.
ex.cn: 她为英国广播公司做有关王室活动的报道。

senses.def: used to show that sth has been stated, and you do not know if it is true or not
senses.chn: （不知传言是否确凿）据说，传闻

ex.en: She is reported to earn over $10 million a year.
ex.cn: 据传她一年挣 1 000 多万美元。

ex.en: The President is reported as saying that he needs a break.
ex.cn: 据传总统说他需要休息一下。

ex.en: It was reported that changes were being considered.
ex.cn: 有传言说改革措施正在酝酿之中。

senses.def: to tell a person in authority about a crime, an accident, an illness, etc. or about sth bad that sb has done

ex.en: Have you reported the accident to the police yet?
ex.cn: 你将这次事故报警了吗？

ex.en: a decrease in the number of reported cases of AIDS
ex.cn: 艾滋病病例报告数量的减少

ex.en: He's already been reported twice for arriving late.
ex.cn: 他因为迟到已经两次被告发。

ex.en: She has reported her daughter missing.
ex.cn: 女儿失踪，她已经向警方报案。

senses.def: to tell sb that you have arrived, for example for work or for a meeting with sb

ex.en: You should report for duty at 9.30 a.m.
ex.cn: 你应该在上午 9:30 报到上班。

ex.en: All visitors must report to the reception desk on arrival.
ex.cn: 所有访客到达后务必在接待处报到。

senses.def: to return to a place, especially in order to work again
senses.chn: 回归；返回；（尤指）回到工作岗位

ex.en: Take an hour for lunch and report back at 2.
ex.cn: 花一个小时吃午饭，两点钟返回。

senses.def: to give sb information about sth that they have asked you to find out about

ex.en: Find out as much as you can about him and report back to me.
ex.cn: 尽量查找有关他的资料，向我汇报。

ex.en: One person in the group should be prepared to report back to the class on your discussion.
ex.cn: 应由其中一名组员准备向全班汇报你们的讨论情况。

ex.en: They reported back that no laws had actually been broken.
ex.cn: 他们汇报说并没有真正发生违法的事。

senses.def: if you report to a particular manager in an organization that you work for, they are officially responsible for your work and tell you what to do
a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast

ex.en: Are these newspaper reports true?
ex.cn: 报纸上这些报道属实吗？

ex.en: a weather report
ex.cn: 天气预报

ex.en: Are these newspaper reports true?
ex.cn: 报纸上这些报道属实吗？

ex.en: It was many years before the full story was made public.
ex.cn: 许多年之后，事情的全貌才公之于众。

ex.en: the front-page story
ex.cn: 头版报道

ex.en: She gave the police a full account of the incident.
ex.cn: 她向警方详尽地叙述了所发生的事情。

senses.def: a spoken or written description of sth containing information that sb needs to have

ex.en: a police/medical report
ex.cn: 警方的／医疗报告

ex.en: Can you give us a progress report?
ex.cn: 你可以给我们提供进度报告吗？

senses.def: an official document written by a group of people who have examined a particular situation or problem

ex.en: The committee will publish their report on the health service in a few weeks.
ex.cn: 委员会将在几周内发表他们对公共医疗服务的调查报告。

senses.def: a story or piece of information that may or may not be true

ex.en: I don't believe these reports of UFO sightings.
ex.cn: 我不相信这些有关目击不明飞行物的传言。

ex.en: There are unconfirmed reports of a shooting in the capital.
ex.cn: 有未经证实的传言说在首都发生了枪击事件。

senses.def: a written statement about a student's work at school, college, etc.

ex.en: a school report
ex.cn: 学生成绩报告单

ex.en: to get a good/bad report
ex.cn: 成绩优异／欠佳

senses.def: an employee whose work is the responsibility of a particular manager

ex.en: a weekly meeting with my direct reports
ex.cn: 同我的直接下属一起开的周会

senses.def: the sound of an explosion or of a gun being fired

ex.en: a loud report
ex.cn: 巨大的爆炸声

senses.def: talked about by people in a bad/good way
the reporting of news or the typical style in which this is done in newspapers, or on TV and radio
senses.chn: 新闻报道；报道风格；报道文体

senses.def: to return to a place, especially in order to work again
senses.chn: 回归；返回；（尤指）回到工作岗位

ex.en: Take an hour for lunch and report back at 2.
ex.cn: 花一个小时吃午饭，两点钟返回。

senses.def: according to what some people say

ex.en: The band have reportedly decided to split up.
ex.cn: 据说这个乐队已经决定解散。

senses.def: a report of what sb has said that does not use their exact words

ex.en: In reported speech, 'I'll come later' becomes 'He said he'd come later'.
ex.cn: 在间接引语中，I'll come later 变为 He said he'd come later。

senses.def: a person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio or television

ex.en: a reporter from the New York Times
ex.cn: 《纽约时报》的记者

ex.en: a crime reporter
ex.cn: 报道罪案的记者

senses.def: the presenting of and writing about news on television and radio, and in newspapers

ex.en: accurate/balanced/objective reporting
ex.cn: 准确的／公正的／客观的新闻报道

ex.en: Reporting restrictions on the trial have been lifted (= it can now legally be reported).
ex.cn: 对报道这次审讯的限制已经撤销。

senses.def: if you report to a particular manager in an organization that you work for, they are officially responsible for your work and tell you what to do
a state of rest, sleep or feeling calm
to be or be kept in a particular place
to lie or rest in a particular place
a place where sth is stored in large quantities
a person or book that is full of information
senses.chn: 学识渊博的人；智囊；知识宝典

ex.en: My father is a repository of family history.
ex.cn: 我的父亲对家族史无所不知。

senses.def: to take back property or goods from sb who has arranged to buy them but who still owes money for them and cannot pay
senses.chn: （因买者未如期付款而）收回（房地产、商品等）

ex.en: First I lost my job, then my house was repossessed.
ex.cn: 我先是失去了工作，后来房子又被收回。

senses.def: the act of repossessing property, goods, etc.

ex.en: families threatened with repossession
ex.cn: 受到房子将被收回威胁的家庭

ex.en: a repossession order
ex.cn: 物品收回令

senses.def: a house, car, etc. that has been repossessed
senses.chn: 被收回的房子（或汽车等）

ex.en: Auctions are the best place for buying repossessions.
ex.cn: 拍卖会是购买被收回商品的最佳地方。

senses.def: morally wrong and deserving criticism
senses.chn: （不道德而）应受指责的，应受谴责的

senses.def: to give, show or send sth again, especially a cheque, bill, etc. that has not been paid
senses.chn: （尤指未支付的支票、账单等）再给予，再呈上，再递上

senses.def: to be a member of a group of people and act or speak on their behalf at an event, a meeting, etc.

ex.en: The competition attracted over 500 contestants representing 8 different countries.
ex.cn: 这次比赛吸引了代表 8 个不同国家的 500 多名参赛者。

ex.en: Local businesses are well represented on the committee (= there are a lot of people from them on the committee).
ex.cn: 委员会中有许多地方企业的代表。

ex.en: The President was represented at the ceremony by the Vice-President.
ex.cn: 副总统代表总统出席了这次庆典。

senses.def: to act or speak officially for sb and defend their interests
senses.chn: 作为…的代言人；维护…的利益

ex.en: The union represents over 200 000 teachers.
ex.cn: 工会代表着 20 余万名教师的利益。

ex.en: The association was formed to represent the interests of women artists.
ex.cn: 成立这个协会是为了维护女性艺术家的利益。

ex.en: Ms Dale is representing the defendant (= is his/her lawyer) in the case.
ex.cn: 在这个案件当中，戴尔女士为被告作辩护。

senses.def: to be sth

ex.en: This contract represents 20% of the company's annual revenue.
ex.cn: 这份合约相当于公司 20% 的年收入。

ex.en: This decision represents a significant departure from previous policy.
ex.cn: 这个决定意味着在很大程度上脱离了原先的政策。

senses.def: to be an example or expression of sth
senses.chn: 成为…实例；成为典型；体现

ex.en: a project representing all that is good in the community
ex.cn: 体现着社区中一切美好形象的工程

ex.en: Those comments do not represent the views of us all.
ex.cn: 这些言论并不代表我们所有人的看法。

senses.def: to be a symbol of sth

ex.en: Each colour on the chart represents a different department.
ex.cn: 图表中的每一种颜色都代表一个不同的部门。

ex.en: Wind direction is represented by arrows.
ex.cn: 风向是用箭头表示的。

senses.def: to show sb/sth, especially in a picture

ex.en: The carvings represent a hunting scene.
ex.cn: 这些雕刻作品描绘了一幅狩猎的场面。

ex.en: The results are represented in fig.3 below.
ex.cn: 结果如下面的图 3 所示。

senses.def: to present or describe sb/sth in a particular way, especially when this may not be fair
senses.chn: （尤指不公平地）展现，描述，表现

ex.en: The king is represented as a villain in the play.
ex.cn: 剧中国王的形象是一个恶棍。

ex.en: The risks were represented as negligible.
ex.cn: 他们把风险说得微不足道。

senses.def: to make a formal statement to sb in authority to make your opinions known or to protest

ex.en: They represented their concerns to the authorities.
ex.cn: 他们向当局陈述了他们关心的问题。

senses.def: the act of presenting sb/sth in a particular way; something that shows or describes sth
senses.chn: 表现；描述；描绘；表现形式

ex.en: the negative representation of single mothers in the media
ex.cn: 媒体对单身母亲的负面描述

ex.en: The snake swallowing its tail is a representation of infinity.
ex.cn: 蛇衔其尾表示无穷无尽。

senses.def: the fact of having representatives who will speak or vote for you or on your behalf
senses.chn: 有代理人；代表；维护；支持

ex.en: The green movement lacks effective representation in Parliament.
ex.cn: 环境保护运动在议会中缺乏有力的支持者。

ex.en: The accused was not allowed legal representation.
ex.cn: 没有允许被告请律师。

senses.def: formal statements made to sb in authority, especially in order to make your opinions known or to protest

ex.en: We have made representations to the prime minister, but without success.
ex.cn: 我们同首相进行交涉，但没有效果。

senses.def: trying to show things as they really are
involving the act of representing sb/sth

ex.en: local representational democracy
ex.cn: 地方代议民主政体

senses.def: a person who has been chosen to speak or vote for sb else or on behalf of a group

ex.en: a representative of the UN
ex.cn: 联合国代表

ex.en: our elected representatives in government
ex.cn: 政府中我们选举产生的代表

ex.en: a union representative
ex.cn: 工会代表

ex.en: The committee includes representatives from industry.
ex.cn: 这个委员会包括产业界的代表。

senses.def: a person who works for a company and travels around selling its products
senses.chn: 销售代表；销售代理；代销人

ex.en: a sales representative
ex.cn: 销售代表

ex.en: She's our representative in France.
ex.cn: 她是我们公司驻法国的销售代表。

senses.def: a person chosen to take the place of sb else

ex.en: He was the Queen's representative at the ceremony.
ex.cn: 他代表女王出席了庆典。

senses.def: a person who is typical of a particular group

ex.en: The singer is regarded as a representative of the youth of her generation.
ex.cn: 这位歌手被看作是她那一代年轻人的典型代表。

senses.def: (in the US) a member of the House of Representatives, the Lower House of Congress; a member of the House of Representatives in the lower house of a state parliament
typical of a particular group of people

ex.en: Is a questionnaire answered by 500 people truly representative of the population as a whole?
ex.cn: 由 500 人参加的问卷调查能真正代表所有民众吗？

senses.def: containing or including examples of all the different types of people or things in a large group

ex.en: a representative sample of teachers
ex.cn: 各类教师的代表

senses.def: able to be used as a typical example of sth

ex.en: The painting is not representative of his work of the period.
ex.cn: 这幅画不是他在那个时期画作的代表作。

senses.def: consisting of people who have been chosen to speak or vote on behalf of the rest of a group
senses.chn: 由代表组成的；代议制的

ex.en: a representative democracy
ex.cn: 代议制民主政体

senses.def: to try not to have or show an emotion, a feeling, etc.

ex.en: to repress a smile
ex.cn: 忍住不笑

ex.en: He burst in, making no effort to repress his fury.
ex.cn: 他冲了进来，毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。

senses.def: to use political and/or military force to control a group of people and restrict their freedom
having emotions or desires that are not allowed to be expressed
not expressed openly

ex.en: repressed anger
ex.cn: 被抑制的怒气

senses.def: the act of using force to control a group of people and restrict their freedom

ex.en: government repression
ex.cn: 政府的压制

senses.def: the act of controlling strong emotions and desires and not allowing them to be expressed so that they no longer seem to exist

ex.en: sexual repression
ex.cn: 性压抑

senses.def: controlling people by force and restricting their freedom

ex.en: a repressive regime/measure/law
ex.cn: 实行高压政策的政权；镇压措施；严厉的法律

senses.def: controlling emotions and desires and not allowing them to be expressed
to officially cancel or delay a punishment for a prisoner who is condemned to death
senses.chn: 撤销…的死刑；缓期执行…的死刑

ex.en: a reprieved murderer
ex.cn: 被判死刑而缓期执行的杀人犯

senses.def: to officially cancel or delay plans to close sth or end sth

ex.en: 70 jobs have been reprieved until next April.
ex.cn: 有 70 个职位暂时保留到明年四月份。

senses.def: an official order stopping a punishment, especially for a prisoner who is condemned to death
senses.chn: 刑罚终止令；（尤指）死刑缓刑令

senses.def: a delay before sth bad happens

ex.en: Campaigners have won a reprieve for the hospital threatened with closure.
ex.cn: 活动家们为这家受关闭威胁的医院赢得了喘息的机会。

senses.def: to tell sb officially that you do not approve of them or their actions

ex.en: The officers were severely reprimanded for their unprofessional behaviour.
ex.cn: 军官们因违反职业操守而受到了严厉的斥责。

senses.def: to print more copies of a book, an article, etc. with few or no changes
an act of printing more copies of a book because all the others have been sold
a book that has been reprinted
a violent or aggressive act towards sb because of sth bad that they have done towards you

ex.en: They did not want to give evidence for fear of reprisals.
ex.cn: 他们因为害怕报复而不想作证。

ex.en: They shot ten hostages in reprisal for the assassination of their leader.
ex.cn: 他们的首领遭到暗杀。为了报复，他们枪杀了十名人质。

senses.def: a repeated part of sth, especially a piece of music
senses.chn: 重复部分；（尤指乐曲的）反复

senses.def: copied, especially from a style that was originally made in the past
senses.chn: （尤指按古典风格）复制的，仿制的

ex.en: Victorian repro furniture
ex.cn: 仿制的维多利亚式家具

senses.def: something that is copied from a style that was originally made in the past
blame or criticism for sth you have done

ex.en: His voice was full of reproach.
ex.cn: 他的话完全是一种责备的语气。

ex.en: The captain's behaviour is above/beyond reproach (= you cannot criticize it).
ex.cn: 队长的行为无可厚非。

senses.def: a word or remark expressing blame or criticism
senses.chn: 责备的话语；批评的言辞

ex.en: He listened to his wife's bitter reproaches.
ex.cn: 他听着妻子严厉的责备。

senses.def: a state of shame or loss of honour

ex.en: Her actions brought reproach upon herself.
ex.cn: 她的举动使她很丢面子。

senses.def: a person or thing that brings shame on sb/sth
senses.chn: （给…）带来羞辱的人（或事）；（使…）丢脸的人（或事）

ex.en: Such living conditions are a reproach to our society.
ex.cn: 这样的生活条件是我们这个社会的耻辱。

senses.def: to blame or criticize sb for sth that they have done or not done, because you are disappointed in them

ex.en: She was reproached by colleagues for leaking the story to the press.
ex.cn: 她因为将这件事透露给新闻媒体而受到同事的指责。

senses.def: to feel guilty about sth that you think you should have done in a different way

ex.en: He reproached himself for not telling her the truth.
ex.cn: 他因为没有告诉她真相而自责。

senses.def: expressing blame or criticism

ex.en: a reproachful look
ex.cn: 责备的目光

senses.def: a person who behaves in a way that society thinks is immoral
to treat waste material so that it can be used again

ex.en: All these countries reprocess nuclear fuel.
ex.cn: 这些国家均对核燃料进行再处理。

senses.def: to make a copy of a picture, piece of text, etc.

ex.en: It is illegal to reproduce these worksheets without permission from the publisher.
ex.cn: 未经出版者许可翻印这些习题是违法的。

ex.en: The photocopier reproduces colours very well.
ex.cn: 这台复印机复制的色彩效果很好。

senses.def: to produce sth again; to make sth happen again in the same way
senses.chn: 再生产；再制造；使再次发生；再现

ex.en: The atmosphere of the novel is successfully reproduced in the movie.
ex.cn: 小说的氛围在电影中得到成功再现。

senses.def: if people, plants, animals, etc. reproduce or reproduce themselves, they produce young

ex.en: Most reptiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.
ex.cn: 大多数爬行动物在陆地产卵进行繁殖。

ex.en: cells reproducing themselves (= making new ones)
ex.cn: 自我繁殖的细胞

senses.def: the act or process of producing babies, young animals or plants

ex.en: sexual reproduction
ex.cn: 有性生殖

senses.def: the act or process of producing copies of a document, book, picture, etc.

ex.en: Use a black pen on white paper to ensure good reproduction.
ex.cn: 用白纸黑笔，以确保复制清晰。

senses.def: the process of recording sounds onto tapes, CDs, DVDs, etc.

ex.en: Digital recording gives excellent sound reproduction.
ex.cn: 数字录音的声音效果极佳。

senses.def: a thing that has been reproduced, especially a copy of a work of art

ex.en: a catalogue with colour reproductions of the paintings for sale
ex.cn: 待售画作的彩色图样目录

ex.en: reproduction furniture (= furniture made as a copy of an earlier style)
ex.cn: 仿制的旧式家具

senses.def: connected with reproducing babies, young animals or plants

ex.en: reproductive organs
ex.cn: 生殖器官

senses.def: the science and practice of copying documents and pictures for publishing, etc.
blame or disapproval

ex.en: His words were a mixture of pity and reproof.
ex.cn: 他的话里既有同情也有责备。

senses.def: a remark that expresses blame or disapproval
senses.chn: 责备的话语；非难的言辞

ex.en: She received a mild reproof from the teacher.
ex.cn: 她受到了老师温和的责备。

senses.def: to tell sb that you do not approve of sth that they have done

ex.en: He reproved her for rushing away.
ex.cn: 他责备她不该匆匆离去。

senses.def: any animal that has cold blood and skin covered in scales, and that lays eggs. Snakes, crocodiles and tortoises are all reptiles.
a country that is governed by a president and politicians elected by the people and where there is no king or queen

ex.en: newly independent republics
ex.cn: 新独立的共和国

ex.en: the Republic of Ireland
ex.cn: 爱尔兰共和国

senses.def: a person who supports a form of government with a president and politicians elected by the people and with no king or queen
senses.chn: 拥护共和政体的人；共和主义者

senses.def: a member or supporter of the Republican Party of the US
senses.chn: （美国）共和党党员，共和党的支持者

senses.def: a person from Northern Ireland who believes that Northern Ireland should be part of the Republic of Ireland and not part of the United Kingdom
senses.chn: 北爱尔兰共和主义者（认为北爱尔兰应脱离英国回归爱尔兰共和国）

senses.def: connected with or like a republic; supporting the principles of a republic
senses.chn: 共和国的；共和政体的；拥护共和政体的

ex.en: a republican government/movement
ex.cn: 共和政体／运动

senses.def: connected with the Republican Party in the US
connected with or supporting the Republicans in Northern Ireland
senses.chn: 北爱尔兰共和主义者的；支持北爱尔兰共和主义者的

senses.def: to refuse to accept sth

ex.en: to repudiate a suggestion
ex.cn: 拒绝一项建议

senses.def: to say officially and/or publicly that sth is not true

ex.en: to repudiate a report
ex.cn: 驳斥一份报告

senses.def: to refuse to be connected with sb any longer
senses.chn: 拒绝与…往来；断绝同…的关系

ex.en: He repudiated his first wife and married her sister.
ex.cn: 他和第一个妻子离了婚，然后娶了她的妹妹。

senses.def: relating to a situation in which sb refuses to do sth that they are legally required to do
a strong feeling of dislike or disgust about sth

ex.en: She was trying to overcome her physical repugnance for him.
ex.cn: 她努力克制对他非常强烈的反感。

senses.def: making you feel strong dislike or disgust
senses.chn: 使十分嫌恶；使反感；不得人心

ex.en: We found his suggestion absolutely repugnant.
ex.cn: 我们觉得他的建议绝对不得人心。

ex.en: The idea of eating meat was repugnant to her.
ex.cn: 一想到吃肉她就想吐。

senses.def: to make sb feel disgust or strong dislike

ex.en: I was repulsed by the horrible smell.
ex.cn: 这种可怕的气味让我恶心。

senses.def: to fight sb who is attacking you and drive them away

ex.en: to repulse an attack/invasion/offensive
ex.cn: 击退一次进攻／入侵／攻势

senses.def: to refuse to accept sb's help, attempts to be friendly, etc.

ex.en: Each time I tried to help I was repulsed.
ex.cn: 每次我想要帮忙都遭到了拒绝。

ex.en: She repulsed his advances.
ex.cn: 她拒绝了他的追求。

senses.def: a feeling of very strong dislike of sth that you find extremely unpleasant
senses.chn: 嫌恶感；强烈的反感；憎恶

senses.def: the force by which objects tend to push each other away

ex.en: the forces of attraction and repulsion
ex.cn: 引力和斥力

senses.def: causing a feeling of strong dislike; very unpleasant
senses.chn: 令人厌恶的；令人反感的；十分讨厌的

ex.en: a repulsive sight/smell/habit
ex.cn: 令人厌恶的情景／气味／习惯

ex.en: What a repulsive man!
ex.cn: 这个人真讨厌！

senses.def: causing repulsion (= a force that pushes away)

ex.en: repulsive forces
ex.cn: 斥力

senses.def: to change sth slightly in order to make it suitable for a new purpose
senses.chn: （为适合新用途）对…稍加修改，略微改动

senses.def: that people consider to be honest and to provide a good service

ex.en: a reputable dealer/company/supplier
ex.cn: 可信赖的交易商／公司／供应商

senses.def: the opinion that people have about what sb/sth is like, based on what has happened in the past

ex.en: to earn/establish/build a reputation
ex.cn: 赢得／确立／树立声誉

ex.en: to have a good/bad reputation
ex.cn: 有好／坏名声

ex.en: She soon acquired a reputation as a first-class cook.
ex.cn: 她不久就获得了一级厨师的荣誉。

ex.en: I'm aware of Mark's reputation for being late.
ex.cn: 我知道马克迟到是出了名的。

ex.en: to damage/ruin sb's reputation
ex.cn: 有损／毁坏某人的名声

ex.en: The weather in England is living up to its reputation (= is exactly as expected).
ex.cn: 英国的天气完全就如人们所说的那样。

senses.def: the opinion that people have of sb/sth

ex.en: She is a writer of international repute.
ex.cn: 她是一位享有国际声誉的作家。

ex.en: My parents were artists of (some) repute (= having a very good reputation).
ex.cn: 我的双亲是具有（一定）知名度的艺术家。

senses.def: generally thought to be sth or to have done sth, although this is not certain

ex.en: He is reputed to be the best heart surgeon in the country.
ex.cn: 他号称是这个国家最好的心脏外科医生。

ex.en: The house is wrongly reputed to have been the poet's birthplace.
ex.cn: 这所房子被误以为是诗人的出生地。

ex.en: She sold her share of the company for a reputed £7 million.
ex.cn: 她的公司股份据说卖了 700 万英镑。

senses.def: the action of asking for sth formally and politely

ex.en: They made a request for further aid.
ex.cn: 他们要求再给一些援助。

ex.en: He was there at the request of his manager/at his manager's request (= because his manager had asked him to go).
ex.cn: 他按照经理的要求到了那里。

ex.en: The writer's name was withheld by request (= because the writer asked for this to be done).
ex.cn: 按照作者的要求，姓名不予公布。

ex.en: Catalogues are available on request.
ex.cn: 目录可以索取。

senses.def: a thing that you formally ask for

ex.en: My request was granted.
ex.cn: 我的要求得到了满足。

ex.en: a radio request programme (= a programme of music, songs, etc. that people have asked for)
ex.cn: 电台点播节目

senses.def: to ask for sth or ask sb to do sth in a polite or formal way

ex.en: She requested permission to film at the White House.
ex.cn: 她申请准予在白宫拍摄。

ex.en: You can request a free copy of the leaflet.
ex.cn: 你可以索要一份免费的宣传单。

ex.en: You are requested not to smoke in the restaurant.
ex.cn: 请不要在餐馆里吸烟。

ex.en: She requested that no one be told of her decision until the next meeting.
ex.cn: 她要求下次开会前不要向任何人透露她的决定。

ex.en: She requested that no one should be told of her decision.
ex.cn: 她要求不要向任何人透露她的决定。

ex.en: 'Please come with me,' he requested.
ex.cn: “请跟我来。” 他要求道。

senses.def: a bus stop where buses stop only if sb signals to the driver that they want the bus to stop
a Christian ceremony for a person who has recently died, at which people say prayers for his or her soul
a piece of music for this ceremony
to need sth; to depend on sb/sth

ex.en: These pets require a lot of care and attention.
ex.cn: 这些宠物需要悉心照顾。

ex.en: This condition requires urgent treatment.
ex.cn: 这种情况得紧急处理。

ex.en: Do you require anything else?(= in a shop/store, for example)
ex.cn: 你还需要什么吗？

ex.en: True marriage requires us to show trust and loyalty.
ex.cn: 真正的婚姻有赖于我们表现出信任与忠诚。

ex.en: The situation required that he be present.
ex.cn: 这种情形需要他在场。

ex.en: The situation required that he should be present.
ex.cn: 这种情形需要他在场。

senses.def: to make sb do or have sth, especially because it is necessary according to a particular law or set of rules
senses.chn: 使做（某事）；使拥有（某物）；（尤指根据法规）规定

ex.en: The wearing of seat belts is required by law.
ex.cn: 法律规定必须系安全带。

ex.en: 'Hamlet' is required reading (= must be read) for this course.
ex.cn: 《哈姆雷特》是这门课程的指定读物。

ex.en: Several students failed to reach the required standard.
ex.cn: 有几名学生没有达到规定的标准。

ex.en: What exactly is required of a receptionist (= what are they expected to do)?
ex.cn: 接待员的职责到底是什么？

ex.en: All candidates will be required to take a short test.
ex.cn: 所有候选者都要参加一次小测验。

ex.en: We require that you comply with the following rules:…
ex.cn: 我们要求你遵守以下规则：…

senses.def: something that you need or want

ex.en: the basic requirements of life
ex.cn: 基本生活所需

ex.en: a software package to meet your requirements
ex.cn: 满足你需要的软件包

ex.en: Our immediate requirement is extra staff.
ex.cn: 我们亟须增加人手。

ex.en: These goods are surplus to requirements (= more than we need).
ex.cn: 这些货物超过了我们的需要。

senses.def: something that you must have in order to do sth else

ex.en: to meet/fulfil/satisfy the requirements
ex.cn: 符合／满足必备的条件

ex.en: What is the minimum entrance requirement for this course?
ex.cn: 这门课程的基本入学条件是什么？

senses.def: necessary for a particular purpose
senses.chn: 必需的；必备的；必不可少的

ex.en: She lacks the requisite experience for the job.
ex.cn: 她缺少做这份工作所必需的经验。

senses.def: something that you need for a particular purpose

ex.en: toilet requisites (= soap, toothpaste, etc.)
ex.cn: 洗漱用品

ex.en: A university degree has become a requisite for entry into most professions.
ex.cn: 大学学位已经成为在大多数行业谋职的必要条件。

senses.def: a formal, official written request or demand for sth

ex.en: the requisition of ships by the government
ex.cn: 政府对船只的征用

ex.en: a requisition form/order
ex.cn: 征用单；征用令

senses.def: to officially demand the use of a building, vehicle, etc., especially during a war or an emergency
senses.chn: （尤指战时或紧急状态时）征用

ex.en: The school was requisitioned as a military hospital.
ex.cn: 学校被征用作为军用医院。

senses.def: to give sth such as love, kindness, a favour, etc. in return for what sb has given you

ex.en: requited love
ex.cn: 得到回报的爱

senses.def: to change the route that a road, vehicle, telephone call, etc. normally follows
senses.chn: 改变…的路线；改变…的线路

senses.def: a television programme that is shown again

ex.en: reruns of old TV shows
ex.cn: 老电视节目的重播

senses.def: an event, such as a race or competition, that is held again
senses.chn: 重新举行的事；重新赛跑；重赛

senses.def: something that is done in the same way as sth in the past

ex.en: We wanted to avoid a rerun of last year's disastrous trip.
ex.cn: 我们想避免去年那种糟糕的旅行再度出现。

senses.def: to show a film/movie, television programme, etc. again
to do sth again in a similar way
senses.chn: （以相同的方式）重做，再次进行

ex.en: to rerun an experiment
ex.cn: 重新做实验

senses.def: to run a race again
the sale to another person of sth that you have bought

ex.en: the resale value of a car
ex.cn: 汽车的转卖价格

senses.def: to change the time at which sth has been arranged to happen, especially so that it takes place later
senses.chn: 将…改期；修改…的时间表；重新安排

ex.en: The meeting has been rescheduled for next week.
ex.cn: 会议改期到下周举行。

senses.def: to arrange for sb to pay back money that they have borrowed at a later date than was originally agreed
to officially state that a law, contract, decision, etc. is no longer valid
the act of cancelling or ending a law, an order, or an agreement
to save sb/sth from a dangerous or harmful situation

ex.en: He rescued a child from drowning.
ex.cn: 他救起了一名落水儿童。

ex.en: The house was rescued from demolition.
ex.cn: 这所房子保住了，可以不拆。

ex.en: You rescued me from an embarrassing situation.
ex.cn: 我正感到尴尬，你为我解了围。

ex.en: They were eventually rescued by helicopter.
ex.cn: 他们最后被直升机救走了。

ex.en: She had despaired of ever being rescued alive.
ex.cn: 她那时对获救生还已经绝望了。

ex.en: Doctors were unable to save him.
ex.cn: 医生未能把他救活。

senses.def: the act of saving sb/sth from a dangerous or difficult situation; the fact of being saved

ex.en: We had given up hope of rescue.
ex.cn: 我们那时已经放弃了获救的希望。

ex.en: A wealthy benefactor came to their rescue with a generous donation.
ex.cn: 一位富有的赞助人慷慨解囊挽救了他们。

ex.en: a rescue attempt/operation
ex.cn: 一次营救行动

ex.en: a mountain rescue team
ex.cn: 登山救援队

ex.en: rescue workers/boats/helicopters
ex.cn: 救援人员／船只／直升机

senses.def: an occasion when sb/sth is saved from a dangerous or difficult situation

ex.en: Ten fishermen were saved in a daring sea rescue.
ex.cn: 在一次惊心动魄的海上营救行动中，十名渔民获救。

senses.def: a person whose job is to try to save people from dangerous or difficult situations, especially after an accident or a disaster

ex.en: Rescue workers are working under very difficult conditions to find survivors from the blast.
ex.cn: 救援人员正在非常困难的条件下努力寻找爆炸的幸存者。

senses.def: a careful study of a subject, especially in order to discover new facts or information about it

ex.en: medical/historical/scientific, etc. research
ex.cn: 医学、历史、科学等研究

ex.en: to do/conduct/undertake research
ex.cn: 做研究

ex.en: He has carried out extensive research into renewable energy sources.
ex.cn: 他对再生能源进行了广泛研究。

ex.en: Recent research on deaf children has produced some interesting findings about their speech.
ex.cn: 对失聪儿童的最新研究已经在言语能力方面取得了一些令人关注的结果。

ex.en: What have their researches shown?
ex.cn: 他们的研究证明了什么？

ex.en: a research project/grant/student
ex.cn: 研究项目／经费；研究生

senses.def: to study sth carefully and try to discover new facts about it

ex.en: They're researching into ways of improving people's diet.
ex.cn: 他们在研究如何改进人们的饮食。

ex.en: to research a problem/topic/market
ex.cn: 研究一个问题／课题／市场

ex.en: She's in New York researching her new book (= finding facts and information to put in it).
ex.cn: 她在纽约为她的新书搜集材料。

ex.en: We have to research how the product will actually be used.
ex.cn: 我们必须研究该产品的实际使用方法。

senses.def: (in industry, etc.) work that tries to find new products and processes or to improve existing ones
to cut out part of an organ or a piece of tissue from the body
to sell sth that you have bought

ex.en: He resells the goods at a profit.
ex.cn: 他转卖货品赢利。

senses.def: the fact of being or looking similar to sb/sth

ex.en: a striking/close/strong resemblance
ex.cn: 明显的／不小的／显著的相似之处

ex.en: family resemblances
ex.cn: 亲缘相似

ex.en: She bears an uncanny resemblance to Dido.
ex.cn: 她长得酷似迪多。

ex.en: The movie bears little resemblance to the original novel.
ex.cn: 电影和原著相去甚远。

ex.en: The resemblance between the two signatures was remarkable.
ex.cn: 两个签名的相似之处非常明显。

senses.def: to look like or be similar to another person or thing

ex.en: She closely resembles her sister.
ex.cn: 她和她姐姐很像。

ex.en: So many hotels resemble each other.
ex.cn: 许多酒店看上去都差不多。

ex.en: The plant resembles grass in appearance.
ex.cn: 这种植物的外形像草。

senses.def: to feel bitter or angry about sth, especially because you feel it is unfair
senses.chn: 愤恨；感到气愤；愤愤不平

ex.en: I deeply resented her criticism.
ex.cn: 我对她的批评感到非常气愤。

ex.en: He bitterly resents being treated like a child.
ex.cn: 他十分厌恶被别人当孩子对待。

ex.en: She resented him making all the decisions.
ex.cn: 她讨厌什么事都要听他的。

ex.en: She resented his making all the decisions.
ex.cn: 她讨厌什么事都要听他的。

senses.def: feeling bitter or angry about sth that you think is unfair
senses.chn: 感到气愤的；憎恨的；愤慨的

ex.en: a resentful look
ex.cn: 充满怨恨的眼神

ex.en: They seemed to be resentful of our presence there.
ex.cn: 他们好像对我们在那里露面很生气。

ex.en: She was resentful at having been left out of the team.
ex.cn: 她对被运动队淘汰感到气愤。

senses.def: a feeling of anger or unhappiness about sth that you think is unfair
