senses.chn: 嘹亮的；响亮的；回响的；悠扬的

ex.en: a deep resonant voice
ex.cn: 深沉而响亮的声音

senses.def: causing sounds to continue for a long time

ex.en: resonant frequencies
ex.cn: 谐振频率

senses.def: having the power to bring images, feelings, memories, etc. into your mind
senses.chn: 引起联想的；产生共鸣的

ex.en: a poem filled with resonant imagery
ex.cn: 充满了让人浮想联翩的意象的诗歌

senses.def: to make a deep, clear sound that continues for a long time
senses.chn: 产生共鸣；发出回响；回荡

senses.def: to be filled with sound; to make a sound continue longer

ex.en: a resonating chamber
ex.cn: 产生回音的房间

ex.en: The room resonated with the chatter of 100 people.
ex.cn: 屋里充满了 100 人唧唧喳喳的声音。

senses.def: to remind sb of sth; to be similar to what sb thinks or believes
senses.chn: 使产生联想；引起共鸣；和…的想法（或观念）类似

ex.en: These issues resonated with the voters.
ex.cn: 这些问题引起了投票者的共鸣。

senses.def: to be full of a particular quality or feeling

ex.en: She makes a simple story resonate with complex themes and emotions.
ex.cn: 她使一部情节简单的小说充满了复杂的主题和情感。

senses.def: to be full of a particular quality or feeling

ex.en: She makes a simple story resonate with complex themes and emotions.
ex.cn: 她使一部情节简单的小说充满了复杂的主题和情感。

senses.def: a device for making sound louder and stronger, especially in a musical instrument
a place where a lot of people go on holiday/vacation

ex.en: seaside/ski/mountain, etc. resorts
ex.cn: 海滨、滑雪、山区等度假胜地

ex.en: a popular holiday resort
ex.cn: 受欢迎的旅游胜地

ex.en: the resort town of Byron Bay
ex.cn: 度假小镇拜伦贝城

senses.def: the act of using sth, especially sth bad or unpleasant, because nothing else is possible

ex.en: There are hopes that the conflict can be resolved without resort to violence.
ex.cn: 冲突有望不需要诉诸武力而得到解决。

senses.def: the first or last course of action that you should or can take in a particular situation
senses.chn: 应急措施；可首先（或最后）采取的手段

ex.en: Strike action should be regarded as a last resort, when all attempts to negotiate have failed.
ex.cn: 罢工应该是最后一着，在所有的谈判努力都告失败时才使用。

ex.en: In the last resort (= in the end) everyone must decide for themselves.
ex.cn: 最后人人都得自己作决定。

senses.def: to make use of sth, especially sth bad, as a means of achieving sth, often because there is no other possible solution

ex.en: They felt obliged to resort to violence.
ex.cn: 他们觉得有必要诉诸暴力。

ex.en: We may have to resort to using untrained staff.
ex.cn: 我们也许只能使用未受过训练的员工了。

senses.def: to make use of sth, especially sth bad, as a means of achieving sth, often because there is no other possible solution

ex.en: They felt obliged to resort to violence.
ex.cn: 他们觉得有必要诉诸暴力。

ex.en: We may have to resort to using untrained staff.
ex.cn: 我们也许只能使用未受过训练的员工了。

senses.def: to fill a place with sound

ex.en: Laughter resounded through the house.
ex.cn: 笑声在屋里回荡。

ex.en: The tragedy resounded around the world.
ex.cn: 这一惨案传遍了全世界。

senses.def: to be filled with sound
senses.chn: 回荡着声音；回响着声音

ex.en: The street resounded to the thud of marching feet.
ex.cn: 街道上回荡着行进步伐的铿锵声。

senses.def: very great

ex.en: a resounding victory/win/defeat
ex.cn: 巨大的胜利／成功／失败

ex.en: The evening was a resounding success.
ex.cn: 晚会办得非常圆满。

senses.def: very loud and continuing for a long time
a supply of sth that a country, an organization or a person has and can use, especially to increase their wealth

ex.en: the exploitation of minerals and other natural resources
ex.cn: 矿产和其他自然资源的开发

ex.en: We do not have the resources (= money) to update our computer software.
ex.cn: 我们没有钱来更新我们的电脑软件。

ex.en: We must make the most efficient use of the available financial resources.
ex.cn: 我们必须最有效地利用现有财力。

ex.en: We agreed to pool our resources (= so that everyone gives sth).
ex.cn: 我们同意把我们的资源集中起来。

senses.def: something that can be used to help achieve an aim, especially a book, equipment, etc. that provides information for teachers and students
senses.chn: 有助于实现目标的东西；资料

ex.en: The database could be used as a teaching resource in colleges.
ex.cn: 该数据库可用作大学里的一种教学辅助工具。

ex.en: Time is your most valuable resource, especially in examinations.
ex.cn: 时间是你最宝贵的东西，尤其是在考试中。

ex.en: resource books for teachers
ex.cn: 教师参考书

senses.def: personal qualities such as courage and imagination that help you deal with difficult situations

ex.en: He has no inner resources and hates being alone.
ex.cn: 他没有什么精神力量，因而害怕独处。

senses.def: to provide sth with the money or equipment that is needed

ex.en: Schools in the area are still inadequately resourced.
ex.cn: 本地区的学校仍然没有足够的资金。

senses.def: good at finding ways of doing things and solving problems, etc.
senses.chn: 机敏的；足智多谋的；随机应变的

senses.def: if a character that has been killed in a video game respawns or is respawned, that character appears again in the game
senses.chn: （电子游戏中的人物）重生，复活

senses.def: a feeling of admiration for sb/sth because of their good qualities or achievements

ex.en: I have the greatest respect for your brother.
ex.cn: 我非常尊敬你的哥哥。

ex.en: A two-minute silence was held as a mark of respect.
ex.cn: 人们静默两分钟以示尊敬。

ex.en: A deep mutual respect and understanding developed between them.
ex.cn: 他们之间产生了深切的相互尊重和理解。

ex.en: It was very interesting. Respect! (= used to praise sb)
ex.cn: 这很有意思。了不起！

senses.def: polite behaviour towards or care for sb/sth that you think is important

ex.en: to show a lack of respect for authority
ex.cn: 蔑视权威

ex.en: He has no respect for her feelings.
ex.cn: 他根本不尊重她的感情。

ex.en: Everyone has a right to be treated with respect.
ex.cn: 人人有权受到尊重。

senses.def: a particular aspect or detail of sth

ex.en: In this respect we are very fortunate.
ex.cn: 在这方面，我们是很幸运的。

ex.en: There was one respect, however, in which they differed.
ex.cn: 然而，他们在一点上有分歧。

senses.def: concerning

ex.en: A writ was served on the firm in respect of their unpaid bill.
ex.cn: 公司由于欠账而收到了传票。

senses.def: in payment for sth

ex.en: money received in respect of overtime worked
ex.cn: 得到的加班费

senses.def: used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with sb
senses.chn: （通常在表示强烈不同意之前说）恕我直言

ex.en: With all due respect, the figures simply do not support you on this.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，这些数字根本不能支持你的观点。

senses.def: concerning

ex.en: The two groups were similar with respect to income and status.
ex.cn: 这两组在收入和地位方面是相似的。

senses.def: used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with sb
senses.chn: （通常在表示强烈不同意之前说）恕我直言

ex.en: With all due respect, the figures simply do not support you on this.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，这些数字根本不能支持你的观点。

senses.def: to visit sb or to send a message of good wishes as a sign of respect for them

ex.en: Many came to pay their last respects (= by attending sb's funeral).
ex.cn: 许多人前来参加葬礼向逝者告别。

senses.def: to have a very good opinion of sb/sth; to admire sb/sth

ex.en: I respect Jack's opinion on most subjects.
ex.cn: 在大多数事情上，我尊重杰克的意见。

ex.en: a much loved and highly respected teacher
ex.cn: 备受爱戴和尊敬的老师

ex.en: She had always been honest with me, and I respect her for that.
ex.cn: 她一直对我很诚实。我非常敬重她这一点。

senses.def: to be careful about sth; to make sure you do not do sth that sb would consider to be wrong
senses.chn: 慎重对待；谨慎从事；尊重

ex.en: to respect other people's property
ex.cn: 不侵犯别人的财产

ex.en: She promised to respect our wishes.
ex.cn: 她保证尊重我们的愿望。

ex.en: He doesn't respect other people's right to privacy.
ex.cn: 他不尊重别人的隐私权。

senses.def: to agree not to break a law, principle, etc.

ex.en: The new leader has promised to respect the constitution.
ex.cn: 新的领导人承诺遵守宪法。

senses.def: the fact of being considered socially acceptable
considered by society to be acceptable, good or correct
senses.chn: 体面的；得体的；值得尊敬的

ex.en: a highly respectable neighbourhood
ex.cn: 非常体面的街区

ex.en: a respectable married man
ex.cn: 正派的已婚男子

ex.en: Go and make yourself look respectable.
ex.cn: 去把自己弄得体面点儿。

senses.def: fairly good; that there is not reason to be ashamed of

ex.en: a perfectly respectable result
ex.cn: 非常好的结果

senses.def: to treat everyone in the same way, without being influenced by their importance, wealth, etc.
showing or feeling respect

ex.en: The onlookers stood at a respectful distance.
ex.cn: 旁观者站在一定的距离之外，以示尊敬。

ex.en: We were brought up to be respectful of authority.
ex.cn: 我们从小就学会了尊重权威。

senses.def: concerning

ex.en: information respecting the child's whereabouts
ex.cn: 关于孩子下落的消息

senses.def: belonging or relating separately to each of the people or things already mentioned

ex.en: They are each recognized specialists in their respective fields.
ex.cn: 他们在各自的领域都被视为专家。

ex.en: the respective roles of men and women in society
ex.cn: 男女在社会中各自的角色

senses.def: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned
senses.chn: 分别；各自；顺序为；依次为

ex.en: Julie and Mark, aged 17 and 19 respectively
ex.cn: 朱莉和马克，年龄分别为 17 岁和 19 岁

senses.def: the act of breathing

ex.en: Blood pressure and respiration are also recorded.
ex.cn: 血压和呼吸也做了记录。

senses.def: a piece of equipment that makes it possible for sb to breathe over a long period when they are unable to do so naturally

ex.en: She was put on a respirator.
ex.cn: 给她戴上了人工呼吸器。

senses.def: a device worn over the nose and mouth to allow sb to breathe in a place where there is a lot of smoke, gas, etc.
connected with breathing

ex.en: the respiratory system
ex.cn: 呼吸系统

ex.en: respiratory diseases
ex.cn: 呼吸道疾病

senses.def: to breathe
a piece of equipment for measuring how much air sb's lungs will hold
a short break or escape from sth difficult or unpleasant

ex.en: The drug brought a brief respite from the pain.
ex.cn: 药物暂时缓解了疼痛。

ex.en: There was no respite from the suffocating heat.
ex.cn: 闷热的天气根本没有缓解。

ex.en: She continued to work without respite.
ex.cn: 她连续工作，没有休息。

ex.en: respite care (= temporary care arranged for old, mentally ill, etc. people so that the people who usually care for them can have a rest)
ex.cn: 暂时托管（为老人或病人提供短期照料以使长期照顾者获得短暂休息）

ex.en: We stopped for a well-earned rest.
ex.cn: 我们停下来作个应有的休息。

ex.en: Let's take a break.
ex.cn: 咱们休息一会儿吧。

senses.def: a short delay allowed before sth difficult or unpleasant must be done

ex.en: His creditors agreed to give him a temporary respite.
ex.cn: 他的债权人同意给他一个喘息的机会。

senses.def: brightly coloured in an impressive way

ex.en: He glimpsed Sonia, resplendent in a red dress.
ex.cn: 他瞥了索尼娅一眼，见她一身红衣，光彩照人。

senses.def: to give a spoken or written answer to sb/sth

ex.en: I asked him his name, but he didn't respond.
ex.cn: 我问他叫什么名字，可他没回答。

ex.en: She never responded to my letter.
ex.cn: 她从来没给我回过信。

ex.en: 'I'm not sure,' she responded.
ex.cn: “我不肯定。” 她答道。

ex.en: When asked about the company's future, the director responded that he remained optimistic.
ex.cn: 问到公司的未来的时候，经理回答说他依然乐观。

ex.en: I'm writing to answer your questions.
ex.cn: 特此函复贵方提问。

ex.en: I'm writing to reply to your questions.
ex.cn: 特此函复贵方提问。

senses.def: to do sth as a reaction to sth that sb has said or done

ex.en: How did they respond to the news?
ex.cn: 他们对这则消息有什么反应？

ex.en: The government responded by banning all future demonstrations.
ex.cn: 政府的反应是今后禁止一切示威活动。

senses.def: to react quickly or in the correct way to sth/sb
senses.chn: 反应灵敏；作出正确反应

ex.en: The car responds very well to the controls.
ex.cn: 这辆汽车操纵自如。

ex.en: You can rely on him to respond to a challenge.
ex.cn: 你可以信赖他，他懂得应付挑战。

senses.def: to improve as a result of a particular kind of treatment
senses.chn: 有改进；见起色；显出效果

ex.en: The infection did not respond to the drugs.
ex.cn: 这些药物对感染没有起作用。

senses.def: a person who answers questions, especially in a survey
senses.chn: 回答问题的人；（尤指）调查对象

ex.en: 60% of the respondents agreed with the suggestion.
ex.cn: 回复调查的人中 60% 同意这项建议。

senses.def: a person who is accused of sth
a spoken or written answer

ex.en: She made no response.
ex.cn: 她没作任何回答。

ex.en: In response to your enquiry…
ex.cn: 兹回复阁下询问…

ex.en: I received an encouraging response to my advertisement.
ex.cn: 我的广告有了令人鼓舞的回应。

senses.def: a reaction to sth that has happened or been said

ex.en: The news provoked an angry response.
ex.cn: 这条消息引起了人们的愤怒。

ex.en: a positive response
ex.cn: 积极的反应

ex.en: I knocked on the door but there was no response.
ex.cn: 我敲了门，可是没有回应。

ex.en: The product was developed in response to customer demand.
ex.cn: 这种产品是为了满足顾客的需要而开发的。

ex.en: We sent out over 1 000 letters but the response rate has been low (= few people replied).
ex.cn: 我们寄出了 1 000 多封信，但回信寥寥。

senses.def: a part of a church service that the people sing or speak as an answer to the part that the priest sings or speaks
senses.chn: （礼拜仪式中的）答唱咏，启应经

senses.def: the length of time that a person or system takes to react to sth

ex.en: The average response time to emergency calls was 9 minutes.
ex.cn: 紧急救助电话的平均回应时间是 9 分钟。

senses.def: a duty to deal with or take care of sb/sth, so that you may be blamed if sth goes wrong

ex.en: We are recruiting a sales manager with responsibility for the European market.
ex.cn: 我们正在招聘负责欧洲市场的销售经理。

ex.en: They have responsibility for ensuring that the rules are enforced.
ex.cn: 他们有责任确保制度的执行。

ex.en: It is their responsibility to ensure that the rules are enforced.
ex.cn: 他们有责任确保制度的执行。

ex.en: parental rights and responsibilities
ex.cn: 父母的权利和义务

ex.en: to take/assume overall responsibility for personnel
ex.cn: 对人事部门全面负责

ex.en: I don't feel ready to take on new responsibilities.
ex.cn: 我觉得还没准备好承担新的责任。

senses.def: blame for sth bad that has happened

ex.en: The bank refuses to accept responsibility for the mistake.
ex.cn: 银行拒绝为这一错误承担责任。

ex.en: Nobody has claimed responsibility for the bombing.
ex.cn: 没有人声称对爆炸事件负责。

senses.def: a duty to help or take care of sb because of your job, position, etc.

ex.en: She feels a strong sense of responsibility towards her employees.
ex.cn: 她对自己的雇员有很强的责任感。

ex.en: I think we have a moral responsibility to help these countries.
ex.cn: 我认为我们在道义上有责任帮助这些国家。

senses.def: having the job or duty of doing sth or taking care of sb/sth, so that you may be blamed if sth goes wrong

ex.en: Mike is responsible for designing the entire project.
ex.cn: 迈克负责设计全部工程。

ex.en: Even where parents no longer live together, they each continue to be responsible for their children.
ex.cn: 即使父母不再共同生活，他们也要分别对子女负责。

senses.def: being able to be blamed for sth

ex.en: Who's responsible for this mess?
ex.cn: 是谁弄得这么乱？

ex.en: Everything will be done to bring those responsible to justice.
ex.cn: 将竭尽全力把罪魁祸首绳之以法。

ex.en: He is mentally ill and cannot be held responsible for his actions.
ex.cn: 他有精神病，不能对自己的行为负责。

senses.def: being the cause of sth

ex.en: Cigarette smoking is responsible for about 90% of deaths from lung cancer.
ex.cn: 因患肺癌而死亡者，约 90% 是吸烟所致。

senses.def: having to report to sb/sth with authority or in a higher position and explain to them what you have done

ex.en: The Council of Ministers is responsible to the Assembly.
ex.cn: 内阁须向议会负责。

senses.def: that you can trust and rely on
senses.chn: 可信任的；可信赖的；可靠的

ex.en: Clare has a mature and responsible attitude to work.
ex.cn: 克莱尔对待工作成熟而可信赖。

senses.def: needing sb who can be trusted and relied on; involving important duties
senses.chn: 责任重大的；需要可靠的人负责的

ex.en: a responsible job/position
ex.cn: 责任重大的工作／岗位

senses.def: in a sensible way that shows you can be trusted
senses.chn: 明事理地；认真负责地；可信赖地

ex.en: to act responsibly
ex.cn: 办事认真负责

senses.def: reacting quickly and in a positive way

ex.en: Firms have to be responsive to consumer demand.
ex.cn: 公司必须对顾客的需求作出积极反应。

ex.en: a flu virus that is not responsive to treatment
ex.cn: 治疗无效的流感病毒

senses.def: reacting with interest or enthusiasm

ex.en: The club is responsive to new ideas.
ex.cn: 俱乐部对新的想法都表示欢迎。

ex.en: a responsive and enthusiastic audience
ex.cn: 反应热烈又热情的观众

senses.def: used to describe a website, etc. that changes to suit the kind of device you are using it on, for example by changing the size of the text or the way that items are arranged on the screen
senses.chn: （网站等）响应式设计的，自适应的（可根据使用者的装置以适当的样式呈现内容）

senses.def: to change the colour of sth, especially a car, by painting it with a spray
the remaining part of sth

ex.en: I'm not doing this job for the rest of my life.
ex.cn: 我不会一辈子干这种工作。

ex.en: How would you like to spend the rest of the day?
ex.cn: 后半天你打算怎么过？

ex.en: Take what you want and throw the rest away.
ex.cn: 把你想要的拿走，其余的丢掉。

senses.def: the remaining people or things; the others
senses.chn: 其余的人；其他事物；其他

ex.en: Don't blame Alex. He's human, like the rest of us.
ex.cn: 不要责怪亚历克斯。他和我们大家一样，也是人。

ex.en: The first question was difficult, but the rest were pretty easy.
ex.cn: 第一个问题很难，但其余的都相当简单。

senses.def: a period of relaxing, sleeping or doing nothing after a period of activity

ex.en: I had a good night's rest.
ex.cn: 我睡了一宿好觉。

ex.en: We stopped for a well-earned rest.
ex.cn: 我们停下来休息，也该休息一下了。

ex.en: to have/take a rest from all your hard work
ex.cn: 放下繁重的工作，休息一下

ex.en: Try to get some rest —you have a busy day tomorrow.
ex.cn: 休息一下吧，你明天还要忙一天呢。

ex.en: There are no matches tomorrow, which is a rest day, but the tournament resumes on Monday.
ex.cn: 明天是休息日，没有比赛，但星期一继续比赛。

ex.en: We stopped for a well-earned rest.
ex.cn: 我们停下来作个应有的休息。

senses.def: an object that is used to support or hold sth

ex.en: an armrest (= for example on a seat or chair)
ex.cn: 座椅扶手

senses.def: a period of silence between notes; a sign that shows a rest between notes
used at the end of a list to mean everything else that you might expect to be on the list

ex.en: He wants a big house and an expensive car and all the rest of it.
ex.cn: 他想要大房子、豪华汽车，如此等等。

senses.def: used to say that the actual amount or number of sth is much higher than sb has stated
senses.chn: （比所说的）还要多；远不只此数

ex.en: 'It cost 250 pounds…' 'And the rest, and the rest!'
ex.cn: “这要花 250 英镑…” “不只这些，不只！”

senses.def: not moving

ex.en: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.
ex.cn: 这种昆虫不动时看上去像一片枯叶。

senses.def: dead and therefore free from trouble or anxiety. People say 'at rest' to avoid saying 'dead'.
senses.chn: （委婉说法，与 dead 同义）安息，长眠

ex.en: She now lies at rest in the churchyard.
ex.cn: 她现在长眠在教堂墓地里。

senses.def: to stop moving

ex.en: The car crashed through the barrier and came to rest in a field.
ex.cn: 汽车闯过护栏，在一块田里停了下来。

ex.en: His eyes came to rest on Clara's face.
ex.cn: 他的目光停留在克拉拉的脸上。

senses.def: apart from that; as far as other matters are concerned

ex.en: The book has some interesting passages about the author's childhood. For the rest, it is extremely dull.
ex.cn: 这本书中关于作者童年的一些章节倒还有意思。除此之外，便无聊至极。

senses.def: used to tell sb to stop talking about sth because they are annoying you
to stop doing sth for a while
to bury sb. People say 'to lay sb to rest' to avoid saying 'to bury' sb.
senses.chn: （委婉说法，与 bury 同义）安葬

ex.en: George was laid to rest beside his parents.
ex.cn: 乔治被安葬在他父母墓旁。

senses.def: to stop sth by showing it is not true

ex.en: The announcement finally laid all the speculation about their future to rest.
ex.cn: 通告最终消除了一切有关他们的未来的推测。

senses.def: used when you are telling a story to say that you do not need to tell the end of it, because everyone knows it already
senses.chn: 结局是尽人皆知的；结果如何不必赘述

senses.def: to do or say sth to make sb stop worrying about sth
used when sb is complaining that they have a lot of work to do
senses.chn: （有人抱怨工作太多时说）恶人绝无平安

senses.def: to relax, sleep or do nothing after a period of activity or illness; to not use a part of your body for some time

ex.en: The doctor told me to rest.
ex.cn: 医生叫我休息。

ex.en: I can rest easy (= stop worrying) knowing that she's safely home.
ex.cn: 知道她安然无恙地回到家里，我就可以放心了。

ex.en: He won't rest (= will never be satisfied) until he finds her.
ex.cn: 他非得找到她才会安心。

ex.en: Rest your eyes every half an hour.
ex.cn: 每过半小时让眼睛休息一下。

senses.def: to support sth by putting it on or against sth; to be supported in this way

ex.en: Rest your head on my shoulder.
ex.cn: 把头靠在我肩上。

ex.en: He rested his chin in his hands.
ex.cn: 他双手托着下巴。

ex.en: His chin rested on his hands.
ex.cn: 他双手托着下巴。

ex.en: Their bikes were resting against the wall.
ex.cn: 他们的自行车靠在墙上。

senses.def: if you let a matter rest, you stop discussing it or dealing with it

ex.en: The matter cannot rest there—I intend to sue.
ex.cn: 这件事不能就此了结，我打算提出诉讼。

senses.def: to be buried. People say 'rest' to avoid saying 'be buried'.
senses.chn: （委婉说法，与 be buried 同义）安息，长眠

ex.en: She rests beside her husband in the local cemetery.
ex.cn: 在当地的墓地里，她长眠在她丈夫的墓旁。

ex.en: May he rest in peace.
ex.cn: 愿他安息吧。

senses.def: used to emphasize that what you say is true or will definitely happen
senses.chn: （强调所言确凿无误）尽管放心

ex.en: You may rest assured that we will do all we can to find him.
ex.cn: 你就放心吧，我们会千方百计找到他。

senses.def: used to say that you do not need to say any more about sth because you think that you have proved your point
senses.chn: 我的论证到此为止（已经足够）

senses.def: used by lawyers in court to say that they have finished presenting their case
senses.chn: （律师在法庭上）对案情陈述完毕

ex.en: The prosecution rests its case.
ex.cn: 控方对案情陈述完毕。

senses.def: to relax and stop worrying

ex.en: You can rest easy—I'm not going to tell anyone.
ex.cn: 你尽管放心，我不会告诉任何人的。

senses.def: used to show respect when you are talking about sb who is dead
senses.chn: （对死者表示敬意）魂归天国，安息主怀

senses.def: to feel so satisfied with what you have already achieved that you do not try to do any more
senses.chn: 满足于既得成就；不思进取

senses.def: to depend or rely on sb/sth

ex.en: All our hopes now rest on you.
ex.cn: 现在所有的希望都寄托在你的身上。

senses.def: to look at sb/sth

ex.en: Her eyes rested on the piece of paper in my hand.
ex.cn: 她的目光落在我手里的一张纸上。

senses.def: to be based on sth

ex.en: The whole argument rests on a false assumption.
ex.cn: 全部论证都是基于一个错误的假设。

senses.def: if it rests with sb to do sth, it is their responsibility to do it

ex.en: It rests with management to justify their actions.
ex.cn: 管理部门应当为他们的行动说出个道理来。

ex.en: The final decision rests with the doctors.
ex.cn: 要由医生作出最后决定。

senses.def: an area beside an important road where people can stop their cars to rest, eat food, etc.
senses.chn: （主干道旁的）停车休息区，休息站

senses.def: to start again, or to make sth start again, after it has stopped

ex.en: to restart a game
ex.cn: 重新开始游戏

ex.en: The doctors struggled to restart his heart.
ex.cn: 医生竭力重新起搏他的心脏。

senses.def: to say sth again or in a different way, especially so that it is more clearly or strongly expressed
a place where you can buy and eat a meal

ex.en: an Italian restaurant
ex.cn: 一家意大利餐馆

ex.en: We had a meal in a restaurant.
ex.cn: 我们在餐厅吃了顿饭。

ex.en: We went out to a restaurant to celebrate.
ex.cn: 我们到一家餐馆里庆祝了一番。

ex.en: a restaurant owner
ex.cn: 餐馆老板

ex.en: a self-service restaurant
ex.cn: 自助餐馆

senses.def: a person who owns and manages a restaurant
a period spent resting or relaxing in order to improve your physical or mental health
feeling healthy and full of energy because you have had a rest
senses.chn: 休息后精力恢复（或精神振作）的

ex.en: I awoke feeling rested and refreshed.
ex.cn: 我睡醒后感觉精力充沛，神清气爽。

senses.def: that makes you feel relaxed and peaceful
senses.chn: 闲适宁静的；使人感到悠闲的

ex.en: a hotel with a restful atmosphere
ex.cn: 气氛闲适幽雅的旅馆

senses.def: a place where old or sick people are cared for
(in parts of Asia and Africa) a house or hut that you can pay to stay in like a hotel room, especially in wild country
senses.chn: （亚洲和非洲部分地区，尤指野外的）客栈，旅舍

senses.def: a grave. People say 'resting place' to avoid saying 'grave'.
senses.chn: （委婉说法，与 grave 同义）坟墓，安息处

ex.en: her final/last resting place
ex.cn: 她的长眠之处

senses.def: a place where you can rest
the act of giving back sth that was lost or stolen to its owner
senses.chn: 归还（真正物主）；归还（赃物等）

senses.def: payment, usually money, for some harm or wrong that sb has suffered
unable to stay still, or unwilling to be controlled, especially because you feel bored or not satisfied
senses.chn: 难驾驭的；焦躁不安的；不耐烦的

senses.def: unable to stay still or be happy where you are, because you are bored or need a change

ex.en: The audience was becoming restless.
ex.cn: 观众开始不耐烦了。

ex.en: After five years in the job, he was beginning to feel restless.
ex.cn: 这份工作干了五年以后，他开始厌烦了。

senses.def: without real rest or sleep
senses.chn: 没有真正休息的；没有睡眠的

ex.en: a restless night
ex.cn: 不眠之夜

senses.def: to fill sth with new or different things to replace those that have been used, sold, etc.; to get a new supply of sth
senses.chn: 更新（旧物品）；补充（货源）；再补给

senses.def: to be based on sth

ex.en: The whole argument rests on a false assumption.
ex.cn: 全部论证都是基于一个错误的假设。

senses.def: the work of repairing and cleaning an old building, a painting, etc. so that its condition is as good as it originally was

ex.en: The palace is closed for restoration.
ex.cn: 王宫因整修而停止开放。

ex.en: restoration work
ex.cn: 修复工作

senses.def: the act of bringing back a system, a law, etc. that existed previously

ex.en: the restoration of democracy/the monarchy
ex.cn: 民主制度／君主政体的恢复

senses.def: the act of returning sth to its correct place, condition or owner

ex.en: the restoration of the Elgin marbles to Greece
ex.cn: 埃尔金大理石雕塑品之交还希腊

senses.def: the time in Britain after 1660 when, following a period with no king or queen, Charles II became king
senses.chn: 王政复辟时期（1660 年，英国经历了一段无王时期后，查理二世登基为王）

ex.en: Restoration comedy/poetry (= written during and after this time)
ex.cn: 王政复辟时期的喜剧／诗歌

senses.def: making you feel strong and healthy again
senses.chn: 恢复健康的；促使康复的

ex.en: the restorative power of fresh air
ex.cn: 新鲜空气的康复功效

senses.def: connected with treatment that repairs the body or a part of it

ex.en: restorative dentistry/surgery
ex.cn: 整形牙科／外科

senses.def: a thing that makes you feel better, stronger, etc.
senses.chn: 有助于恢复健康的事物；滋补品

senses.def: to bring back a situation or feeling that existed before

ex.en: The measures are intended to restore public confidence in the economy.
ex.cn: 这些举措旨在恢复公众对经济的信心。

ex.en: Order was quickly restored after the riots.
ex.cn: 暴乱过后秩序很快得到了恢复。

ex.en: Such kindness restores your faith in human nature (= makes you believe most people are kind).
ex.cn: 这样的善心使人又一次感到人性善良。

ex.en: The operation restored his sight (= made him able to see again).
ex.cn: 手术使他恢复了视力。

senses.def: to bring sb/sth back to a former condition, place or position

ex.en: He is now fully restored to health.
ex.cn: 他现在完全恢复了健康。

ex.en: We hope to restore the garden to its former glory (= make it as beautiful as it used to be).
ex.cn: 我们想把这花园变得和过去一样美丽。

senses.def: to repair a building, work of art, piece of furniture, etc. so that it looks as good as it did originally

ex.en: Her job is restoring old paintings.
ex.cn: 她的工作是修复旧画。

senses.def: to bring a law, tradition, way of working, etc. back into use

ex.en: to restore ancient traditions
ex.cn: 恢复古老的传统

ex.en: Some people argue that the death penalty should be restored.
ex.cn: 有些人主张恢复死刑。

senses.def: to give sth that was lost or stolen back to sb

ex.en: The police have now restored the painting to its rightful owner.
ex.cn: 警察已经把这幅油画归还给了它的合法主人。

senses.def: a person whose job is to repair old buildings, works of art, etc. so that they look as they did when new
to stop sb/sth from doing sth, especially by using physical force

ex.en: The prisoner had to be restrained by the police.
ex.cn: 警方只好强行制住囚犯。

ex.en: He placed a restraining hand on her arm.
ex.cn: 他拉住她的胳膊制止她。

ex.en: They have obtained an injunction restraining the company from selling the product.
ex.cn: 他们已经得到阻止这家公司出售这一产品的禁销令。

senses.def: to stop yourself from feeling an emotion or doing sth that you would like to do
senses.chn: 约束（自己）；控制（自己）；忍住

ex.en: John managed to restrain his anger.
ex.cn: 约翰努力压制住自己的怒气。

ex.en: She had to restrain herself from crying out in pain.
ex.cn: 她只得忍住疼痛，不哭出来。

senses.def: to stop sth that is growing or increasing from becoming too large

ex.en: The government is taking steps to restrain inflation.
ex.cn: 政府正在采取措施控制通货膨胀。

senses.def: showing calm control rather than emotion

ex.en: her restrained smile
ex.cn: 她克制的微笑

senses.def: not too brightly coloured or decorated

ex.en: The costumes and lighting in the play were restrained.
ex.cn: 这出戏的服装和灯光都很朴实。

senses.def: an official order given by a judge which demands that sth must or must not be done. A restraining order does not require a trial in court but only lasts for a limited period of time.
a rule, a fact, an idea, etc. that limits or controls what people can do
senses.chn: 约束力；管制措施；制约因素

ex.en: The government has imposed export restraints on some products.
ex.cn: 政府对一些产品实行了出口控制。

ex.en: The EU has set strict limits on pollution levels.
ex.cn: 欧盟对污染程度作了严格的限定。

ex.en: the speed limit
ex.cn: 速度限制

ex.en: There are no restrictions on the amount of money you can withdraw.
ex.cn: 取款没有限额。

ex.en: arms control
ex.cn: 军备控制

ex.en: We have to work within severe constraints of time and money.
ex.cn: 我们必须在时间紧迫、资金紧张的限制下工作。

senses.def: the act of controlling or limiting sth because it is necessary or sensible to do so

ex.en: wage restraint
ex.cn: 限制工资增长

senses.def: the quality of behaving calmly and with control

ex.en: The police appealed to the crowd for restraint.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁群众保持克制。

ex.en: He exercised considerable restraint in ignoring the insults.
ex.cn: 他表现出相当的克制，没去理会种种侮辱。

senses.def: the use of physical force to control sb who is behaving in a violent way

ex.en: the physical restraint of prisoners
ex.cn: 对囚犯的人身限制

senses.def: a type of seat belt or safety device

ex.en: Children must use an approved child restraint or adult seat belt.
ex.cn: 儿童必须使用经过认可的儿童安全带或成人座椅安全带。

senses.def: to limit the size, amount or range of sth

ex.en: Speed is restricted to 30 mph in towns.
ex.cn: 在城里车速不得超过每小时 30 英里。

ex.en: We restrict the number of students per class to 10.
ex.cn: 我们将每个班的学生人数限定为 10 人。

ex.en: Fog severely restricted visibility.
ex.cn: 浓雾严重影响了能见度。

ex.en: Having small children tends to restrict your freedom.
ex.cn: 有了小孩往往会限制你的自由。

senses.def: to stop sb/sth from moving or acting freely

ex.en: The long skirt restricted her movements.
ex.cn: 长裙妨碍了她的行动。

senses.def: to control sth with rules or laws

ex.en: Access to the club is restricted to members only.
ex.cn: 俱乐部仅对会员开放。

senses.def: to allow yourself or sb to have only a limited amount of sth or to do only a particular kind of activity

ex.en: I restrict myself to one cup of coffee a day.
ex.cn: 我控制自己每天只喝一杯咖啡。

senses.def: limited or small in size or amount

ex.en: a restricted space
ex.cn: 有限的空间

ex.en: a restricted range of foods
ex.cn: 有限的食物种类

senses.def: limited in what you are able to do
senses.chn: （指能做的事）有限的，受限制的

ex.en: In those days women led fairly restricted lives.
ex.cn: 那时，妇女过着相当受限制的生活。

ex.en: Her vision is restricted in one eye.
ex.cn: 她只有一只眼睛有视力。

senses.def: controlled by rules or laws
senses.chn: 受（法规）制约的；受控制的；受约束的

ex.en: to allow children only restricted access to the Internet
ex.cn: 只允许儿童有限地接触互联网

ex.en: a restricted area (= controlled by laws about speed or parking)
ex.cn: （车速或停车）限制区

ex.en: The tournament is restricted to players under the age of 23.
ex.cn: 这次比赛只允许 23 岁以下的选手参加。

senses.def: only open to people with special permission, especially because it is secret or dangerous

ex.en: to enter a restricted zone
ex.cn: 进入禁区

senses.def: officially secret and only available to people with special permission
senses.chn: 保密的；限于内部传阅的

ex.en: a restricted document
ex.cn: 保密文件

senses.def: a rule or law that limits what you can do or what can happen

ex.en: import/speed/travel, etc. restrictions
ex.cn: 进口、速度、旅行等限制

ex.en: to impose/place a restriction on sth
ex.cn: 对某事实行限制

ex.en: The government has agreed to lift restrictions on press freedom.
ex.cn: 政府已经同意撤销对新闻自由的限制。

ex.en: The EU has set strict limits on pollution levels.
ex.cn: 欧盟对污染程度作了严格的限定。

ex.en: the speed limit
ex.cn: 速度限制

ex.en: There are no restrictions on the amount of money you can withdraw.
ex.cn: 取款没有限额。

senses.def: the act of limiting or controlling sb/sth

ex.en: sports clothes that prevent any restriction of movement
ex.cn: 宽松的运动服

senses.def: a thing that limits the amount of freedom you have

ex.en: the restrictions of a prison
ex.cn: 监狱的种种约束

senses.def: preventing people from doing what they want

ex.en: restrictive laws
ex.cn: 限制性法规

senses.def: explaining which particular person or thing you are talking about rather than giving extra information about them. In 'The books which are on the table are mine', 'which are on the table' is a restrictive relative clause.
agreements or ways of working that limit the freedom of workers or employers in order to prevent competition or to protect people's jobs
senses.chn: 限制竞争协议，限制竞争的行为（限制工人或雇主的自由，以防止竞争，保护就业）

senses.def: to fit new strings on a musical instrument such as a guitar or violin, or on a sports racket
senses.chn: 给（乐器或球拍）重新装弦

senses.def: a room with a toilet in a public place, such as a theatre or restaurant
senses.chn: （公共场所的）盥洗室，洗手间；公共厕所

senses.def: to organize sth such as a system or a company in a new and different way
an area beside an important road where people can stop their cars to rest, eat food, etc.
senses.chn: （主干道旁的）停车休息区，休息站

senses.def: used to say that you do not need to say any more about sth because you think that you have proved your point
senses.chn: 我的论证到此为止（已经足够）

senses.def: used by lawyers in court to say that they have finished presenting their case
senses.chn: （律师在法庭上）对案情陈述完毕

ex.en: The prosecution rests its case.
ex.cn: 控方对案情陈述完毕。

senses.def: a thing that is caused or produced because of sth else

ex.en: She died as a result of her injuries.
ex.cn: 她因伤死亡。

ex.en: The failure of the company was a direct result of bad management.
ex.cn: 公司倒闭的直接原因是经营不善。

ex.en: He made one big mistake, and, as a result, lost his job.
ex.cn: 他犯了个大错，结果丢了工作。

ex.en: The farm was flooded, with the result that most of the harvest was lost.
ex.cn: 农场被淹，收成损失了一大半。

ex.en: The end result (= the final one) of her hard work was a place at medical school.
ex.cn: 她勤奋苦读，终于进了医学院。

ex.en: This book is the result of 25 years of research.
ex.cn: 这本书是 25 年研究的结晶。

senses.def: the final score or the name of the winner in a sports event, competition, election, etc.
senses.chn: 结果（包括比分、得票、获胜者或当选者名单等）

ex.en: They will announce the result of the vote tonight.
ex.cn: 今晚他们将宣布投票结果。

ex.en: the election results
ex.cn: 选举结果

ex.en: the football results
ex.cn: 足球比赛的结果

senses.def: a victory or a success, especially in a game of football (soccer)

ex.en: We badly need to get a result from this match.
ex.cn: 这场比赛我们非赢不可。

senses.def: the mark/grade you get in an exam or in a number of exams

ex.en: Have you had your results yet?
ex.cn: 你知道考试成绩了吗？

senses.def: the information that you get from a scientific test or piece of research

ex.en: the result of an experiment
ex.cn: 实验结果

senses.def: things that are achieved successfully
senses.chn: 成功实现的事；成果；成效

ex.en: The project is beginning to show results.
ex.cn: 这项工程开始显出成效。

ex.en: a coach who knows how to get results from his players
ex.cn: 善于调动队员获取成功的教练

senses.def: to happen because of sth else that happened first

ex.en: job losses resulting from changes in production
ex.cn: 生产革新造成的失业

ex.en: When water levels rise, flooding results.
ex.cn: 水位上升，就会发生洪水。

ex.en: It was a large explosion and the resulting damage was extensive.
ex.cn: 爆炸相当剧烈，造成的破坏范围很大。

senses.def: to make sth happen

ex.en: The cyclone has resulted in many thousands of deaths.
ex.cn: 气旋已经造成了成千上万的人死亡。

ex.en: These policies resulted in many elderly people suffering hardship.
ex.cn: 这些政策使得许多老人饱受困苦。

ex.en: Childhood obesity can cause / lead to long-term health problems.
ex.cn: 儿童肥胖可能导致长期的健康问题。

ex.en: Changes in lifestyle and diet over the last twenty years have caused / led to / resulted in a sharp increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 过去二十年生活方式及饮食的变化导致肥胖儿童数量急剧上升。

ex.en: Several factors, including changes in diet and lifestyle, have contributed to the increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 包括饮食及生活方式变化在内的多个因素促使肥胖儿童数量增加。

ex.en: Research suggests that fast food and soft drinks directly contribute to childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 研究表明快餐和软饮料会直接导致儿童肥胖。

senses.def: caused by the thing that has just been mentioned
senses.chn: 因而发生的；因此而产生的

ex.en: the growing economic crisis and resultant unemployment
ex.cn: 不断加剧的经济危机以及由此而产生的失业

senses.def: expressing or relating to the result of an action
senses.chn: 表示结果的；结果性的；结果格的

senses.def: to make sth happen

ex.en: The cyclone has resulted in many thousands of deaths.
ex.cn: 气旋已经造成了成千上万的人死亡。

ex.en: These policies resulted in many elderly people suffering hardship.
ex.cn: 这些政策使得许多老人饱受困苦。

ex.en: Childhood obesity can cause / lead to long-term health problems.
ex.cn: 儿童肥胖可能导致长期的健康问题。

ex.en: Changes in lifestyle and diet over the last twenty years have caused / led to / resulted in a sharp increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 过去二十年生活方式及饮食的变化导致肥胖儿童数量急剧上升。

ex.en: Several factors, including changes in diet and lifestyle, have contributed to the increase in childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 包括饮食及生活方式变化在内的多个因素促使肥胖儿童数量增加。

ex.en: Research suggests that fast food and soft drinks directly contribute to childhood obesity.
ex.cn: 研究表明快餐和软饮料会直接导致儿童肥胖。

senses.def: if you resume an activity, or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption

ex.en: to resume talks/negotiations
ex.cn: 重新进行会谈／谈判

ex.en: She resumed her career after an interval of six years.
ex.cn: 时隔六年之后她又开始了自己的职业生涯。

ex.en: The noise resumed, louder than before.
ex.cn: 噪声再起，比先前更大。

ex.en: He got back in the car and resumed driving.
ex.cn: 他回到车上，继续开车。

senses.def: to go back to the seat or place that you had before
senses.chn: 回到（原来的座位、地方或位置）

senses.def: the act of beginning sth again after it has stopped
senses.chn: 重新开始；继续进行；恢复

ex.en: We are hoping for an early resumption of peace talks.
ex.cn: 我们企盼着早日恢复和谈。

senses.def: to give sb new supplies of sth they need; to give sth to sb again in a different form
senses.chn: 向…再供给（所需物品）；（以另一形式）重新提供

senses.def: to come to the surface again after being underwater or under the ground
senses.chn: 再次浮出，再次露出（水面或地面）

ex.en: The submarine resurfaced.
ex.cn: 潜艇重新浮出水面。

ex.en: All the old hostilities resurfaced when they met again.
ex.cn: 他们再次碰面时，过去的种种敌意又都冒了出来。

senses.def: to put a new surface on a road, path, etc.
the return and growth of an activity that had stopped
becoming stronger or more popular again
senses.chn: 复兴的；恢复生机活力的；再度流行的

senses.def: to bring back into use sth, such as a belief, a practice, etc., that had disappeared or been forgotten
senses.chn: 重新应用；恢复使用；使复兴

senses.def: to bring a dead person back to life
the time when Jesus Christ returned to life again after his death; the time when all dead people will become alive again, when the world ends
senses.chn: 耶稣复活；（世界末日）所有亡者复活

senses.def: a new beginning for sth which is old or which had disappeared or become weak
to make sb start breathing again or become conscious again after they have almost died

ex.en: He had a heart attack and all attempts to resuscitate him failed.
ex.cn: 他的心脏病发作，所有抢救他的努力都失败了。

ex.en: efforts to resuscitate the economy
ex.cn: 重振经济的努力

senses.def: the selling of goods to the public, usually through shops/stores

ex.en: The recommended retail price is £9.99.
ex.cn: 建议零售价为 9.99 英镑。

ex.en: department stores and other retail outlets
ex.cn: 百货商店和其他零售店

ex.en: the retail trade
ex.cn: 零售业

senses.def: to sell goods to the public, usually through shops/stores

ex.en: The firm manufactures and retails its own range of sportswear.
ex.cn: 公司生产并零售自己的运动服装系列。

senses.def: to be sold at a particular price

ex.en: The book retails at £14.95.
ex.cn: 这本书的零售价为 14.95 英镑。

senses.def: to tell people about sth, especially about a person's behaviour or private life
senses.chn: 详说，述说（尤指别人的事情）

ex.en: She retailed the neighbours' activities with relish.
ex.cn: 她饶有兴趣地对邻居们的活动说三道四。

senses.def: a person or business that sells goods to the public
the business of selling goods to the public, usually through shops/stores

ex.en: career opportunities in retailing
ex.cn: 零售业的职业机会

senses.def: an area containing a group of large shops/stores, located outside a town
(in Britain) a list of the prices of some ordinary goods and services which shows how much these prices change each month
the act of going shopping and buying things in order to make yourself feel more cheerful
senses.chn: 购物疗法（对花钱买乐这一做法的戏称）

ex.en: I was ready for a little retail therapy.
ex.cn: 我准备去接受一下购物治疗。

senses.def: to keep sth; to continue to have sth
senses.chn: 保持；持有；保留；继续拥有

ex.en: to retain your independence
ex.cn: 保持独立

ex.en: He struggled to retain control of the situation.
ex.cn: 他曾努力保持对局势的控制。

ex.en: The house retains much of its original charm.
ex.cn: 这所房子保留了许多原有的魅力。

ex.en: She retained her tennis title for the third year.
ex.cn: 她第三年保住了网球冠军的头衔。

senses.def: to continue to hold or contain sth

ex.en: a soil that retains moisture
ex.cn: 保持水分的土壤

ex.en: This information is no longer retained within the computer's main memory.
ex.cn: 该数据已不再保留在计算机的主存储器中。

ex.en: She has a good memory and finds it easy to retain facts.
ex.cn: 她记忆力好，很容易记住事情。

senses.def: if a member of the public retains sb such as a lawyer, he or she pays money regularly or in advance so the lawyer, etc. will do work for him or her

ex.en: a retaining fee
ex.cn: 给所委托律师的预付辩护费

ex.en: to retain the services of a lawyer
ex.cn: 聘定律师

senses.def: a sum of money that is paid to sb to make sure they will be available to do work when they are needed
senses.chn: （聘请律师等的）预付费用，保留金

ex.en: The agency will pay you a monthly retainer.
ex.cn: 这个机构将会每月付给你聘金。

senses.def: a small amount of rent that you pay for a room, etc. when you are not there in order to keep it available for your use
senses.chn: （为保留租房而付的）租房订金

senses.def: a device that keeps a person's teeth straight after they have had orthodontic treatment with braces
a servant, especially one who has been with a family for a long time
intended to keep sth in the correct position

ex.en: a retaining wall (= one that keeps the earth or water behind it in position)
ex.cn: 挡土墙；挡水墙

senses.def: to take control of sth such as a town again

ex.en: Government forces moved in to retake the city.
ex.cn: 政府军开进城市，以恢复对它的控制。

ex.en: Moore fought back to retake the lead later in the race.
ex.cn: 后来穆尔奋力反击，重新夺回了比赛中的领先地位。

senses.def: the act of filming a scene in a film/movie again, because it was not right before
to do sth harmful to sb because they have harmed you first

ex.en: to retaliate against an attack
ex.cn: 对攻击进行还击

ex.en: The boy hit his sister, who retaliated by kicking him.
ex.cn: 男孩打了他妹妹，妹妹则回敬了他一脚。

senses.def: action that a person takes against sb who has harmed them in some way

ex.en: retaliation against UN workers
ex.cn: 对联合国工作人员的报复

ex.en: The shooting may have been in retaliation for the arrest of the terrorist suspects.
ex.cn: 枪击事件可能是对逮捕嫌疑恐怖分子进行的报复行动。

senses.def: to make the development or progress of sth slower

ex.en: The progression of the disease can be retarded by early surgery.
ex.cn: 早期手术可以抑制病情的发展。

senses.def: an offensive way of describing sb who is not intelligent or who has not developed normally
less developed mentally than is normal for a particular age
senses.chn: 迟钝的；弱智的；智力发育迟缓的

senses.def: to make sounds and movements as if you are vomiting although you do not actually do so

ex.en: The smell made her retch.
ex.cn: 这气味让她恶心。

senses.def: to tell a story again, often in a different way
senses.chn: （通常以不同的方式）复述，重新讲述

senses.def: the action of keeping sth rather than losing it or stopping it

ex.en: The company needs to improve its training and retention of staff.
ex.cn: 公司需要改进对员工的培训和留用工作。

senses.def: the action of keeping liquid, heat, etc. inside sth rather than letting it escape

ex.en: Eating too much salt can cause fluid retention.
ex.cn: 摄盐过多会导致体液潴留。

senses.def: the ability to remember things

ex.en: Visual material aids the retention of information.
ex.cn: 直观材料有助于加强记忆。

senses.def: able to store facts and remember things easily
to test sb/sth again
senses.chn: 再测验；再测试；重新试验

ex.en: Subjects were retested one month later.
ex.cn: 受实验者一个月后再次接受测试。

senses.def: to think again about an idea, a course of action, etc., especially in order to change it

ex.en: to rethink a plan
ex.cn: 重新考虑一项计划

senses.def: unwilling to tell people about things
senses.chn: 寡言少语；不愿与人交谈；有保留

ex.en: She was shy and reticent.
ex.cn: 她羞怯而寡言少语。

ex.en: He was extremely reticent about his personal life.
ex.cn: 他对自己的私人生活讳莫如深。

senses.def: built, arranged or marked like a net or network, with many small squares or sections
a woman's small bag, usually made of cloth and with a string that can be pulled tight to close it
a layer of tissue at the back of the eye that is sensitive to light and sends signals to the brain about what is seen
a group of people who travel with an important person to provide help and support
to stop doing your job, especially because you have reached a particular age or because you are ill/sick; to tell sb they must stop doing their job

ex.en: She was forced to retire early from teaching because of ill health.
ex.cn: 她由于身体不好而被迫早早地从教学岗位上退休。

ex.en: The company's official retiring age is 65.
ex.cn: 公司正式的退休年龄为 65 岁。

ex.en: My dream is to retire to a villa in France.
ex.cn: 我的梦想是退休后在法国住上一栋别墅。

ex.en: He has no plans to retire as editor of the magazine.
ex.cn: 他还不打算从杂志主编的位子上退休。

ex.en: She was retired on medical grounds.
ex.cn: 她由于健康原因被安排退休了。

senses.def: to stop competing during a game, race, etc., usually because you are injured

ex.en: She fell badly, spraining her ankle, and had to retire.
ex.cn: 她摔得很重，扭伤了脚踝，只好退出比赛。

ex.en: He retired hurt in the first five minutes of the game.
ex.cn: 比赛才开始五分钟，他就因伤退场。

senses.def: to leave a place, especially to go somewhere quieter or more private

ex.en: The jury retired to consider the evidence.
ex.cn: 陪审团退庭对证据进行评判。

ex.en: After dinner he likes to retire to his study.
ex.cn: 晚饭后，他喜欢躲到书房里去。

senses.def: to move back from a battle in order to organize your soldiers in a different way
to go to bed

ex.en: I retired late that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上我睡得晚。

senses.def: to make a player or team have to stop their turn at batting

ex.en: He retired twelve batters in a row.
ex.cn: 他一连使十二个击球手出局。

senses.def: having retired from work

ex.en: a retired doctor
ex.cn: 退休医生

ex.en: Dad is retired now.
ex.cn: 爸爸现在已经退休了。

senses.def: a person who has stopped working because of their age
the fact of stopping work because you have reached a particular age; the time when you do this

ex.en: At 60, he was now approaching retirement.
ex.cn: 他 60 岁了，就要退休了。

ex.en: Susan is going to take early retirement (= retire before the usual age).
ex.cn: 苏珊要提前退休。

ex.en: retirement age
ex.cn: 退休年龄

ex.en: a retirement pension
ex.cn: 退休金

senses.def: the period of your life after you have stopped work at a particular age

ex.en: to provide for retirement
ex.cn: 为退休生活做准备

ex.en: We all wish you a long and happy retirement.
ex.cn: 我们大家祝愿你的退休生活长久而幸福。

ex.en: Up to a third of one's life is now being spent in retirement.
ex.cn: 现在人们一生中能有三分之一的时间过退休生活。

senses.def: the act of stopping a particular type of work, especially in sport, politics, etc.
senses.chn: （尤指从体育、政治等方面的）退出，引退，退职

ex.en: He announced his retirement from football.
ex.cn: 他宣布退出足球运动。

ex.en: She came out of retirement to win two gold medals at the championships.
ex.cn: 她复出后在锦标赛上赢得了两枚金牌。

senses.def: a place where old people live and are cared for
preferring not to spend time with other people

ex.en: a quiet, retiring man
ex.cn: 话少而又腼腆的男子

senses.def: to replace or change the machines or equipment in a factory so that it can produce new or better goods
senses.chn: 更换，重新装配（机器设备）

senses.def: to organize sth in a new or different way
to reply quickly to a comment, in an angry, offended or humorous way

ex.en: 'Don't be ridiculous!' Pat retorted angrily.
ex.cn: “别荒唐了！” 帕特生气地回答道。

ex.en: Sam retorted that it was my fault as much as his.
ex.cn: 萨姆反驳说我和他同样有错。

senses.def: a quick, angry or humorous reply

ex.en: She bit back (= stopped herself from making) a sharp retort.
ex.cn: 她克制住了自己，没有尖刻地反驳。

senses.def: a closed bottle with a long narrow bent spout that is used in a laboratory for heating chemicals
to make small changes to a picture or photograph so that it looks better
senses.chn: 修饰，修整（图片或照片等）

senses.def: to go back along exactly the same path or route that you have come along

ex.en: She turned around and began to retrace her steps towards the house.
ex.cn: 她转身沿原路向那栋房子走去。

senses.def: to make the same trip that sb else has made in the past

ex.en: They are hoping to retrace the epic voyage of Christopher Columbus.
ex.cn: 他们期待着沿哥伦布的壮丽航程进行一次航行。

senses.def: to find out what sb has done or where they have been

ex.en: Detectives are trying to retrace her movements on the night she disappeared.
ex.cn: 侦探们试图查出她失踪当晚的行踪。

senses.def: to say that sth you have said earlier is not true or correct or that you did not mean it

ex.en: He made a false confession which he later retracted.
ex.cn: 他作了假供词，后来又翻供。

ex.en: They tried to persuade me to retract my words.
ex.cn: 他们试图说服我收回我的话。

senses.def: to refuse to keep an agreement, a promise, etc.

ex.en: to retract an offer
ex.cn: 撤销提议

senses.def: to move back into the main part of sth; to pull sth back into the main part of sth

ex.en: The animal retracted into its shell.
ex.cn: 这只动物缩回到自己的壳里。

ex.en: The undercarriage was fully retracted.
ex.cn: 起落架被完全收起。

senses.def: that can be moved or pulled back into the main part of sth

ex.en: a knife with a retractable blade
ex.cn: 弹簧刀

senses.def: a statement saying that sth you previously said or wrote is not true

ex.en: He demanded a full retraction of the allegations against him.
ex.cn: 他要求全部撤回针对他的无证指控。

senses.def: the act of pulling sth back (= of retracting it)

ex.en: the retraction of a cat's claws
ex.cn: 猫爪子的回缩

senses.def: to learn, or to teach sb, a new type of work, a new skill, etc.
senses.chn: （接受）重新培养，再教育，再培训

ex.en: She retrained as a teacher.
ex.cn: 她接受了教师再培训。

ex.en: Staff have been retrained to use the new technology.
ex.cn: 为使员工学会运用新技术，对他们进行了再培训。

senses.def: a tyre made by putting a new rubber surface on an old tyre
a book, film/movie, song, etc. that contains ideas that have been used before
to move away from a place or an enemy because you are in danger or because you have been defeated

ex.en: The army was forced to retreat after suffering heavy losses.
ex.cn: 部队因伤亡惨重被迫撤退。

ex.en: We retreated back down the mountain.
ex.cn: 我们从山上撤了下来。

senses.def: to move away or back

ex.en: He watched her retreating figure.
ex.cn: 他看着她的身影渐渐远去。

ex.en: The flood waters slowly retreated.
ex.cn: 洪水慢慢地消退了。

senses.def: to change your mind about sth because of criticism or because a situation has become too difficult
senses.chn: （由于批评或环境过于恶劣）改变主意，退缩

ex.en: The government had retreated from its pledge to reduce class sizes.
ex.cn: 政府已经改变了缩小班级规模的承诺。

senses.def: to escape to a place that is quieter or safer

ex.en: Bored with the conversation, she retreated to her bedroom.
ex.cn: 她厌倦了这样的交谈，躲进了自己的卧室。

ex.en: He retreated into a world of fantasy.
ex.cn: 他遁入了幻想世界。

senses.def: to lose value

ex.en: Share prices retreated 45p to 538p.
ex.cn: 这股票价格下跌 45 便士，降到了 538 便士。

senses.def: a movement away from a place or an enemy because of danger or defeat

ex.en: Napoleon's retreat from Moscow
ex.cn: 拿破仑从莫斯科的撤退

ex.en: The army was in full retreat (= retreating very quickly).
ex.cn: 部队全线撤退。

ex.en: to sound the retreat (= to give a loud signal for an army to move away)
ex.cn: 发出撤退信号

senses.def: an act of trying to escape from a particular situation to one that you think is safer or more pleasant

ex.en: Is watching television a retreat from reality?
ex.cn: 看电视是对现实的一种逃避吗？

senses.def: an act of changing a decision because of criticism or because a situation has become too difficult
senses.chn: （由于批评或环境过于恶劣）改变决定，退缩

ex.en: The Senator made an embarrassing retreat from his earlier position.
ex.cn: 这位参议员很尴尬地改变了他早先的立场。

senses.def: a quiet, private place that you go to in order to get away from your usual life

ex.en: a country retreat
ex.cn: 乡间隐居处

senses.def: a period of time when sb stops their usual activities and goes to a quiet place for prayer and thought; an organized event when people can do this

ex.en: He went into retreat and tried to resolve the conflicts within himself.
ex.cn: 他去静修并试图调节自己内心的矛盾冲突。

ex.en: to go on a Buddhist retreat
ex.cn: 去参加佛教的静修

senses.def: to go away or back quickly, especially to avoid sth unpleasant
to spend less money; to reduce costs
to tell sb that they cannot continue working for you
a new trial of a person whose criminal offence has already been judged once in court
severe punishment for sth seriously wrong that sb has done

ex.en: People are seeking retribution for the latest terrorist outrages.
ex.cn: 人们在设法对恐怖分子最近的暴行进行严惩。

ex.en: fear of divine retribution (= punishment from God)
ex.cn: 对上帝的惩罚的畏惧

senses.def: the process of getting sth back, especially from a place where it should not be

ex.en: The ship was buried, beyond retrieval, at the bottom of the sea.
ex.cn: 船已葬身海底，无法打捞。

ex.en: By then the situation was beyond retrieval (= impossible to put right).
ex.cn: 到那时，局势已无法挽回。

senses.def: the process of getting back information that is stored on a computer

ex.en: methods of information retrieval
ex.cn: 数据检索方法

senses.def: to bring or get sth back, especially from a place where it should not be

ex.en: She bent to retrieve her comb from the floor.
ex.cn: 她弯腰从地板上捡起她的梳子。

ex.en: The police have managed to retrieve some of the stolen money.
ex.cn: 警方已经追回了部分被盗钱款。

senses.def: to find and get back data or information that has been stored in the memory of a computer

ex.en: to retrieve information from the database
ex.cn: 从数据库检索资料

ex.en: The program allows you to retrieve items quickly by searching under a keyword.
ex.cn: 这个程序通过关键词进行搜索，能让你迅速获取数据项。

senses.def: to make a bad situation better; to get back sth that was lost

ex.en: You can only retrieve the situation by apologizing.
ex.cn: 你只有道歉才能挽回这个局面。

senses.def: a large dog used in hunting to bring back birds that have been shot
using styles or fashions from the recent past
senses.chn: （时装款式等）前不久刚流行过的，再度流行的，回归的

ex.en: the current Seventies retro trend
ex.cn: 当前回归七十年代的流行趋势

senses.def: back or backwards

ex.en: retrograde
ex.cn: 倒退的

ex.en: retrospectively
ex.cn: 回顾地

senses.def: to put a new piece of equipment into a machine that did not have it when it was built; to provide a machine with a new part, etc.
senses.chn: 给机器设备装配（新部件）；翻新；改型

ex.en: Voice recorders were retrofitted into planes already in service.
ex.cn: 录音设备安在了正在服役的飞机上。

ex.en: They retrofitted the plane with improved seating.
ex.cn: 他们在飞机上安装了经过改良的座椅。

senses.def: turned backwards
produced with the end of the tongue turned up against the hard palate
making a situation worse or returning to how sth was in the past

ex.en: The closure of the factory is a retrograde step.
ex.cn: 工厂的关闭是一大退步。

senses.def: returning to old-fashioned ideas or methods instead of making progress
thinking about a past event or situation, often with a different opinion of it from the one you had at the time

ex.en: In retrospect, I think that I was wrong.
ex.cn: 回首往事，我觉得当时我错了。

ex.en: The decision seems extremely odd, in retrospect.
ex.cn: 回想起来，这个决定显得极其荒谬。

senses.def: thinking about past events or situations
thinking about or connected with sth that happened in the past
intended to take effect from a particular date in the past rather than from the present date
senses.chn: 有追溯效力的；溯及既往的

ex.en: retrospective legislation
ex.cn: 有溯及力的法律

ex.en: retrospective pay awards
ex.cn: 有追溯效力的加薪

senses.def: a public exhibition of the work that an artist has done in the past, showing how his or her work has developed
any of a group of viruses that includes HIV. Retroviruses multiply by making changes to DNA.
senses.chn: 反转录病毒，逆转录病毒（如人类免疫缺损病毒）

senses.def: to examine a person or case again in court
to make another attempt to do sth, especially on a computer
a type of red or white wine from Greece that is given a special flavour with resin (1)
to come or go back from one place to another

ex.cn: 我等他回来等了很长时间。

ex.cn: 她在欧洲逗留了六个月，明天要返回澳大利亚了。

ex.cn: 法官命令将孩子送回到他的母亲身边。

ex.cn: 有传言说这个乐队将再度聚集，作一次环球巡演。

ex.cn: 作为领导，他的主要目标就是要使党内各派团结起来。

ex.cn: 信封请重复利用。

ex.cn: 她发誓一定要报复他们所有的人。

ex.cn: 上星期，政府的命运发生了逆转。

ex.en: It wasn't easy to persuade her to come— quite the reverse.
ex.cn: 说服她过来不容易，实在太难了。

senses.def: the back of a coin, piece of material, piece of paper, etc.
the machinery in a vehicle used to make it move backwards

ex.en: Put the car in/into reverse.
ex.cn: 给汽车挂上倒挡。

senses.def: a loss or defeat; a change from success to failure

ex.en: Property values have suffered another reverse.
ex.cn: 房地产价值再次遭受损失。

ex.en: a damaging political reverse
ex.cn: 具有破坏性的政治倒退

senses.def: in the opposite order or way

ex.en: The secret number is my phone number in reverse.
ex.cn: 这个密码是我的电话号码的逆序排列。

ex.en: We did a similar trip to you, but in reverse.
ex.cn: 我们走了和你相似的旅程，但方向相反。

senses.def: to start to happen or to make sth happen in the opposite way

ex.en: In 2008 economic growth went into reverse.
ex.cn: 2008 年，经济增长发生了逆转。

senses.def: opposite to what has been mentioned

ex.en: to travel in the reverse direction
ex.cn: 向相反方向行进

ex.en: The winners were announced in reverse order (= the person in the lowest place was announced first).
ex.cn: 获胜者是按逆序宣布的。

ex.en: The experiment had the reverse effect to what was intended.
ex.cn: 实验的结果与原来的意图相反。

senses.def: opposite to the front

ex.en: Iron the garment on the reverse side.
ex.cn: 这件衣服要从反面熨。

senses.def: a reverse-charge telephone call is paid for by the person who receives the call, not by the person who makes it
senses.chn: （电话）由受话方付费的，对方付费的

senses.def: the practice or policy of making sure that a particular number of jobs, etc. are given to people from groups that are often treated unfairly because of their race, sex, etc.
senses.chn: 反向区别对待，反向歧视，逆向歧视（对因种族、性别等原因遭受歧视的群体在就业等方面给予特别照顾）

senses.def: the copying of another company's product after examining it carefully to find out how it is made
senses.chn: 逆向工程，倒序制造（研究另一家公司产品的制造后加以仿制）

senses.def: that can be turned inside out and worn or used with either side showing
senses.chn: 可翻转的；可两面穿的；正反两用的

ex.en: a reversible jacket
ex.cn: 可两面穿的夹克

senses.def: that can be changed so that sth returns to its original state or situation
senses.chn: 可逆的；可恢复原状的；可医治的

ex.en: Is the trend towards privatization reversible?
ex.cn: 私有化趋势可能逆转吗？

ex.en: reversible kidney failure
ex.cn: 可医治的肾衰竭

senses.def: a white light at the back of a vehicle that comes on when the vehicle moves backwards
the act or process of returning to a former state or condition

ex.en: a reversion to traditional farming methods
ex.cn: 传统耕作方法的回归

senses.def: the return of land or property to sb
senses.chn: （土地或财产的）归还，归属原主

ex.en: the reversion of Hong Kong to China
ex.cn: 香港回归中国

senses.def: to reply

ex.en: Excellent openings—kindly revert with your updated CV.
ex.cn: 绝佳招聘职位，请回信寄来您的最新简历。

senses.def: to return to the original owner again
to return to a former state; to start doing sth again that you used to do in the past

ex.en: After her divorce she reverted to her maiden name.
ex.cn: 离婚以后，她重新用起娘家的姓氏。

ex.en: His manner seems to have reverted to normal.
ex.cn: 他的举止好像已经恢复了正常。

ex.en: Try not to revert to your old eating habits.
ex.cn: 尽力不要恢复你过去的饮食习惯。

senses.def: to return to an earlier topic or subject
senses.chn: 重提，回到，恢复（先前的话题或主题）

ex.en: So, to revert to your earlier question…
ex.cn: 那么，回到你先前所提的问题…

ex.en: The conversation kept reverting to the events of March 6th.
ex.cn: 谈话一再回到 3 月 6 日所发生的事件上来。

senses.def: to return to a former state; to start doing sth again that you used to do in the past

ex.en: After her divorce she reverted to her maiden name.
ex.cn: 离婚以后，她重新用起娘家的姓氏。

ex.en: His manner seems to have reverted to normal.
ex.cn: 他的举止好像已经恢复了正常。

ex.en: Try not to revert to your old eating habits.
ex.cn: 尽力不要恢复你过去的饮食习惯。

senses.def: to return to an earlier topic or subject
senses.chn: 重提，回到，恢复（先前的话题或主题）

ex.en: So, to revert to your earlier question…
ex.cn: 那么，回到你先前所提的问题…

ex.en: The conversation kept reverting to the events of March 6th.
ex.cn: 谈话一再回到 3 月 6 日所发生的事件上来。

senses.def: stones or other material used to make a wall stronger, hold back a bank of earth, etc.
an examination of sth, with the intention of changing it if necessary
senses.chn: 评审，审查，检查，检讨（以进行必要的修改）

ex.en: the government's review of its education policy
ex.cn: 政府对其教育政策的检讨

ex.en: The case is subject to judicial review.
ex.cn: 这个案子必须接受司法审查。

ex.en: His parole application is up for review next week.
ex.cn: 他的假释申请下周审查。

ex.en: The terms of the contract are under review.
ex.cn: 合同条文正在审议。

ex.en: a pay/salary review
ex.cn: 薪酬审定

ex.en: a review body/date/panel
ex.cn: 评审机构／日期／小组

senses.def: a report in a newspaper or magazine, or on the Internet, television or radio, in which sb gives their opinion of a book, play, film/movie, etc.; the act of writing this kind of report
senses.chn: （对图书、戏剧、电影等的）评介，评论

ex.en: a book review
ex.cn: 书评

ex.en: the reviews (page) in the papers
ex.cn: 报纸的评论版

ex.en: good/bad/mixed/rave reviews in the national press
ex.cn: 全国性报刊上良好的／不好的／毁誉参半的／高度赞誉的评论

ex.en: He submitted his latest novel for review.
ex.cn: 他提交了自己的最新小说供评论。

senses.def: a report on a subject or on a series of events

ex.en: a review of customer complaints
ex.cn: 有关消费者投诉的汇报

ex.en: to publish a review of recent cancer research
ex.cn: 发表有关最近癌症研究的报告

senses.def: a ceremony that involves an official inspection of soldiers, etc. by an important visitor
a lesson in which you look again at sth you have studied, especially in order to prepare for an exam
senses.chn: （尤指为准备考试的）温习课，复习课

senses.def: to carefully examine or consider sth again, especially so that you can decide if it is necessary to make changes

ex.en: to review the evidence
ex.cn: 复查证据

ex.en: The government will review the situation later in the year.
ex.cn: 政府将在今年晚些时候对形势重新加以研究。

ex.en: These ideas will be examined in more detail in Chapter 10.
ex.cn: 这些观点将在第 10 章作更为详细的探讨。

ex.en: The job involves gathering and analysing data.
ex.cn: 这项工作需要搜集和分析资料。

ex.en: He tried to analyse his feelings.
ex.cn: 他试图分析自己的感情。

ex.en: The government will review the situation later in the year.
ex.cn: 政府将在今年晚些时候重新检讨形势。

senses.def: to think about past events, for example to try to understand why they happened

ex.en: to review your failures and triumphs
ex.cn: 回顾自己的成功和失败

ex.en: She had been reviewing the previous week on her way home.
ex.cn: 她在回家的路上对前一个星期进行了回顾。

senses.def: to write a report of a book, play, film/movie, etc. in which you give your opinion of it
senses.chn: 写（关于书籍、戏剧、电影等的）评论；评介

ex.en: The play was reviewed in the national newspapers.
ex.cn: 全国性报纸都对这部戏剧作了评论。

senses.def: to make an official inspection of a group of soldiers, etc. in a military ceremony
to look again at sth you have studied, especially in order to prepare for an exam
senses.chn: （尤指为准备考试而）温习，复习

senses.def: to check a piece of work to see if there are any mistakes
a person who writes reviews of books, films/movies or plays
a person who examines or considers sth carefully, for example to see if any changes need to be made
to criticize sb/sth in a way that shows how much you dislike them
to change your opinions or plans, for example because of sth you have learned

ex.en: I can see I will have to revise my opinions of his abilities now.
ex.cn: 我明白我现在不得不改变对他的能力的看法了。

ex.en: The government may need to revise its policy in the light of this report.
ex.cn: 政府可能需要根据这份报告改变其政策。

senses.def: to change sth, such as a book or an estimate, in order to correct or improve it

ex.en: a revised edition of a textbook
ex.cn: 课本的修订版

ex.en: I'll prepare a revised estimate for you.
ex.cn: 我将为你准备一份经过修正的评估报告。

ex.en: We may have to revise this figure upwards.
ex.cn: 我们也许要将这个数字往上调一调。

senses.def: to prepare for an exam by looking again at work that you have done

ex.en: I spent the weekend revising for my exam.
ex.cn: 我花了整个周末复习备考。

ex.en: I can't come out tonight. I have to revise.
ex.cn: 我今晚不能出去。我得复习。

ex.en: I'm revising Geography today.
ex.cn: 我今天复习地理。

senses.def: a change or set of changes to sth

ex.en: He made some minor revisions to the report before printing it out.
ex.cn: 把报告打印出来之前，他做了一些小的修改。

senses.def: the act of changing sth, or of examining sth with the intention of changing it

ex.en: a system in need of revision
ex.cn: 需要更新的系统

ex.en: a revision of trading standards
ex.cn: 贸易标准的修改

senses.def: the process of learning work for an exam

ex.en: Have you started your revision yet?
ex.cn: 你开始复习了吗？

senses.def: ideas that are different from, and want to change, the main ideas or practices of a political system, especially Marxism
to visit a place again, especially after a long period of time
to return to an idea or a subject and discuss it again

ex.en: It's an idea that may be worth revisiting at a later date.
ex.cn: 这个观点值得以后进一步探讨。

senses.def: to make sth stronger, more active or more healthy
senses.chn: 使更强壮；使恢复生机（或健康）

ex.en: measures to revitalize the inner cities
ex.cn: 让内城区重焕活力的措施

senses.def: an improvement in the condition or strength of sth
senses.chn: （状况或力量的）进步，振兴，复苏

ex.en: the revival of trade
ex.cn: 贸易振兴

ex.en: an economic revival
ex.cn: 经济复苏

ex.en: a revival of interest in folk music
ex.cn: 对民间音乐的兴趣的恢复

senses.def: the process of sth becoming or being made popular or fashionable again

ex.en: a religious revival
ex.cn: 宗教的奋兴

ex.en: Jazz is enjoying a revival.
ex.cn: 爵士音乐再度盛行。

senses.def: a new production of a play that has not been performed for some time

ex.en: a revival of Peter Shaffer's 'Equus'
ex.cn: 彼得 · 谢弗的《马》的重演

senses.def: the process of creating interest in sth again, especially religion
the practice of using ideas, designs, etc. from the past

ex.en: revivalism in architecture
ex.cn: 建筑的复古

senses.def: a person who tries to make sth popular again
senses.chn: 推动复兴者；复兴运动倡导者

senses.def: to become, or to make sb/sth become, conscious or healthy and strong again

ex.en: The flowers soon revived in water.
ex.cn: 这些花见了水很快就活过来了。

ex.en: The economy is beginning to revive.
ex.cn: 经济开始复苏。

ex.en: The paramedics couldn't revive her.
ex.cn: 护理人员无法使她苏醒。

ex.en: This movie is intended to revive her flagging career.
ex.cn: 这部电影意在使她渐趋衰败的事业再现辉煌。

senses.def: to make sth start being used or done again

ex.en: This quaint custom should be revived.
ex.cn: 应该恢复这一独特的风俗。

ex.en: She has been trying to revive the debate over equal pay.
ex.cn: 她一直在设法再次展开同工同酬的辩论。

senses.def: to produce again a play, etc. that has not been performed for some time

ex.en: This 1930s musical is being revived at the National Theatre.
ex.cn: 这部 20 世纪 30 年代的音乐剧正在国家剧院重新上演。

senses.def: to give new life or health to sth
senses.chn: 使获得新生；使复活；使再生；使恢复健康

senses.def: the act of cancelling a law, etc.

ex.en: the revocation of planning permission
ex.cn: 建筑许可的撤销

senses.def: to officially cancel sth so that it is no longer valid
a protest against authority, especially that of a government, often involving violence; the action of protesting against authority
senses.chn: （尤指针对政府的）反抗，违抗；起义；叛乱

ex.en: the Peasants' Revolt of 1381
ex.cn: 1381 年的农民起义

ex.en: to lead/stage a revolt
ex.cn: 领导／发动起义

ex.en: The army quickly crushed the revolt.
ex.cn: 军队很快镇压了叛乱。

ex.en: the biggest back-bench revolt this government has ever seen
ex.cn: 本届政府所遭遇到的规模最大的一次普通下院议员的抗议

ex.en: Attempts to negotiate peace ended in armed revolt.
ex.cn: 和谈的努力最后以武装叛乱告终。

ex.en: The people rose in revolt.
ex.cn: 人民奋起反抗。

senses.def: to take violent action against the people in power

ex.en: The peasants threatened to revolt.
ex.cn: 农民威胁说要造反。

ex.en: Finally the people revolted against the military dictatorship.
ex.cn: 人民最终起来反抗军事独裁。

senses.def: to behave in a way that is the opposite of what sb expects of you, especially in protest

ex.en: Teenagers often revolt against parental discipline.
ex.cn: 青少年常常不遵从父母的条条框框。

senses.def: to make you feel horror or disgust

ex.en: All the violence in the movie revolted me.
ex.cn: 电影里的各种暴力场面令我非常震惊。

ex.en: The way he ate his food revolted me.
ex.cn: 他吃饭的样子让我感到恶心。

senses.def: extremely unpleasant
senses.chn: 令人作呕的；极其讨厌的

ex.en: a revolting smell
ex.cn: 令人作呕的气味

ex.en: a revolting little man
ex.cn: 可恶的家伙

ex.en: What a disgusting smell!
ex.cn: 这气味真难闻！

ex.en: She could smell his foul breath.
ex.cn: 她闻得到他的口臭。

ex.en: The stew looked revolting.
ex.cn: 这煨菜看上去令人作呕。

senses.def: an attempt, by a large number of people, to change the government of a country, especially by violent action

ex.en: a socialist revolution
ex.cn: 社会主义革命

ex.en: the outbreak of the French Revolution in 1789
ex.cn: 1789 年法国大革命的爆发

ex.en: to start a revolution
ex.cn: 发动一场革命

ex.en: a country on the brink of revolution
ex.cn: 即将发生革命的国家

senses.def: a great change in conditions, ways of working, beliefs, etc. that affects large numbers of people

ex.en: a cultural/social/scientific, etc. revolution
ex.cn: 文化、社会、科学等的重大变革

ex.en: A revolution in information technology is taking place.
ex.cn: 信息技术正在发生巨变。

senses.def: a complete circular movement around a point, especially of one planet around another
senses.chn: （环绕中心点的）旋转；（尤指）天体运行

ex.en: the revolution of the earth around the sun
ex.cn: 地球环绕太阳的公转

senses.def: a circular movement made by sth fixed to a central point, for example in a car engine

ex.en: rotating at 300 revolutions per minute
ex.cn: 以每分钟 300 转的速度旋转

senses.def: connected with political revolution

ex.en: a revolutionary leader
ex.cn: 革命领袖

ex.en: revolutionary uprisings
ex.cn: 革命起义

senses.def: involving a great or complete change
senses.chn: 革命性的；大变革的；巨变的

ex.en: a revolutionary idea
ex.cn: 革命性的想法

ex.en: a time of rapid and revolutionary change
ex.cn: 迅速剧烈变革的时期

senses.def: a person who starts or supports a revolution, especially a political one
senses.chn: （支持）改革者；（尤指）革命者，革命支持者

ex.en: socialist revolutionaries
ex.cn: 社会主义革命者

senses.def: to completely change the way that sth is done

ex.en: Aerial photography has revolutionized the study of archaeology.
ex.cn: 航空摄影已经给考古学研究带来了一场革命。

senses.def: to go in a circle around a central point

ex.en: The fan revolved slowly.
ex.cn: 电扇缓慢地转动着。

ex.en: The earth revolves on its axis.
ex.cn: 地球环绕自身的轴心转动。

senses.def: to move around sth in a circle

ex.en: The earth revolves around the sun.
ex.cn: 地球绕太阳公转。

senses.def: to have sb/sth as the main interest or subject
senses.chn: 围绕；以…为中心；将…作为主要兴趣（或主题）

ex.en: His whole life revolves around surfing.
ex.cn: 他一生都在做与冲浪相关的事。

ex.en: She thinks that the world revolves around her.
ex.cn: 她以为整个世界都以她为中心。

ex.en: The discussion revolved around the question of changing the club's name.
ex.cn: 讨论的中心问题是改变俱乐部的名称。

senses.def: a small gun that has a container for bullets that turns around so that shots can be fired quickly without having to stop to put more bullets in
able to turn in a circle

ex.en: a revolving chair
ex.cn: 转椅

ex.en: The theatre has a revolving stage.
ex.cn: 剧院有一个旋转舞台。

senses.def: a type of door in an entrance to a large building that turns around in a circle as people go through it
used to talk about a place or an organization that people enter and then leave again very quickly
senses.chn: 中转站（指人们进入后很快又离开的地方或机构）

ex.en: The company became a revolving-door workplace.
ex.cn: 这家公司成了工作的中转站。

senses.def: a show in a theatre, with songs, dances, jokes, short plays, etc., often about recent events
a strong feeling of disgust or horror

ex.en: She felt a deep sense of revulsion at the violence.
ex.cn: 她对这一暴行深恶痛绝。

ex.en: I started to feel a revulsion against their decadent lifestyle.
ex.cn: 我对他们那腐朽的生活方式开始感到厌恶。

ex.en: Most people viewed the bombings with revulsion.
ex.cn: 大多数人对爆炸事件表现出惊恐不安。

senses.def: a thing that you are given because you have done sth good, worked hard, etc.

ex.en: a financial reward
ex.cn: 经济奖励

ex.en: a reward for good behaviour
ex.cn: 优秀行为奖

ex.en: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.
ex.cn: 你帮了这么大的忙，理应受到奖励。

ex.en: Winning the match was just reward for the effort the team had made.
ex.cn: 赢得比赛的胜利是全队付出努力应得的回报。

ex.en: The company is now reaping the rewards of their investments.
ex.cn: 公司正在收获他们的投资回报。

senses.def: an amount of money that is offered to sb for helping the police to find a criminal or for finding sth that is lost

ex.en: A £100 reward has been offered for the return of the necklace.
ex.cn: 已悬赏 100 英镑找寻项链。

senses.def: the reward for acting in a moral or correct way is the knowledge that you have done so, and you should not expect more than this, for example praise from other people or payment
senses.chn: 施恩无他图，有德便是报；美德本身就是报偿

senses.def: to give sth to sb because they have done sth good, worked hard, etc.

ex.en: She was rewarded for her efforts with a cash bonus.
ex.cn: 她因自己所作的努力而得到一笔奖金。

ex.en: He rewarded us handsomely (= with a lot of money) for helping him.
ex.cn: 对于我们的帮助，他大加酬谢。

ex.en: She started singing to the baby and was rewarded with a smile.
ex.cn: 她开始给孩子唱歌，孩子则报以微笑。

ex.en: Our patience was finally rewarded.
ex.cn: 我们的耐心最终得到了回报。

senses.def: worth doing; that makes you happy because you think it is useful or important

ex.en: a rewarding experience/job
ex.cn: 有益的经历／工作

ex.en: It's satisfying to play a game really well.
ex.cn: 打一场出色的比赛是一件惬意的事。

ex.en: Nursing can be a very rewarding career.
ex.cn: 做护士可以是非常有意义的职业。

ex.en: It was a simple but pleasing design.
ex.cn: 这是一项简单但令人满意的设计。

ex.en: It is gratifying to see such good results.
ex.cn: 看到这么好的结果真令人欣慰。

ex.en: I'm finding the work much more fulfilling now.
ex.cn: 我现在觉得这工作有意义多了。

senses.def: producing a lot of money

ex.en: Teaching is not very financially rewarding (= is not very well paid).
ex.cn: 教书不会有很高的报酬。

senses.def: the practice of helping large areas of land to return to their natural state
senses.chn: （大片土地的）野化，恢复原始样貌

ex.en: There is a proposal for the rewilding of the islands.
ex.cn: 有人建议恢复这些岛屿的自然样貌。

ex.en: Rewilding represents a desire to return to the state in which humans existed before the advent of civilization.
ex.cn: 回归原始代表着渴望回到人类在文明出现之前的存在状态。

senses.def: to make sth such as a film or a recording go backwards
senses.chn: 使（影片、录音、视频等）倒回；倒带

senses.def: to put new electrical wires into a building or piece of equipment
