ex.cn: 她打字很慢而且错误百出。

senses.def: to sit on a horse, etc. and control it as it moves

ex.en: I learnt to ride as a child.
ex.cn: 我小时候就学会了骑马。

ex.en: They rode along narrow country lanes.
ex.cn: 他们骑马走在狭窄的乡村小路上。

ex.en: He was riding on a large black horse.
ex.cn: 他骑在一匹高大的黑马上。

ex.en: She had never ridden a horse before.
ex.cn: 她以前从没骑过马。

ex.en: He's ridden six winners so far this year (= in horse racing).
ex.cn: 他今年到目前为止已六次在赛马中夺标。

senses.def: to spend time riding a horse for pleasure

ex.en: How often do you go riding?
ex.cn: 你多长时间骑一次马？

senses.def: to sit on and control a bicycle, motorcycle, etc.

ex.en: The boys were riding their bikes around the streets.
ex.cn: 男孩子们骑着自行车在街上兜风。

ex.en: He rode a Harley Davidson.
ex.cn: 他骑着一辆哈雷摩托车。

ex.en: The ground there is too rough to ride over.
ex.cn: 那里地面高低不平，无法骑车。

senses.def: to travel in a vehicle, especially as a passenger

ex.en: I walked back while the others rode in the car.
ex.cn: 别人都乘车，而我是走回来的。

ex.en: to ride the subway/an elevator, etc.
ex.cn: 乘地铁、电梯等

ex.en: She rode the bus to school every day.
ex.cn: 她每天乘公共汽车去上学。

senses.def: to float or be supported on water or air

ex.en: We watched the balloon riding high above the fields.
ex.cn: 我们看着气球高高地飘浮在田野上空。

ex.en: surfers riding the waves
ex.cn: 踏浪而行的冲浪者

senses.def: to go through or over an area on a horse, bicycle, etc.

ex.en: We rode the mountain trails.
ex.cn: 我们骑着马走在山里的小路上。

senses.def: to criticize or tease sb in an annoying way

ex.en: Why is everybody riding me today?
ex.cn: 怎么今天大家都拿我取笑？

senses.def: to be doing sth that involves risks and that may end in disaster
senses.chn: 做事莽撞；做招致风险的事

senses.def: to be successful or very confident
to decide to do nothing about a problem that you know you may have to deal with later
senses.chn: 决定对…不立即采取行动

senses.def: to enjoy great success or support because of a particular situation or event

ex.en: The band is riding the crest of its last tour.
ex.cn: 乐队正处于最近这次巡回演出后的顶峰状态。

senses.def: to keep watch or control over sb/sth
senses.chn: 监视；对某人／某物严加控制

ex.en: police riding herd on crowds of youths on the streets
ex.cn: 警方监视着街上成群结队的年轻人

senses.def: to ride in the front passenger seat of a car or truck
to enjoy or be supported by the particular situation or quality mentioned

ex.en: Schools are riding a wave of renewed public interest.
ex.cn: 各校重新受益于公众的关注。

senses.def: wishing for sth does not make it happen
senses.chn: 想有不见得就有；愿望不等于事实

senses.def: to depend on sth

ex.en: My whole future is riding on this interview.
ex.cn: 我的未来全靠这次面试了。

senses.def: to manage to survive a difficult situation or time without having to make great changes
senses.chn: 安然渡过（难关）；经受得住

senses.def: to move gradually upwards, out of position
senses.chn: 慢慢向上移动；渐渐缩上去

ex.en: Short skirts tend to ride up when you sit down.
ex.cn: 坐下来的时候，短裙就会往上收。

senses.def: a short journey in a vehicle, on a bicycle, etc.

ex.en: a train ride through beautiful countryside
ex.cn: 乘火车穿越美丽乡村的旅程

ex.en: It's a ten-minute bus ride from here to town.
ex.cn: 从这里到镇上乘公共汽车要花十分钟。

ex.en: Steve gave me a ride on his motorbike.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫用摩托车捎了我一程。

ex.en: We went for a ride on our bikes.
ex.cn: 我们骑自行车出去兜了一圈。

ex.en: a bike ride
ex.cn: 骑自行车出行

senses.def: a free ride in a car, etc. to a place you want to get to

ex.en: She hitched a ride to the station.
ex.cn: 她搭便车去车站。

ex.en: We managed to get a ride into town when we missed the bus.
ex.cn: 我们没赶上公共汽车，就设法搭了一辆便车去城里。

senses.def: the kind of journey you make in a car, etc.

ex.en: a smooth/comfortable/bumpy, etc. ride
ex.cn: 舒适、颠簸等的旅行

ex.en: The new legislation faces a bumpy ride (= will meet with opposition and difficulties).
ex.cn: 新的法规前路崎岖。

senses.def: a short journey on a horse, etc.

ex.en: a pony ride
ex.cn: 骑一会儿小马

ex.en: The kids had a ride on an elephant at the zoo.
ex.cn: 在动物园里，孩子们骑着大象走了一圈。

ex.en: He goes for a ride most mornings.
ex.cn: 他上午经常骑马出去兜一圈。

senses.def: a large machine at a funfair or amusement park that you ride on for fun or excitement; an occasion when you go on one of these
senses.chn: 供乘骑的游乐设施；乘坐（游乐设施）

ex.en: The rides are free.
ex.cn: 免费乘坐。

ex.en: a roller coaster ride
ex.cn: 坐一趟过山车

senses.def: to join in an activity for pleasure but without being seriously interested in it
senses.chn: 随大溜；凑凑热闹；逢场作戏

senses.def: to experience/not experience difficulties when you are doing sth; to make things difficult/easy for sb

ex.en: He will be given a rough ride at the party conference.
ex.cn: 在党员大会上他会很难过这一关。

senses.def: to cheat or trick sb

ex.en: It's not a pleasant feeling to discover you've been taken for a ride by someone you trusted.
ex.cn: 发现被你信任的人骗了，心里很不是滋味。

senses.def: to get or take sth without paying because sb else is paying for it
senses.chn: 白白得到好处（因他人已代付款）

senses.def: to depend on sth

ex.en: My whole future is riding on this interview.
ex.cn: 我的未来全靠这次面试了。

senses.def: a person who rides a horse, bicycle or motorcycle
senses.chn: 骑手；骑马（或自行车、摩托车）的人

ex.en: Three riders (= people riding horses) were approaching.
ex.cn: 三个骑马的人越来越近。

ex.en: horses and their riders
ex.cn: 马匹及其骑手

ex.en: She's an experienced rider.
ex.cn: 她是位有经验的骑手。

ex.en: a motorcycle dispatch rider
ex.cn: 骑摩托车的通信员

senses.def: an extra piece of information that is added to an official document
to ride in the front passenger seat of a car or truck
to enjoy great success or support because of a particular situation or event

ex.en: The band is riding the crest of its last tour.
ex.cn: 乐队正处于最近这次巡回演出后的顶峰状态。

senses.def: to move gradually upwards, out of position
senses.chn: 慢慢向上移动；渐渐缩上去

ex.en: Short skirts tend to ride up when you sit down.
ex.cn: 坐下来的时候，短裙就会往上收。

senses.def: a narrow area of high land along the top of a line of hills; a high pointed area near the top of a mountain

ex.en: walking along the ridge
ex.cn: 沿着山脊行走

ex.en: the north-east ridge of the Matterhorn
ex.cn: 马特峰的东北部

senses.def: a raised line on the surface of sth; the point where two sloping surfaces join

ex.en: The ridges on the soles of my boots stopped me from slipping.
ex.cn: 我靴子底上有隆起的纹路，使我没有滑倒。

ex.en: the ridge of the roof
ex.cn: 屋脊

senses.def: a long narrow area of high pressure in the atmosphere
to make narrow raised lines or areas on the surface of sth
with raised lines on the surface
senses.chn: 有隆凸线条的；有埂子的

senses.def: a tent which forms an upside-down V shape
unkind comments that make fun of sb/sth or make them look silly

ex.en: She is an object of ridicule in the tabloid newspapers.
ex.cn: 她是小报讥笑讽刺的对象。

ex.en: to hold sb up to ridicule (= make fun of sb publicly)
ex.cn: 公然取笑某人

senses.def: to make sb/sth look silly by laughing at them or it in an unkind way
very silly or unreasonable

ex.en: I look ridiculous in this hat.
ex.cn: 我戴这顶帽子看上去很可笑。

ex.en: Don't be ridiculous! You can't pay £50 for a T-shirt!
ex.cn: 别犯傻了！怎么能花 50 英镑买一件 T 恤衫！

senses.def: used to describe a situation in which sth serious, important or of high quality is followed by sth silly, unimportant or of poor quality
senses.chn: 从高超到荒谬；从高妙到低俗

senses.def: the sport or activity of riding horses

ex.en: I'm taking riding lessons.
ex.cn: 我在学习骑马。

ex.en: riding boots
ex.cn: 马靴

ex.en: to go riding
ex.cn: 去骑马

ex.en: to go horseback riding
ex.cn: 去骑马

senses.def: one of the three former parts of the English county of Yorkshire called the East Riding, the North Riding and the West Riding
senses.chn: 区（英格兰约克郡以前的东、西、北三个行政分区之一）

senses.def: if sth bad or unpleasant is rife in a place, it is very common there

ex.en: It is a country where corruption is rife.
ex.cn: 这是个腐败成风的国家。

ex.en: Rumours are rife that he is going to resign.
ex.cn: 到处都在传，说他要辞职了。

senses.def: full of sth bad or unpleasant

ex.en: Los Angeles is rife with gossip about the stars' private lives.
ex.cn: 洛杉矶盛传明星私生活的流言蜚语。

senses.def: a short repeated pattern of notes in popular music or jazz
senses.chn: （流行音乐或爵士乐的）重复段

senses.def: to turn over papers or the pages of a book quickly and without reading them all

ex.en: He was riffling through the papers on his desk.
ex.cn: 他很快地翻着他桌上的文件。

ex.en: to riffle the pages of a book
ex.cn: 随意翻动书页

senses.def: an insulting way of referring to people of low social class or people who are not considered socially acceptable
senses.chn: 贱民；不三不四的下等人

senses.def: a gun with a long barrel which you hold to your shoulder to fire
to search quickly through sth in order to find or steal sth

ex.en: She rifled through her clothes for something suitable to wear.
ex.cn: 她急匆匆地在衣服堆里找合适的衣服穿。

senses.def: to steal sth from somewhere

ex.en: His wallet had been rifled.
ex.cn: 他的钱包被偷了。

senses.def: to kick a ball very hard and straight in a game of football (soccer)
a soldier who carries a rifle
a place where people practise shooting with rifles
the distance that a bullet from a rifle will travel
a serious disagreement between people that stops their relationship from continuing

ex.en: The rift within the party deepened.
ex.cn: 党内的分歧加深了。

ex.en: Efforts to heal the rift between the two countries have failed.
ex.cn: 弥合两国间分歧的各种努力都已失败。

senses.def: a large crack or opening in the ground, rocks or clouds
a valley with steep sides formed when two parallel cracks develop in the earth's surface and the land between them sinks
to arrange or influence sth in a dishonest way in order to get the result that you want

ex.en: He said the election had been rigged.
ex.cn: 他说选举被人操纵了。

ex.en: to rig the market (= to cause an artificial rise or fall in prices, in order to make a profit)
ex.cn: 操纵市场

senses.def: to provide a ship or boat with ropes, sails, etc.; to fit the sails, etc. in position
to fit equipment somewhere, sometimes secretly

ex.en: The lights had been rigged (up) but not yet tested.
ex.cn: 灯已经装好了，但还没有经过测试。

ex.en: The car had been rigged with about 300 lbs of explosive.
ex.cn: 有人暗中在车上放了大约 300 磅炸药。

senses.def: to provide sb/sth with a particular kind of clothes or equipment

ex.en: I was accepted for the job and rigged out in a uniform.
ex.cn: 我获得录用从事这份工作，并配发了制服。

senses.def: to make or to build sth quickly, using whatever materials are available
senses.chn: （用现有的材料）匆匆做成，草草搭建

ex.en: We managed to rig up a shelter for the night.
ex.cn: 我们匆匆搭了个棚子过夜。

senses.def: a large piece of equipment that is used for taking oil or gas from the ground or the bottom of the sea

ex.en: an oil rig
ex.cn: 石油钻机

senses.def: the way that the masts and sails on a boat, etc. are arranged
senses.chn: 帆装（船桅和风帆等的安装模式）

senses.def: a large lorry/truck
equipment that is used for a special purpose

ex.en: a CB radio rig
ex.cn: 民用波段无线电设备

senses.def: the ropes that support the masts and sails of a boat or ship
senses.chn: （牵拉船桅和风帆的）绳索，索具

senses.def: the act of influencing sth in a dishonest way in order to get the result that you want

ex.en: vote rigging
ex.cn: 操纵投票

senses.def: morally good or acceptable; correct according to law or a person's duty

ex.en: You were quite right to criticize him.
ex.cn: 你批评他批评得很对。

ex.en: Is it ever right to kill?
ex.cn: 有没有什么情况下，杀人是对的？

ex.en: It seems only right to warn you of the risk.
ex.cn: 似乎应该警告你有风险。

ex.en: I hope we're doing the right thing.
ex.cn: 我希望我们这样做是妥当的。

senses.def: true or correct as a fact

ex.en: Did you get the answer right?
ex.cn: 你回答得正确吗？

ex.en: 'What's the right time?' '10.37.'
ex.cn: “现在的准确时间是几点？” “ 10 点 37 分。”

ex.en: 'David, isn't it?' 'Yes, that's right.'
ex.cn: “是戴维吗？” “对，没错。”

ex.en: It was Monday you went to see Angie, right?
ex.cn: 你是星期一去看望安吉的，对不对？

ex.en: Let me get this right (= understand correctly) —you want us to do an extra ten hours' work for no extra pay?
ex.cn: 让我先搞清楚这一点，你想让我们加班十个小时而不给加班费，是不是？

ex.en: Are the following statements true or false?
ex.cn: 下列说法是对还是错？

senses.def: correct for a particular situation or thing, or for a particular person

ex.en: Have you got the right money (= the exact amount) for the bus fare?
ex.cn: 你有数额刚好的零钱付公交车车费吗？

ex.en: Is this the right way to the beach?
ex.cn: 去海滩是走这条路吗？

ex.en: You're not holding it the right way up.
ex.cn: 你把它拿倒了。

ex.en: Are you sure you've got that on the right way round?
ex.cn: 你能肯定位置放对了吗？

ex.en: Next time we'll get it right.
ex.cn: 下次我们就不会错了。

ex.en: He's the right man for the job.
ex.cn: 他是这份工作的合适人选。

senses.def: correct in your opinion or judgement

ex.en: She was right about Tom having no money.
ex.cn: 她认为汤姆没有钱，她的判断是对的。

ex.en: You're right to be cautious.
ex.cn: 你保持谨慎是应当的。

ex.en: 'It's not easy.' 'Yeah, you're right.'
ex.cn: “这不容易。” “对，你说得没错。”

ex.en: Am I right in thinking we've met before?
ex.cn: 我们以前见过面，我说得对吗？

senses.def: in a normal or good enough condition

ex.en: I don't feel quite right today (= I feel ill/sick).
ex.cn: 我今天感觉不太舒服。

ex.en: That sausage doesn't smell right.
ex.cn: 那香肠闻起来不对劲。

ex.en: Things aren't right between her parents.
ex.cn: 她父母的关系不太正常。

ex.en: If only I could have helped put matters right.
ex.cn: 要是我当时能帮着把错误纠正过来就好了。

ex.en: He's not quite right in the head (= not mentally normal).
ex.cn: 他精神不太正常。

senses.def: of, on or towards the side of the body that is towards the east when a person faces north

ex.en: my right eye
ex.cn: 我的右眼

ex.en: Keep on the right side of the road.
ex.cn: 靠马路的右边行走。

ex.en: Take a right turn at the intersection.
ex.cn: 在十字路口向右拐。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth bad

ex.en: You made a right mess of that!
ex.cn: 你把这件事完全给弄糟了！

ex.en: I felt a right idiot.
ex.cn: 我觉得自己就像个十足的白痴。

senses.def: used to say that sb is willing to give up a lot in order to have or do sth that they really want
senses.chn: 为…情愿舍弃很多；不惜任何代价

ex.en: I'd have given my right arm to have been there with them.
ex.cn: 要是当时能跟他们一起去那儿，我宁愿放弃一切。

senses.def: (not) mentally normal

ex.en: I thought I'd go mad if I stayed any longer.
ex.cn: 我觉得再待久一点我就会发疯。

ex.en: A crazy old woman rented the upstairs room.
ex.cn: 一个疯老太婆租了楼上那个房间。

ex.en: That noise is driving me nuts!
ex.cn: 那噪音吵得我要疯了！

ex.en: You guys are nuts!
ex.cn: 你们这些家伙全疯了！

ex.en: Her mum's completely batty.
ex.cn: 她妈妈完全是疯疯癫癫的。

ex.en: She was out of her mind with grief.
ex.cn: 她悲痛得精神失常了。

senses.def: in excellent health or condition
certainly; in a way that cannot be denied

ex.en: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).
ex.cn: 你肯定听到我说了什么。

senses.def: used to express strong approval or encouragement
senses.chn: （表示明确的赞同或鼓励）完全正确

senses.def: with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position
senses.chn: 正面朝上；位置正确；在正常位置

ex.en: I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.
ex.cn: 我把烤面包掉在地上，但幸好它正面朝上。

senses.def: used to say that everything will be all right, even if there is a problem now
senses.chn: 一切都会好的（即使现在有问题）

senses.def: used to say that there is no doubt about sth
senses.chn: 毫无疑问；一点不错；对极啦

ex.en: 'We need to stick together.' 'Too right!'
ex.cn: “我们得团结一致。” “对极啦！”

ex.en: 'I'll have to do it again.' 'Too right you will.'
ex.cn: “我得再做一次。” “你说得一点不错。”

senses.def: to do exactly the right things to please sb
senses.chn: 做得面面俱到以讨好人

ex.en: a new satirical comedy show that pushes all the right buttons
ex.cn: 一出新的极尽搞笑之能事的讽刺喜剧

senses.def: to start a relationship well/badly

ex.en: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.
ex.cn: 看来我和新老板的关系一开头就不好。

senses.def: to be a sensible person
used to say that sb's intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
senses.chn: 本意是好的；心眼是好的

senses.def: to have found a very good or successful way of living, doing sth, etc.
senses.chn: 找到好的（或成功的）方式；找对路

ex.en: He's certainly got the right idea—retiring at 55.
ex.cn: 他真的想通了，打算在 55 岁时退休。

senses.def: in all directions; everywhere

ex.en: He's giving away money left, right and centre.
ex.cn: 他到处赠款。

senses.def: having the power to do sth gives you the right to do it

ex.en: Their foreign policy is based on the principle that 'might is right'.
ex.cn: 他们的外交政策遵循 “强权即公理” 的原则。

senses.def: the man who would be the right husband for a particular woman

ex.en: I'm not getting married in a hurry—I'm waiting for Mr Right to come along.
ex.cn: 我不想匆忙结婚，我在等如意郎君出现。

senses.def: to do, say or write sth that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
senses.chn: 做（或说、写）得得体／不得体

senses.def: to make sb pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.chn: 讨得某人的欢心；惹得某人恼怒

senses.def: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
senses.chn: 不到／已过 40 岁（或 50 岁等）

senses.def: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way
senses.chn: 思路对头／不对头；做法对路／不对路

senses.def: exactly; directly

ex.en: Lee was standing right behind her.
ex.cn: 李就站在她身后。

ex.en: The wind was right in our faces.
ex.cn: 风迎面吹来。

ex.en: I'm right behind you on this one (= I am supporting you).
ex.cn: 在这件事情上，我完全支持你。

ex.en: The bus came right on time.
ex.cn: 公共汽车正好准时到达。

senses.def: all the way; completely

ex.en: The car spun right off the track.
ex.cn: 汽车完全开出了车道。

ex.en: I'm right out of ideas.
ex.cn: 我完全没了主意。

ex.en: She kept right on swimming until she reached the other side.
ex.cn: 她一直游到对岸。

senses.def: immediately; without delay

ex.en: I'll be right back.
ex.cn: 我马上就回来。

ex.en: I'll be right with you (= I am coming very soon).
ex.cn: 我这就过来。

senses.def: correctly

ex.en: You guessed right.
ex.cn: 你猜着了。

senses.def: in the way that things should happen or are supposed to happen

ex.en: Nothing's going right for me today.
ex.cn: 今天没有哪一件事让我顺心。

ex.en: He did it right.
ex.cn: 他做得对。

ex.en: Did I spell your name right?
ex.cn: 你的名字我拼得对不对？

ex.en: Is your name spelled correctly?
ex.cn: 你的名字拼正确了吗？

ex.en: They are rightly proud of their children.
ex.cn: 他们当然为他们的孩子而骄傲。

ex.en: As you rightly say, we have a serious problem.
ex.cn: 你说得对，我们有严重困难。

senses.def: on or to the right side

ex.en: Turn right at the end of the street.
ex.cn: 在街的那头往右拐。

senses.def: everywhere

ex.en: She owes money right and left.
ex.cn: 她到处欠债。

senses.def: immediately; without delay

ex.en: I want it sent right away.
ex.cn: 马上把它发出去。

ex.en: I told him right off what I thought of him.
ex.cn: 我直截了当地告诉了他我对他的看法。

senses.def: at this moment

ex.en: He's not in the office right now.
ex.cn: 他现在不在办公室。

senses.def: immediately

ex.en: Do it right now!
ex.cn: 这件事马上做！

senses.def: immediately; without delay

ex.en: We both liked each other right off the bat.
ex.cn: 我们俩一见如故。

senses.def: to make sure that sb has all they need or want
senses.chn: 确保（或负责）满足某人的一切需求

ex.en: You needn't worry about money—I'll see you right.
ex.cn: 你不必担心钱的问题，我会给你的。

senses.def: to be very obvious to sb
used to say that sth that has happened to sb is their own fault and they deserve it

ex.en: Left you, did she? It serves you right for being so selfish.
ex.cn: 她离开了你，是吗？那你活该，你太自私了。

senses.def: very suitable for you because it is sth that you know a lot about or are very interested in

ex.en: This job seems right up your street.
ex.cn: 这工作看来对你正合适。

senses.def: to say what sb else was going to say
what is morally good or correct

ex.en: She doesn't understand the difference between right and wrong.
ex.cn: 她不能明辨是非。

ex.en: You did right to tell me about it.
ex.cn: 你把这件事告诉我，做得很对。

ex.en: They both had some right on their side.
ex.cn: 他们双方都有一定的道理。

ex.en: He wouldn't apologize. He knew he was in the right (= had justice on his side).
ex.cn: 他不肯道歉。他知道自己是有理的。

ex.en: It was difficult to establish the rights and wrongs (= the true facts) of the matter.
ex.cn: 很难确定这件事情的真相。

senses.def: a moral or legal claim to have or get sth or to behave in a particular way

ex.en: Everyone has a right to a fair trial.
ex.cn: 每个人都有权获得公正的审判。

ex.en: You have no right to stop me from going in there.
ex.cn: 你无权阻止我进去。

ex.en: What gives you the right to do that?
ex.cn: 你有什么权利这样做？

ex.en: She had every right to be angry.
ex.cn: 她完全有理由生气。

ex.en: You're quite within your rights to ask for your money back.
ex.cn: 你完全有权要回你的钱。

ex.en: By rights (= if justice were done) half the money should be mine.
ex.cn: 按理说，应该有一半的钱归我。

senses.def: the authority to perform, publish, film, etc. a particular work, event, etc.

ex.en: He sold the rights for $2 million.
ex.cn: 他以 200 万美元的价格出售了版权。

ex.en: all rights reserved (= protected or kept for the owners of the book, film/movie, etc.)
ex.cn: 版权所有

senses.def: the right side or direction

ex.en: Take the first street on the right.
ex.cn: 走右手的第一条街。

ex.en: She seated me on her right.
ex.cn: 她让我坐在她的右边。

senses.def: the first, second, etc. road on the right side
senses.chn: 右边的（第一条、第二条等）路

ex.en: Take the first right, then the second left.
ex.cn: 在第一个路口向右拐，然后再在第二个路口向左拐。

senses.def: a turn to the right

ex.en: to make a right
ex.cn: 向右转弯

ex.en: to hang a right
ex.cn: 右拐弯

senses.def: political groups that most strongly support the capitalist system

ex.en: The Right in British politics is represented by the Conservative Party.
ex.cn: 英国政坛的右派是以保守党为代表的。

senses.def: the part of a political party whose members are most conservative

ex.en: He's on the right of the Labour Party.
ex.cn: 他是工党内的右派成员。

senses.def: a blow that is made with your right hand
with definite proof of having committed a crime, so that you cannot claim to be innocent

ex.en: We've got you bang to rights handling stolen property.
ex.cn: 你在销赃时被我们抓了个正着。

senses.def: to treat sb fairly
because of your personal qualifications or efforts, not because of your connection with sb else

ex.en: She sings with a rock band, but she's also a jazz musician in her own right.
ex.cn: 她随一支摇滚乐队演唱，但她本身也是爵士乐手。

senses.def: to correct sb/sth; to put things in their right places or right order
senses.chn: 纠正；改正；收拾；恢复秩序

ex.en: It took me ages to put things to rights after the workmen had left.
ex.cn: 工人们走后，我花了好长时间才收拾好。

senses.def: to talk about how the world could be changed to be a better place
senses.chn: 谈论如何使世界变得更好

ex.en: We stayed up all night, setting the world to rights.
ex.cn: 我们一夜没睡，谈论着如何拯救世界。

senses.def: used to say that if sb does sth bad to you, the situation will not be improved by doing sth bad to them
senses.chn: 冤冤相报永无完了；以牙还牙行不通

senses.def: to return sb/sth/yourself to the normal, vertical position
senses.chn: 使回到正常位置；把…扶正；使…直立

ex.en: They learnt to right a capsized canoe.
ex.cn: 他们学会了将倾覆的独木舟翻过来。

ex.en: At last the plane righted itself and flew on.
ex.cn: 最后，飞机终于恢复了平稳，继续飞行。

senses.def: to correct sth that is wrong or not in its normal state

ex.en: Righting the economy will demand major cuts in expenditure.
ex.cn: 恢复经济需要大量削减开支。

senses.def: to do sth to correct an unfair situation or sth bad that you have done
used to show that you accept a statement or an order

ex.en: 'You may find it hurts a little at first.' 'Right.'
ex.cn: “开始时，你会觉得有点疼。” “噢。”

ex.en: 'Barry's here.' 'Oh, right.'
ex.cn: “巴里在这儿。” “哦，太好了。”

ex.en: 'I'll have a whisky and soda.' ' Right you are, sir.'
ex.cn: “我要一份威士忌加苏打。” “马上就送来，先生。”

senses.def: used to get sb's attention to say that you are ready to do sth, or to tell them to do sth
senses.chn: （引起注意，表示已做好准备或让别人做某事）嗨，喂

ex.en: Right! Let's get going.
ex.cn: 行了！我们走吧。

senses.def: used to check that sb agrees with you or has understood you
senses.chn: （要确保对方同意或明白时说）对不

ex.en: So that's twenty of each sort, right?
ex.cn: 那么，每一种都是二十个，对不对？

ex.en: And I didn't think any more of it, right, but Mum says I should see a doctor.
ex.cn: 我本来不再想这事了，知道吗？可妈妈说我该看医生。

senses.def: used to say that you do not believe sb or that you disagree with them
senses.chn: （表示不相信或不同意）是吗，好哇

ex.en: 'I won't be late tonight.' ' Yeah, right.'
ex.cn: “今天晚上我不会晚的。” “是么，好哇。”

senses.def: everywhere

ex.en: She owes money right and left.
ex.cn: 她到处欠债。

senses.def: an angle of 90°

ex.en: Place the table at right angles/at a right angle to the wall.
ex.cn: 将桌子跟墙垂直摆放。

senses.def: having or consisting of a right angle
a triangle with a right angle
to do sth to correct an unfair situation or sth bad that you have done
the right side of the human brain, that is thought to be used for creating new ideas and to be where emotions come from
senses.chn: （人的）右脑（据信用于构思新思想和主管情感）

senses.def: to choose a particular function or item on a computer screen, etc., by pressing the button on a mouse that is on the right side
certainly; in a way that cannot be denied

ex.en: You heard me right enough (= so don't pretend that you did not).
ex.cn: 你肯定听到我说了什么。

senses.def: morally right and good

ex.en: a righteous God
ex.cn: 公正的上帝

senses.def: that you think is morally acceptable or fair
senses.chn: 正当的；公平合理的；正义的

ex.en: righteous anger/indignation, etc.
ex.cn: 义愤等

senses.def: the part of the field to the right of the batter
senses.chn: 右外场（击球手右边的场地）

senses.def: that is correct, right or legal

ex.en: The stolen car was returned to its rightful owner.
ex.cn: 被盗的汽车还给了其合法的主人。

senses.def: on the right side of sth

ex.en: on the right-hand side of the road
ex.cn: 在路的右边

ex.en: the top right-hand corner of the screen
ex.cn: 屏幕的右上角

senses.def: intended for use by your right hand

ex.en: a right-hand glove
ex.cn: 右手的手套

senses.def: with the driver's seat and steering wheel on the right side
a person who is right-handed uses their right hand for writing, using tools, etc.
a right-handed tool is designed to be used with the right hand
a person who uses their right hand for writing, using tools, etc.
a hit with the right hand
a person who helps sb a lot and who they rely on, especially in an important job

ex.en: the President's right-hand man
ex.cn: 总统的得力助手

senses.def: a title of respect used when talking to or about a person of high social rank, especially a lord
senses.chn: （对上层社会人士，尤指对贵族的尊称）阁下

senses.def: the title of respect used by Members of Parliament in Britain when talking to or about a senior Member of Parliament during a debate
senses.chn: （英国议会成员对资深议员的尊称）阁下

senses.def: a person who supports right-wing political parties and their ideas
for a good reason

ex.en: The school was rightly proud of the excellent exam results.
ex.cn: 学校为这次出色的考试成绩感到骄傲，这是理所当然的。

ex.en: He was proud of his beautiful house, and rightly so.
ex.cn: 他为自己的漂亮房子感到骄傲，这是很自然的。

ex.en: Quite rightly, the environment is of great concern.
ex.cn: 当然，环境问题非常受关注。

senses.def: in a correct or accurate way

ex.en: Rightly or wrongly, many older people are afraid of violence in the streets.
ex.cn: 不管正不正当，反正许多年长者都害怕街头暴力。

ex.en: As she rightly pointed out, the illness can affect adults as well as children.
ex.cn: 她说得对，这种病不仅影响儿童，也会影响成年人。

ex.en: I can't rightly say what happened.
ex.cn: 我说不准到底发生了什么事。

ex.en: I don't rightly know where he's gone.
ex.cn: 我说不好他上哪儿去了。

ex.en: If I remember rightly, there's a train at six o'clock.
ex.cn: 如果我没记错的话，六点钟有一趟火车。

ex.en: He did it right.
ex.cn: 他做得对。

senses.def: having beliefs and opinions that most people approve of
furthest to the right
at this moment

ex.en: He's not in the office right now.
ex.cn: 他现在不在办公室。

senses.def: immediately

ex.en: Do it right now!
ex.cn: 这件事马上做！

senses.def: used to show that you accept a statement or an order
official permission that allows a person to live in a particular country
immediately; without delay

ex.en: We both liked each other right off the bat.
ex.cn: 我们俩一见如故。

senses.def: legal permission to go onto or through another person's land
senses.chn: （进入或穿越他人土地的）通行权

ex.en: Private property—no right of way.
ex.cn: 私有房产，禁止穿行。

senses.def: a public path that goes through private land
the right to drive across or into a road before another vehicle

ex.en: I had right of way at the junction.
ex.cn: 我在这交叉路口有优先通行权。

ex.en: Whose right of way is it?
ex.cn: 这里谁有优先通行权？

senses.def: used to express strong approval or encouragement
senses.chn: （表示明确的赞同或鼓励）完全正确

senses.def: having political opinions or being aware of social issues that are fashionable and left-wing

ex.en: right-on middle-class intellectuals
ex.cn: 左倾的中产阶级知识分子

senses.def: a title of respect used when talking about a bishop (= a senior priest)
with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position
senses.chn: 正面朝上；位置正确；在正常位置

ex.en: I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.
ex.cn: 我把烤面包掉在地上，但幸好它正面朝上。

senses.def: an offer to buy shares in a company at a cheaper price to people who already own some shares in it
senses.chn: 认股权发行，有购股权的证券发行（公司以优惠价格向现有股东发售新股）

senses.def: to change the size of a company in order to reduce costs, especially by reducing the number of employees
senses.chn: （通过裁员等）使公司规模适中，精简公司的规模

senses.def: on or to the right

ex.en: a rightward movement
ex.cn: 向右的移动

senses.def: towards more right-wing political ideas

ex.en: a rightward shift in voting patterns
ex.cn: 选举格局的右倾化转变

senses.def: strongly supporting the capitalist system

ex.en: right-wing policies
ex.cn: 右倾政策

senses.def: a person on the right wing of a political party

ex.en: She is a prominent Tory right-winger.
ex.cn: 她是保守党中赫赫有名的右派。

senses.def: a person who plays on the right side of the field in a sports game
very strict and difficult to change

ex.en: The curriculum was too narrow and too rigid.
ex.cn: 课程设置过于狭窄和死板。

ex.en: His rigid adherence to the rules made him unpopular.
ex.cn: 他对规则的刻板坚持使得他不受欢迎。

senses.def: not willing to change their ideas or behaviour
senses.chn: 固执的；僵化的；一成不变的

ex.en: rigid attitudes
ex.cn: 固执的态度

senses.def: stiff and difficult to move or bend
senses.chn: 坚硬的；不弯曲的；僵直的

ex.en: a rigid support for the tent
ex.cn: 帐篷坚硬的支柱

ex.en: She sat upright, her body rigid with fear.
ex.cn: 她直挺挺地坐着，吓得浑身发僵。

ex.en: I was bored rigid (= extremely bored).
ex.cn: 我觉得无聊极了。

senses.def: a long and complicated process that is annoying and seems unnecessary

ex.en: I couldn't face the whole rigmarole of getting a work permit again.
ex.cn: 我无法再次面对获取工作许可证所需的各种冗长复杂的手续。

senses.def: a long and complicated story
the process by which the body becomes stiff after death
done carefully and with a lot of attention to detail

ex.en: a rigorous analysis
ex.cn: 细致的分析

senses.def: demanding that particular rules, processes, etc. are strictly followed

ex.en: The work failed to meet their rigorous standards.
ex.cn: 工作没有达到他们的严格标准。

senses.def: the fact of being careful and paying great attention to detail

ex.en: academic/intellectual/scientific, etc. rigour
ex.cn: 学术、思想、科学等方面的严谨

senses.def: the fact of being strict or severe

ex.en: This crime must be treated with the full rigour of the law.
ex.cn: 这一罪行必须严格依法审理。

senses.def: the difficulties and unpleasant conditions of sth

ex.en: The plants were unable to withstand the rigours of a harsh winter.
ex.cn: 这些植物经受不住严冬的考验。

senses.def: a set of clothes worn together

ex.en: Where are you going in that rig-out?
ex.cn: 你穿着那身打扮要去哪里？

senses.def: to annoy sb or make them angry

ex.en: Nothing ever seemed to rile him.
ex.cn: 好像从来没有什么事让他烦恼。

senses.def: to be or get very annoyed
to live an enjoyable and comfortable life with no problems or responsibilities
senses.chn: 无忧无虑地生活；安逸地生活；舒适愉快地生活

senses.def: a shallow channel cut by water flowing over rock or soil
the edge of sth in the shape of a circle

ex.en: He looked at them over the rim of his glass.
ex.cn: 他从杯口的上方看着他们。

ex.en: The rims of her eyes were red with crying.
ex.cn: 她的眼眶都哭红了。

ex.en: spectacles with gold rims
ex.cn: 金框眼镜

senses.def: the metal edge of a wheel onto which the tyre is fixed
having a particular type of rim

ex.en: gold-rimmed spectacles
ex.cn: 金框眼镜

ex.en: red-rimmed eyes (= for example, from crying)
ex.cn: 眼眶红红的眼睛

senses.def: to form an edge around sth
frost
having lenses(= the transparent parts that you look through) that are not surrounded by frames
the thick outer layer of some types of fruit

ex.en: lemon rind
ex.cn: 柠檬皮

senses.def: the thick outer skin of some foods such as bacon and some types of cheese
senses.chn: （熏肉和某些干酪等食物的）外皮

senses.def: a piece of jewellery that you wear on your finger, consisting of a round band of gold, silver, etc., sometimes decorated with precious stones

ex.en: a gold ring
ex.cn: 金戒指

ex.en: A diamond glittered on her ring finger (= the finger next to the little finger, especially on the left hand).
ex.cn: 一颗钻石在她的无名指上闪闪发光。

senses.def: an object in the shape of a circle with a large hole in the middle

ex.en: a key ring
ex.cn: 钥匙环

ex.en: curtain rings
ex.cn: 窗帘环

ex.en: onion rings
ex.cn: 洋葱圈

senses.def: a round mark or shape

ex.en: She had dark rings around her eyes from lack of sleep.
ex.cn: 她因为缺觉，眼圈儿都黑了。

ex.en: The children sat on the floor in a ring.
ex.cn: 孩子们围成一圈，坐在地板上。

senses.def: a confined area in which animals or people perform or compete, with seats around the outside for the audience

ex.en: a boxing ring
ex.cn: 拳击场

ex.en: a circus ring
ex.cn: 马戏场

senses.def: a small flat place on a cooker/stove that is heated by gas or electricity and is used for cooking on

ex.en: to turn off the gas ring
ex.cn: 关上煤气灶

senses.def: a group of people who are working together, especially in secret or illegally
senses.chn: （尤指秘密的或非法的）团伙，帮派，集团

ex.en: a spy ring
ex.cn: 间谍网

ex.en: a drugs ring
ex.cn: 贩毒集团

senses.def: to be much better at doing sth than sb else
senses.chn: 做事远比某人好；遥遥领先

senses.def: to announce officially that you are going to compete in an election, a competition, etc.
senses.chn: 正式宣布参加竞选（或比赛等）

senses.def: to surround sb/sth

ex.en: Thousands of demonstrators ringed the building.
ex.cn: 成千上万的示威者包围了大楼。

senses.def: to put a metal ring around a bird's leg so that it can be easily identified in the future
senses.chn: 给…戴上金属环（以便将来辨认）

senses.def: to draw a circle around sth

ex.en: Ring the correct answer in pencil.
ex.cn: 用铅笔圈出正确答案。

senses.def: to telephone sb/sth

ex.en: I'll ring you up later.
ex.cn: 我稍后再给你打电话。

ex.en: He rang up the police station.
ex.cn: 他给警察局打了电话。

ex.en: When is the best time to ring New York?
ex.cn: 什么时间给纽约打电话最好？

ex.en: David rang up while you were out.
ex.cn: 你不在的时候戴维打电话来了。

ex.en: He said he was ringing from London.
ex.cn: 他说他是从伦敦打来的。

ex.en: I'm ringing about your advertisement in the paper.
ex.cn: 我打电话来问一下你们在报纸上登的广告。

senses.def: to make a sound because sb is trying to telephone you

ex.en: Will you answer the telephone if it rings?
ex.cn: 电话铃响时你接一下好吗？

senses.def: if you ring a bell or if a bell rings, it produces a sound

ex.en: Someone was ringing the doorbell.
ex.cn: 有人在按门铃。

ex.en: The church bells rang.
ex.cn: 教堂的钟声响了。

ex.en: Just ring for the nurse (= attract the nurse's attention by ringing a bell) if you need her.
ex.cn: 如果需要护士，按一下铃就行了。

senses.def: to be full of a sound; to fill a place with sound

ex.en: The house rang with children's laughter.
ex.cn: 房子里回响着孩子们的笑声。

ex.en: Applause rang through the hall.
ex.cn: 掌声响彻整个大厅。

senses.def: to be full of a particular quality

ex.en: His words rang with pride.
ex.cn: 他的话充满了骄傲。

senses.def: to be uncomfortable and be unable to hear clearly, usually because you have heard a loud noise, etc.

ex.en: The music was so loud it made my ears ring.
ex.cn: 音乐的声音太大了，震得我的耳朵嗡嗡响。

senses.def: to sound familiar to you, as though you have heard it before

ex.en: His name rings a bell but I can't think where we met.
ex.cn: 他的名字听着很熟，但我想不起我们在哪里见过。

senses.def: to make changes to sth in order to have greater variety

ex.en: Ring the changes with a new colour.
ex.cn: 用一种新的颜色来改变一下。

senses.def: to make you feel that you can still hear sth

ex.en: His warning was still ringing in my ears.
ex.cn: 他的警告依然在我耳边回响。

senses.def: to ring many times

ex.en: The phone has been ringing off the hook with offers of help.
ex.cn: 表示愿意提供援助的电话接连不断。

senses.def: to give the impression of being sincere/true or not sincere/true
senses.chn: 给人以真实（或空洞、虚假）的印象

ex.en: It may seem a strange story but it rings true to me.
ex.cn: 这个故事也许显得离奇，但我却觉得很真实。

senses.def: if you say that alarm bells are ringing, you mean that people are starting to feel worried and suspicious
senses.chn: 警钟敲响；发出危险信号

senses.def: to telephone sb again, for example because they were not there when you called earlier, or to return a call they made to you

ex.en: He isn't here now—could you ring back later?

ex.cn: 煤气价格上涨了。

ex.en: Gas rose in price.
ex.cn: 煤气涨价了。

ex.en: Unemployment rose (by) 3%.
ex.cn: 失业人数增长了 3%。

ex.en: Air pollution has risen above an acceptable level.
ex.cn: 空气污染已经超出了人们可接受的程度。

ex.en: Student numbers in English language schools in this country increased from 66 000 in 2008 to just over 84 000 in 2009.
ex.cn: 这个国家英语语言学校的学生人数从 2008 年的 66 000 增长到 2009 年的 84 000 多一点。

senses.def: to become more successful, important, powerful, etc.
senses.chn: 变得更加成功（或重要、强大等）

ex.en: a rising young politician
ex.cn: 崭露头角的年轻政治家

ex.en: She rose to power in the 70s.
ex.cn: 她于 20 世纪 70 年代掌握了大权。

ex.en: He rose to the rank of general.
ex.cn: 他升至将级军官。

ex.en: She rose through the ranks to become managing director.
ex.cn: 她从普通员工逐步晋升为总经理。

senses.def: if a sound rises, it becomes louder and higher

ex.en: Her voice rose angrily.
ex.cn: 她气得提高了嗓门。

senses.def: if the wind rises, it begins to blow more strongly
if a feeling rises inside you, it begins and gets stronger

ex.en: He felt anger rising inside him.
ex.cn: 他心里直冒火。

ex.en: Her spirits rose (= she felt happier) at the news.
ex.cn: 听到这个消息，她高兴起来。

senses.def: if your colour rises, your face becomes pink or red with embarrassment
if hair rises, it stands vertical instead of lying flat

ex.en: The hair on the back of my neck rose when I heard the scream.
ex.cn: 听到那尖叫声，我不禁毛骨悚然。

senses.def: to begin to fight against your ruler or government or against a foreign army

ex.en: The peasants rose in revolt.
ex.cn: 农民起来造反了。

ex.en: He called on the people to rise up against the invaders.
ex.cn: 他号召民众起来反抗入侵者。

senses.def: to be or become visible above the surroundings

ex.en: Mountains rose in the distance.
ex.cn: 远处山峦叠起。

senses.def: if land rises, it slopes upwards

ex.en: The ground rose steeply all around.
ex.cn: 这块地方四周都是陡坡。

senses.def: a river rises where it begins to flow

ex.en: The Thames rises in the Cotswold hills.
ex.cn: 泰晤士河起源于科茨沃尔德丘陵。

senses.def: when bread, cakes, etc. rise, they swell because of the action of yeast or baking powder
to come to life again

ex.en: to rise from the dead
ex.cn: 复活

ex.en: Can a new party rise from the ashes of the old one?
ex.cn: 在旧政党的灰烬中会诞生出一个新的政党吗？

senses.def: usually used in orders to tell sb to get out of bed and be active
somebody feels so angry about sth that they feel physically sick
to make sb angry
to stand straight and tall in order to show your determination or high status
senses.chn: 昂首挺胸地站立（以示决心或地位高）

senses.def: to not be affected or limited by problems, insults, etc.
senses.chn: 克服（障碍）；超越（限制）；战胜（困难）

ex.en: She had the courage and determination to rise above her physical disability.
ex.cn: 她有战胜自身残疾的勇气和决心。

senses.def: to be wise enough or morally good enough not to do sth wrong or not to think the same as other people

ex.en: I try to rise above prejudice.
ex.cn: 我尽力摆脱偏见。

senses.def: to be of a higher standard than other things of a similar kind

ex.en: His work rarely rises above the mediocre.
ex.cn: 他工作平平，很少有突出的表现。

senses.def: to show that you are able to deal with an unexpected situation, problem, etc.
senses.chn: 能够处理，有能力处理（突发情况、问题等）

ex.en: Luckily, my mother rose to the occasion.
ex.cn: 幸好当时我母亲挺身而出。

ex.en: He was determined to rise to the challenge.
ex.cn: 他决心克服困难迎接挑战。

senses.def: to react when sb is deliberately trying to make you angry or get you interested in sth

ex.en: I refuse to rise to that sort of comment.
ex.cn: 我拒绝对那样的评论作出反应。

ex.en: As soon as I mentioned money he rose to the bait.
ex.cn: 我一提到钱，他就上钩了。

senses.def: to not be affected or limited by problems, insults, etc.
senses.chn: 克服（障碍）；超越（限制）；战胜（困难）

ex.en: She had the courage and determination to rise above her physical disability.
ex.cn: 她有战胜自身残疾的勇气和决心。

senses.def: to be wise enough or morally good enough not to do sth wrong or not to think the same as other people

ex.en: I try to rise above prejudice.
ex.cn: 我尽力摆脱偏见。

senses.def: to be of a higher standard than other things of a similar kind

ex.en: His work rarely rises above the mediocre.
ex.cn: 他工作平平，很少有突出的表现。

senses.def: usually used in orders to tell sb to get out of bed and be active
a person who usually gets out of bed early/late in the morning
the vertical part between two steps in a set of stairs
senses.chn: 立板（楼梯踏步板的竖直部分）

senses.def: to show that you are able to deal with an unexpected situation, problem, etc.
senses.chn: 能够处理，有能力处理（突发情况、问题等）

ex.en: Luckily, my mother rose to the occasion.
ex.cn: 幸好当时我母亲挺身而出。

ex.en: He was determined to rise to the challenge.
ex.cn: 他决心克服困难迎接挑战。

senses.def: to react when sb is deliberately trying to make you angry or get you interested in sth

ex.en: I refuse to rise to that sort of comment.
ex.cn: 我拒绝对那样的评论作出反应。

ex.en: As soon as I mentioned money he rose to the bait.
ex.cn: 我一提到钱，他就上钩了。

senses.def: deserving to be laughed at rather than taken seriously
a situation in which a group of people protest against, and try to get rid of, a government, a leader, etc.
a condition in which water comes up from the ground into the walls of a building, causing damage
senses.chn: 从地下渗入墙壁的潮气

senses.def: the possibility of sth bad happening at some time in the future; a situation that could be dangerous or have a bad result

ex.en: Smoking can increase the risk of developing heart disease.
ex.cn: 吸烟会增加得心脏病的危险。

ex.en: Patients should be made aware of the risks involved with this treatment.
ex.cn: 应该告诉病人这种治疗所涉及的风险。

ex.en: There is still a risk that the whole deal will fall through.
ex.cn: 整桩买卖化为泡影的风险仍然存在。

ex.en: The chemicals pose little risk (= are not dangerous) to human health.
ex.cn: 这些化学制品对人类健康没有什么危害。

ex.en: a calculated risk (= one that you think is small compared with the possible benefits)
ex.cn: 值得承担的风险

ex.en: Any business venture contains an element of risk.
ex.cn: 任何商业投资都包含一定的风险因素。

senses.def: a person or thing that is likely to cause problems or danger at some time in the future
senses.chn: 危险人物；会带来风险的事物

ex.en: The group was considered to be a risk to national security.
ex.cn: 这伙人被认为是威胁国家安全的危险分子。

ex.en: a major health/fire risk
ex.cn: 健康／火灾的一大隐患

senses.def: a person or business that a bank or an insurance company is willing/unwilling to lend money or sell insurance to because they are likely/unlikely to pay back the money etc.
senses.chn: （风险很小／很大的）借款人，保险对象

ex.en: With five previous claims, he's now a bad insurance risk.
ex.cn: 由于已有了五次索赔要求，他现在是一位风险很大的被保险人。

senses.def: in danger of sth unpleasant or harmful happening

ex.en: As with all diseases, certain groups will be more at risk than others.
ex.cn: 所有的疾病都是如此，一些群体比另一些群体更容易受到威胁。

ex.en: If we go to war, innocent lives will be put at risk.
ex.cn: 如果我们发动战争，无辜的生命就会受到威胁。

senses.def: used to introduce sth that may sound stupid or may offend sb
senses.chn: （用以引出可能听上去愚蠢或冒犯人的话）冒着…的风险

ex.en: At the risk of showing my ignorance, how exactly does the Internet work?
ex.cn: 也许我难免显得无知，可互联网到底是怎么运作的呢？

senses.def: with the possibility of harming yourself/sb/sth

ex.en: He dived in to save the dog at considerable risk to his own life.
ex.cn: 他冒着相当大的生命危险跳到水里去救那只狗。

senses.def: to do sth even though you have been warned about the possible dangers and will have to take responsibility for anything bad that happens

ex.en: Persons swimming beyond this point do so at their own risk (= on a notice).
ex.cn: 游泳者越过此界限后果自负。

ex.en: Valuables are left at their owner's risk (= on a notice).
ex.cn: 贵重物品须看管，否则风险自负。

senses.def: to be in a situation in which sth bad could happen to you

ex.en: People who are overweight run a risk of a heart attack or stroke.
ex.cn: 超重的人有犯心脏病和中风的危险。

senses.def: to be or put yourself in a situation in which sth bad could happen to you

ex.en: We don't want to run the risk of losing their business.
ex.cn: 我们不想冒险失去他们的生意。

ex.en: Investment is all about running risks.
ex.cn: 投资就是要冒风险。

senses.def: to do sth even though you know that sth bad could happen as a result

ex.en: That's a risk I'm not prepared to take.
ex.cn: 我不愿意去冒这个险。

ex.en: You have no right to take risks with other people's lives.
ex.cn: 你没有权利拿别人的生命去冒险。

senses.def: to put sth valuable or important in a dangerous situation, in which it could be lost or damaged
senses.chn: 面临危险；使处于危险境地

ex.en: He risked his life to save her.
ex.cn: 他冒着生命危险去救她。

ex.en: She was risking her own and her children's health.
ex.cn: 她在使自己和子女的健康遭受威胁。

ex.en: He risked all his money on a game of cards.
ex.cn: 他冒险把自己所有的钱都押在了一场纸牌游戏上。

senses.def: to do sth that may mean that you get into a situation which is unpleasant or harmful for you

ex.en: There was no choice. If they stayed there, they risked death.
ex.cn: 他们别无选择。如果待在那儿，就面临死亡。

ex.en: They knew they risked being arrested.
ex.cn: 他们知道自己冒着被捕的危险。

senses.def: to do sth that you know is not really a good idea or may not succeed
senses.chn: 冒险做；（明知结果而）大胆做

ex.en: He risked a glance at her furious face.
ex.cn: 他壮着胆子瞅了瞅她那张愤怒的脸。

ex.en: It was a difficult decision but we decided to risk it.
ex.cn: 这件事决心难下，但我们决定冒险一试。

ex.en: We've been advised not to risk travelling in these conditions.
ex.cn: 我们受到忠告，在这种条件下不要冒险出行。

senses.def: to risk being killed or injured in order to do sth

the act of identifying possible risks, calculating how likely they are to happen and estimating what effects they might have, especially in the context of a company taking responsibility for the safety of its employees or members of the public
senses.chn: 风险评估；（尤指公司中涉及员工或公众安全的）危险性评估

ex.en: The employer has an obligation to carry out a risk assessment.
ex.cn: 雇主有义务对危险作出评估。

senses.def: not willing to do sth if it is possible that sth bad could happen as a result

ex.en: We live in a risk-averse culture.
ex.cn: 我们生活在没有冒险精神的文化中。

ex.en: In business you cannot be innovative and risk-averse at the same time.
ex.cn: 经商不可能既要创新又不肯冒险。

senses.def: to risk being killed or injured in order to do sth
the practice of doing things that involve risks in order to achieve sth
involving the possibility of sth bad happening

ex.en: Life as an aid worker can be a risky business (= dangerous).
ex.cn: 救援人员的工作会有危险。

ex.en: a risky investment
ex.cn: 有风险的投资

ex.en: It's far too risky to generalize from one set of results.
ex.cn: 仅根据一组结果进行概括是十分不可靠的。

senses.def: to risk being killed or injured in order to do sth
an Italian dish of rice cooked with vegetables, meat, etc.
a small flat mass or ball of chopped meat that is fried. It is sometimes covered with breadcrumbs or, in the US, with pastry before it is cooked.
a ceremony performed by a particular group of people, often for religious purposes

ex.en: funeral rites
ex.cn: 丧葬仪式

ex.en: initiation rites (= performed when a new member joins a secret society)
ex.cn: （秘密团体的）入会仪式

senses.def: a ceremony or an event that marks an important stage in sb's life
senses.chn: （标志人生重要阶段的）通过仪式，重大事件

senses.def: a series of actions that are always performed in the same way, especially as part of a religious ceremony
senses.chn: 程序；仪规；礼节；（尤指）宗教仪式

ex.en: religious rituals
ex.cn: 宗教仪式

ex.en: She objects to the ritual of organized religion.
ex.cn: 她反对有组织宗教的仪规。

senses.def: something that is done regularly and always in the same way

ex.en: Sunday lunch with the in-laws has become something of a ritual.
ex.cn: 星期天和姻亲们共进午餐已经成了例行的公事。

senses.def: done as part of a ritual or ceremony

ex.en: ritual chanting
ex.cn: 礼仪上的圣咏演唱

senses.def: always done or said in the same way, especially when this is not sincere
senses.chn: 习惯的；老套的；例行公事的

ex.en: ritual expressions of sympathy
ex.cn: 例行公事地表示同情

senses.def: connected with the rituals performed as part of a ceremony

ex.en: a ritualistic act of worship
ex.cn: 崇拜仪式

senses.def: always done or said in the same way, especially when this is not sincere
to do sth in the same way or pattern every time

ex.en: ritualized expressions of grief
ex.cn: 以例行的方式表达悲伤

senses.def: expensive and fashionable
a person, company or thing that competes with another in sport, business, etc.

ex.en: The two teams have always been rivals.
ex.cn: 这两个队一直是竞争对手。

ex.en: The Japanese are our biggest economic rivals.
ex.cn: 日本人是我们最大的经济竞争对手。

ex.en: This latest design has no rivals (= it is easily the best design available).
ex.cn: 这种最新款式独领风骚。

senses.def: competing with another person, company, thing, etc.

ex.en: a rival bid/claim/offer
ex.cn: 竞争投标；对立的权利要求；竞争的出价

ex.en: fighting between rival groups
ex.cn: 对立团体间的争斗

ex.en: He was shot by a member of a rival gang.
ex.cn: 他被敌对团伙的一名成员开枪击中。

senses.def: to be as good, impressive, etc. as sb/sth else

ex.en: You will find scenery to rival anything you can see in the Alps.
ex.cn: 你看到的景色可与你在阿尔卑斯山所看到的景色相媲美。

senses.def: a state in which two people, companies, etc. are competing for the same thing

ex.en: a fierce rivalry for world supremacy
ex.cn: 夺取世界霸权的激烈竞争

ex.en: There is a certain amount of friendly rivalry between the teams.
ex.cn: 两队间有某种程度上的友好较量。

ex.en: political rivalries
ex.cn: 政治对抗

ex.en: sibling rivalry (= between brothers and sisters)
ex.cn: 兄弟姐妹间的较劲

senses.def: divided because of disagreements, especially in a violent way

ex.en: a party riven by internal disputes
ex.cn: 由于内部分歧而四分五裂的政党

senses.def: divided into two or more pieces
a natural flow of water that continues in a long line across land to the sea/ocean

ex.en: the River Thames
ex.cn: 泰晤士河

ex.en: the Hudson River
ex.cn: 哈得孙河

ex.en: on the banks of the river (= the ground at the side of a river)
ex.cn: 在河岸上

ex.en: to travel up/down river (= in the opposite direction to/in the same direction as the way in which the river is flowing)
ex.cn: 逆流而上；顺流而下

ex.en: the mouth of the river (= where it enters the sea/ocean)
ex.cn: 河口

ex.en: Can we swim in the river?
ex.cn: 我们可以下河游泳吗？

senses.def: a large amount of liquid that is flowing in a particular direction

ex.en: Rivers of molten lava flowed down the mountain.
ex.cn: 大量的熔岩顺着山坡流下来。

senses.def: to give poor or unfair treatment to sb you have promised to help
the ground at the side of a river

ex.en: on the riverbank
ex.cn: 在河岸上

senses.def: the area of ground over which a river usually flows

ex.en: a dried-up river bed
ex.cn: 干涸的河床

senses.def: a tropical skin disease caused by a parasite of certain flies that breed in rivers, which can also cause a person to become blind
senses.chn: 盘尾丝虫病，河盲症（由河中繁殖的苍蝇的寄生虫引起的热带皮肤病，可导致失明）

senses.def: an area of land next to a river with buildings, shops/stores, restaurants, etc. on it
on, near, or relating to a river or the banks of a river
senses.chn: 河流（上）的；河流附近的；河岸（上）的

senses.def: the ground along either side of a river

ex.en: a riverside path
ex.cn: 滨河小道

ex.en: a walk by the riverside
ex.cn: 河边漫步

senses.def: a metal pin that is used to fasten two pieces of leather, metal, etc. together
to hold sb's interest or attention so completely that they cannot look away or think of anything else

ex.en: I was absolutely riveted by her story.
ex.cn: 我完全被她的故事吸引住了。

ex.en: My eyes were riveted on the figure lying in the road.
ex.cn: 我眼睛盯着躺在路上的人。

senses.def: to fasten sth with rivets

ex.en: The steel plates were riveted together.
ex.cn: 钢板被固定在一起。

senses.def: to be so shocked or frightened that you cannot move
so interesting or exciting that it holds your attention completely
an area by the sea that is warm and popular for holidays, especially the Mediterranean coast of France
senses.chn: 海滨度假胜地（尤指法国的地中海海滨）

ex.en: the French Riviera
ex.cn: 法国的里维埃拉地区

senses.def: a very small river; a small stream of water or other liquid
(in Britain) Royal Marine
registered nurse
(in Britain) Royal Navy
a chemical present in all living cells; like DNA it is a type of nucleic acid
a small European freshwater fish
senses.chn: 拟鲤（见于欧洲的淡水小鱼）

senses.def: the end part of a cigarette containing marijuana
a hard surface built for vehicles to travel on

ex.en: a main/major/minor road
ex.cn: 公路干线；大路；支路

ex.en: a country/mountain road
ex.cn: 乡村道路；山路

ex.en: They live just along/up/down the road (= further on the same road).
ex.cn: 他们就住在这条路前面不远的地方。

ex.en: The house is on a very busy road.
ex.cn: 房子位于一条交通非常繁忙的公路旁边。

ex.en: He was walking along the road when he was attacked.
ex.cn: 他正在路边散步，突然遭到袭击。

ex.en: It takes about five hours by road (= driving).
ex.cn: 开车大约要花五个小时。

senses.def: used in names of roads, especially in towns
senses.chn: （用于道路名称，尤指城镇的）路

ex.en: 35 York Road
ex.cn: 约克路 35 号

ex.en: a street map of London
ex.cn: 伦敦街道图

ex.en: Oxford Street
ex.cn: 牛津街

ex.en: Mile End Road
ex.cn: 迈尔恩德路

ex.en: the record store in the High Street
ex.cn: 商业大街的唱片商店

ex.en: high street shops
ex.cn: 市镇大街的商店

senses.def: the way to achieving sth

ex.en: to be on the road to recovery
ex.cn: 正在恢复之中

ex.en: We have discussed privatization, but we would prefer not to go down that particular road.
ex.cn: 我们已经讨论了私有化问题，但不想采用这种方法。

senses.def: at some time in the future

ex.en: There are certain to be more job losses further down the road.
ex.cn: 往后肯定会有更多人失业。

senses.def: a last alcoholic drink before you leave a party, etc.
senses.chn: 告辞前喝的最后一杯酒

senses.def: travelling, especially for long distances or periods of time
senses.chn: 在途中；（尤指）长途旅行中

ex.en: The band has been on the road for six months.
ex.cn: 那支乐队巡回演出已有六个月了。

senses.def: in good condition so that it can be legally driven

ex.en: It will cost about £500 to get the car back on the road.
ex.cn: 要花大约 500 英镑才能让车子重新上路。

senses.def: moving from place to place, and having no permanent home

ex.en: Life on the road can be very hard.
ex.cn: 流浪生活会非常艰辛。

senses.def: it is not enough to intend to do good things; you must actually do them
senses.chn: 黄泉路上徒有好意多；光说不练是不够的

senses.def: (to reach) the point at which sth can no longer continue in the same way

ex.en: A defeat in the second round marked the end of the line for last year's champion.
ex.cn: 第二局的失利表明去年的冠军得主已卫冕无望。

senses.def: to start a journey/trip
to put off dealing with a problem
senses.chn: 拖延处理问题；把难题往后推迟

ex.en: This is another attempt to kick the can down the road and leave it to the next generation.
ex.cn: 这又是试图把问题拖延，留给下一代人面对。

senses.def: the point at which sth is tested and you really find out whether it is successful or true
senses.chn: 接受考验的时刻；检验成败的时刻；检验真伪的时刻

ex.en: Here's where the rubber meets the road: will consumers actually buy the product?
ex.cn: 检验成败的时刻到了：消费者真的会购买这种产品吗？

senses.def: to start an activity or a journey

ex.en: Let's get this show on the road!
ex.cn: 咱们这就开始吧！

senses.def: a simple card game in which players try to collect particular combinations of cards
senses.chn: 拉米纸牌游戏（玩者要尽可能找出某种组合的牌）

senses.def: a piece of information, or a story, that people talk about, but that may not be true

ex.en: to start/spread a rumour
ex.cn: 制造／散布谣言

ex.en: There are widespread rumours of job losses.
ex.cn: 到处谣传要裁员。

ex.en: Some malicious rumours are circulating about his past.
ex.cn: 有人别有用心地散布谣言，说他过去如何如何。

ex.en: I heard a rumour that they are getting married.
ex.cn: 我听到传闻，说他们要结婚了。

ex.en: Many of the stories are based on rumour.
ex.cn: 这些说法很多都是道听途说。

ex.en: Rumour has it (= people say) that he was murdered.
ex.cn: 有传言说他被杀害了。

senses.def: to be reported as a rumour and possibly not true

ex.en: It's widely rumoured that she's getting promoted.
ex.cn: 到处都在传要提拔她了。

ex.en: He was rumoured to be involved in the crime.
ex.cn: 有传言说他卷入了这桩罪行。

senses.def: a person who spreads rumours
the round area of flesh at the top of the back legs of an animal that has four legs
a piece of good quality meat cut from the rump of a cow
the part of the body that you sit on
the small or unimportant part of a group or an organization that remains when most of its members have left
senses.chn: （团体或组织的）无足轻重的残留部分

senses.def: to make sth untidy or not smooth and neat

ex.en: She rumpled his hair playfully.
ex.cn: 她顽皮地弄乱他的头发。

ex.en: The bed was rumpled where he had slept.
ex.cn: 床上他睡过的地方有皱痕。

senses.def: a lot of noise that is made especially by people who are complaining about sth

ex.en: to cause a rumpus
ex.cn: 引起骚动

senses.def: a room in a house for playing games in, sometimes in the basement
senses.chn: 娱乐室（有时设在地下室）

senses.def: the physical activity of sex
to move using your legs, going faster than when you walk

ex.en: Can you run as fast as Mike?
ex.cn: 你能和迈克跑得一样快吗？

ex.en: They turned and ran when they saw us coming.
ex.cn: 他们看见我们过来，转身就跑。

ex.en: She came running to meet us.
ex.cn: 她跑着来迎接我们。

ex.en: The dogs ran off as soon as we appeared.
ex.cn: 我们一露面狗就跑了。

ex.en: Run and get your swimsuits, kids.
ex.cn: 孩子们，快去拿你们的泳衣。

ex.en: I ran and knocked on the nearest door.
ex.cn: 我赶紧冲去敲紧邻的门。

senses.def: to travel a particular distance by running

ex.en: Who was the first person to run a mile in under four minutes?
ex.cn: 是谁第一个用了不到四分钟跑完一英里？

senses.def: to run as a sport

ex.en: She used to run when she was at college.
ex.cn: 她上大学的时候经常跑步。

ex.en: I often go running before work.
ex.cn: 我常常在上班前跑步。

senses.def: to take part in a race

ex.en: He will be running in the 100 metres tonight.
ex.cn: 今晚他将参加 100 米赛跑。

ex.en: There are only five horses running in the first race.
ex.cn: 只有五匹马参加第一场比赛。

ex.en: to run the marathon
ex.cn: 参加马拉松比赛

ex.en: Holmes ran a fine race to take the gold medal.
ex.cn: 霍姆斯赛跑表现不错，获得了金牌。

senses.def: to make a race take place

ex.en: The Derby will be run in spite of the bad weather.
ex.cn: 尽管天气恶劣，德比马赛仍将举行。

senses.def: to hurry from one place to another
senses.chn: 迅速赶往；匆忙跑（到另一处）

ex.en: I've spent the whole day running around after the kids.
ex.cn: 我这一整天都跟在孩子们后面跑来跑去。

senses.def: to be in charge of a business, etc.

ex.en: to run a hotel/store/language school
ex.cn: 经营一家旅店／商店／语言学校

ex.en: He has no idea how to run a business.
ex.cn: 他丝毫不懂企业管理。

ex.en: Stop trying to run my life (= organize it) for me.
ex.cn: 别老想操纵我的生活。

ex.en: The shareholders want more say in how the company is run.
ex.cn: 股东们想要在公司的经营管理上拥有更多的发言权。

ex.en: a badly run company
ex.cn: 经营不善的公司

ex.en: state-run industries
ex.cn: 国家经营的行业

senses.def: to make a service, course of study, etc. available to people

ex.en: The college runs summer courses for foreign students.
ex.cn: 这所大学为外国学生开设暑期课程。

senses.def: to own and use a vehicle or machine
senses.chn: 拥有并使用（车辆或机器等）

ex.en: I can't afford to run a car on my salary.
ex.cn: 我的工资养不起汽车。

senses.def: to operate or function; to make sth do this

ex.en: Stan had the chainsaw running.
ex.cn: 斯坦开动了链锯。

ex.en: Her life had always run smoothly before.
ex.cn: 她以前的生活一直很稳定。

ex.en: Our van runs on (= uses) diesel.
ex.cn: 我们的货车用的是柴油。

ex.en: Could you run the engine for a moment?
ex.cn: 你来操作一会儿发动机好吗？

senses.def: to travel on a particular route

ex.en: Buses to Oxford run every half hour.
ex.cn: 到牛津的汽车每半个小时发一趟。

ex.en: All the trains are running late (= are leaving later than planned).
ex.cn: 所有的列车都晚点了。

senses.def: to make buses, trains, etc. travel on a particular route
senses.chn: 使（按某一路线）行驶；使运行

ex.en: They run extra trains during the rush hour.
ex.cn: 他们在交通高峰时段加开了列车。

senses.def: to drive sb to a place in a car

ex.en: Shall I run you home?
ex.cn: 我开车送你回家好吗？

senses.def: to move, especially quickly, in a particular direction

ex.en: The car ran off the road into a ditch.
ex.cn: 汽车猛地开出路面，掉进沟里。

ex.en: A shiver ran down my spine.
ex.cn: 我猛然感到脊背发凉。

ex.en: The sledge ran smoothly over the frozen snow.
ex.cn: 雪橇在冻结的雪面上平稳地滑行。

ex.en: The old tramlines are still there but now no trams run on them.
ex.cn: 昔日的电车轨道还在，现在却没有电车在上面运行了。

senses.def: to move sth in a particular direction

ex.en: She ran her fingers nervously through her hair.
ex.cn: 她紧张地用手指拨弄头发。

ex.en: I ran my eyes over the page.
ex.cn: 我匆匆地看了看这一页。

senses.def: to lead or stretch from one place to another; to make sth do this

ex.en: He had a scar running down his left cheek.
ex.cn: 他左脸上竖着一道伤疤。

ex.en: The road runs parallel to the river.
ex.cn: 这条路和这条河是平行的。

ex.en: We ran a cable from the lights to the stage.
ex.cn: 我们从电灯那里拉了一条电缆通到舞台。

senses.def: to continue for a particular period of time without stopping

ex.en: Her last musical ran for six months on Broadway.
ex.cn: 她上一部音乐剧在百老汇连续上演了六个月。

ex.en: This debate will run and run!
ex.cn: 这场辩论会没完没了地继续下去！

senses.def: to operate or be valid for a particular period of time

ex.en: The permit runs for three months.
ex.cn: 许可证的有效期为三个月。

ex.en: The lease on my house only has a year left to run.
ex.cn: 我房子的租期只剩下一年了。

senses.def: to happen at the time mentioned

ex.en: Programmes are running a few minutes behind schedule this evening.
ex.cn: 今晚播出的节目比预定的时间晚了几分钟。

ex.en: The murderer was given three life sentences, to run concurrently.
ex.cn: 这个杀人犯被判处三项无期徒刑，合并执行。

senses.def: to bring or take sth into a country illegally and secretly
senses.chn: 走私；非法携运；秘密携带

senses.def: to have particular words, contents, etc.

ex.en: Their argument ran something like this…
ex.cn: 他们的论点大致是这样的…

ex.en: 'Ten shot dead by gunmen,' ran the newspaper headline.
ex.cn: 报纸的标题为 “枪手击毙十人”。

senses.def: to flow

ex.en: The tears ran down her cheeks.
ex.cn: 泪水顺着她的脸淌下来。

ex.en: Water was running all over the bathroom floor.
ex.cn: 浴室里水流满地。

senses.def: to make liquid flow

ex.en: She ran hot water into the bucket.
ex.cn: 她把热水注入桶里。

ex.en: to run the hot tap (= to turn it so that water flows from it)
ex.cn: 拧开热水龙头

ex.en: I'll run a bath for you.
ex.cn: 我去给你放洗澡水。

ex.en: I'll run you a bath.
ex.cn: 我去给你放洗澡水。

senses.def: to send out a liquid

ex.en: Who left the tap running?
ex.cn: 谁没关水龙头？

ex.en: Your nose is running (= mucus is flowing from it).
ex.cn: 你流鼻涕了。

ex.en: The smoke makes my eyes run.
ex.cn: 烟熏得我直流眼泪。

senses.def: to be covered with a liquid

ex.en: His face was running with sweat.
ex.cn: 他满脸是汗。

ex.en: The bathroom floor was running with water.
ex.cn: 浴室的地面上全是水。

senses.def: if the colour runs in a piece of clothing when it gets wet, it dissolves and may come out of the clothing into other things
to melt

ex.en: The wax began to run.
ex.cn: 蜡开始熔化了。

senses.def: to become different in a particular way, especially a bad way
senses.chn: 变成，成为，变得（尤指不利的变化）

ex.en: The river ran dry (= stopped flowing) during the drought.
ex.cn: 这条河在干旱期间断流了。

ex.en: Supplies are running low.
ex.cn: 物资供应渐趋不足。

ex.en: We've run short of milk.
ex.cn: 我们牛奶不够了。

ex.en: You've got your rivals running scared.
ex.cn: 你已经使对手感到恐惧了。

senses.def: to be at or near a particular level

ex.en: Inflation was running at 26%.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀达到了 26%。

senses.def: to print and publish an item or a story

ex.en: On advice from their lawyers they decided not to run the story.
ex.cn: 根据他们的律师的建议，他们决定不刊载这篇报道。

senses.def: to do a test/check on sth

ex.en: The doctors decided to run some more tests on the blood samples.
ex.cn: 医生决定对血样再进行一些化验。

senses.def: to be a candidate in an election for a political position, especially in the US

ex.en: Bush ran a second time in 2004.
ex.cn: 2004 年，布什第二次参选。

ex.en: to run for president
ex.cn: 竞选总统

ex.en: to run in the election
ex.cn: 参加竞选

senses.def: if tights or stockings run, a long thin hole appears in them
to be pleased to do what sb wants
senses.chn: 赶紧做某人喜欢的事；急于应某人的要求

ex.en: She knew she had only to call and he would come running.
ex.cn: 她知道只要打个电话，他就会高高兴兴地照办。

senses.def: to run in order to escape from sb/sth
working fully and correctly

ex.en: It will be a lot easier when we have the database up and running.
ex.cn: 等我们把数据库弄好以后，就省事多了。

senses.def: a situation in which sb only just wins or loses, for example in a competition or an election
senses.chn: （比赛或选举等中的）险胜，差距很小的败北

senses.def: to start doing sth and continue very quickly and successfully
senses.chn: 迅速而顺利地投入某事；一炮打响；一举成功

senses.def: to meet sb or find sth by chance
to try to have a romantic or sexual relationship with sb

ex.en: He's always running after younger women.
ex.cn: 他老是追年轻女子。

senses.def: to run to try to catch sb/sth
used in orders to tell sb, especially a child, to go away
to spend a lot of time with sb

ex.en: She's always running around with older men.
ex.cn: 她老是跟年纪较大的男人来往。

senses.def: to run towards sb to attack or as if to attack them

ex.en: He ran at me with a knife.
ex.cn: 他拿着刀朝我冲过来。

senses.def: to leave sb/a place suddenly; to escape from sb/a place

ex.en: He ran away from home at the age of thirteen.
ex.cn: 他十三岁时离家出走。

ex.en: Looking at all the accusing faces, she felt a sudden urge to run away.
ex.cn: 看着一张张脸上那责备的神情，她突然想赶快溜走。

senses.def: to try to avoid sth because you are shy, lack confidence, etc.

ex.en: You can't just run away from the situation.
ex.cn: 这事你不能回避了事。

senses.def: if a feeling runs away with you, it gets out of your control

ex.en: Her imagination tends to run away with her.
ex.cn: 她动辄想入非非。

senses.def: to leave home, your husband, wife, etc. in order to have a relationship with another person

ex.en: She ran away with her boss.
ex.cn: 她与老板私奔了。

ex.en: She and her boss ran away together.
ex.cn: 她和老板一起私奔了。

senses.def: to win sth clearly or easily
to believe sth that is not true
senses.chn: 相信（不真实的东西）；误以为

ex.en: I don't want you to run away with the impression that all I do is have meetings all day.
ex.cn: 我不想让你误以为我整天的工作就是开会。

senses.def: to discuss or consider sth again

ex.en: I'll run back over the procedure once again.
ex.cn: 我将重新考虑这个程序。

senses.def: to show sb sth or tell sb about an idea in order to see their reaction to it
senses.chn: 给某人看，说给某人听（以观察其反应）

senses.def: to lose power or stop working

ex.en: The battery has run down.
ex.cn: 电池没电了。

senses.def: to gradually stop functioning or become smaller in size or number
senses.chn: 逐渐失去作用；萎缩；衰减

ex.en: British manufacturing industry has been running down for years.
ex.cn: 英国的制造业多年来一直在萎缩。

senses.def: to make sth lose power or stop working
senses.chn: 使耗尽能量；使停止工作

ex.en: If you leave your headlights on you'll soon run down the battery.
ex.cn: 如果你让车头灯一直亮着，很快就会把电池耗尽。

senses.def: to make sth gradually stop functioning or become smaller in size or number
senses.chn: 使逐渐失去作用；使萎缩；使衰减

ex.en: The company is running down its sales force.
ex.cn: 公司正在削减销售人员。

senses.def: to hit sb/sth and knock them/it to the ground
to criticize sb/sth in an unkind way
senses.chn: 恶意批评；说…的坏话；贬低

ex.en: He's always running her down in front of other people.
ex.cn: 他总是在别人面前说她的坏话。

senses.def: to find sb/sth after a search
to arrest sb and take them to a police station
(in the past) to prepare the engine of a new car for normal use by driving slowly and carefully

ex.en: Whatever system you choose, it must be run in properly.
ex.cn: 不管你选择什么样的体系，都必须经过适当的磨合。

senses.def: to meet sb by chance

ex.en: Guess who I ran into today!
ex.cn: 猜猜我今天碰见谁了！

senses.def: to enter an area of bad weather while travelling

ex.en: We ran into thick fog on the way home.
ex.cn: 在回家的路上，我们遇上了大雾。

senses.def: to experience difficulties, etc.

ex.en: Be careful not to run into debt.
ex.cn: 小心不要背上债务。

ex.en: to run into danger/trouble/difficulties
ex.cn: 遭遇危险／麻烦／困难

senses.def: to reach a particular level or amount

ex.en: Her income runs into six figures (= is more than £100 000, $100 000, etc.).
ex.cn: 她的收入达到了六位数。

senses.def: to crash into sb/sth

ex.en: The bus went out of control and ran into a line of people.
ex.cn: 公共汽车失控，撞上了一排人。

senses.def: to make a vehicle crash into sb/sth

ex.en: He ran his car into a tree.
ex.cn: 他开车撞上了一棵树。

senses.def: to flow out of a container
to copy sth on a machine

ex.en: Could you run off twenty copies of the agenda?
ex.cn: 你给我复印二十份会议议程好吗？

senses.def: to cause a race to be run

ex.en: The heats of the 200 metres will be run off tomorrow.
ex.cn: 200 米预赛将在明天举行。

senses.def: to make a liquid flow out of a container
to steal sth and take it away

ex.en: The treasurer had run off with the club's funds.
ex.cn: 财务主管盗走了俱乐部的资金。

senses.def: to continue without stopping; to continue longer than is necessary or expected

ex.en: The meeting will finish promptly—I don't want it to run on.
ex.cn: 会议必须按时结束，我不想拖延下去。

senses.def: if your thoughts, a discussion, etc. run on a subject, you think or talk a lot about that subject
if a supply of sth runs out, it is used up or finished

ex.en: Time is running out for the trapped miners.
ex.cn: 被困矿工的时间不多了。

senses.def: if an agreement or a document runs out, it becomes no longer valid
to use up or finish a supply of sth

ex.en: We ran out of fuel.
ex.cn: 我们的燃料用光了。

ex.en: Could I have a cigarette? I seem to have run out.
ex.cn: 给我一支烟可以吗？我的烟好像抽完了。

senses.def: to leave sb that you live with, especially when they need your help
to make a player stop batting by hitting the wicket with the ball before the player has completed his or her run
senses.chn: 将（正在跑的击球员）截杀出局

senses.def: if a container or its contents run over, the contents come over the edge of the container
to knock a person or an animal down and drive over their body or a part of it

ex.en: Two children were run over and killed.
ex.cn: 两名儿童被轧死了。

senses.def: to read through or practise sth quickly

ex.en: She ran over her notes before giving the lecture.
ex.cn: 讲课之前，她翻阅了一下自己的讲稿。

senses.def: to kill sb by sticking a knife, sword, etc. through them
to discuss, repeat or read sth quickly
senses.chn: 匆匆讨论；快速阅读；很快地重复

ex.en: He ran through the names on the list.
ex.cn: 他快速浏览了一下名单。

ex.en: Could we run through your proposals once again?
ex.cn: 我们再简要讨论一下你的建议，好吗？

senses.def: to pass quickly through sth

ex.en: An angry murmur ran through the crowd.
ex.cn: 愤怒的抱怨声在人群中迅速蔓延。

ex.en: Thoughts of revenge kept running through his mind.
ex.cn: 报复的念头不断在他的脑子里闪过。

senses.def: to be present in every part of sth

ex.en: A deep melancholy runs through her poetry.
ex.cn: 她的诗充满了深深的感伤。

senses.def: to perform, act or practise sth

ex.en: Can we run through Scene 3 again, please?
ex.cn: 请大家再来排练一下第 3 场好吗？

senses.def: to use up or spend money carelessly

ex.en: She ran through the entire amount within two years.
ex.cn: 她不到两年就把所有的钱挥霍光了。

senses.def: to be of a particular size or amount
senses.chn: 达到，有（某一规模或数量）

ex.en: The book runs to nearly 800 pages.
ex.cn: 这本书有近 800 页。

senses.def: if you or your money will not run to sth, you do not have enough money for sth

ex.en: Our funds won't run to a trip abroad this year.
ex.cn: 今年我们没有足够的钱去国外旅行。

senses.def: to allow a bill, debt, etc. to reach a large total

ex.en: How had he managed to run up so many debts?
ex.cn: 他怎么欠了这么多债？

senses.def: to make a piece of clothing quickly, especially by sewing

ex.en: to run up a blouse
ex.cn: 赶制一件女式衬衫

senses.def: to raise sth, especially a flag
to experience a difficulty

ex.en: The government is running up against considerable opposition to its tax reforms.
ex.cn: 政府的税务改革遇到了相当大的阻力。

senses.def: to accept or start to use a particular idea or method

ex.en: OK, let's run with Jan's suggestion.
ex.cn: 好，咱们就照简的建议干吧。

senses.def: an act of running; a period of time spent running or the distance that sb runs
senses.chn: 跑；跑步；跑步的时间（或距离）

ex.en: I go for a run every morning.
ex.cn: 我每天早晨都去跑步。

ex.en: a five-mile run
ex.cn: 跑上五英里

ex.en: Catching sight of her he broke into a run (= started running).
ex.cn: 他一看见她就跑了起来。

ex.en: I decided to make a run for it (= to escape by running).
ex.cn: 我决定逃跑。

ex.en: She took the stairs at a run.
ex.cn: 她跑着上了楼梯。

senses.def: a trip by car, plane, boat, etc., especially a short one or one that is made regularly
senses.chn: （尤指短程或定期，乘交通工具的）旅程，航程

ex.en: They took the car out for a run.
ex.cn: 他们开车出去旅行。

senses.def: a period of sth good or bad happening; a series of successes or failures
senses.chn: 一段（幸运或倒霉的）时光；一系列（成功或失败）

ex.en: a run of good/bad luck
ex.cn: 一连串好运／噩运

ex.en: Liverpool lost to Leeds, ending an unbeaten run of 18 games.
ex.cn: 利物浦队输给了利兹队，结束了连续 18 场不败的纪录。

senses.def: a series of performances of a play or film/movie

ex.en: The show had a record-breaking run in the London theatre.
ex.cn: 这出戏在伦敦剧院连续上演，打破了演出纪录。

senses.def: the amount of a product that a company decides to make at one time

ex.en: The first print run of 6 000 copies sold out.

ex.cn: 冠军：凯 · 霍尔。亚军：克里斯 · 普拉茨。

ex.cn: 会议必须按时结束，我不想拖延下去。

ex.cn: 愤怒的抱怨声在人群中迅速蔓延。

ex.cn: 她不到两年就把所有的钱挥霍光了。

ex.cn: 今年我们没有足够的钱去国外旅行。
